Query_Text_en: Six fatalities arose from persons falling , either to a lower deck , or in the sea , the latter including the lifeboat maintenance accident where a conventional lifeboat was undergoing maintenance and fell uncontrolled into the water from normal height , due to failure of the prevention mechanism .
Translation: 六起死亡事故系人员坠落所致，包括坠入下层甲板或海中，后者涉及一起救生艇维护事故，当时常规救生艇正在正常高度进行维护，因防坠装置失效而失控坠入水中。

Query_Text_en: It may be observed that no fatalities have been associated with hydrocarbon releases during this period .
Translation: 在此期间，未发现与碳氢化合物泄漏相关的死亡事件。

Query_Text_en: The last fatality associated with hydrocarbon releases was in 1985 , when one fatality occurred due to an ignited shallow gas blowout .
Translation: 最后一次因碳氢化合物泄漏导致的死亡事件发生于1985年，当时一起浅层气井喷引发的火灾造成一人死亡。

Query_Text_en: The situation is very different in the British sector , due to the Piper Alpha accident in 1988 , with 167 fatalities .
Translation: 在英国海域，由于1988年"派珀·阿尔法"平台爆炸事故造成167人遇难，情况大不相同。

Query_Text_en: This section presents historic FAR levels for occupational accidents [ except helicopter and diving risk ] , averaged for all personnel on board .
Translation: 本节列出了职业事故（不含直升机和潜水风险）的历史FAR水平，数据为船上全体人员的平均值。

Query_Text_en: These values are calculated as averages over the last 10 years [ 1996 - 2005 ] .
Translation: 这些数值是按过去10年的平均值计算得出的（1996年至2005年）。

Query_Text_en: The estimates of FAR levels are presented in Table 3.1 .
Translation: 表3.1列出了FAR水平的估算值。

Query_Text_en: It should be noted that one accident has been excluded for the fixed installations , where three fatalities resulted from a helicopter accident during flare tip replacement .
Translation: 需注意，在固定设施的统计中已排除一起事故，该事故发生在火炬顶端更换期间，由直升机事故导致三人死亡。

Query_Text_en: Diving is therefore not included in any of the values given above .
Translation: 因此，上述各项数值均未包含跳水项目。

Query_Text_en: Except in the case of the helicopter accident in 1997 , the values are limited to occupational accidents , due to the fact that no major accident with fatalities has occurred .
Translation: 除1997年直升机事故外，数据仅涵盖职业事故，因为未发生过导致人员伤亡的重大事故。

Query_Text_en: A true risk picture therefore needs to consider additional ways to estimate risk levels .
Translation: 因此，要描绘真实的风险图景，就需要考虑更多评估风险等级的途径。

Query_Text_en: An important aspect has been to identify possible trends in historic fatality risk levels , in order to identify areas or operations where special efforts may be necessary .
Translation: 一个重要方面是识别历史死亡风险水平的可能趋势，以便确定可能需要付出特别努力的领域或业务。

Query_Text_en: Thus fatalities in the Alexander L. Kielland accident and other major hazard accidents are excluded .
Translation: 因此，亚历山大·L·基尔兰事故及其他重大事故中的死亡人数被排除在外。

Query_Text_en: These trends have been established separately for production installations , mobile drilling units and attendant vessels .
Translation: 这些趋势已分别针对生产设施、移动钻井装置及辅助船舶进行了确立。

Query_Text_en: [ in the case of production , these values are available from PSA . For the other activities , the values are mainly derived from activity levels ] .
Translation: 在生产环节中，这些价值可由PSA提供。对于其他活动，其价值主要根据活动水平确定。

Query_Text_en: FAR values for production and mobile installations are read against the primary vertical axis , and have come down from about 250 over the 40 years .
Translation: 生产设施和移动设施的FAR值以主纵轴为基准进行读取，并在过去40年间从约250下降。

Query_Text_en: For attendant vessels , the values are read against the secondary [ right-hand side ] vertical axis , and the FAR values start around 750 .
Translation: 对于配套船舶，其数值应参照右侧的次级垂直轴，而FAR值则从约750开始。

Query_Text_en: The sharp falls in FAR values took place before 1985 and since then the levels have been much more constant .
Translation: FAR值的急剧下降发生在1985年之前，而自那以后其水平一直保持相对稳定。

Query_Text_en: The next illustration looks more closely at the second half of the period , the last 20 years ; see Figure 3.6 .
Translation: 下一图表对这一时期后半段，即最近20年进行了更深入的分析；参见图3.6。

Query_Text_en: The values include all fatalities that have occurred in the Norwegian sector of the North Sea , and are calculated as rolling ten year average values .
Translation: 这些数值涵盖了挪威北海区块内发生的所有死亡事故，并以滚动十年平均值进行计算。

Query_Text_en: For production installations there is a downward trend over the entire period , although it could be argued that the level was stable until year 2000 .
Translation: 对于生产设施而言，整个期间内呈现下降趋势，尽管有人认为其水平在2000年之前保持稳定。

Query_Text_en: There were no fatal accidents in the years 2003 , 2004 and 2005 , as in the years 1996 - 98 .
Translation: 2003年至2005年间同样没有发生致命事故，与1996年至1998年的情况相同。

Query_Text_en: For mobile drilling units , there is a generally falling trend over the entire period .
Translation: 移动式钻井装置在整个期间呈现总体下降趋势。

Query_Text_en: This has not occurred before .
Translation: 此前从未发生过。

Query_Text_en: The variations are actually the largest for attendant vessels , but it should be noted that as fewer manhors are worked on these vessels one additional fatality will have a larger influence .
Translation: 伴随船只的变动幅度实际上最大，但需注意的是，由于这些船只上的人工作业时间较少，因此每增加一例伤亡都会对结果产生更大的影响。

Query_Text_en: Still , attendant vessels is the group with the highest number of fatalities in the 20 year period , see Section 3.1.3 .
Translation: 不过，在过去20年期间，辅助船只仍是死亡人数最多的类别，详见第3.1.3节。

Query_Text_en: The number of fatalities fell sharply during the second half of the 1980s , then increased for more than 10 years , and has been falling again since year 2000 .
Translation: 20世纪80年代后半期伤亡人数急剧下降，随后上升趋势持续了十余年，自2000年以来又开始持续下降。

Query_Text_en: It should be noted that the attendant vessel owners and the oil companies in the Norwegian sector worked together in 1998 and 1999 to improve the safety aspects of attendant vessels .
Translation: 需指出的是，挪威海域的拖船船东和石油公司于1998年至1999年间携手合作，共同提升伴航船舶的安全性能。

Query_Text_en: It is the first time that no fatalities have occurred in three consecutive years .
Translation: 这是首次实现连续三年未发生人员死亡。

Query_Text_en: There are thus several clear signals that the situation has improved since year 2000 .
Translation: 因此，自2000年以来，形势已出现明显好转的若干迹象。

Query_Text_en: We do not know , but there are indications that we may hope that accidents will be few and rare .
Translation: 我们并不知晓，但有迹象表明，或许可以期待事故将少之又少且罕见。

Query_Text_en: This will also depend on actions taken by all parties involved .
Translation: 这也取决于相关各方所采取的行动。

Query_Text_en: It should be noted that taking the value calculated for the last year of a period , is actually taking the average value for the preceding 10 years , due to the rolling average calculation .
Translation: 需要指出的是，由于采用了移动平均计算方法，取某时间段最后一年的计算值实际上等同于取此前十年的平均值。

Query_Text_en: Taking this average may be too optimistic , where there is a clearly increasing trend .
Translation: 采用这一平均值可能过于乐观，尤其是在存在明显上升趋势的情况下。

Query_Text_en: Where the trend is close to constant , this may be more justifiable as an assumption .
Translation: 当趋势接近恒定时，这一假设作为前提可能更具合理性。

Query_Text_en: The values from these curves are used in the risk potential projection in Section 3.1.7 below , and it becomes important which values to use .
Translation: 这些曲线中的数值被用于下文第3.1.7节的风险潜力预测，因此选择使用哪些数值变得尤为重要。

Query_Text_en: It has been chosen based on the curves shown , to assume constant trends in the future , based upon the average of the last ten years for production and mobile drilling installations .
Translation: 根据所示曲线，选定以过去十年生产及移动式钻井装置的平均值为基础，假设未来趋势保持稳定。

Query_Text_en: Because of the sharply increasing trend for attendant vessels , it is considered more realistic to use an average of the last 5 years rather than 10 years .
Translation: 鉴于服务船舶数量急剧上升的趋势，采用过去5年的平均值而非过去10年的平均值被认为更具现实性。

Query_Text_en: This equates to a FAR value of 39.4 per 100 million manhors , which is distinctly over the values shown in the diagram .
Translation: 这相当于每1亿人小时的FAR值为39.4，明显高于图表中所示数值。

Query_Text_en: Helicopter risk is considered separately , as it is an activity that involves virtually all personnel engaged in offshore oil and gas activities and has a relatively high risk level .
Translation: 直升机风险需单独考虑，因其涉及几乎所有从事海上油气活动的人员且风险等级相对较高。

Query_Text_en: Several serious fatal accidents occurred during Norwegian operations in the period 1977 - 80 , whereas in the UK the period 1981 - 86 was a period with a high number of fatalities in helicopter operations .
Translation: 1977年至1980年期间，挪威运营中发生了多起严重致命事故，而英国在1981年至1986年期间直升机运营中的致命事故数量较高。

Query_Text_en: There have been significantly fewer fatal accidents in the period since 1986 .
Translation: 自1986年以来，这一时期的致命事故数量显著减少。

Query_Text_en: The study conducted in 1998 [ Vinnem and Vinnem , 1998 ] divided the accident frequency into separate values for cruising and landing/takeoff .
Translation: 1998年开展的研究[Vinnem和Vinnem, 1998]将事故频率区分为巡航阶段和起降阶段的独立数值。

Query_Text_en: The Helicopter Safety Study was updated in 1999 [ HSS2 , SINTEF , 1999 ] , and the most recent statistics from SINTEF were compiled in a white paper [ NOU , 2002 ] on helicopter safety in 2002 .
Translation: 《直升机安全研究报告》（HSS2，SINTEF，1999）于1999年进行了更新。2002年，挪威技术研究院将最新统计数据编入了题为《直升机安全》的白皮书（NOU, 2002）。

Query_Text_en: The white paper has also proposed the objective to reduce the risk level by 50 % over a 10 year period , compared to the average for the period 1990 - 2000 .
Translation: 白皮书还提出了在十年期间内将风险等级降低50%的目标，与1990至2000年期间的平均水平相比。

Query_Text_en: It is an established fact that improvements were introduced in helicopter operations in the 1980s because of the high number of accidents and thus a reduction in frequency of accidents would be expected .
Translation: 众所周知，20世纪80年代由于事故频发，直升机运营中引入了改进措施，因此预期事故频率会降低。

Query_Text_en: One of the deficiencies of the SINTEF studies is the lack of distinction between fatality risk during cruise and landing/take-off .
Translation: SINTEF研究的缺陷之一是没有区分巡航阶段与起降阶段的致命风险。

Query_Text_en: This is an important distinction especially when shuttling is considered .
Translation: 这一点在涉及来回周旋时尤为重要。

Query_Text_en: It might be argued that taking only the ten year period following the period with the high fatalities gives rise to an over-optimistic estimate .
Translation: 仅选取高死亡率时期之后的十年期进行分析，可能会导致过于乐观的估计。

Query_Text_en: However , it would be impossible to define how much of the earlier period would need to be included to avoid such optimism .
Translation: 然而，无法界定需要纳入多少早期阶段才能避免这种乐观预期。

Query_Text_en: It is also noted that one of the most severe helicopter accidents in the Norwegian sector [ in 1997 ] is included in the period which is considered in order to establish a historic risk level .
Translation: 值得注意的是，1997年挪威海域发生的最严重的直升机事故之一被纳入了用于确定历史风险水平的考察时段。

Query_Text_en: In order to consider what is the most appropriate personnel risk level for helicopter transport , an update of the statistical analysis has been performed .
Translation: 为了确定直升机运输中最合适的人员风险等级，已对统计分析进行了更新。

Query_Text_en: The main focus is on the last 10 years , 1996 - 2005 .
Translation: 重点集中于1996年至2005年的十年期间。

Query_Text_en: The data basis is presented in Table 3.2 and Table 3.3 .
Translation: 数据基础列于表3.2和表3.3中。

Query_Text_en: There have , however , been some near-misses .
Translation: 然而，此前已出现过一些险情。

Query_Text_en: This implies a value which is virtually unchanged from the value stated in NOU [ 2002 ] , which was 1.4 per million person flight hours .
Translation: 这表明该数值与2002年白皮书（NOU [2002]）中所述的1.4（数值单位为每百万飞行小时每人）几乎未发生变化。

Query_Text_en: If the corresponding value is calculated for the period 1987 - 2005 , this becomes 1.35 per million person flight hours .
Translation: 如果在1987年至2005年期间进行计算，这一数值将为每百万飞行小时人次数1.35。

Query_Text_en: The trend during the last 10 years , presented as rolling 10 year average values , is shown in Figure 3.7 .
Translation: 过去10年的趋势以滚动10年平均值的形式呈现，如图3.7所示。

Query_Text_en: It may be observed that there has been limited change during this period .
Translation: 可以注意到，在此期间变化有限。

Query_Text_en: In the NOU white paper , 5 year rolling averages were shown ; these were naturally varying more extensively .
Translation: 在NOU白皮书中显示了五年滚动平均值；这些数值的波动范围自然更为广泛。

Query_Text_en: 2002 : 11 fatalities in one accident , during approach to platform , UK .
Translation: 2002年：一起事故在接近平台时发生于英国，造成11人死亡。

Query_Text_en: It should be noted that we have deliberately chosen the period considered , 1987 - 2005 , in order to avoid inclusion of the accident with the Chinook helicopter in 1986 .
Translation: 需要指出的是，我们特意将研究时段选定为1987年至2005年，以避免纳入1986年支奴干直升机事故。

Query_Text_en: This type of helicopter was taken out of service in North Sea offshore operations shortly after that accident and this accident is unrepresentative of present operations .
Translation: 该型直升机在那次事故后不久便退出了北海离岸作业，而此次事故的情况并不具有代表性，不能反映当前的作业水平。

Query_Text_en: Table 3.4 presents the derivation of fatal accident rates for cruising and landing on installation separately .
Translation: 表3.4分别列出了设施巡航和着陆阶段致命事故率的推导过程。

Query_Text_en: A brief comparison has been made between the average offshore fatality risk level and the most appropriate onshore activity , namely oil refineries .
Translation: 已对海上平均死亡风险水平与最合适的陆上活动——即炼油厂——进行了简要比较。

Query_Text_en: The comparison is based on actual occupational risk during a ten year period , based on Vinnem and Vinnem [ 1998 ] .
Translation: 该比较基于十年期间的实际职业风险，依据Vinnem和Vinnem[1998]的研究。

Query_Text_en: Only the figure for production installations is shown as it is not considered appropriate to compare drilling units and attendant vessels with refinery statistics .
Translation: 仅展示生产设施的数据，由于认为不适宜将钻井平台和辅助船只与炼油厂数据进行比较。

Query_Text_en: All estimates are based on actual working hours , calculated on the basis of 12 hours per day offshore and 7.5 hours per day onshore .
Translation: 所有估算均基于实际工作时长，其中离岸部分按每天12小时计算，在岸部分按每天7.5小时计算。

Query_Text_en: The total number of working hours per year should be about the same per person for both industries .
Translation: 两个行业的人均年工作小时总数应大致相同。

Query_Text_en: Two fatalities and 619 injuries have been reported for refineries in the period 1988 - 97 , and six fatalities and 5,855 injuries on offshore production installations .
Translation: 在1988年至1997年间，炼油厂报告了2人死亡和619人受伤，海上生产设施报告了6人死亡和5855人受伤。

Query_Text_en: It should be noted that the total number of working hours in the ten year period are very different in the two activities , 32.2 vs 215.5 million hours , respectively for refineries and offshore production installations .
Translation: 需要指出的是，在十年期间，两项活动的总工时差异显著，分别为炼油厂的3220万小时和海上生产设施的21550万小时。

Query_Text_en: It should also be noted that the relevant authorities reckon that only about a third of all injuries are actually reported for onshore industries , whereas the underreporting of injuries is considered to be very small offshore .
Translation: 值得注意的是，有关部门认为陆上行业实际报告的工伤事故仅占三分之一左右，而海上行业的工伤漏报情况则被认为非常少。

Query_Text_en: This is the reason why injury frequencies have not been compared in Figure 3.8 .
Translation: 这就是图3.8中未对伤害发生率进行比较的原因。

Query_Text_en: This should , over time , give improved possibilities for comparison statistically .
Translation: 这将随时间推移逐步提升统计比较的可能性。

Query_Text_en: Figure 3.8 shows that the average FAR value in refineries is a factor of 1.5 or 4.9 higher than the average FAR value on offshore production installations , depending on which period is considered for offshore FAR values .
Translation: 图3.8显示，炼油厂的平均FAR值比海上生产设施的平均FAR值高出1.5倍或4.9倍，具体取决于所采用的海上设施FAR值时间段。

Query_Text_en: The difference is clearly visible in the diagram , but not significant in a statistical sense , due to the [ fortunately ] low number of fatal accidents .
Translation: 图表中差异明显可见，但由于致命事故数量较低（幸运的是），在统计学意义上并不显著。

Query_Text_en: It is considered that offshore production installations and refineries generally are quite similar with respect to occupational hazards .
Translation: 通常认为，海上生产设施和炼油厂在职业危害方面具有较高相似性。

Query_Text_en: If anything , workers on off-shore installations should be more exposed to falls , because generally refineries are more spread out at ground level , while offshore installations have modules stacked on top of each other and several deck levels .
Translation: 事实上，海上平台作业人员面临的坠落风险可能更高，因为陆上炼油厂的设施通常较为分散且布局在地面，而海上平台的模块呈层叠堆放结构且存在多层甲板层级。

Query_Text_en: Thus , the results tend to suggest that safety management is more effective offshore than onshore in similar industries .
Translation: 因此，研究结果表明，在同类行业中，离岸的安全管理往往比在岸更为有效。

Query_Text_en: It could in fact be argued that this flotel accident was related to a mobile unit , rather than a production installation .
Translation: 事实上可以认为，此次漂浮酒店事故与移动装置有关，而非生产设施。

Query_Text_en: In regulatory terms , however , it is regarded as a “ production installation ” as long as it is part of the production operations for a considerable period .
Translation: 但从监管角度来看，只要其属于生产运营且持续较长时间，即被认定为生产设备。

Query_Text_en: The risk levels presented above therefore underpredict the average number of fatalities that are likely to occur , because the contributions from extremely rare but extremely serious accidents are not represented .
Translation: 因此，上述风险等级低估了可能发生的平均死亡人数，因为极罕见但后果极其严重的事故影响未被纳入考量。

Query_Text_en: The Norwegian Risk Level Report [ Vinnem and Vinnem , 1998 ] has therefore considered contributions from major hazards in addition to fatalities due to occupational accidents in the future , as one way to illustrate the risk potential .
Translation: 因此，挪威风险等级报告（Vinnem和Vinnem，1998）在评估未来风险潜力时，除了考虑职业事故导致的死亡外，还将重大危险源的影响纳入考量，以此作为展示风险潜力的一种方式。

Query_Text_en: Figure 3.9 presents a summary of the estimated future fatality risk levels for personnel on production installations , mobile drilling units and attendant vessels .
Translation: 图3.9总结了对未来生产设施、移动钻井平台及伴随船只上人员致命风险等级的估算结果。

Query_Text_en: These estimates are based on average FAR values from the period 1988 - 97 , from Vinnem and Vinnem [ 1998 ] .
Translation: 这些估算基于1988年至1997年期间的平均FAR值，数据来源于Vinnem和Vinnem[1998]。

Query_Text_en: The occupational and transportation risk elements are based on previous levels , and the major accident risk is estimated based on generic concept failure frequencies .
Translation: 职业风险要素和运输风险要素基于前序等级，重大事故风险则根据通用概念故障频率进行估算。

Query_Text_en: The values shown in Figure 3.9 are based on total annual offshore exposure , i.e. , 24 hours of exposure per 24 hours of offshore stay .
Translation: 图3.9所示数值基于年度离岸暴露总量，即每离岸停留24小时对应24小时的暴露量。

Query_Text_en: This is required in order that the contributions from the different activities may be added .
Translation: 这是为了能够将各项活动的贡献汇总起来。

Query_Text_en: The values are therefore half the values shown in Section 3.1.3 , which were based upon work time exposure hours only .
Translation: 因此，这些数值仅为第3.1.3节中所列数值的一半，后者仅基于工作时间暴露小时数计算得出。

Query_Text_en: The most extensive differences are related to occupational accidents where the risk level on MODUs is 4.6 times higher than on production installations .
Translation: 最大的差异体现在职业事故方面，其中移动式钻井装置上的风险水平是生产设施的4.6倍。

Query_Text_en: Some of these differences have become somewhat smaller according to the values in Section 3.1.3 .
Translation: 根据第3.1.3节的数值，其中部分差异有所缩小。

Query_Text_en: The FAR value for all shuttle tankers is reported as 5.3 [ fatalities/1008 man-hours ] , corresponding to an annual average of 0.10 fatalities per year , or 1.0 during a ten year period .
Translation: 所有航天飞机油轮的FAR值报告为5.3[每1008人小时死亡人数]，相当于年均0.10人死亡，或十年期间约为1.0。

Query_Text_en: Occupational accidents contribute 45 % of the total FAR value .
Translation: 职业事故占总FAR值的45%。

Query_Text_en: The challenge implied in attempting to express what is the overall risk level from occupational accidents and major hazard risks has also been faced in the RNNS project .
Translation: 在尝试界定职业事故和重大危险源风险的整体风险等级时所面临的挑战，RNNS项目也已遭遇过。

Query_Text_en: The presentation of these indicators has on the other hand emphasis on relative trends and contributions .
Translation: 这些指标的展示则侧重于相对趋势和贡献因素。

Query_Text_en: Figure 3.10 presents a summary where FAR values have been calculated for occupational and helicopter accidents , and major hazards risk has been calculated based on RNNS major hazard indicators .
Translation: 图3.10总结了职业事故和直升机事故的FAR值计算结果，并基于RNNS重大危险源指标对重大危险源风险进行了测算。

Query_Text_en: In 1998 a so-called NORSOK Standard on “ Risk and Emergency Preparedness Analysis ” was issued for the Norwegian offshore industry , the second edition was issued in 2001 [ NORSOK , 2001 ] .
Translation: 1998年，挪威针对海上石油工业发布了所谓的《NORSOK标准》之"风险与应急准备分析"，第二版于2001年发布[NORSOK, 2001]。

Query_Text_en: This standard gave risk acceptance criteria a somewhat different interpretation compared to the previous regulatory definition [ NPD , 1990 ] .
Translation: 与之前的监管定义相比，该标准对风险接受标准作出了不同解读[NPD, 1990]。

Query_Text_en: 1990 regulatory definition : Criteria used to express an acceptable level of risk in the activities .
Translation: 1990年监管定义：用于在相关活动中表达可接受风险水平的标准。

Query_Text_en: NORSOK definition : Criteria that are used to express a risk level that is considered acceptable for the activity in question , limited to the high level expressions of risk .
Translation: NORSOK定义：用于表达某项活动视为可接受的风险水平的标准，仅限于对风险的高层次表述。

Query_Text_en: The main difference is shown in italics above , and relates to the type of risk expressions that risk acceptance criteria shall be related to .
Translation: 如上文斜体所示，主要区别在于风险接受标准所关联的风险表达类型。

Query_Text_en: The wording of the regulations is such that risk acceptance criteria shall be established prior to any type of risk analysis which is conducted .
Translation: 根据规定措辞，必须在开展任何形式的风险分析之前先制定风险接受标准。

Query_Text_en: A second revision of the NORSOK standard was issued in 2001 , and new regulations came into effect from 1 January 2002 .
Translation: 2001年发布了NORSOK标准的第二次修订版，新的规定自2002年1月1日起施行。

Query_Text_en: criteria that are used to express a risk level that is considered tolerable for the activity in question ' .
Translation: 用于界定所涉活动可接受风险水平的标准。

Query_Text_en: The NORSOK text from 2001 was based on an acknowledgement that , in practice , risk acceptance criteria are impossible to formulate and use effectively and logically for many qualitative risk analyses and studies with a limited scope .
Translation: 2001年的NORSOK文本基于一种认识，即在实践中，风险接受标准对于许多定性风险分析以及范围有限的研究而言，无法有效且合乎逻辑地制定和应用。

Query_Text_en: The NOR-SOK definition therefore allowed the use of risk acceptance criteria to be limited to the high level expressions of risk .
Translation: 因此，NOR-SOK定义使得风险接受标准的使用仅限于风险的高层次表述。

Query_Text_en: These expressions are usually related to global risk estimates , which apply to the entire installation .
Translation: 这些表述通常涉及适用于整个设施的整体风险评估。

Query_Text_en: For personnel , these will be values such as PLL , AIR , FAR , group risk , frequency of impairment of safety functions , etc.
Translation: 对于人员相关指标，这些包括人员损失等级（PLL）、年度预期损失（AIR）、故障发生率（FAR）、群体风险以及安全功能失效频率等。

Query_Text_en: Also the requirements stated by PSA and HSE are presented in the following sections .
Translation: 此外，PSA和HSE提出的要求列于以下章节中。

Query_Text_en: The first risk acceptance criteria were implicitly introduced into Norwegian offshore legislation around 1980 , and were extensively used until 2000 .
Translation: 挪威近海立法于20世纪80年代初首次以隐含方式纳入风险可接受标准，并一直广泛运用至2000年。

Query_Text_en: The new regulatory regime which was introduced from 1 January 2002 , referred to risk acceptance criteria as well as the ALARP [ As Low As Reasonably Practicable ] principle .
Translation: 自2002年1月1日实施的新监管制度涉及风险接受标准以及合理可行最低原则（ALARP）。

Query_Text_en: Risk acceptance criteria still continued to be the main instrument for risk acceptance , but since 2004 there has been an increasing focus on the ALARP principle as a supplement or substitution for risk acceptance criteria .
Translation: 风险接受标准一直作为风险接受的主要工具，但自2004年以来，ALARP原则作为其补充或替代方案日益受到关注。

Query_Text_en: The ALARP principle implies that all risk reduction proposals that are well founded should be implemented unless it may be shown that costs and/or other negative effects are in gross disproportion to the benefits .
Translation: ALARP原则表明，所有具有充分依据的风险降低建议均应予实施，除非能够证明其成本及/或其他负面影响与所获效益之间存在严重不成比例的情形。

Query_Text_en: This approach is similar to an ALARP evaluation .
Translation: 这一方法类似于ALARP评估。

Query_Text_en: The authors believe that in the very mature Norwegian offshore industry risk acceptance criteria could be removed as a requirement from the regulations .
Translation: 作者认为，在高度成熟的挪威离岸产业领域，风险接受标准可从法规要求中取消。

Query_Text_en: The regulations , however , still have requirements for the formulation and use of risk acceptance criteria .
Translation: 然而，相关规定仍对风险接受标准的制定和使用提出要求。

Query_Text_en: It is therefore important to address the use of such criteria , even if we would prefer them not to be used .
Translation: 因此，即使我们更倾向于不采用这些标准，也需要对其使用进行规范。

Query_Text_en: PSA 's requirements regarding acceptance criteria and their use are presented explicitly in the HES Management regulations [ PSA , 2002b ] .
Translation: PSA关于验收标准及其应用的要求在《HES管理规定》[PSA, 2002b]中已明确规定。

Query_Text_en: The regulations consist of normative requirements and guidelines .
Translation: 该条例由规范性要求和指南构成。

Query_Text_en: Acceptance criteria mean the upper limit of acceptable risk relating to major accidents and risk relating to the environment .
Translation: 可接受标准指重大事故风险及环境风险可接受程度的上限。

Query_Text_en: Major accident means an accident involving several serious personal injuries or deaths or an accident that jeopardises the integrity of the facility .
Translation: 重大事故是指造成多人严重人身伤害或死亡的事故，或危及设施完整的事故。

Query_Text_en: Environmental risk means the risk of pollution , cf. the Framework Regulations Chapter III on principles relating to health , environment and safety .
Translation: 环境风险指污染风险，参见《框架条例》第三章关于健康、环境与安全原则的规定。

Query_Text_en: In order to fulfil the acceptance criteria for major accidents as mentioned in the first paragraph and in the second paragraph literas a and b , the NORSOK Z  013 standard Chapter 4 should be used .
Translation: 为满足第1段及第2段a和b项中所述重大事故的验收标准，应采用NORSOK Z 013标准第四章。

Query_Text_en: When setting acceptance criteria relating to risk as mentioned in the second paragraph litera a , methods of averaging risk should be used to ensure that the acceptance criteria for the personnel as a whole and for exposed groups of personnel complement each other , see also the NORSOK Z  013 standard Appendix A. 2.1.4 .
Translation: 在制定第二段a项所述与风险相关的验收标准时，应采用风险均摊方法，确保对全体人员和接触风险群体的验收标准相互补充，参见NORSOK Z 013标准附录A.2.1.4。

Query_Text_en: Acceptance criteria relating to environmental risk as mentioned in the second paragraph litera c , should be related to the facility and the effect on the individual environmental resources and the eco systems from the activities of the facility .
Translation: 根据第二段第(c)项所述的环境风险验收标准，应与设施及其活动对具体环境资源和生态系统所产生的影响相关。

Query_Text_en: When setting the acceptance criteria , a number of facilities should be considered in context to a large extent .
Translation: 在制定验收标准时，应结合具体背景在很大程度上考虑诸多设施。

Query_Text_en: The level of acceptable risk should be clarified in cooperation with other operators , if there be any , in the area that may be affected by the activities of the facility .
Translation: 在设施运营可能影响的区域内，如有其他相关运营方，应与其合作明确可接受的风险等级。

Query_Text_en: When setting the acceptance criteria , the authorities ' considerations with respect to the environmental basis that have been presented in , inter alia , reports to the Storting and in impact assessments for the area which may be affected by the activities of the facility , should be taken into account .
Translation: 在向斯特林廷提交的报告以及可能受该设施活动影响区域的影响评估中阐述的主管部门关于环境依据的考量意见，应予考虑。

Query_Text_en: By reference to Section 14 , the risk arising from transportation of personnel shall be included .
Translation: 根据第14条，人员运输产生的风险应予包含。

Query_Text_en: They also establish the limitations of risk assessment and its importance in safety management .
Translation: 他们还确立了风险评估的局限性及其在安全管理中的重要性。

Query_Text_en: The criteria used by the UK petroleum industry are mainly those that have been formulated by HSE and are embodied in statutory legislation .
Translation: 英国石油工业所采用的标准主要由HSE制定，并体现在成文立法中。

Query_Text_en: These are introduced briefly below .
Translation: 以下将对相关内容进行简要介绍。

Query_Text_en: The focus in the Safety Case Regulations ( SCR ) [ HSE , 2005c ] is on the ALARP [ As Low As Reasonably Practicable ] principle .
Translation: 《安全案例法规》（SCR）[英国健康与安全执行局（HSE），2005c] 的核心在于"最低合理可行"（ALARP）原则。

Query_Text_en: In this extract , the ALARP principle is directly tied to the safety of persons .
Translation: 在本段中，ALARP原则直接关系到人员安全。

Query_Text_en: However , if we look to the Guidance to the Safety Case Regulations [ HSE , 1992 ] , we will find that the same principle is used in relation to the loss of integrity of the temporary refuge [ Content of Safety Cases : General Guidance , Para 117 ] .
Translation: 查阅健康与安全执行局（HSE）1992年《安全案例法规指南》可以发现，关于临时避难所完整性丧失的情形，同样援引了这一原则（安全案例内容：通用指南 第117段）。

Query_Text_en: These are not conflicting , but it should be pointed out that risk to persons can also be expressed in other ways that are more direct than through impairment of the TR .
Translation: 这两者并不矛盾，但需要指出的是，对人员的风险也可以通过比TR受损更为直接的方式加以表述。

Query_Text_en: As mentioned in Section 1.6.1 , this wording was removed from the regulations , in the 2005 version .
Translation: 如第1.6.1节所述，该表述在2005年版的规章中已被删除。

Query_Text_en: This quote may therefore still be considered appropriate .
Translation: 因此，这一表述仍可被视为恰当。

Query_Text_en: The SCR require that the frequency of loss of integrity of the temporary refuge is less than 10-3 / year .
Translation: SCR要求临时避难所完整性丧失的频率小于每年10⁻³次。

Query_Text_en: This criterion is often regarded as the main criterion for UK installations .
Translation: 这一标准常被视为英国设施的主要标准。

Query_Text_en: It is worthwhile noting that this criterion is not detailed in the SCR although it is mentioned in the HSE Guidance to the regulations .
Translation: 值得注意的是，尽管该标准在HSE的《法规指导文件》中有所提及，但在SCR中并未详细规定。

Query_Text_en: The Schedules detail the content of Safety Cases for fixed and mobile installations , which is further described in the General Guidance on Content of Safety Cases .
Translation: 附录详细规定了固定和移动设施的安全方案内容，其具体内容在《安全方案内容通用指南》中进一步阐述。

Query_Text_en: The TR is part of the arrangements for protecting personnel from “ hazards of explosion , fire , heat , smoke , toxic gas or fumes ” , together with escape routes to and from TR , evacuation means , and facilities for monitoring and controlling the incident .
Translation: TR是保护人员免受爆炸、火灾、高温、烟雾、有毒气体或烟尘等危害的防护措施之一，包括通往TR及从TR撤离的逃生路线、疏散方式以及事故监测与控制设施。

Query_Text_en: The minimum period for which the TR must maintain its integrity in the face of design events [ endurance time ] .
Translation: TR在设计基准事件作用下必须保持其完整性的最短时间[耐受时间]。

Query_Text_en: The quantitative acceptance criterion in the SCR is tied to the TR , but the regulations also require that the operator provides escape ways to the TR , escape from TR , and sufficient evacuation means .
Translation: 《SCR中的定量验收标准与TR相关联，但相关法规还要求运营方须提供通往TR的逃生通道、逃离TR的途径以及足够的疏散手段。》

Query_Text_en: The operator will have to specify criteria for these functions .
Translation: 运营方需要明确这些职能的具体标准。

Query_Text_en: It is interesting to note how closely this can be compared with the Norwegian Main Safety Functions , previously given as shelter area , escape ways and evacuation station .
Translation: 值得注意的是，这一点与挪威核心安全功能的相似性之高令人惊叹，后者此前被列为避难区、逃生通道和疏散站点。

Query_Text_en: This shows clearly the strong parallels between the two different sets of legislation .
Translation: 这清楚地表明了两套不同立法之间的显著相似性。

Query_Text_en: The only quantitative criterion given in the SCR is the maximum allowable frequency for impairment of the TR .
Translation: 在监管审查中规定的唯一定量标准是交易对手风险减值的可接受最高频率。

Query_Text_en: This is in line with the Cullen report [ Cullen , 1990 ] , which stated that the operators themselves should specify other criteria .
Translation: 这与卡伦报告[1990]一致，该报告指出运营方自身应明确其他标准。

Query_Text_en: Because of this , the focus in the initial phases of the Safety Case work was on the performance of the TR and on ensuring compliance with the maximum upper limit impairment frequency .
Translation: 因此，在安全案例工作的初期阶段，重点在于TR的性能以及确保符合最大上限故障频率。

Query_Text_en: Later however , operators have looked at personnel risk more directly , as expressed through expected fatalities , individual fatality risk , or other risk measures .
Translation: 然而，此后，运营方更加直接地审视了人员风险，通过预期伤亡人数、个体伤亡风险或其他风险指标等具体指标。

Query_Text_en: Several operators are clearly favoring the individual fatality risk as a measure of the risk .
Translation: 部分运营商明显倾向于将个体死亡风险作为风险评估的指标。

Query_Text_en: Typically , the risk is calculated by considering a group of personnel , e.g. production operators , and calculating the annual expected fatality risk for the individuals in the group .
Translation: 通常情况下，风险计算是以某类人员群体为研究对象（例如生产操作人员），并计算该群体中个体成员的年度预期死亡风险。

Query_Text_en: This is a very direct measure of risk , but it also has its weaknesses , primarily because it does not address the whole risk picture for an installation .
Translation: 虽然这是一种极为直接的风险衡量指标，但也存在不足之处，主要因为它未能涵盖设施所面临的风险全貌。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , the total expected number of fatalities for the entire platform will be a more useful risk measure .
Translation: 为此，整个平台的预期死亡总数将作为更有用的风险衡量指标。

Query_Text_en: HSE has , in one of the supporting documents , indicated that the average individual risk , arising from major hazards , is 1 · 10 -3 per year , see Table 3.1 .
Translation: HSE在其一份相关文件中指出，由重大危险源引发的平均个人风险为每年1×10⁻³次，具体数据见表3.1。

Query_Text_en: Table 3.5 presents an overview of employee fatality risk for different industries and occupations , extracted from HSE [ 1992 ] .
Translation: 表3.5概述了不同行业和职业的员工死亡风险情况，数据来源于英国健康与安全局（HSE）[1992]的报告。

Query_Text_en: This is based on UK accident statistics , for the period 1986/87 to 1990/91 .
Translation: 这是基于英国1986/87年至1990/91年的事故统计数据。

Query_Text_en: The offshore oil and gas industry is seen to be at an average risk level of 10-3 per person per year .
Translation: 海上油气行业的平均风险水平被评估为每年每千人一次。

Query_Text_en: This is only due to “ major hazards ” and does not include transportation or occupational accidents .
Translation: 这仅归因于"重大隐患"，并不包括交通事故或职业事故。

Query_Text_en: The FAR value corresponding to AIR = 10-3 , with approximately 3200 exposure hours per person per year is 32 .
Translation: 当AIR值为10⁻³且每人每年暴露小时数约为3200时，对应的FAR值为32。

Query_Text_en: This has a very large effect on the calculated risk level .
Translation: 这对标的风险水平测算具有重大影响。

Query_Text_en: The Norwegian statistics show risk levels that are almost one order of magnitude apart , with and without the Alexander L Kielland accident .
Translation: 挪威的统计数据显示，在发生和未发生亚历山大·L·基尔兰事故的情况下，风险水平相差近一个数量级。

Query_Text_en: The NORSOK Risk and Emergency Preparedness Analysis Standard [ NORSOK , 2001 ] requires the formulation of risk acceptance criteria that are efficient to use .
Translation: 挪威石油标准化委员会《风险与应急准备分析标准》[NORSOK, 2001]要求制定高效实用的风险可接受标准。

Query_Text_en: Be independent of concepts i.e. , not favor any particular concept .
Translation: 独立于各种概念，即不偏袒任何特定概念。

Query_Text_en: It is noteworthy that the NORSOK standard does not provide any guidelines on what actual values to choose for risk acceptance criteria in relation to risk for personnel .
Translation: 值得注意的是，NORSOK标准并未就人员风险相关的风险接受准则具体数值选择提供任何指导原则。

Query_Text_en: It would not however , have been surprising if some guidelines had been formulated .
Translation: 不过，如果制定了一些指导原则，这也不会令人感到意外。

Query_Text_en: The situation is different with respect to environmental risk .
Translation: 就环境风险而言，情况有所不同。

Query_Text_en: OLF Guidelines [ OLF , 2001 ] provides guidelines as to how risk acceptance criteria may be developed for the environmental aspects , including some examples .
Translation: OLF指南[OLF,2001]提供了关于如何制定环境方面风险可接受标准的指导原则，并包含一些示例。

Query_Text_en: In relation to the risk to personnel , the NORSOK standard is limited to general requirements regarding the formulation of risk acceptance criteria .
Translation: 在人员风险方面，NORSOK标准仅对风险接受标准的制定提出一般性要求。

Query_Text_en: These requirements are discussed separately below .
Translation: 以下各项要求将在下文中分别进行讨论。

Query_Text_en: Risk acceptance criteria that are simple to use in a decision-making process are often precise and associated with particular features of an installation or an activity .
Translation: 在决策过程中易于使用的风险接受标准通常具有精确性，并与特定设施或活动的特征相关联。

Query_Text_en: Such risk acceptance criteria are suitable for measuring the effect of risk reducing actions and other changes to design or operations .
Translation: 此类风险接受标准适用于衡量降低风险措施及其他设计或运营变更的效果。

Query_Text_en: allow comparison of risk with other activities .
Translation: 可与其他活动的风险进行对比。

Query_Text_en: The communication of the risk acceptance relates to how the criteria are interpreted and understood among all involved parties , such as those that are exposed to the risk , the management of the company , authorities , the public etc.
Translation: 风险接受的沟通涉及各相关方对标准的解释与理解，包括面临风险的各方、公司管理层、监管部门、公众等。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , risk acceptance criteria that are easy to understand may represent an oversimplification if the problem being addressed is very complicated or difficult to understand .
Translation: 另一方面，易于理解的风险接受标准可能过于简单化，如果所处理的问题本身非常复杂或难以理解的话。

Query_Text_en: Risk acceptance criteria that express a societal dimension will often enable comparison with other activities in the society .
Translation: 具有社会维度的风险接受标准通常能够与其他社会活动进行比较。

Query_Text_en: Such risk acceptance criteria are often related to parameters that are associated with the latter stages in the sequence of events [ such as fatalities ] .
Translation: 此类风险接受标准通常与事件序列后期阶段相关的参数有关，例如伤亡。

Query_Text_en: Unambiguity in the present context has the sense that the risk acceptance criteria should be formulated in such a way that unreasonable or unintentional effects do not arise when expressing or evaluating risk levels .
Translation: 在此背景下，明确性意味着制定风险接受标准时应确保在表述或评估风险等级时不会产生不合理或非预期的影响。

Query_Text_en: alternative ways of averaging the risk .
Translation: 风险分摊的替代方式

Query_Text_en: Another possible problem is that different risk acceptance criteria may be aimed at the same type of risk [ for example risk to personnel expressed by means of FAR versus impairment risk for main safety functions ] .
Translation: 另一个潜在问题是可能存在针对同一类型风险的不同风险接受标准（例如通过FAR表示的人员风险与主要安全功能的失效风险）。

Query_Text_en: In this event different ranking of risk may occur for alternative solutions when considering the different risk acceptance criteria .
Translation: 在这种情况下，当考虑不同的风险接受标准时，不同解决方案的风险等级排序可能会出现差异。

Query_Text_en: The discussion below demonstrates some important aspects relating to how Norwegian companies have developed their risk acceptance criteria .
Translation: 下文讨论阐明了挪威企业制定风险接受标准方式的一些重要方面。

Query_Text_en: It must be noted that the values shown are illustrative only , and may vary significantly from one operator to another .
Translation: 需注意，所示数值仅供参考，且不同运营商之间可能存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Risk Matrix .
Translation: 风险矩阵

Query_Text_en: There are two main approaches used by Norwegian oil and gas offshore operators , with respect to use of risk acceptance criteria .
Translation: 挪威油气海上运营商在风险接受标准的使用方面主要采用两种方法。

Query_Text_en: Statoil and some other companies have stipulated FAR = 10 as a risk acceptance limit expressed as an average for the total offshore installation workforce .
Translation: 挪威国家石油公司及其他一些企业将FAR=10规定为风险接受限度，该数值是以所有海上设施作业人员的平均值表示的。

Query_Text_en: The regulations also require a risk acceptance limit for the groups/individuals that are exposed to the highest risk levels .
Translation: 规定还要求，对于面临最高风险等级的群体或个人，必须设定风险承受阈值。

Query_Text_en: Some of the companies have stipulated FAR = 20 as the acceptance limit for the most exposed groups .
Translation: 部分企业将FAR=20规定为最易受影响群体的接受上限。

Query_Text_en: The other main approach used by Norwegian operators is to use AIR = 0.001 per year as a risk acceptance limit .
Translation: 挪威运营商采用的另一种主要方法是将年度风险接受限值设定为每年0.001。

Query_Text_en: Some companies have explicitly stated that this is the risk acceptance limit for the most exposed groups , other companies are less clear about this .
Translation: 部分企业已明确表示这是对风险最高群体的可接受风险阈值，其他企业对此则界定不清。

Query_Text_en: It was shown in Chapter 2 that AIR = 0.001 per year may correspond to a FAR of just above 30 . Accordingly , there is a factor of about 3 between these limits .
Translation: 第二章显示，当AIR为每年0.001时，对应的FAR可能略高于30。因此，这两个临界值之间的差距约为3倍。

Query_Text_en: Whereas FAR = 10 may be considered a realistic , but slightly high limit , AIR = 0.001 per year is a very high and relaxed limit which has no risk reduction potential .
Translation: 相比之下，FAR=10可被视为一个现实但略微偏高的限制，而AIR=每年0.001则是一个非常高且宽松的限制，这一指标没有进一步降低风险的潜力。

Query_Text_en: Even when AIR = 0.001 per year is used as a limit for the most exposed group , it has little risk reduction potential .
Translation: 即使将暴露程度最高群体的年AIR限值设定为0.001，其风险降低效果也十分有限。

Query_Text_en: FAR = 10 is to some extent relaxed for large integrated installations , but quite challenging for a small installation .
Translation: 容积率10的要求对大型综合项目有所放宽，但对小型项目而言颇具挑战性。

Query_Text_en: If the value FAR = 10 was claimed as the risk acceptance limit for the most exposed groups , it would be a challenge for all installations .
Translation: 如果将FAR=10的值认定为最易受影响群体的风险可接受限值，这将对所有设施构成挑战。

Query_Text_en: One company in Norway uses an frequency distribution curve as the acceptance limit .
Translation: 挪威某公司以频率分布曲线作为验收限值。

Query_Text_en: Using Equation 2.16 this corresponds to an average FAR = 5.9 , which signifies that this limit is more challenging than an average FAR = 10 .
Translation: 根据式2.16，这相当于平均FAR为5.9，表明这一阈值比平均FAR为10时更具挑战性。

Query_Text_en: Also the fact that a distribution is used instead of a single value , makes it more challenging to satisfy this limit .
Translation: 使用分布而非单一数值这一事实，使得满足这一限制变得更加困难。

Query_Text_en: The values are adjusted according to the max POB onboard , as follows .
Translation: 数值将根据船上最大人员定额进行调整，具体如下：

Query_Text_en: It is not common to define acceptance limits for PLL , but PLL may be used for decision-making in some circumstances .
Translation: 通常不会为PLL定义接受限度，但在某些情况下，PLL可能被用于决策。

Query_Text_en: PLL is well suited to comparing alternative solutions for the same development objective .
Translation: PLL非常适合用于对同一发展目标的不同解决方案进行比较。

Query_Text_en: The objective will then be to minimize the PLL value .
Translation: 目标将是使PLL值最小化。

Query_Text_en: PLL is relatively easy to understand for non-experts due to its calculation of an absolute level of fatalities .
Translation: 由于其采用对死亡人数的绝对水平进行计算的方式，PLL相对易于非专业人士理解。

Query_Text_en: This has to be observed carefully when comparing with other activities , especially if the number of individuals is different .
Translation: 在与其他活动进行比较时，这一点需要特别注意，尤其是当个体数量不同时。

Query_Text_en: PLL is on the other hand difficult to express in physical terms , as the value is usually below 1.0 .
Translation: 另一方面，PLL的数值通常低于1.0，因此难以用物理量进行表达。

Query_Text_en: Such a value may be illustrated by expressing it as 10 % probability of one fatality , although this is slightly imprecise , because there is also a small probability of more than one fatality .
Translation: 这一数值可通过将其表述为发生一起致命事故的概率为10%来体现，尽管这一表述稍显不准确，因为还存在发生多起致命事故的较小概率。

Query_Text_en: It is usually possible to define the PLL unambiguously .
Translation: 通常可以对PLL进行明确界定。

Query_Text_en: PLL is not well suited for averaging differences between personnel groups etc.
Translation: PLL不适合用于平衡不同人员群体间的差异等。

Query_Text_en: The PLL value will often favor the development concept that has the lowest manning level resulting from a lower number of individuals exposed to risk .
Translation: 由于面临风险的个体数量较少，PLL值往往倾向于支持人员配置水平最低的发展理念。

Query_Text_en: This underlines the fact that one way to reduce societal risk is to limit the number of personnel exposed to risk .
Translation: 这突显了减少社会风险的一个途径是限制暴露于风险中的人员数量。

Query_Text_en: The most recent documentation of how risk acceptance criteria for the environment are derived is found in the OLF MIRA [ OLF , 2001 ] report .
Translation: 关于环境风险接受标准制定方法的最新文件收录于OLF MIRA [OLF, 2001]报告中。

Query_Text_en: Quantitative risk analysis was for a long time used mainly for the design phase and for extensive modifications .
Translation: 长期以来，定量风险分析主要用于设计阶段和重大修改。

Query_Text_en: If the analysis was carried out in the operations phase , it was conducted in a way corresponding to use in the design phase , without reflecting the vast differences between design and operation from a HES [ or strictly speaking major hazard risk ] management point of view .
Translation: 如果在运营阶段开展分析，则其采用的方式与设计阶段相适应，但未能从HES（或严格来说重大危险源风险）管理视角反映出设计与运营阶段之间的显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Several aspects in this connection are discussed in this chapter .
Translation: 本章对与之相关的若干方面进行了探讨。

Query_Text_en: The main use of risk evaluations in the operations phase is for qualitative evaluations , as review and work preparation tools . This is briefly considered .
Translation: 运营阶段的风险评估主要用于作为定性评估的复盘和准备工作工具，此处仅作简要说明。

Query_Text_en: During new developments , study updating will be carried out in several stages during the engineering phases .
Translation: 在新项目推进过程中，研究更新将在工程阶段分阶段实施。

Query_Text_en: The final updating of risk [ and emergency preparedness ] analysis should be carried out towards the end of these phases .
Translation: 应在这些阶段末尾进行风险（和应急准备）分析的最终更新。

Query_Text_en: Emergency preparedness analysis is not the subject of this book , but is included for the sake of completeness .
Translation: 应急准备分析并非本书的核心内容，但出于内容完整性的考虑而被纳入其中。

Query_Text_en: [ Document the results from the emergency preparedness analysis in a suitable way , for all design accidental events and DFU , possible causes , and effects of accidents for use in the operational phase .
Translation: 以适当方式记录应急准备分析结果，针对所有设计基准事故及DFU，包括事故的可能原因及影响，以便在运行阶段使用。

Query_Text_en: Included in this phase are normal operation , inspection , maintenance , and limited modifications .
Translation: 本阶段包括正常运行、检查、维护和有限改进。

Query_Text_en: To ensure that the risk level is monitored according to updated risk analysis databases , tools , methods and experience .
Translation: 确保风险等级监测依据更新后的风险分析数据库、工具、方法及经验进行。

Query_Text_en: Qualitative studies should be carried out when planning and preparing for work tasks that have vital importance for operational safety .
Translation: 在规划和准备对运行安全具有重要意义的工作任务时，应开展定性研究。

Query_Text_en: There are a few formal requirements relating to the use of qualitative studies , such as Safe Job Analysis .
Translation: 在使用定性研究（如安全作业分析）方面存在一些正式要求。

Query_Text_en: It is important that the workforce and other operational personnel are actively involved in the work .
Translation: 确保员工及其他运营人员积极参与工作至关重要。

Query_Text_en: Studies during engineering phases should not be limited to the production installa-tion , but should also cover nearby vessels and installations if they are close enough to be affected by accidental effects .
Translation: 工程阶段的研究不应仅限于生产设施，还应涵盖那些因距离足够近而可能受到事故影响的附近船只及设施。

Query_Text_en: Updating of risk [ and emergency preparedness ] analyses should identify the needs for further risk reducing measures such as emergency preparedness meas-ures , and identify areas for particular attention in the HES management work .
Translation: 风险[和应急准备]分析的更新应识别进一步采取风险缓解措施（例如应急准备措施）的需求，并确定HES管理工作中需要特别关注的领域。

Query_Text_en: QRA studies should also be updated on the basis of experience from near-misses and accidents that have occurred , organisational changes , and changes to regulations .
Translation: 应根据未遂事件和事故积累的经验、组织架构变动以及法规修订等情况，对QRA研究进行更新。

Query_Text_en: The installation and operations in accordance with the development of the activity .
Translation: 安装与运营需与活动发展相适应。

Query_Text_en: Further development of these as assumptions may also be needed .
Translation: 可能还需要对这些假设作进一步完善。

Query_Text_en: Whether the risk associated with planned operations , or new equipment , has been assessed at an earlier stage .
Translation: 是否在早期阶段已对与计划中的操作或新设备相关的风险进行了评估。

Query_Text_en: The data basis used as influenced by new experience , new knowledge or changes in the databases that have been used , including revision of experi-ence data from own operations .
Translation: 所使用的数据基础会受到新的经验、新知识或已使用数据库变更的影响，包括对自身运营经验数据的修订。

Query_Text_en: The methodology used .
Translation: 所采用的方法论。

Query_Text_en: The analysis results in the light of possible changes to the operators ' / owner 's risk acceptance criteria for the installation or operations .
Translation: 根据操作者或所有者对设施或运营风险接受标准可能发生的变更，分析结果如下。

Query_Text_en: The operator/owner should formulate minimum requirements for the frequency of updating of the quantified risk analyses and emergency preparedness analysis unless technical or operational circumstances require more frequent updating .
Translation: 运营方/所有权方应制定定量风险分析和应急准备分析的最低更新频率要求，除非因技术或运营情况需要更频繁更新。

Query_Text_en: The UK Safety Case Regulations [ HSE , 2005c ] have quite rigid requirements for updating safety cases , and thus also the QRA studies .
Translation: 英国健康与安全执行局（HSE，2005c）的《英国安全案例法规》对安全案例的更新提出了相当严格的要求，因此对定量风险评估研究的要求同样严格。

Query_Text_en: It appears that operators otherwise often fail to see the need for updating QRA studies .
Translation: 似乎运营方却常常未能认识到更新QRA研究的必要性。

Query_Text_en: The Guidance to the Safety Case Regulations [ HSE , 2005c ] refers to the ` salami ' principle , by which many minor modifications over time may result in quite substantial overall effects on the risk level .
Translation: 《安全案例法规指南》[HSE, 2005c]提到了"腊肠原则"，即随着时间推移逐步进行的小范围调整可能导致整体风险水平发生显著变化。

Query_Text_en: One of the objectives of the strict requirements of HSE is to ensure that such overall effects are not overlooked .
Translation: HSE严格要求的目标之一是确保这些总体影响不被忽视。

Query_Text_en: One of the important aspects of updating during the operations phase is to reflect specific changes in data relating to relevant equipment , facilities , and operations .
Translation: 运营阶段的更新工作重要方面之一是反映与相关设备、设施及运营情况有关的数据具体变化。

Query_Text_en: This may result in the updated risk level being reduced if operation specific data can be utilised .
Translation: 如果能够运用特定运营数据，经更新的风险等级可能会降低。

Query_Text_en: There is often a tendency to use conservative data and assumptions when studies are performed prior to the operations phase .
Translation: 在运营阶段前进行研究时，往往倾向于使用保守的数据和假设。

Query_Text_en: Updating in the light of operational experience [ see Subsection 2.4.3 ] may therefore give a more representative risk level .
Translation: 因此，根据运营经验进行更新（见2.4.3节）可能会得出更具代表性的风险水平。

Query_Text_en: It should be noted , however , that when such an update is made , the risk level is not reduced in reality , but a less conservative estimate of the risk level is produced .
Translation: 不过需要指出的是，当进行此类更新时，风险等级实际上并未降低，而是生成了一个风险等级的较为不保守的评估结果。

Query_Text_en: The Safety Case Regulations [ HSE , 1992 ] required previously that no longer than three years pass between each time the Safety Cases [ and QRA if relevant ] were updated and resubmitted .
Translation: 安全案例法规（HSE，1992）此前规定，安全案例（如相关则包括QRA）每次更新并重新提交之间的时间间隔不得超过三年。

Query_Text_en: The need to always keep the safety case up to date remains .
Translation: 必须始终确保安全论证的及时更新。

Query_Text_en: The BORA methodology was outlined in Subsection 6.2.6.1 .
Translation: BORA方法论在第6.2.6.1小节中进行了阐述。

Query_Text_en: Some of the case studies conducted in the project were also aimed at this .
Translation: 项目中开展的部分案例研究也旨在实现这一目标。

Query_Text_en: Case studies were planned and conducted as part of the BORA methodology development , in order to explore how effectively the approach could be applied , the availability of sources for assessment of the status of the RIFs , and the type of results that may be achieved through these studies .
Translation: 作为BORA方法论开发的一部分，开展了案例研究工作，旨在探讨该方法的应用效果、评估资源获取状况的可行性，以及通过此类研究可能取得的成果类型。

Query_Text_en: The case studies were conducted for stand-alone production installations in the Norwegian sector , Case study 1 for an old installation with steel jacket support structure , and Case study 2 for a relatively new floating production installation .
Translation: 该案例研究针对挪威海域的独立生产设施开展，案例1涉及采用钢制导管架支撑结构的老旧设施，案例2则聚焦相对较新的浮式生产设施。

Query_Text_en: Scenario D : Release due to external corrosion [ qualitatively ] .
Translation: 情境D：因外部腐蚀引发的释放[定性分析]。

Query_Text_en: Scenario B : Release due failure prior to or during disassembling of HC-system .
Translation: 场景B：在拆卸HC系统前或过程中因故障导致的释放。

Query_Text_en: Case study 1 is presented in detail in Skletetal . Case study 1 was limited to containment barriers , whereas Case study 2 also considered a selection of consequence barriers i.e. , barrier functions intended to limit the consequences of a hydrocarbon leak , if it occurs .
Translation: 案例1在Skletetal中得到了详细阐述。案例1仅涉及遏制屏障，而案例2还纳入了若干后果屏障，即旨在限制烃类泄漏一旦发生后影响的屏障功能。

Query_Text_en: One of the advantages of the BORA approach is that sensitivity studies are easy to carry out to evaluate the effect of potential actions in order to reduce risk .
Translation: BORA方法的优势之一在于，其易于开展敏感性研究以评估潜在行动的影响，从而降低风险。

Query_Text_en: As an illustration of how this is performed , consider Table 15.1 , which summarises some results from sensitivity studies .
Translation: 以表15.1为例，该表汇总了敏感性分析的部分结果，展示了这一方法的具体实施方式。

Query_Text_en: The value for Scenario A , 0.20 , implies that if the probability that a checker will fail to detect a valve in the wrong position when the isolation plan is not used can be reduced by a factor of 10 , then the probability of a leak due to Scenario A will be reduced by a factor of 5 [ or down to 20 % of original value ] , when no other changes to probabilities are made .
Translation: 场景A的值0.20表明，若在未采用隔离方案时，检查员未能发现阀门位置错误的概率可降低一个数量级（即减少到原值的十分之一），且在其他概率参数不变的情况下，因场景A导致泄漏的概率将降低到原值的五分之一（即20%）。

Query_Text_en: The values shown in Table 15.1 are those that have the most extensive effects , for the two scenarios considered in the case study .
Translation: 表15.1中所示的数值是案例研究中所考虑的两种情景下影响范围最广的数值。

Query_Text_en: This arose due to the need to install more equipment on one of the platforms .
Translation: 这源于需要在其中一个平台上安装更多设备。

Query_Text_en: In this work , it was determined that one of the installations , the so-called ` TCP2 ' processing platform , needed to have further segregation of fire areas in order to limit the fire water supply needs .
Translation: 在此项工作中确定，所谓的"TCP2"处理平台需要进一步划分防火区域，以限制消防用水需求。

Query_Text_en: Even so , a new fire water supply was also required .
Translation: 即便如此，新建消防供水系统也是必需的。

Query_Text_en: An increase in the fire water capacity of 46,000 litres/minute , almost double the previous capacity , was found to be necessary for the total Frigg Cental Complex , consisting of the three bridge linked installations , the TCP2 process plat-form , the TP1 riser platform , and the QP quarters platform .
Translation: 经评估认为，需要将整个弗里格中央综合体的消防水量提升至每分钟4.6万升，几乎达到原有容量的两倍。该综合体由三座桥接平台设施构成，包括TCP2处理平台、TP1输油平台以及QP生活区平台。

Query_Text_en: Experience from similar upgrading tasks of old installations in the offshore industry has shown that such improvements often have knock-on effects for other safety systems and functions [ area segregation by means of fire walls may sometimes introduce a ventilation problem ] .
Translation: 海洋石油工业中老旧设施类似升级任务的相关经验表明，此类改进往往会对其他安全系统和功能产生连带影响（通过防火墙进行区域隔离有时可能引发通风问题）。

Query_Text_en: It was therefore decided to evaluate all safety systems on TCP2 in order to decide if any further upgrading was necessary , and to ensure that unwanted negative effects were not generated .
Translation: 因此决定对TCP2的所有安全系统进行评估，以确定是否有必要进行进一步升级，并确保不会产生不必要的负面影响。

Query_Text_en: Several other safety systems and functions were later found to need upgrading , resulting in a need for comparative studies to assess the possibilities for risk reduction .
Translation: 后续发现其他多个安全系统和功能存在升级需求，由此需要开展对比研究以评估风险降低的可能性。

Query_Text_en: Comparative studies were conducted , supported by specialist calculations including explosion simulations and structural fire response .
Translation: 开展了比较研究，得到了包括爆炸模拟和结构火灾响应在内的专业计算支持。

Query_Text_en: Some of the work carried out during these studies is outlined in Vinnem et al. [ 1996b ] .
Translation: 这些研究中开展的部分工作已在Vinnem等[1996b]中进行了概述。

Query_Text_en: The TCP2 platform , which at the time was the main processing platform of the Frigg Central Complex , was designed in the mid-1970s , when offshore safety standards were quite different from today ' s practice .
Translation: TCP2平台是弗里格中央综合体当时的主要处理平台，其设计始于20世纪70年代中期，而那时的海上安全标准与当今行业规范存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Under Norwegian legislation , it has not generally been required to upgrade technical equipment on old instal-lations to comply with present standards .
Translation: 根据挪威法律规定，通常不要求对现有设施的技术设备进行升级改造以符合现行标准。

Query_Text_en: However , in the UK , there is a need for all platforms , irrespective of their age , to comply with the risk based approach to safety by demonstrating through the Safety Case that risks to personnel are ALARP .
Translation: 然而，在英国，所有平台无论使用年限长短，均需通过提交安全案例证明人员安全风险已降至合理可行最低水平，以此符合基于风险的安全管理要求。

Query_Text_en: In Norway , there is a similar requirement to demonstrate that the risk level is acceptable in relation to the company 's risk acceptance criteria .
Translation: 在挪威，也存在类似的要求，即证明其风险水平符合公司的风险可接受标准。

Query_Text_en: To demonstrate that risks are as low as reasonably practicable .
Translation: 证明风险已尽可能降低到合理可行的最低程度。

Query_Text_en: The decision as to what is necessary and what is a sufficient risk reduction was therefore very demanding .
Translation: 因此，确定必要措施与充分风险降低标准的决策极具挑战性。

Query_Text_en: Relatively advanced approaches were therefore required to determine the merit of any risk reducing actions .
Translation: 因此，需要采用较为先进的方法来评估任何降低风险措施的成效。

Query_Text_en: The results from sensitivity studies , as shown in Figure 13.1 , demonstrate the difficulty in decision-making .
Translation: 如图13.1所示，敏感性分析的结果表明了决策的难度。

Query_Text_en: Figure 13.1 showed what the effect on the risk levels would be , if a certain parameter value in the event tree is changed to 50 % of the original value .
Translation: 图13.1展示了若将事件树中的某个参数值调整为原值的50%，其对风险等级的影响会是怎样的。

Query_Text_en: Reduction of the hot work activity by 50 % implies about 18 % reduction of the immediate fatality risk to personnel , and about 32 % reduction of the frequency of significant material damage cases .
Translation: 热工作业量减少50%意味着人员即时死亡风险降低约18%，同时重大财产损失事件的发生频率降低约32%。

Query_Text_en: Only two of the aspects considered have anything above an insignificant effect on the risk levels for personnel , namely reduction in hot work activities and reduction of explosion overpressure .
Translation: 经评估，仅热工作业活动减少和爆炸超压降低两个因素对人员风险等级具有显著影响。

Query_Text_en: In the case of the Frigg installations , the decision on which safety systems to improve became even more difficult , because it was demonstrated in the original Safety Case that the risk level for personnel was quite low [ see Vinnem et al. , 1996b ] , especially when considering the age of the installations .
Translation: 在弗里格设施案例中，决定改进哪些安全系统变得更加困难，因为在最初的《安全方案》中已证明人员风险水平相当低（参见Vinnem等，1996b），尤其是考虑到设施的老旧程度。

Query_Text_en: However , as could be expected for an ageing installation , the risk of damage to the installation resulting in loss of assets was quite a bit higher .
Translation: 然而，正如对老化设施所预期的那样，设施受损进而导致资产损失的风险显著更高。

Query_Text_en: There is often a limit to what can be done in terms of technical upgrading of an existing installation , without running into costs that are difficult to justify .
Translation: 在现有设施的技术升级方面，往往存在一个限制，否则将面临难以合理化的成本。

Query_Text_en: Procedural risk reduction measures can , however , often be implemented at a minimal initial cost , although there is often limited scope regarding what these procedures can achieve .
Translation: 然而，程序性风险防控措施通常可以以极低的初始成本实施，但其实际效果往往存在局限性。

Query_Text_en: This is particularly the case if the procedure is intended to control actions during an emergency .
Translation: 尤其在需要在紧急情况下控制行动时更是如此。

Query_Text_en: One example of such a measure is the required response time to allow initiation of manual blowdown .
Translation: 此类措施的一个例子是规定响应时间，以确保能够启动手动泄放。

Query_Text_en: In the case discussed here there was strong emphasis from the very beginning that suboptimisation of this kind could not be allowed .
Translation: 在本文讨论的案例中，从一开始便始终强调不能容许出现这种次优化情况。

Query_Text_en: The possible negative effects of area segregation on ventilation were avoided by the use of arrangements which had only a minimum effect on ventilation .
Translation: 通过采用对通风影响极小的布局设计，避免了区域隔离可能对通风造成的负面影响。

Query_Text_en: This enabled a reduction in the blowdown times on the old part of TCP2 .
Translation: 这使得TCP2老旧部分的排空次数得以减少。

Query_Text_en: In some cases these were quite long , and not in line with current practice .
Translation: 在某些情况下，这些内容较为冗长，且不符合现行实践。

Query_Text_en: Process studies had shown , however , that the blowdown flow restrictions were associated with valves and piping systems , which would require extensive replacement if blowdown times were to be substantially reduced .
Translation: 然而，工艺研究表明，排泄流量限制与阀门和管道系统有关，若要大幅缩短排泄时间，就需要对这些系统进行大规模更换。

Query_Text_en: This is very expensive on a live platform , and also requires periods of full production shutdown .
Translation: 在实时运行的平台上实施这一操作成本非常高，且需要多次全面停产。

Query_Text_en: Another significant effect of such a blowdown modification would be extensive hot works , in terms of welding and cutting .
Translation: 此类泄放系统改造的另一重大影响将是产生大量热工作业，尤其是在焊接和切割领域。

Query_Text_en: This is in itself one of the main sources of risk , and was an aspect that would cause considerable concern .
Translation: 这本身即为重要的风险来源之一，同时也是会引发重大关切的因素。

Query_Text_en: Quantification of the risk reduction potential was therefore required .
Translation: 因此，对风险降低潜力的量化成为必要。

Query_Text_en: The blowdown times for the process equipment receiving gas and oil from the new satellite fields were , with one minor exception , noted to be in line with current practice i.e. , capable of reducing pressure to below 7 bar [ or half of initial value ] in no more than 15 minutes .
Translation: 接收新卫星油田油气的工艺设备泄压时间，除一个例外情况外，均符合现行规范，即能够在15分钟内将压力降至7巴以下（或初始值的一半）。

Query_Text_en: On a qualitative basis it was noted that blowdown would reduce the duration of a fire and thereby also reduce the likelihood of the fire escalating from the original process segment .
Translation: 从定性分析来看，泄压可缩短火灾持续时间，从而降低火灾从最初工艺段蔓延的可能性。

Query_Text_en: The development of the fire in the first few minutes is therefore virtually unaffected by initiation of blowdown .
Translation: 因此，火灾在最初的几分钟内的发展几乎不受吹扫启动的影响。

Query_Text_en: Reduction of the blowdown time to 15 minutes [ 7 bar ] for all segments where applicable .
Translation: 将所有适用环节的泄压时间缩短至15分钟[7巴]。

Query_Text_en: Reduction of the blowdown time to 7.5 minutes for four segments that , from the QRA , had been determined to be most critical i.e. , with the highest fire frequency .
Translation: 将这四个根据定量风险评估（QRA）确定的最关键区域（即火灾频率最高的区域）的泄放时间缩短至7.5分钟。

Query_Text_en: In this case , other segments retain their original blowdown time .
Translation: 在这种情况下，其他部分仍保持原有的泄压时间。

Query_Text_en: The behavior and duration of the fire resulting from these options was modelled directly in the flow calculations , and was in need of no further attention .
Translation: 由这些方案引发的火灾行为特性及持续时间已在流量计算中直接建模，因此无需进一步关注。

Query_Text_en: It was , however , realized that fairly detailed modelling of escalation from one segment to another would be required in order to enable a realistic reflection of the differences between the cases studied .
Translation: 然而，人们认识到，为了能够真实反映所研究案例之间的差异，需要对从一个阶段向另一个阶段的升级过程进行较为详细的建模。

Query_Text_en: This required further development of the fire escalation model is described below .
Translation: 需要进一步发展的火灾蔓延模型将在下文进行阐述。

Query_Text_en: It should be noted that no further development of escalation due to explosion was considered necessary .
Translation: 需要指出的是，没有必要再继续因爆炸事件导致局势升级。

Query_Text_en: This model assumes , somewhat simplistically and conservatively , that at an overpressure at 0.3 barg or above there will be an immediate rupture of piping which results in escalation .
Translation: 该模型较为简单且保守地假设，当超压达到或超过0.3巴时，管道将发生即时破裂并导致事态升级。

Query_Text_en: This is described in Subsection 6.9.1 .
Translation: 这在第6.9.1款中有详细描述。

Query_Text_en: It was found that the risk to assets was only marginally affected , by reduced blowdown times , with less than 2 % reduction in the frequency of total loss of the platform .
Translation: 研究发现，缩短泄压时间仅使资产风险受到轻微影响，平台完全损失的频率降低了不足2%。

Query_Text_en: These results were somewhat surprising , and some comments are appropriate regarding special aspects of the TCP2 platform which have influenced these results .
Translation: 这些结果略显意外，有必要对TCP2平台的特定特性进行评述，因其对结果产生了影响。

Query_Text_en: It should first of all be noted that the platform mainly has an open layout , with-out clear separation of segments and systems .
Translation: 首先需要指出的是，该平台主要采用开放式架构，板块和系统之间没有明确的划分。

Query_Text_en: This implies that it is quite likely that a fire in one segment will impinge upon small sized piping from another sys-tem resulting in a likely failure in a short time [ about 2 - 5 minutes , see Figure 6.27 ] , irrespective of whether the blowdown is within 7.5 or 15 minutes .
Translation: 这表明，某一区域发生火灾极有可能蔓延至另一系统的 小口径管道，导致短时间内（约2至5分钟，见图6.27）发生故障，无论吹扫时间是否在7.5或15分钟范围内。

Query_Text_en: For blowdown to be effective in controlling escalation of fire , the blowdown times have to be less than 5 minutes .
Translation: 为了有效控制火势升级，泄压排放时间必须短于5分钟。

Query_Text_en: Alternatively , longer blowdown times may be combined with passive fire protection of small bore piping .
Translation: 或者，较长的排放时间可与小口径管道的被动防火保护相结合。

Query_Text_en: In the present case , none of these actions were practical or economical to implement .
Translation: 在目前的情况下，这些措施在实施时既不切实可行，也不经济。

Query_Text_en: It should also be observed that the escalation of accidents is strongly influenced by explosion over-pressure , which actually was most important for escalation on the TCP2 platform .
Translation: 值得注意的是，事故的升级程度受到爆炸超压的显著影响，这一因素实际上对TCP2平台上的事故升级起到了最关键作用。

Query_Text_en: The conclusion of this evaluation was therefore that the costs of the measures to improve the blowdown system were in gross disproportion to the benefits that could be expected .
Translation: 因此，此次评估的结论是，改进排污系统的措施成本与预期收益严重不成比例。

Query_Text_en: This was obvious as far as the risk to personnel was concerned , but when the economic benefits were compared to the costs , it was also shown to be the case for risk to assets .
Translation: 就人员风险而言，这一点显而易见；而在经济收益与成本的比较中，资产风险的情况同样如此。

Query_Text_en: The economic benefits in this regard are the values of reduced accident costs [ resulting from shorter fire duration ] and likewise reduced reconstruction times .
Translation: 在这方面带来的经济效益包括因火灾持续时间缩短而减少的事故成本价值，以及重建时间缩短的效益。

Query_Text_en: For TCP2 it was therefore decided to employ compensating actions and essentially leave the blowdown system in its initial state , apart from a minor replacement of one blowdown valve .
Translation: 对于TCP2，因此决定采取补偿措施，并基本上保持排放系统处于初始状态，仅对其中一个排放阀进行了小范围更换。

Query_Text_en: This clear conclusion was made without consideration of the increased risk from hot work if the work was undertaken .
Translation: 这一明确结论是在未考虑若开展动火作业将增加相关风险的情况下得出的。

Query_Text_en: 7.0 % of frequency of total loss .
Translation: 全部损失的发生频率为7.0%。

Query_Text_en: This implies that if changes to the blowdown system required more than 1000 hours of open flame hot work , then several years would pass before the total accumulated effect was a positive risk reduction .
Translation: 若排放系统变更需要超过1000小时的明火作业，则需经过数年时间，其整体累积效果才会显现为风险降低。

Query_Text_en: The compensating measure chosen was to increase the explosion venting areas by removing a significant amount of the cladded outer walls .
Translation: 所采取的补救措施是通过拆除大量包覆外壁来增加爆炸泄压区面积。

Query_Text_en: Through CFD explosion simulation and ventilation studies this was shown to have good effects for explosion overpressure as well as ventilation rates .
Translation: 通过计算流体动力学（CFD）爆炸模拟和通风研究，该方案在爆炸超压控制及通风率方面均显示出良好的效果。

Query_Text_en: Some of the principles of cost benefit analysis are presented through a case study , which is focused on whether additional passive fire protection should be provided .
Translation: 通过一个围绕是否需要加强被动防火保护措施的案例研究，阐述了成本效益分析的部分原则。

Query_Text_en: It should be emphasised , however , that demonstration of ALARP [ As Low As Reasonably Practicable ] is considerably more extensive than just performing a cost benefit analysis ; see Aven and Vinnem [ 2007 ] .
Translation: 需要强调的是，证明ALARP（尽可能合理可行的最低限度）原则远不止进行成本效益分析；参见Aven和Vinnem（2007）。

Query_Text_en: The periods have not been changed in this edition of the book .
Translation: 本书此版中，相关时期的划分未作改动。

Query_Text_en: The overall field characteristics first need to be defined .
Translation: 总体领域的特征首先需要明确。

Query_Text_en: The oil production profile [ gas production disregarded ] , and assumed oil price curve are shown in Figure 15.1 .
Translation: 如图15.1所示，石油生产曲线（不考虑天然气产量）和假设的油价曲线如下。

Query_Text_en: A plateau production period of four years is followed by a period of steeply declining production , perhaps due to increased water production .
Translation: 四年平台期的生产阶段之后，生产将进入急剧下降阶段，这可能是因为地下水开采量增加所致。

Query_Text_en: Figure 15.2 shows a comparison of the base case production curve with the deferred production curve following a 1 year delay in 2003 .
Translation: 图15.2展示了2003年延迟一年后基准生产曲线与延迟生产曲线的对比。

Query_Text_en: The plateau production level is also extended into 2004 and the production curve in the following years is shifted one year to the right i.e. , the production volume in year 2008 with the delay corresponds to the production in year 2007 without the delay .
Translation: 平台期生产水平延续至2004年，后续年份的生产曲线向右平移一年，即延迟后的2008年产量对应的未延迟情况下的2007年产量。

Query_Text_en: The interest rate used in the calculations is 10 % .
Translation: 在计算中所采用的利率为10%。

Query_Text_en: It should be noted that cost inflation is not included in this illustration .
Translation: 需注意，本示例未包含成本上涨因素。

Query_Text_en: Total : Entire platform
Translation: 总计：全平台

Query_Text_en: The RRM considered is the application of passive fire protection on a selected part of the platform structure considered to be the most critical .
Translation: 所考虑的RRM是在平台结构中被认为最关键的部分应用被动防火保护。

Query_Text_en: Annual cost of inspection : 0.06 MNOK .
Translation: 年度检验费用：0.06百万挪威克朗。

Query_Text_en: There is also a small reduction in the annual PLL .
Translation: 年度PLL也出现了小幅减少。

Query_Text_en: Annual PLL value reduces by : 3.5 10-3 per year .
Translation: 年PLL值减少量为：每年3.5×10⁻³。

Query_Text_en: The second evaluation is to determine if the RRM is according to good design or operational practice .
Translation: 第二次评估旨在确定RRM是否符合良好的设计或操作规范。

Query_Text_en: The costs per averted statistical fatality have to be considered .
Translation: 每避免一起统计性死亡所需的成本必须予以考虑。

Query_Text_en: If the costs are in gross disproportion to the benefits , then this RRM should not be implemented .
Translation: 如果成本与收益严重不成比例，则不应实施该RRM。

Query_Text_en: If there had been an environmental aspect of this RRM , the economical value of the spill should be integrated into the calculation after consideration of the material damage , but before the risk to personnel .
Translation: 如果该风险缓解措施涉及环境方面，则应在考虑物质损害之后、人员风险之前，将泄漏的经济价值纳入计算。

Query_Text_en: Neither insurance , tax savings , nor partner share aspects of cost are included , this may be regarded as a societal consideration .
Translation: 保险、税收优惠或合作伙伴分摊成本方面的因素均未被纳入，这可能被视为一种社会考量。

Query_Text_en: It should be noted that loss of prestige , contract obligations etc. , are not taken into consideration .
Translation: 需注意，声誉损失、合同义务等未被纳入考虑范围。

Query_Text_en: An example may illustrate this .
Translation: 以下例子可以说明这一点。

Query_Text_en: A field may be owned by a partner group of typically four to six companies , where the field operator may have a 30 % ownership [ or less ] in the field .
Translation: 一个油田通常由四至六家公司的合作伙伴集团共同拥有，其中作业者可能持有该油田30%（或更低）的权益。

Query_Text_en: It is not uncommon that the tax on profit in the petroleum sector is quite high , say 60 - 80 % .
Translation: 石油行业的利润税非常高，并不鲜见，例如可达60%至80%。

Query_Text_en: If we use 30 % ownership and 70 % tax , the operator implicitly carries only 9 % of any expenditure [ assuming that he has an annual profit ] .
Translation: 如果采用30%的所有权和70%的税率，运营商实际仅承担9%的支出（假设其每年有盈利）。

Query_Text_en: But if the decision is made not to install a particular risk reduction measure and an accident occurs , which the measure could have eliminated [ or reduced ] , then it is quite likely that the field operator will carry all of the ` blame ' as assessed by the media and public opinion , if the accident occurs .
Translation: 如果决定不采取某项风险防控措施，而事故发生时该措施本可避免或降低事故影响，那么一旦事故发生，现场运营方很可能将承担媒体和公众舆论认定的全部责任。

Query_Text_en: The interest of the field operator will therefore often be best served by the implementation of risk reducing measures .
Translation: 因此，实施风险降低措施往往最符合现场运营商的利益。

Query_Text_en: Another aspect is that the government often is the major loser in the event of accidents due to reduced tax income .
Translation: 另一方面，政府往往是在事故中蒙受重大损失的一方，因为税收收入会因此减少。

Query_Text_en: This is not insured , and is another reason why the consideration of risk reducing measures should be carried out in a societal context without consideration of tax and insurance issues .
Translation: 这未被投保，这也是风险降低措施的制定应在社会背景下进行而不考虑税收和保险问题的另一个原因。

Query_Text_en: Table 15.3 presents the relative changes in production costs for the entire field life , according to the year in which the accident occurs .
Translation: 表15.3展示了整个油田生命周期内生产成本的相对变化，根据事故发生年份进行划分。

Query_Text_en: For significant damage it is seen that there is a considerable loss the year the accident occurs .
Translation: 对于重大损害的情况，可见事故发生的当年会出现显著的损失。

Query_Text_en: The value of the lost production [ the year the accident occurs ] increases with the assumed oil price for the duration of the plateau period , and decreases when the production volume in the year is lower .
Translation: [事故发生当年]的损失产量价值在整个平台期内随假设油价的上涨而增加，而当该年产量较低时则会减少。

Query_Text_en: In most of the cases , the nominal value of the delayed production is higher , due to the assumed increase in oil price .
Translation: 在大多数情况下，由于假设的油价上涨，推迟生产的名义价值更高。

Query_Text_en: When the loss occurs during the plateau production period , the lost production can not be reclaimed until the plateau period has ended .
Translation: 在生产平台期发生损失时，损失的产量只能在平台期结束后才能得到弥补。

Query_Text_en: For severe damage it is seen that the extraordinary costs are the material damage , plus the value of lost production .
Translation: 对于严重损害的情况，可见额外费用包括物质损失，加上生产损失的价值。

Query_Text_en: This will lead to increased production after the plateau period and thereby provide extra income in later years for the duration of the production period .
Translation: 这将在平台期结束后提升产量，从而在未来几年的整个生产周期内带来额外收入。

Query_Text_en: 12,500 bbls lost production per day for 90 days with a value of 110 NOK\/bbl equals a total of 123.75 MNOK .
Translation: 每天损失12,500桶的生产量，持续90天，按每桶110挪威克朗计算，总计损失为1.2375亿挪威克朗。

Query_Text_en: 50,000 bbls lost production each for 365 days with a value of 110 NOK\/bbl of total 2007.5 MNOK .
Translation: 每天损失50,000桶的生产量，持续365天，每桶价值110挪威克朗，总计2007.5百万挪威克朗。

Query_Text_en: In the case of significant damage , the deferred production will be produced after the production plateau period is finished , by prolonging the plateau level with one extra year , and increased production the following year .
Translation: 在遭受重大损失的情况下，延迟生产的产能将在生产平台期结束后进行补产，通过将平台期延长一年并在次年提升产量实现。

Query_Text_en: The values [ negative loss i.e. , extra income ] in the illustration is seen in years 2003 and 2004 , which have an extra income of 144 MNOK , in contrast to the production loss of 123.75 MNOK in year 2001 [ both 2000 year values , since no inflation is considered ] .
Translation: 图表中显示，2003年和2004年出现了负损失（即额外收入），分别为144 MNOK，而2001年的生产损失为123.75 MNOK（均为2000年基值，因未考虑通货膨胀）。

Query_Text_en: A refinement to the calculation would be to assume that the accident occurs in the middle of the year .
Translation: 对计算方法进行改进的一种方式是假设事故在年中发生。

Query_Text_en: The values for both the damage categories are now multiplied by the annual changes in frequencies , in order to get the expected values , as shown in Table 15.4 .
Translation: 两类损失的数值现已乘以各年的频率变化，以得到预期值，如表15.4所示。

Query_Text_en: Finally , the Net Present Values of the changes are calculated for the profiles shown in Table 15.4 .
Translation: 最终，根据表15.4所示的各方案，计算了各项变动的净现值。

Query_Text_en: The resulting NPV values are shown in Table 15.5 .
Translation: 计算得出的净现值数值如表15.5所示。

Query_Text_en: These expected values are calculated for occurrence of the accident in each year . Thus , these values are additive .
Translation: 这些预期值是根据每年事故发生的概率计算得出的，因此这些数值可以累加。

Query_Text_en: The accumulated benefit from Table 15.5 is 4.67 MNOK , which is the economic benefit of the risk reducing measure .
Translation: 表15.5的累计效益为4.67百万挪威克朗，即为风险降低措施的经济效益。

Query_Text_en: The initial investment cost is 6 MNOK and the annual operational cost is 0.06 MNOK per year .
Translation: 初始投资成本为6百万挪威克朗，年度运营成本每年为0.06百万挪威克朗。

Query_Text_en: The total cost of the RRM is thus 6.53 MNOK .
Translation: 因此，RRM的总成本为653万挪威克朗。

Query_Text_en: Cost : 6.53 MNOK .
Translation: 成本：653万挪威克朗。

Query_Text_en: The net investment is therefore 1.86 MNOK [ NPV ] .
Translation: 因此，净投资（NPV）为1.86亿挪威克朗。

Query_Text_en: This corresponds to an investment of 44.3 MNOK per averted statistical fatality .
Translation: 这相当于每避免一起统计死亡需投入4430万挪威克朗。

Query_Text_en: Figure 15.3 presents a sensitivity analysis for the variations in net investment and the ratio of this investment per averted statistically fatality over the field life , depending on the interest rate used in the calculations .
Translation: 图15.3展示了净投资变化及其在整个使用寿命期内每避免一次统计性伤亡所需投资比率的敏感性分析，该分析取决于计算中所采用的利率。

Query_Text_en: This shows that the calculations are not very sensitive to the interest rate .
Translation: 这表明相关计算对利率的敏感性较低。

Query_Text_en: It should further be noted that other sensitivity studies should also be conducted .
Translation: 此外，还需开展其他敏感性研究。

Query_Text_en: For a single installation there are two outcomes resulting from implement-tation of a RRM .
Translation: 对于单次安装而言，实施RRM将产生两种结果。

Query_Text_en: Either [ very high probability ] there is no such accident and the investment in the RRM is a pure loss , or [ very low probability ] an accident occurs , and the reduction in accident costs are very extensive .
Translation: 极有可能不会发生此类事故，因此对RRM的投资将完全损失；或者（极低概率）事故确实发生，此时事故成本的降低将非常显著。

Query_Text_en: It is presupposed that the operator is financially capable of surviving the year with the highest nominal loss .
Translation: 预设运营方具备在亏损额最高的年份维持运营的财务能力。

Query_Text_en: Despite these limitations cost benefit analysis is considered to be the only way to get an objective analysis of the economical values of a possible risk reducing measure .
Translation: 尽管存在这些局限性，成本效益分析仍被视为对可能采取的风险降低措施的经济价值进行客观分析的唯一途径。

Query_Text_en: It is not sufficiently high to conclude gross disproportion , and thus be rejected .
Translation: 该数值不足以认定存在重大失衡，因而不予采纳。

Query_Text_en: It is likely that the conclusion in the present case could be implemen-tation , if the application of the passive fire protection is in accordance with good design practice .
Translation: 如果被动防火保护的应用符合良好的设计规范，本案的结论很可能得以实施。

Query_Text_en: This has not been done in the case study .
Translation: 这在案例研究中未被涉及。

Query_Text_en: If this had been done , it would have required several cases of passive fire protection coverage to be analyzed for costs and benefits , and the equivalent cost per life saved calculated in the same way as above .
Translation: 如果当时采取了这一做法，就需要对多个被动式防火保护措施案例进行成本效益分析，并以同样的方法计算每拯救一人生命的等效成本。

Query_Text_en: It shows the resulting equivalent cost per statistical life saved [ in MNOK ] , as a function of the extent of passive fire protection applied to the structure , measured as an investment cost [ MNOK ] .
Translation: 该图表展示了建筑结构中被动防火保护措施的应用程度所对应的每拯救一个统计生命等效成本（百万挪威克朗），其以投资成本（MNOK）为衡量依据。

Query_Text_en: The step change in the curve occurs from 10 MNOK to about 25 MNOK , implying that an investment up to 10 MNOK is certainly not in gross disproportion as it corresponds to a value of 47 MNOK per life saved .
Translation: 曲线中的转折点出现在10 MNOK到约25 MNOK之间，这表明投资额不超过10 MNOK绝非严重失衡，因为其对应的是每拯救一条生命价值47 MNOK。

Query_Text_en: The upper step change for the curve , corresponding to 26 MNOK invested and 89 MNOK per life saved , certainly indicates that costs per life saved exceeding 89 MNOK are in gross disproportion .
Translation: 曲线的上部转折点，对应投入26 MNOK和每挽救生命需花费89 MNOK，显然表明，每挽救生命成本超过89 MNOK的情况存在严重不成比例。

Query_Text_en: Where , in the interval from 10 to 26 MNOK , the limit for gross disproportion would be determined to be , would be open to evaluations according to the specifics of the case , and no general rules can be stated .
Translation: 在10至26 MNOK的区间内，重大失衡的限额确定将根据具体案情进行评估，因此无法制定统一规则。

Query_Text_en: It is therefore recommended that the risk level in the operations phase is monitored in order to identify how the risk level changes .
Translation: 因此，建议对运营阶段的风险等级进行监测，以便识别风险等级的变化。

Query_Text_en: This will enable effective monitoring of the risk level .
