Query_Text_en: The certificates issued under regulations 12 and 13 shall be readily available on board for examination at all times .
Translation: 根据第12条和第13条规定签发的证书应随时在船上备查。

Query_Text_en: They shall be regarded by the other Contracting Governments as having the same force as certificates issued by them .
Translation: 其他缔约国政府应将这些证书视为与本国签发的证书具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] If in the course of a particular voyage a ship has on board a number of persons less than the total number stated in the Passenger Ship Safety Certificate and is in consequence , in accordance with the provisions of the present regulations , free to carry a smaller number of lifeboats and other life-saving appliances than that stated in the certificate , an annex may be issued by the Government , person or organization referred to in regulation 12 or 13 of this chapter .
Translation: 若某次特定航行中，船舶实际搭载的乘客人数少于客船安全证书载明的总人数，因此根据本规定条款，可相应减少配备证书所载数量的救生艇和其他救生设备时，本章第12条或第13条规定的主管机关、人员或组织可签发附录。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] This annex shall state that in the circumstances there is no infringement of the provisions of the present regulations .
Translation: 本附件应声明，鉴于上述情况，不构成对本规定条款的违反。

Query_Text_en: It shall be annexed to the certificate and shall be substituted for it in so far as the life-saving appliances are concerned .
Translation: 该附件应附于证书，并在涉及救生设备事宜时替代该证书。

Query_Text_en: It shall be valid only for the particular voyage for which it is issued .
Translation: 本证书仅对签发时指定的特定航次有效。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Every ship when in a port of another Contracting Government is subject to control by officers duly authorized by such Government in so far as this control is directed towards verifying that the certificates issued under regulation 12 or regulation 13 are valid .
Translation: 船舶在另一缔约国政府的港口期间，应接受该政府授权官员的检查，以核查根据第12条或第13条签发的证书是否有效。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Such certificates , if valid , shall be accepted unless there are clear grounds for believing that the condition of the ship or of its equipment does not correspond substantially with the particulars of any of the certificates or that the ship and its equipment are not in compliance with the provisions of regulation 11 [ a ] and [ b ] .
Translation: 此类证书如经验证有效，应予接受，除非存在明确理由认为船舶状况或设备情况与证书所载内容存在实质性不符，或船舶及其设备不符合第11条（a）和（b）款的规定。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] In the event of this control giving rise to an intervention of any kind , the officer carrying out the control shall forthwith inform , in writing , the Consul or , in his absence , the nearest diplomatic representative of the State whose flag the ship is entitled to fly of all the circumstances in which intervention was deemed necessary .
Translation: 如果实施此类控制导致任何形式的干预，执行控制的官员应立即以书面形式通知相关船舶有权悬挂其国旗的国家的领事或（如领事不在时）最近的外交代表，说明采取干预措施的全部情况。

Query_Text_en: In addition , nominated surveyors or recognized organizations responsible for the issue of the certificates shall also be notified .
Translation: 此外，负责签发证书的指定验船师或认可机构也应予以通知。

Query_Text_en: The facts concerning the intervention shall be reported to the Organization .
Translation: 有关干预行动的事实情况应向该组织报告。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] The port State authority concerned shall notify all relevant information about the ship to the authorities of the next port of call , in addition to parties mentioned in paragraph [ d ] , if it is unable to take action as specified in paragraphs [ c ] and [ d ] or if the ship has been allowed to proceed to the next port of call .
Translation: 相关港口国当局如其无法按照第[c]款和第[d]款规定采取行动，或船舶已被准许驶往下一停靠港，除第[d]款所述各方外，应当向下一停靠港的主管当局通报船舶相关信息。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] When exercising control under this regulation all possible efforts shall be made to avoid a ship being unduly detained or delayed .
Translation: 根据本规定实施监管时，应尽最大努力避免船舶遭受不正当滞留或延误。

Query_Text_en: If a ship is thereby unduly detained or delayed it shall be entitled to compensation for any loss or damage suffered .
Translation: 如果船舶因此被不当扣留或延误，其有权就所遭受的任何损失或损害获得赔偿。

Query_Text_en: The privileges of the present Convention may not be claimed in favor of any ship unless it holds appropriate valid certificates .
Translation: 除非船舶持有有效适当证书，否则不得为任何船舶主张本公约规定的优惠待遇。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to the Procedures for port State control adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 787 [ 19 ] , as amended by resolution A. 882 [ 21 ] .
Translation: 参照该组织根据A.787[19]号决议采纳，并依据A.882[21]号决议修正的港口国监督程序。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Each Administration undertakes to conduct an investigation to any casualty occurring to any of its ships subject to the provisions of the present Convention when it judges that such an investigation may assist in determining what changes in the present regulations might be desirable . \*
Translation: 每一管理机构承诺，对其任何船舶发生的事故根据本公约的规定进行调查，当该管理机构判断此类调查可能有助于确定现行条例中何项变更值得考虑时。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Each Contracting Government undertakes to supply the Organization with pertinent information concerning the findings of such investigations .
Translation: 每一缔约国政府承诺向该组织提供此类调查结果的相关信息。

Query_Text_en: No reports or recommendations of the Organization based upon such information shall disclose the identity or nationality of the ships concerned or in any manner fix or imply responsibility upon any ship or person .
Translation: 组织根据此类信息发布的任何报告或建议均不得披露有关船舶的身份或船旗国，也不得以任何方式确定或暗示任何船舶或个人的责任。

Query_Text_en: Resolution A 849 [ 20 ] : Code for the investigation of marine casualties and incidents , as amended by resolution A884 [ 21 ] .
Translation: 《关于海事事故和事件调查规则的第20届849号决议（A.849(20)），经第21届884号决议（A.884(21)）修正》。

Query_Text_en: Refer also to : MSC\/Circ .953 - MEPC\/Circ .372 : Reports on marine casualties and incidents .
Translation: MSC通函953号及MEPC通函372号：关于海事事故和事件的报告。

Query_Text_en: Revised harmonized reporting procedures - Reports required under SOLAS regulation I/21 and MARPOL 73/78 articles 8 and 12 .
Translation: 修订后的协调报告程序——根据SOLAS公约I/21条款及MARPOL 73/78公约第8条和第12条要求提交的报告。

Query_Text_en: [ viii ] the certificates referred to in this regulation shall be issued or endorsed either by the Administration or by any person or organization authorized by it . In every case , that Administration assumes full responsibility for the certificates .
Translation: 本条例所指证书应由主管机关签发或签注，或由其授权的任何个人或组织签发或签注。在任何情况下，该主管机关均应对证书承担全部责任。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] In the circumstances given in paragraph [ b ] or where a certificate has expired or ceased to be valid . The officer carrying out the control shall take steps to ensure that the ship shall not sail until it can proceed to sea or leave the port for the purpose of proceeding to the appropriate repair yard without danger to the ship or persons on board .
Translation: 在本条(b)款所述情形下或证书已过期或失效的情况下，执行检查的主管人员应采取措施确保船舶不得离港，直至该船能够安全前往海上航行或出于前往合适修船厂目的离开港口且不会对船舶或船上人员造成危险为止。

Query_Text_en: 1 The requirements in this part shall apply to cargo ships over 100 m in length [ Ls ] but shall exclude those ships which are shown to comply with subdivision and damage stability regulations in other instruments ② developed by the Organization .
Translation: 本部分的要求适用于长度[ Ls ]超过100米的货船，但不包括那些经证明符合本组织制定的其他文件②中水密分舱和破损稳性规定的船舶。

Query_Text_en: The requirements in this part shall also apply to cargo ships of 80 m in Ls and upwards but not exceeding 100 m in Ls constructed on or after 1 July 1998 .
Translation: 本部分的要求也适用于1998年7月1日或以后建造的、垂线间长80米及以上但不超过100米的货船。

Query_Text_en: 2 Any reference hereinafter to regulations refers to the set of regulations contained in this part .
Translation: 本文件以下各处所指的"规定"均指本部分所载规定。

Query_Text_en: 3 The Administration may for a particular ship or group of ships accept alternative arrangements , if it is satisfied that at least the same degree of safety as represented by these regulations is achieved .
Translation: 主管机关可对特定船舶或船舶群体接受替代安排，如果经确认其安全水平不低于本法规所规定的标准。

Query_Text_en: Any Administration which allows such alternative arrangements shall communicate to the Organization particulars thereof .
Translation: 允许此类替代安排的任何主管部门应当向该组织通报有关详情。

Query_Text_en: 1.1 Subdivision load line is a waterline used in determining the subdivision of the ship .
Translation: 1.1 分舱载重线是一种用于确定船舶分舱的水线。

Query_Text_en: 1.2 Deepest subdivision load line is the subdivision load line which corresponds to the summer draught to be assigned to the ship .
Translation: 1.2 最深分舱载重线即对应船舶所分配夏季吃水的分舱载重线。

Query_Text_en: 1.3 Partial load line is the light ship draught plus 60 % of the difference between the light ship draught and deepest subdivision load line .
Translation: 1.3 部分载重线是指空船吃水加上空船吃水与最深分舱载重线之差的60%。

Query_Text_en: 2.1 Subdivision length of the ship [ Ls ] is the greatest projected molded length of that part of the ship at or below deck or decks limiting the vertical extent of flooding with the ship at the deepest subdivision load line .
Translation: 船舶分舱长度[Ls]是指船舶处于最深分舱载重线时，限制船舶进水垂直范围的甲板或甲板以下部分的最大投影型长。

Query_Text_en: \* The Maritime Safety Committee , in adopting the regulations contained in part B-l , invited Administrations to note that the regulations should be applied in conjunction with the Explanatory notes to the SOLAS regulations on subdivision and damage stability of cargo ships of 100 metres in length and over , which were adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 684 [ 17 ] , in order to ensure their uniform application .
Translation: 海上安全委员会在通过B-1部分所载的法规时，建议各缔约国政府注意这些法规应与本组织经第17届会议A.684号决议采纳的《国际海上人命安全公约》（SOLAS）关于100米及以上的货船分舱和破损稳性法规的解释性说明一并适用，以便确保这些法规得到统一实施。

Query_Text_en: Refer also to resolution MSC .76 [ 69 ] on Extended application of the Explanatory Notes to the SOLAS regulations on subdivision and damage stability of cargo ships of 100 metres in length and over [ resolution A. 684 [ 17 ] ] .
Translation: 并参考MSC.76[69]号决议关于《国际海上人命安全公约》（SOLAS）规定中长度100米及以上货船分舱和破损稳性解释说明的扩大适用，以及A.684[17]号决议。

Query_Text_en: .6 Damage stability requirements of regulation 27 of the 1966 Load Line Convention as applied in compliance with resolutions A. 320 [ IX ] and A. 514 [ 13 ] , provided that in the case of ships to which regulation 27 [ 9 ] applies , main transverse watertight bulkheads , to be considered effective , are spaced according to paragraph [ 12 ] [ f ] of resolution A. 320 [ IX ] .
Translation: 根据1966年《载重线公约》第27条规定的损坏稳性要求，在符合A.320(IX)和A.514(13)决议的前提下适用。对于适用第27条第9项的船舶，若要被视为有效的主要横向水密舱壁，其布置应按照A.320(IX)决议第12段f项的规定执行。

Query_Text_en: 2.2 Mid-length is the mid-point of the subdivision length of the ship .
Translation: 2.2 船舶的中长是其分舱长度的中点。

Query_Text_en: 2.3 Aft terminal is the aft limit of the subdivision length .
Translation: 2.3 尾端是分段长度的尾部界限。

Query_Text_en: 2.4 Forward terminal is the forward limit of the subdivision length .
Translation: 前向终端是分段长度的前端极限。

Query_Text_en: 3 Breadth [ B ] is the greatest molded breadth of the ship at or below the deepest subdivision load line .
Translation: 船宽[B]是指船舶在或低于最深分舱载重线处的最大型宽。

Query_Text_en: 4 Draught [ d ] is the vertical distance from the molded baseline at mid-length to the waterline in question .
Translation: 吃水[d]是指从中段处型基线到所对应水线的垂直距离。

Query_Text_en: 5 Permeability [ ] of a space is the proportion of the immersed volume of that space which can be occupied by water .
Translation: 某一空间的渗透率是指其浸没体积中可被水占据的比例。

Query_Text_en: 1 These regulations are intended to provide ships with a minimum standard of subdivision .
Translation: 本规定旨在为船舶设定最低分舱标准。

Query_Text_en: where Ro is the value R as calculated in accordance with the formula in subparagraph .1 .
Translation: 其中，Ro为根据第.1款所述公式计算得出的R值。

Query_Text_en: 1 The attained subdivision index A , calculated in accordance with this regulation , shall not be less than the required subdivision index R , calculated in accordance with paragraph 2 of regulation 25-3 .
Translation: 根据本条例计算得出的实际分隔指数A，不得低于根据第25-3条第2款计算得出的要求分隔指数R。

Query_Text_en: si accounts for the probability of survival after flooding the compartment or group of compartments under consideration , including the effects of any horizontal subdivision .
Translation: 该指数考虑了所涉及舱室或舱室组被淹没后幸存的概率，包括任何横向分隔的影响。

Query_Text_en: 3 In calculating A , level trim shall be used .
Translation: 在计算A时，应使用水平调整。

Query_Text_en: 4 This summation covers only those cases of flooding which contribute to the value of the attained subdivision index A.
Translation: 本汇总仅涵盖那些对已计算的子分类指数A的数值有贡献的洪水案例。

Query_Text_en: 5 The summation indicated by the above formula shall be taken over the ship 's length for all cases of flooding in which a single compartment or two or more adjacent compartments are involved .
Translation: 对于所有涉及单一舱室或两个及以上相邻舱室的进水情况，上述公式的总和应沿船舶长度进行计算。

Query_Text_en: and additionally , for all cases of simultaneous flooding of a wing compartment or compartments and the adjacent inboard compartment or compartments , assuming a rectangular penetration which extends to the ship s centerline , but excludes damage to any centerline bulkhead .
Translation: 此外，对于机舱（或多个机舱）与相邻的内侧舱室（或多个内侧舱室）同时进水的所有情况，假设存在一个延伸至船体中心线的矩形破口，但不包括对任何中心线舱壁的损坏。

Query_Text_en: 7 The assumed vertical extent of damage is to extend from the baseline upwards to any watertight horizontal subdivision above the waterline or higher .
Translation: 假设的垂直破损范围应从基线向上延伸至水线以上或更高的任何水密横向分舱。

Query_Text_en: However , if a lesser extent will give a more severe result , such extent is to be assumed .
Translation: 然而，若程度较轻却导致更严重的结果，则应推定存在该程度。

Query_Text_en: 8 If pipes , ducts or tunnels are situated within assumed flooded compartments , arrangements are to be made to ensure that progressive flooding can not thereby extend to compartments other than those assumed flooded .
Translation: 如果管道、风道或隧道设置在预定浸水的舱室内，应采取措施确保渐进式进水不会因此蔓延到其他非预定浸水的舱室。

Query_Text_en: However , the Administration may permit minor progressive flooding if it is demonstrated that its effects can be easily controlled and the safety of the ship is not impaired .
Translation: 然而，若经证明其影响可轻易控制且船舶安全未受影响，主管部门可批准轻微渐进式进水。

Query_Text_en: 9 In the flooding calculations carried out according to the regulations , only one breach of the hull need be assumed .
Translation: 9. 按照规定进行的浸水计算中，只需假设船体存在一处破损。

Query_Text_en: The maximum nondimensional damage length J 48 max = Ls , but not more than 0.24 .
Translation: 最大无量纲损伤长度J48max等于Ls，但不得超过0.24。

Query_Text_en: The assumed distribution density of damage location along the ship 's lengtha = 1.2 + 0.8 E , but not more than 1.2 .
Translation: 沿船长方向的损伤位置假设分布密度a = 1.2 + 0.8 E，但不超过1.2。

Query_Text_en: F y2 y 1 2 = - + otherwise .
Translation: 您提供的表达式存在格式问题，无法进行准确翻译。建议您重新检查并明确表达式结构（例如：函数定义、运算符位置、变量关系等），以便我为您提供符合要求的翻译服务。

Query_Text_en: 1.1.5 In applying the formulae of paragraphs 1.1.2 , 1.1.3 and 1.1.4 , where the compartment considered extends over the mid-length , these formulae values shall be reduced by an amount determined according to the formula for q , in which F2 is calculated taking y to be J ' \/ Jmax .
Translation: 在应用第1.1.2、1.1.3和1.1.4段所述的计算公式时，若所考虑的隔舱跨越船舶中段，则需根据q的计算公式确定数值折减量，其中F2的计算需将y取为J'/Jmax。

Query_Text_en: 2 Wherever wing compartments are fitted , the pi-value for a wing compartment shall be obtained by multiplying the value , as determined in paragraph 3 , by the reduction factor r according to paragraph 2.2 , which represents the probability that the inboard spaces will not be flooded .
Translation: 凡安装有机翼隔舱之处，机翼隔舱的pi值应通过以下方式确定：将第3款确定的数值乘以第2.2款规定的折减系数r，该系数表示内侧舱室不被淹没的概率。

Query_Text_en: 2.1 The pi-value for the case of simultaneous flooding of a wing and adjacent inboard compartment shall be obtained by using the formulae of paragraph 3 , multiplied by the factor [ 1 - r ] .
Translation: 当舷侧舱及其相邻内侧舱室同时浸水时，pi值应通过第三段所述公式计算，并乘以因子[1 - r]。

Query_Text_en: For J [ 0.2 b\/B the reduction factor r shall be determined by linear interpolation between : r = 1 , for J = 0 and r = as for the case where J 0.2 b\/B , for J = 0.2 b\/B
Translation: 当J在0到0.2b/B范围内时，缩减系数r应通过线性插值确定：在J=0时r=1，而在J=0.2b/B时，r应取与J超过0.2b/B情况相同的值。

Query_Text_en: b = the mean transverse distance in meters measured at right angles to the centerline at the deepest subdivision load line between the shell and a plane through the outermost portion of and parallel to that part of the longitudinal bulkhead which extends between the longitudinal limits used in calculating the factor pi .
Translation: b = 在计算因子π时所采用的纵向界限之间延伸的纵向水密舱壁的外缘部分所构成的平面与船体之间，在最深分舱载重线处与中心线垂直方向上测得的横向平均距离（单位：米）。

Query_Text_en: 3 To evaluate pi for compartments taken singly the formulae in paragraphs 1 and 2 shall be applied directly .
Translation: 对于单独选取的隔间评估pi值时，应直接应用第1段和第2段中的公式。

Query_Text_en: pi = p23 - p2 - p3 , etc.
Translation: pi 等于 p23 减去 p2 和 p3，等等。
pi 等于 p234 减去 p23 和 p34 再加上 p3，等等。
pi 等于 p2345 减去 p234，再减去 p345，再加上 p34，等等。

Query_Text_en: shall be calculated according to the formulae in paragraphs 1 and 2 for a single compartment whose nondimensional length J corresponds to that of a group consisting of the compartments indicated by the indices assigned to p.
Translation: 应根据第1段和第2段中的公式，对单个舱室进行计算，该舱室的无量纲长度J应与由分配给p的索引所指示的舱室组成的组的无量纲长度相等。

Query_Text_en: 3.2 The factor pi for a group of three or more adjacent compartments equals zero if the no dimensional length of such a group minus the nondimensional length of the aftermost and foremost compartments in the group is greater than Jmax .
Translation: 当三个或更多相邻隔舱组成的组的无量纲长度减去该组中最末端和最前端隔舱的无量纲长度之和大于Jmax时，该组的因数π等于零。

Query_Text_en: range = range of positive righting levers beyond the angle of equilibrium [ degrees ] but not more than 20o ; however , the range shall be terminated at the angle where openings not capable of being closed weather tight are immersed ;
Translation: 正浮力臂范围指超过平衡角时的正复原力臂区间（单位：度），但不得超过20°；然而，该范围应终止于无法气密关闭的开口被浸没时的角度。

Query_Text_en: e = final equilibrium angle of heel [ degrees ] .
Translation: e = 最终平衡横倾角 [度]。

Query_Text_en: 1.2 s = 0 where the final waterline taking into account sinkage , heel and trim , immerses the lower edge of openings through which progressive flooding may take place .
Translation: 1.2 当考虑下沉、横倾和吃水差后的最终水线淹没可能引发渐进式进水的开口的下边缘时，s = 0。

Query_Text_en: Such opening shall include air-pipes , ventilators and openings which are closed by means of weather tight doors or hatch covers , and may exclude those openings closed by means of watertight manhole covers and flush scuttles , small watertight hatch covers which maintain the high integrity of the deck , remotely operated sliding watertight doors , access doors and access hatch covers , of watertight integrity , normally closed at sea and side scuttles of the non-opening type .
Translation: 本条款所述开口应包括设有风雨密门或舱盖关闭的空气管、通风口及开口，但可排除以下开口：通过水密人孔盖和平式舷窗、保持甲板高完整性的小型水密舱盖、遥控滑动水密门、水密完整性的通道门及舱盖（通常在海上保持关闭状态），以及非开启式舷侧舷窗。

Query_Text_en: However , if the compartments so flooded are taken into account in the calculations the requirements of this regulation shall be applied .
Translation: 然而，如果在计算中考虑了上述被淹没的舱室，则本法规的要求应予适用。

Query_Text_en: sp is the s-factor at the partial load line .
Translation: SP 是部分负荷线上的 S 因子。

Query_Text_en: 2 For all compartments forward of the collision bulkhead , the s-value , calculated assuming the ship to be at its deepest subdivision load line and with assumed unlimited vertical extent of damage , is to be equal to 1 .
Translation: 位于碰撞舱壁前的所有隔舱，应假设船舶处于最深分舱载重线状态且破损的垂直范围无限时，计算所得的S值须等于1。

Query_Text_en: 3.1 The s-value for the lower compartment or group of compartments shall be obtained by multiplying the value as determined in paragraph 1.1 by the reduction factor v according to paragraph 3.3 , which represents the probability that the spaces above the horizontal subdivision will not be flooded .
Translation: 下层隔间或隔间组的S值应通过将第1.1款确定的数值乘以第3.3款规定的缩减因子v得出，该因子表示水平分隔上方空间不被淹没的概率。

Query_Text_en: 3.2 In cases of positive contribution to index A due to simultaneous flooding of the spaces above the horizontal subdivision , the resulting s-value for such a compartment or group of compartments shall be obtained by an increase of the value as determined by paragraph 3.1 by the s-value for simultaneous flooding according to paragraph 1.1 , multiplied by the factor [ 1 - v ] .
Translation: 3.2 当因水平分隔上方空间的同时浸水对指数A产生正贡献时，此类舱室或舱室组的s值应为根据第3.1款确定的值加上根据第1.1款规定的同时浸水的s值，再乘以因子[1 - v]。

Query_Text_en: or whichever is less .
Translation: 或两者中较低者。

Query_Text_en: 1 The master of the ship shall be supplied with such reliable information as is necessary to enable him by rapid and simple means to obtain accurate guidance as to the stability of the ship under varying conditions of service .
Translation: 船舶船长应获得所需可靠信息，以便其能够通过快速简便的方式获取船舶在不同服务条件下的稳定性准确指导。

Query_Text_en: .3 all other data and aids which might be necessary to maintain stability after damage .
Translation: 3. 损坏后维持稳定所需的所有其他必要数据及辅助工具。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to MSC\/Circ .651 , Interpretations of regulations of part B-1 of SOLAS chapter II-1 .
Translation: 参考国际海事组织通函MSC.651号《国际海事组织海上人命安全公约（SOLAS）第二章第1部分B-1节的法规解释》。

Query_Text_en: ② Whichever results in the more severe requirements .
Translation: 导致要求更为严格者。

Query_Text_en: 2 There shall be permanently exhibited , or readily available on the navigation bridge , for the guidance of the officer in charge of the ship , plans showing clearly for each deck and hold the boundaries of the watertight compartments , the openings therein with the means of closure and position of any controls thereof , and the arrangements for the correction of any list due to flooding .
Translation: 船舶值班驾驶员值班期间，应永久展示或在驾驶台易于取用下列图纸以供参考：各甲板及舱室的水密隔舱边界、各边界开口及其关闭装置的位置和控制装置的设置，以及因进水导致的倾斜校正装置布置。

Query_Text_en: In addition , booklets containing the aforementioned information shall be made available to the officers of the ship . \*
Translation: 此外，应制作包含上述信息的小册子，并提供给船舶的船员。*

Query_Text_en: 3 In order to provide the information referred to in paragraph 1.1 , the limiting GM [ or KG ] values to be used , if they have been determined from considerations related to the subdivision index , the limiting GM shall be varied linearly between the deepest subdivision load line and the partial load line .
Translation: 在提供第1.1款所述信息时，若限制初稳性高度[或初稳性高度上限]值是根据水密分舱指数确定的，则该限制初稳性高度值应按线性规律在最深分舱吃水载重线与部分载重线之间变化。

Query_Text_en: In such cases , for draughts below the partial load line if the minimum GM requirement at this draught results from the calculation of the subdivision index , then this GM value shall be assumed for lesser draughts , unless the intact stability requirements apply .
Translation: 在这种情况下，若某一吃水下的最小GM要求系根据分舱指数计算得出，则当吃水低于部分载重线时，该GM值应适用于更小的吃水，除非适用完整稳性要求。

Query_Text_en: 1 The number of openings in watertight subdivisions is to be kept to a minimum compatible with the design and proper working of the ship .
Translation: 水密分舱上的开口数量应尽可能减少，同时需与船舶设计及正常运行相协调。

Query_Text_en: Where penetrations of watertight bulkheads and internal decks are necessary for access , piping , ventilation , electrical cables , etc. , arrangements are to be made to maintain the watertight integrity .
Translation: 凡需在水密舱壁和内部甲板开设开口以供通道、管路、通风系统、电缆等时，必须采取相应布置以确保水密完整性。

Query_Text_en: The Administration may permit relaxation in the water tightness of openings above the freeboard deck , provided that it is demonstrated that any progressive flooding can be easily controlled and that the safety of the ship is not impaired .
Translation: 主管机关可允许放宽干舷甲板以上开口的水密性要求，只要经证明任何渐进式进水均可得到有效控制且不会影响船舶安全。

Query_Text_en: 2 Doors provided to ensure the watertight integrity of internal openings which are used while at sea are to be sliding watertight doors capable of being remotely closed from the bridge and are also to be operable locally from each side of the bulkhead .
Translation: 为确保航行中使用的内部开口的水密完整性，应设置2扇滑动式水密门，该门应能从驾驶室远程关闭，并应能从舱壁的每一侧就地操作。

Query_Text_en: Indicators are to be provided at the control position showing whether the doors are open or closed , and an audible alarm is to be provided at the door closure .
Translation: 控制位置应设置显示门的开闭状态的指示器，并在门关闭处设置声音报警装置。

Query_Text_en: The power , control and indicators are to be operable in the event of main power failure .
Translation: 在主电源故障的情况下，电源、控制装置和指示器应能正常工作。

Query_Text_en: Particular attention is to be paid to minimizing the effect of control system failure .
Translation: 必须高度重视减少控制系统故障的影响。

Query_Text_en: Each power-operated sliding watertight door shall be provided with an individual hand-operated mechanism .
Translation: 每个动力操作滑动水密门应各自配备一个手动操作机构。

Query_Text_en: It shall be possible to open and close the door by hand at the door itself from both sides .
Translation: 应能在门体两侧手动开启和关闭门。

Query_Text_en: 3 Access doors and access hatch covers normally closed at sea , intended to ensure the watertight integrity of internal openings , shall be provided with means of indication locally and on the bridge showing whether these doors or hatch covers are open or closed .
Translation: 3. 在航行中通常处于关闭状态的通道门和舱口盖，其设计目的是确保内部开口的水密完整性，应配备就地和驾驶室的指示装置，以显示这些门或盖板的开闭状态。

Query_Text_en: A notice is to be affixed to each such door or hatch cover to the effect that it is not to be left open .
Translation: 每一扇此类门或舱盖均应张贴告示，内容为不得敞开。

Query_Text_en: The use of such doors and hatch covers shall be authorized by the officer of the watch .
Translation: 使用此类门和舱口盖应经值班驾驶员批准。

Query_Text_en: 4 Watertight doors or ramps of satisfactory construction may be fitted to internally subdivide large cargo spaces , provided that the Administration is satisfied that such doors or ramps are essential .
Translation: 4. 经主管机关认可，可在大型货舱区域内设置结构合格的水密门或坡道，以实现内部分隔，但须确保此类门或坡道确属必要。

Query_Text_en: These doors or ramps may be hinged , rolling or sliding doors or ramps , but shall not be remotely controlled .
Translation: 这些门或坡道可以是铰链式、滚动式或滑动式门或坡道，但不得远程控制。

Query_Text_en: Such doors or ramps shall be closed before the voyage commences and shall be kept closed during navigation ; the time of opening such doors or ramps in port and of closing them before the ship leaves port shall be entered in the log-book .
Translation: 此类门或坡道应在航行开始前关闭，并在航行期间保持关闭；在港口开启此类门或坡道的时间以及船舶离港前关闭的时间，应记录在航海日志中。

Query_Text_en: Should any of the doors or ramps be accessible during the voyage , they shall be fitted with a device which prevents unauthorized opening .
Translation: 若航行期间有任何门或坡道处于可开启状态，则应配备防止未经授权开启的装置。

Query_Text_en: 5 Other closing appliances which are kept permanently closed at sea to ensure the watertight integrity of internal openings shall be provided with a notice which is to be affixed to each such closing appliance to the effect that it is to be kept closed .
Translation: 其他保持关闭的装置应在海上航行时始终保持关闭状态，以确保内部开口处的水密完整性。每个此类关闭装置应设置标识牌，注明须保持关闭。

Query_Text_en: Manholes fitted with closely bolted covers need not be so marked .
Translation: 设置有紧密固定井盖的人孔无需特别标注。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to MSC\/Circ .919 , Guidelines for damage control plans .
Translation: 参考MSC/Circ.919，《损害管制计划指南》。

Query_Text_en: ② Refer to MSC/Circ .651 , Interpretations of regulations of part B-1 of SOLAS chapter II-1 .
Translation: ② 参见MSC通函651《关于SOLAS公约第II-1章B-1部分规定的解释》。

Query_Text_en: 1 All external openings leading to compartments assumed intact in the damage analysis , which are below the final damage waterline , are required to be watertight .
Translation: 在破损分析中，假定未受损且位于最终破损水线以下的所有通向相关隔舱的外部开口，均须保持水密。

Query_Text_en: 2 External openings required to be watertight in accordance with paragraph 1 shall be of sufficient strength and , except for cargo hatch covers , shall be fitted with indicators on the bridge .
Translation: 根据第1款要求设置水密的外部开口，应具备足够的强度，并除货舱舱盖外，应在驾驶室安装指示器。

Query_Text_en: 3 Openings in the shell plating below the deck limiting the vertical extent of damage shall be kept permanently closed while at sea .
Translation: 船舶航行时，甲板以下船体外板上限制损害垂直范围的开口应始终保持关闭。

Query_Text_en: Should any of these openings be accessible during the voyage , they shall be fitted with a device which prevents unauthorized opening .
Translation: 如果这些开口中的任何一个在航行期间保持可进入状态，则必须配备防止未经授权开启的装置。

Query_Text_en: 4 Notwithstanding the requirements of paragraph 3 , the Administration may authorize that particular doors may be opened at the discretion of the master , if necessary for the operation of the ship and provided that the safety of the ship is not impaired .
Translation: 尽管第3款有相关规定，但主管机关可授权在因船舶运营需要且不影响船舶安全的情况下，由船长自行决定开启特定舱门。

Query_Text_en: 5 Other closing appliances which are kept permanently closed at sea to ensure the watertight integrity of external openings shall be provided with a notice affixed to each appliance to the effect that it is to be kept closed .
Translation: 其他需在海上始终处于关闭状态以确保外部开口水密完整性的闭锁装置，应在每个装置上设置固定标识牌，注明该装置须保持关闭。

Query_Text_en: 1 The machinery , boilers and other pressure vessels , associated piping systems and fittings shall be of a design and construction adequate for the service for which they are intended and shall be so installed and protected as to reduce to a minimum any danger to persons on board , due regard being paid to moving parts , hot surfaces and other hazards .
Translation: 机械装置、锅炉及其他压力容器、相关管道系统及部件的设计和建造应能满足其预定用途的要求，其安装和防护措施应确保将船上人员面临的危险降至最低限度，并充分考虑运动部件、高温表面及其他危险因素。

Query_Text_en: The design shall have regard to materials used in construction , the purpose for which the equipment is intended , the working conditions to which it will be subjected and the environmental conditions on board . \*
Translation: 设计应考虑所用的建筑材料、设备预期用途、设备将承受的工作条件及船上环境条件。

Query_Text_en: 2 The Administration shall give special consideration to the reliability of single essential propulsion components and may require a separate source of propulsion power sufficient to give the ship a navigable speed , especially in the case of unconventional arrangements .
Translation: 主管机关应特别考虑关键单一推进组件的可靠性，并可要求设置独立推进动力源，以确保船舶达到可航行速度，尤其是在采用非常规布置的情况下。

Query_Text_en: 3 Means shall be provided whereby normal operation of propulsion machinery can be sustained or restored even though one of the essential auxiliaries becomes inoperative .
Translation: 应设置相应措施，确保即使其中一个关键辅助设备失效，仍能维持或恢复推进机械的正常运行。

Query_Text_en: .10 the hydraulic , pneumatic or electrical means for control in main propulsion machinery including controllable pitch propellers .
Translation: 主推进机械（包括可变螺距螺旋桨）控制所采用的液压、气动或电动装置。

Query_Text_en: However , the Administration , having regard to overall safety considerations , may accept a partial reduction in propulsion capability from normal operation .
Translation: 然而，主管部门考虑到总体安全因素，可能接受推进能力相对于正常运行的部分降低。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to MSC\/Circ .834 , Guidelines for engine-room lay-out , design and arrangement .
Translation: 参考MSC/Circ.834文件，《机舱布局、设计和布置指南》。

Query_Text_en: ? Refer to MSC\/Circ .647 , Guidelines to minimize leakage from flammable liquid systems , as supplemented by MSC\/Circ .851 , Guidelines on engine-room oil fuel systems .
Translation: 根据MSC/Circ.647，《减少易燃液体系统泄漏的指南》，以及根据MSC/Circ.851，《机舱燃油系统指南》。

Query_Text_en: 4 Means shall be provided to ensure that the machinery can be brought into operation from the dead ship condition without external aid .
Translation: 应配备必要的措施，确保船舶在无动力状态下无需外部援助即可启动机械装置。

Query_Text_en: 5 All boilers , all parts of machinery , all steam , hydraulic , pneumatic and other systems and their associated fittings which are under internal pressure shall be subjected to appropriate tests including a pressure test before being put into service for the first time .
Translation: 所有锅炉、机械的所有部件以及承受内部压力的蒸汽、液压、气压及其他系统及其相关附属装置，在首次投入使用前均应进行包括压力试验在内的适当试验。

Query_Text_en: 6 Main propulsion machinery and all auxiliary machinery essential to the propulsion and the safety of the ship shall , as fitted in the ship , be designed to operate when the ship is upright and when inclined at any angle of list up to and including 15o either way under static conditions and 22.5 o under dynamic conditions [ rolling ] either way and simultaneously inclined dynamically [ pitching ] 7.5 o by bow or stem .
Translation: 船舶主推进机械以及确保船舶推进和安全所需的所有辅助机械，在船舶安装状态下应设计为能够在以下条件下正常运行：船舶处于正浮状态，或在静态条件下向任一侧横倾不超过15°，或在动态条件下[横摇]向任一侧横倾不超过22.5°，同时动态[纵摇]首或尾方向倾斜7.5°。

Query_Text_en: The Administration may permit deviation from these angles , taking into consideration the type , size and service conditions of the ship .
Translation: 主管部门可允许偏离这些角度，考虑到船舶的类型、尺寸及服务条件。

Query_Text_en: 7 Provision shall be made to facilitate cleaning , inspection and maintenance of main propulsion and auxiliary machinery including boilers and pressure vessels .
Translation: 应采取措施便于清洁、检查和维护主推进装置及辅助机械，包括锅炉和压力容器。

Query_Text_en: 8 Special consideration shall be given to the design , construction and installation of propulsion machinery systems so that any mode of their vibrations shall not cause undue stresses in this machinery in the normal operating ranges .
Translation: 推进机械系统的设 计、建造及安装应特别考虑其各种振动模式，确保在正常工作范围内不会导致该机械产生过度应力。

Query_Text_en: 9 Non-metallic expansion joints in piping systems , if located in a system which penetrates the ship 's side and both the penetration and the non-metallic expansion joint are located below the deepest load waterline , shall be inspected as part of the surveys prescribed in regulation I\/10 [ a ] and replaced as necessary , or at an interval recommended by the manufacturer .
Translation: 在船舶管道系统中，若非金属膨胀节位于穿透船体的系统内，且该穿透点及非金属膨胀节均处于船舶最深载重线以下，则应将其纳入规则 I/10 [a] 规定的检验范畴进行检查，并根据需要更换，或按制造商建议的间隔进行更换。

Query_Text_en: 10 Operating and maintenance instructions and engineering drawings for ship machinery and equipment essential to the safe operation of the ship shall be written in a language understandable by those officers and crew members who are required to understand such information in the performance of their duties .
Translation: 船舶安全运营所必需的机械和设备的操作和维护说明以及工程图纸，应使用在履行职责时需要理解此类信息的船员和工作人员能够理解的语言编写。

Query_Text_en: 11 Location and arrangement of vent pipes for fuel oil service , settling and lubrication oil tanks shall be such that in the event of a broken vent pipe this shall not directly lead to the risk of ingress of seawater splashes or rainwater .
Translation: 燃油服务、沉淀及滑油油舱的通气管位置和布置应确保在通气管断裂时，不会直接导致海水飞溅或雨水进入的风险。

Query_Text_en: Two fuel oil service tanks for each type of fuel used on board necessary for propulsion and vital systems or equivalent arrangements shall be provided on each new ship , with a capacity of at least 8 h at maximum continuous rating of the propulsion plant and normal operating load at sea of the generator plant . \*
Translation: 每艘新船应为推进和关键系统所必需的船上使用各类燃油配备至少两个燃油日用柜，或等效布置，并且其容量至少为推进装置的最大持续功率及发电机装置在海况正常运行负荷下的8小时用量。

Query_Text_en: This paragraph applies only to ships constructed on or after 1 July 1998 .
Translation: 本段仅适用于1998年7月1日或之后建造的船舶。

Query_Text_en: 1 Where risk from overspeeding of machinery exists , means shall be provided to ensure that the safe speed is not exceeded .
Translation: 存在机械超速风险时，应采取措施确保不超过安全速度。

Query_Text_en: 2 Where main or auxiliary machinery including pressure vessels or any parts of such machinery are subject to internal pressure and may be subject to dangerous overpressure , means shall be provided where practicable to protect against such excessive pressure .
Translation: 对于主辅机械（包括压力容器及其任何部件）内部承受压力且可能产生危险超压的场合，在可行的情况下应采取措施防止出现过高的压力。

Query_Text_en: 3 All gearing and every shaft and coupling used for transmission of power to machinery essential for the propulsion and safety of the ship or for the safety of persons on board shall be so designed and constructed that they will withstand the maximum working stresses to which they may be subjected in all service conditions , and due consideration shall be given to the type of engines by which they are driven or of which they form part .
Translation: 所有用于向船舶推进和安全所必需的机械装置或船上人员安全所需设备传递动力的齿轮装置、轴及联轴器，均应设计和建造得能够承受在各种运行条件下可能产生的最大工作应力，并应充分考虑其所驱动或所属的发动机类型。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to regulation II-2 \/ 4.2 , Arrangements for oil fuel , lubricating oil and other flammable oils .
Translation: 参考II-2章/4.2条，关于燃油、润滑油及其他可燃液体的布置规定。

Query_Text_en: 4 Internal combustion engines of a cylinder diameter of 200 mm or a crankcase volume of 0.6 m3 and above shall be provided with crankcase explosion relief valves of a suitable type with sufficient relief area .
Translation: 气缸直径为200毫米或曲轴箱容积为0.6立方米及以上的内燃机应配备适当类型且泄压面积足够的曲轴箱爆炸泄压阀。

Query_Text_en: The relief valves shall be arranged or provided with means to ensure that discharge from them is so directed as to minimize the possibility of injury to personnel .
Translation: 安全阀应布置或配备相应装置，确保其排放方向能够最大限度地减少人员受伤的可能性。

Query_Text_en: 5 Main turbine propulsion machinery and , where applicable , main internal combustion propulsion machinery and auxiliary machinery shall be provided with automatic shutoff arrangements in the case of failures such as lubricating oil supply failure which could lead rapidly to complete breakdown , serious damage or explosion .
Translation: 主推进涡轮机械以及适用时的主内燃机推进机械和辅助机械应设置自动关闭装置，以应对润滑剂供应故障等可能导致完全失效、严重损坏或爆炸的故障情况。

Query_Text_en: The Administration may permit provisions for overriding automatic shutoff devices .
Translation: 行政部门可能允许制定绕过自动关闭装置的条款。

Query_Text_en: 1 Sufficient power for going astern shall be provided to secure proper control of the ship in all normal circumstances .
Translation: 应提供倒航所需的充足动力，以确保船舶在所有正常情况下得到有效控制。

Query_Text_en: 2 The ability of the machinery to reverse the direction of thrust of the propeller in sufficient time , and so to bring the ship to rest within a reasonable distance from maximum ahead service speed , shall be demonstrated and recorded .
Translation: 船舶应通过试验并记录结果，证明其机械装置能够在足够时间内反转螺旋桨推力方向，并能在从最大前进服务速度到完全停止的过程中，在合理距离内使船舶停稳。

Query_Text_en: 3 The stopping times , ship headings and distances recorded on trials , together with the results of trials to determine the ability of ships having multiple propellers to navigate and maneuver with one or more propellers inoperative , shall be available on board for the use of the master or designated personnel .
Translation: 停车时间、船舶航向及试验中记录的距离，以及为确定船舶在多个螺旋桨中一个或多个失效时的航行和操纵能力而进行的试验结果，应存放在船上供船长或指定人员使用。

Query_Text_en: 4 Where the ship is provided with supplementary means for manoeuvring or stopping , the effectiveness of such means shall be demonstrated and recorded as referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3 .
Translation: 若船舶配备有辅助操纵或停船手段，应按照本规则第2款和第3款的要求，验证并记录这些手段的有效性。

Query_Text_en: 1 Unless expressly provided otherwise , every ship shall be provided with a main steering gear and an auxiliary steering gear to the satisfaction of the Administration .
Translation: 除非另有规定，每一艘船舶应配备主操舵装置和辅操舵装置，且须符合主管机关的要求。

Query_Text_en: The main steering gear and the auxiliary steering gear shall be so arranged that the failure of one of them will not render the other one inoperative .
Translation: 主操舵装置和辅助操舵装置应布置成，当其中一个发生故障时，不会导致另一个无法工作。

Query_Text_en: 2.1 All the steering gear components and the rudder stock shall be of sound and reliable construction to the satisfaction of the Administration .
Translation: 所有舵机部件和舵杆的结构应坚固可靠，并符合主管机关的要求。

Query_Text_en: Special consideration shall be given to the suitability of any essential component which is not duplicated .
Translation: 对于任何未冗余的关键部件，应特别考虑其适用性。

Query_Text_en: Any such essential component shall , where appropriate , utilize antifriction beatings such as ball-bearings , roller-beatings or sleeve-bearings which shall be permanently lubricated or provided with lubrication fittings .
Translation: 任何此类关键部件在适当情况下应采用抗摩擦轴承（如滚珠轴承、滚柱轴承或滑动轴承），并应具备永久润滑功能或配备润滑装置。

Query_Text_en: 2.2 The design pressure for calculations to determine the scantlings of piping and other steering gear components subjected to internal hydraulic pressure shall be at least 1.25 times the maximum working pressure to be expected under the operational conditions specified in paragraph 3.2 , taking into account any pressure which may exist in the low-pressure side of the system .
Translation: 进行管道及相关舵机部件尺寸计算时所采用的设计压力，应至少为第三.2款规定操作条件下预期最大工作压力的1.25倍，并需考虑系统低压侧可能存在的压力。

Query_Text_en: At the discretion of the Administration , fatigue criteria shall be applied for the design of piping and components , taking into account pulsating pressures due to dynamic loads .
Translation: 由主管部门根据情况决定，在管道和部件的设计中应采用疲劳设计准则，并考虑动态载荷引起的脉动压力因素。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to the Recommendation on the provision and the display of maneuvering information on board ships [ resolution A. 60l [ 15 ] ] , the Standards for ship maneuverability [ resolution MSC .137 [ 76 ] ] , and the Explanatory notes to the standards for ship maneuverability [ MSC\/Circ .1053 ] .
Translation: 依据《船舶操纵信息的提供与显示决议》（A.601(15)）、《船舶操纵性标准》（MSC.137(76)）以及《船舶操纵性标准解释说明》（MSC通函1053号）。

Query_Text_en: ② Refer to resolution A. 415 [ XI ] on improved steering gear standards for passenger and cargo ships and resolution A. 416 [ XI ] on examination of steering gears on existing tankers .
Translation: 参见第A.415[十一]号决议《关于客船和货船改进舵机标准》及第A.416[十一]号决议《关于现有油轮舵机检验的规定》。

Query_Text_en: 2.3 Relief valves shall be fitted to any part of the hydraulic system which can be isolated and in which pressure can be generated from the power source or from external forces .
Translation: 液压系统中任何可隔离的部分均应安装安全阀，且该部分压力可能由动力源或外部力量产生。

Query_Text_en: The setting of the relief valves shall not exceed the design pressure .
Translation: 安全阀的设定值不得超过设计压力。

Query_Text_en: The valves shall be of adequate size and so arranged as to avoid an undue rise in pressure above the design pressure .
Translation: 阀门应具有足够的尺寸，并合理布置，以避免压力超过设计值时产生不适当升高。

Query_Text_en: .4 so designed that they will not be damaged at maximum astern speed ; however , this design requirement need not be proved by trials at maximum astern speed and maximum rudder angle .
Translation: 应设计为在最大倒车航速下不会受损；但无需通过最大倒车航速和最大舵角的试验来验证这一设计要求。

Query_Text_en: .3 operated by power where necessary to meet the requirements of paragraph 4.2 and in any case when the Administration requires a rudder stock of over 230 mm diameter in way of the tiller , excluding strengthening for navigation in ice .
Translation: 在必要时采用动力操作以满足第4.2款的要求，且当主管机关要求舵柄处舵杆直径（不包括冰区航行加固部分）超过230毫米时。

Query_Text_en: .2 capable of being brought into operation from a position on the navigation bridge .
Translation: .2 可从驾驶室位置启动运行。

Query_Text_en: In the event of a power failure to any one of the steering gear power units , an audible and visual alarm shall be given on the navigation bridge .
Translation: 当舵机动力装置中的任何一个发生断电时，应在驾驶台触发声光报警信号。

Query_Text_en: .3 the main steering gear is so arranged that after a single failure in its piping system or in one of the power units the defect can be isolated so that steering capability can be maintained or speedily regained .
Translation: 主操舵装置的设计应确保当其管路系统或其中一个动力单元发生单一故障时，能够将缺陷隔离，从而维持舵机能力或迅速恢复该能力。

Query_Text_en: 6.2 The Administration may , until 1 September 1986 , accept the fitting of a steering gear which has a proven record of reliability but does not comply with the requirements of paragraph 6.1.3 for a hydraulic system .
Translation: 6.2 主管机关可直至1986年9月1日接受安装具有可靠运行记录但不符合第6.1.3款对液压系统要求的舵机装置。

Query_Text_en: 6.3 Steering gears , other than of the hydraulic type , shall achieve standards equivalent to the requirements of this paragraph to the satisfaction of the Administration .
Translation: 非液压型舵机应达到等效于本款规定要求的标准，并经主管机关认可。

Query_Text_en: This does not require duplication of the steering wheel or steering lever .
Translation: 这无需复制方向盘或操纵杆。

Query_Text_en: .3 for the auxiliary steering gear , in the steering gear compartment and , if power-operated , it shall also be operable from the navigation bridge and shall be independent of the control system for the main steering gear .
Translation: 3. 辅助舵机应安装在舵机舱内；若为动力操作，则还应能从驾驶台操作，且其控制系统应独立于主舵机的控制系统。

Query_Text_en: .5 short circuit protection only shall be provided for steering gear control supply circuits .
Translation: .5 舵机控制供电电路应仅设置短路保护。

Query_Text_en: 9 The electrical power circuits and the steering gear control systems with their associated components , cables and pipes required by this regulation and by regulation 30 shall be separated as far as is practicable throughout their length .
Translation: 本法规及第30条要求的电气电路和舵机控制系统，连同其相关组件、电缆和管路，应尽可能沿其全长予以隔离。

Query_Text_en: 10 A means of communication shall be provided between the navigation bridge and the steering gear compartment .
Translation: 10 应在驾驶台和舵机舱之间设置通信设备。

Query_Text_en: .1 if the main steering gear is power-operated , be indicated on the navigation bridge .
Translation: 如果主操舵装置为动力操作，则应在驾驶室设有指示装置。

Query_Text_en: .2 be recognizable in the steering gear compartment .
Translation: 应在舵机舱内可识别。

Query_Text_en: .2 a low-level alarm for each hydraulic fluid reservoir to give the earliest practicable indication of hydraulic fluid leakage .
Translation: 2. 每个液压油箱均配备低液位警报，以便尽早指示液压油泄漏情况。

Query_Text_en: .3 a fixed storage tank having sufficient capacity to recharge at least one power actuating system including the reservoir , where the main steering gear is required to be power-operated .
Translation: .3 当主操舵装置需要动力操作时，应配备一个容量足够的固定储液罐，该储液6液罐需能够为至少一个包含蓄能器的动力驱动系统补充液体。

Query_Text_en: The storage tank shall be permanently connected by piping in such a manner that the hydraulic systems can be readily recharged from a position within the steering gear compartment and shall be provided with a contents gauge .
Translation: 储液罐应通过管道永久连接，以确保液压系统可在舵机舱内位置方便地重新加注，并应配备容量指示表。

Query_Text_en: .2 provided with suitable arrangements to ensure working access to steering gear machinery and controls .
Translation: .2 应配备适当的设施，以确保能够正常操作舵机机械和控制装置。

Query_Text_en: These arrangements shall include handrails and gratings or other nonslip surfaces to ensure suitable working conditions in the event of hydraulic fluid leakage .
Translation: 这些设施应包括护栏、格栅或其他防滑表面，以确保在液压油泄漏情况下工作条件符合要求。

Query_Text_en: 14 Where the rudder stock is required to be over 230 mm diameter in way of the tiller , excluding strengthening for navigation in ice , an alternative power supply , sufficient at least to supply the steering gear power unit which complies with the requirements of paragraph 4.2 and also its associated control system and the rudder angle indicator , shall be provided automatically , within 45 s , either from the emergency source of electrical power or from an independent source of power located in the steering gear compartment .
Translation: 当舵杆在舵柄处的直径超过230毫米（不包括冰区航行所需的加强部分）时，应能自动在45秒内通过应急电源或设在舵机室内的独立电源，向符合本章4.2款要求的舵机动力设备及其相关控制系统和舵角指示器提供足够的替代电源。

Query_Text_en: This independent source of power shall be used only for this purpose .
Translation: 本独立电源应仅用于此目的。

Query_Text_en: In every ship of 10,000 gross tonnage and upwards , the alternative power supply shall have a capacity for at least 30 min of continuous operation and in any other ship for at least 10 min .
Translation: 对于10000总吨位及以上的船舶，备用电源应具备至少30分钟的连续供电能力；其他船舶则应至少达到10分钟。

Query_Text_en: l5 In every tanker , chemical tanker or gas carrier of 10,000 gross tonnage and upwards and in every other ship of 70,000 gross tonnage and upwards , the main steering gear shall comprise two or more identical power units complying with the provisions of paragraph 6 .
Translation: 凡10,000总吨及以上的油轮、化学品运输船或气体运输船，以及70,000总吨及以上的其他船舶，其主操舵装置应配备两个或多个相同的动力单元，其设计需符合第6款规定。

Query_Text_en: .2.2 at least two identical power actuating systems which , acting simultaneously in normal operation , shall be capable of meeting the requirements of paragraph 3.2 .
Translation: 2.2 至少配备两套相同的动力驱动系统，其在正常运行时同时作用时，应能够满足第3.2款的要求。

Query_Text_en: Where necessary to comply with this requirement , interconnection of hydraulic power actuating systems shall be provided .
Translation: 为满足本要求的必要情况下，应提供液压动力执行系统的互联。

Query_Text_en: Loss of hydraulic fluid from one system shall be capable of being detected and the defective system automatically isolated so that the other actuating system or systems shall remain fully operational ;
Translation: 当一个液压系统发生油液流失时，应能检测到故障并自动隔离该系统，从而确保其他执行系统保持完全可用状态。

Query_Text_en: .3 steering gears other than of the hydraulic type shall achieve equivalent standards .
Translation: 3. 非液压式转向装置应达到等效标准。

Query_Text_en: .2 where the steering gear includes only a single rudder actuator special consideration is given to stress analysis for the design appropriate , to the material used , to the installation of sealing arrangements and to testing and inspection and to the provision of effective maintenance .
Translation: 当舵机系统仅配备单一舵机作动器时，应对设计合理性、所用材料、密封装置安装、测试检验以及有效维护措施的配备等方面给予特别重视。

Query_Text_en: In consideration of the foregoing , the Administration shall adopt regulations which include the provisions of the Guidelines for acceptance of non-duplicated rudder actuators for tankers , chemical tankers and gas carriers of 10,000 gross tonnage and above but less than 100,000 tonnes deadweight , adopted by the Organization .
Translation: 鉴于上述情况，主管机关应采纳包含本组织通过的《指南》中关于接受非冗余舵机规定的条款，适用于总吨位1万总吨及以上但载重吨不足10万吨的油船、化学品船和气体运输船。

Query_Text_en: 18 For a tanker , chemical tanker or gas carrier of 10,000 gross tonnage and upwards , but less than 70,000 tonnes deadweight , the Administration may , until 1 September 1986 , accept a steering gear system with a proven record of reliability which does not comply with the single failure criterion required for a hydraulic system in paragraph 16 .
Translation: 对于总吨位10,000吨及以上但载重吨不足70,000吨的油轮、化学品船或气体运输船，主管机关可在1986年9月1日前接受不符合第16段对液压系统规定之单一故障准则、但具有可靠运行记录的舵机系统。

Query_Text_en: .2 two independent steering gear control systems shall be provided each of which can be operated from the navigation bridge .
Translation: .2 应设置两套相互独立的舵机控制系统，每套均可在驾驶室操作。

Query_Text_en: .4 each steering gear control system , if electric , shall be served by its own separate circuit supplied from the steering gear power circuit or directly from switchboard bus bars supplying that steering gear power circuit at a point on the switchboard adjacent to the supply to the steering gear power circuit .
Translation: 每个舵机控制系统如为电动式，应由独立的专用电路供电，该电路应从舵机电源电路或直接从配电板母线引出，且该母线应位于配电板上靠近舵机电源电路供电点的位置。

Query_Text_en: 20 In addition to the requirements of paragraph 19 , in every tanker , chemical tanker or gas carrier of 40,000 gross tonnage and upwards , constructed before 1 September 1984 , the steering gear shall , not later than 1 September 1988 , be so arranged that , in the event of a single failure of the piping or of one of the power units , steering capability can be maintained or the rudder movement can be limited so that steering capability can be speedily regained .
Translation: 除第19条要求外，对于1984年9月1日前建造的4万总吨及以上的油船、化学品船或气体运输船，其舵机系统应不迟于1988年9月1日完成改装，确保在管路或其中一个动力单元发生单一故障时，能够保持舵机功能或限制舵叶动作，以便迅速恢复舵机功能。

Query_Text_en: \* Adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 467 [ XII ] .
Translation: * 根据A.467（第12届）号决议由本组织通过。

Query_Text_en: .3 an arrangement such that , where hydraulic power systems are interconnected , loss of hydraulic fluid from one system shall be detected and the defective system isolated either automatically or from the navigation bridge so that the other system remains fully operational .
Translation: 当相互连接的液压动力系统发生液压油泄漏时，应能够检测到泄漏并自动或通过驾驶台操作将故障系统进行隔离，以确保另一系统仍能保持完全可用状态。

Query_Text_en: 1 Means for indicating that the motors of electric and electric hydraulic steering gear are running shall be installed on the navigation bridge and at a suitable main machinery control position .
Translation: 应在驾驶室和适当的主要推进装置操纵位置设置电动及电动液压舵机电机运行指示装置。

Query_Text_en: 2 Each electric or electrohydraulic steering gear comprising one or more power units shall be served by at least two exclusive circuits fed directly from the main switchboard ; however , one of the circuits may be supplied through the emergency switchboard .
Translation: 每个包含一个或多个动力单元的电动或电液式舵机应由至少两条直接来自主配电板的专用电路供电；但其中一条电路可通过应急配电板供电。

Query_Text_en: An auxiliary electric or electrohydraulic steering gear associated with a main electric or electrohydraulic steering gear may be connected to one of the circuits supplying this main steering gear .
Translation: 与主电动或电液舵机相关联的辅助电动或电液舵机，可连接到为主舵机供电的其中一个电路中。

Query_Text_en: The circuits supplying an electric or electrohydraulic steering gear shall have adequate rating for supplying all motors which can be simultaneously connected to them and may be required to operate simultaneously .
Translation: 为电力或电液式转向系统供电的电路，应具备足够的额定容量，以满足同时连接到该电路的所有电动机可能同时运行的需求。

Query_Text_en: 3 Short circuit protection and an overload alarm shall be provided for such circuits and motors .
Translation: 3 对于此类电路和电动机，应设置短路保护和过载报警装置。

Query_Text_en: Protection against excess current , including starting current , if provided , shall be for not less than twice the full load current of the motor or circuit so protected , and shall be arranged to permit the passage of the appropriate starting currents .
Translation: 过电流保护（包括启动电流）若设置时，应不小于被保护电机或电路的额定负载电流的两倍，并应设计为允许相应的启动电流通过。

Query_Text_en: Where a three-phase supply is used an alarm shall be provided that will indicate failure of any one of the supply phases .
Translation: 当使用三相供电系统时，应设置报警装置，当任何一相发生故障时，该装置应能发出警报。

Query_Text_en: The alarms required in this paragraph shall be both audible and visual and shall be situated in a conspicuous position in the main machinery space or control room from which the main machinery is normally controlled and as may be required by regulation 51 .
Translation: 本段要求的报警装置应同时具备听觉和视觉功能，并应设置在主推进机器处所或通常控制主推进机器的控制室内的显眼位置，同时需符合第51条的规定。

Query_Text_en: 4 When in a ship of less than 1,600 gross tonnage an auxiliary steering gear which is required by regulation 29.4.3 to be operated by power is not electrically powered or is powered by an electric motor primarily intended for other services , the main steering gear may be fed by one circuit from the main switchboard .
Translation: 当小于1,600总吨位的船舶所配备的辅助操舵系统（根据第29.4.3条要求应由动力操作）未采用电力驱动，或其动力源自主要设计用于其他服务的电动机时，主操舵系统可由主配电板的一个电路供电。

Query_Text_en: Where such an electric motor primarily intended for other services is arranged to power such an auxiliary steering gear , the requirement of paragraph 3 may be waived by the Administration if satisfied with the protection arrangement together with the requirements of regulation 29.5.1 and .2 and 29.7.3 applicable to auxiliary steering gear .
Translation: 当主要用于其他服务的电动机被用于驱动辅助操舵装置时，若主管机关对保护装置的设置以及适用于辅助操舵装置的第29.5.1、29.5.2和29.7.3款的要求感到满意，可豁免第三段规定的要求。

Query_Text_en: 1 Main and auxiliary machinery essential for the propulsion and safety of the ship shall be provided with effective means for its operation and control .
Translation: 船舶推进和安全所必需的主推进和辅助机械应配备有效操作和控制手段。

Query_Text_en: .2 the remote control shall be performed , for each independent propeller , by a control device so designed and constructed that its operation does not require particular attention to the operational details of the machinery .
Translation: 每个独立螺旋桨的遥控操作应通过专门设计和构造的控制装置进行，其操作无需特别关注机械装置的具体运行细节。

Query_Text_en: .5 remote control of the propulsion machinery shall be possible only from one location at a time ; at such locations inter-connected control positions are permitted .
Translation: 推进机械的遥控应仅能在某一地点进行；在相互连接的控制位置之间允许进行此类操作。

Query_Text_en: 1 Unless expressly provided otherwise , this chapter shall apply to ships the keels of which are laid or which are at a similar stage of construction on or after 1 July 1998 .
Translation: 除非另有明确规定，本章规定应适用于1998年7月1日或之后安放龙骨或处于相同建造阶段的船舶。

Query_Text_en: .2 assembly of that ship has commenced comprising at least 50 tones or 1 % of the estimated mass of all structural material , whichever is less .
Translation: 该船舶的建造已启动，且已达到至少50吨或所有结构材料预估总质量的1%，以较低者为准。

Query_Text_en: .3 a cargo ship , whenever built , which is converted to a passenger ship shall be treated as a passenger ship constructed on the date on which such a conversion commences .
Translation: .3 凡货船（无论何时建造）经改建为客船的，应视为其建造日期为改建开始之日。

Query_Text_en: .2 ensure that when life-saving appliances or arrangements on such ships are replaced or such ships undergo repairs , alterations or modifications of a major character which involve replacement of , or any addition to , their existing life-saving appliances or arrangements , such life-saving appliances or arrangements , in so far as is reasonable and practicable , comply with the requirements of this chapter .
Translation: 当此类船舶更换救生设备或装置，或进行涉及救生设备或装置更换、新增等重大性质的修理、改装或改造时，其救生设备或装置应尽可能符合本章规定的要求。

Query_Text_en: However , if a survival craft other than an inflatable liferaft is replaced without replacing its launching appliance , or vice versa , the survival craft or launching appliance may be of the same type as that replaced .
Translation: 但是，若更换除充气式救生筏以外的救生艇时未同时更换其吊放装置，或者反之，更换吊放装置而未更换救生艇，则所更换的救生艇或吊放装置可以与被替换的同类型。

Query_Text_en: 1 The Administration may , if it considers that the sheltered nature and conditions of the voyage are such as to render the application of any specific requirements of this chapter unreasonable or unnecessary , exempt from those requirements individual ships or classes of ships which , in the course of their voyage , do not proceed more than 20 miles from the nearest land .
Translation: 主管机关如认为某次航行的受保护性质和条件使得本章任何具体要求的适用变得不合理或没有必要，可对在其航行过程中未超过距最近陆地20海里的特定船舶或船级，豁免其遵守这些要求。

Query_Text_en: .2 the roles annexed to the Protocol on Space Requirements for Special Trade Passenger Ships , 1973 .
Translation: 1973年特种贸易客船空间标准议定书所附的附件。

Query_Text_en: 1 Anti-exposure suit is a protective suit designed for use by rescue boat crews and marine evacuation system parties .
Translation: 防暴露服是专为救生艇船员及船舶紧急撤离系统操作人员设计的防护服。

Query_Text_en: 2 Certificated person is a person who holds a certificate of proficiency in survival craft issued under the authority of , or recognized as valid by , the Administration in accordance with the requirements of the International Convention on Standards of Training , Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers , in force ; or a person who holds a certificate issued or recognized by the Administration of a State not a Party to that Convention for the same purpose as the convention certificate .
Translation: "经认证人员"是指持有依据现行有效的《海员培训、发证和值班标准国际公约》要求，由主管机关颁发或经其认可的救生艇操作熟练证书的人员；或是持有未加入该公约的国家主管机关为相同目的签发或认可的具有同等效力证书的人员。

Query_Text_en: 3 Detection is the determination of the location of survivors or survival craft .
Translation: 3 检测是指确定幸存者或救生艇的位置。

Query_Text_en: 4 Embarkation ladder is the ladder provided at survival craft embarkation stations to permit safe access to survival craft after launching .
Translation: 登乘梯是指设置于救生艇筏登乘站处，以便在释放后安全登乘救生艇筏的梯子。

Query_Text_en: 5 Float-free launching is that method of launching a survival craft whereby the craft is automatically released from a sinking ship and is ready for use .
Translation: 浮离式释放是一种救生艇的释放方式，即当救生艇自动脱离正在下沉的船舶后，即可立即投入使用。

Query_Text_en: 6 Free-fall launching is that method of launching a survival craft whereby the craft with its omplement of persons and equipment on board is released and allowed to fall into the sea without any restraining apparatus .
Translation: 自由降落式释放是指在救生艇满载额定乘员和设备的情况下，将其释放并允许无任何限制装置落入海中的救生艇释放方式。

Query_Text_en: 7 Immersion suit is a protective suit which reduces the body heat loss of a person wearing it in cold water .
Translation: 浸水服是一种防护服，可在冷水中穿着时减少人体热量散失。

Query_Text_en: 8 Inflatable appliance is an appliance which depends upon non-rigid , gas-filled chambers for buoyancy and which is normally kept uninflected until ready for use .
Translation: 可充气装置是一种依靠非刚性气体填充舱室提供浮力的器具，通常在使用前保持未充气状态。

Query_Text_en: 9 Inflated appliance is an appliance which depends upon non-rigid , gas-failed chambers for buoyancy and which is kept inflated and ready for use at all times .
Translation: 充气装置是一种依靠非刚性气体填充舱室提供浮力的设备，其始终保持充气状态并处于可用状态。

Query_Text_en: 10 International Life-Saving Appliance [ LSA ] Code [ referred to as `` the Code '' in this chapter ] means the International Life-Saving Appliance [ LSA ] Code adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization by solution MSC .48 [ 66 ] , as it may be amended by the Organization , provided that such amendments are adopted , brought into force and take fact in accordance with the provisions of article VIII of the present Convention concerning the amendment procedures applicable to the annex other than chapter I.
Translation: 国际救生设备规则[LSA规则]（在本章中简称为"规则"）系指国际海事组织海事安全委员会以MSC.48(66)决议形式通过的《国际救生设备规则》，并根据本组织可能对其进行的修订，前提是此类修订须按照本公约第八条关于除第一章外附则修正程序的规定获得通过、生效并实施。

Query_Text_en: 11 Launching appliance or arrangement is a means of transferring a survival craft or rescue boat from its stowed position safely to the water .
Translation: 释放装置或布置是指用于将救生艇或救援艇从存放位置安全转移到水中的设备。

Query_Text_en: 12 Length is 96 % of the total length on a waterline at 85 % of the least moulded depth measured from the top of the keel , or the length from the fore-side of the stem to the axis of the rudder stock on that waterline , if that be greater .
Translation: 船舶长度为自龙骨上缘量起最小型深85%处水线上的全长的96%，或若从船首柱前缘至舵杆轴线在该水线上的长度更大，则取该长度。

Query_Text_en: In ships designed with a rake of keel the waterline on which this is measured shall be parallel to the designed waterline .
Translation: 在设计有龙骨前倾的船舶中，进行测量的水线应与设计水线保持平行。

Query_Text_en: 13 Lightest seagoing condition is the loading condition with the ship on even keel , without cargo , with 10 % stores and fuel remaining and in the case of a passenger ship with the full number of passengers and crew and their luggage .
Translation: 最轻航次状态是指船舶处于平吃水状态且无货物装载时的载重情况，此时剩余10%的物料和燃料；对于客船而言，则包括全部乘客、船员及其行李。

Query_Text_en: 14 Marine evacuation system is an appliance for the rapid transfer of persons from the embarkation deck of a ship to a floating survival craft .
Translation: 海上撤离系统是一种用于快速将人员从船舶的登乘甲板转移至漂浮救生艇的装置。

Query_Text_en: .1 The moulded depth is the vertical distance measured from the top of the keel to the top of the freeboard deck beam at side .
Translation: 型深是从龙骨上缘到船舷处甲板边线的垂直距离。

Query_Text_en: In wood and composite ships the distance is measured from the lower edge of the keel rabbet .
Translation: 在木制和复合材料船舶中，距离的测量起始于龙骨槽的下缘。

Query_Text_en: Where the form at the lower part of the midship section is of a hollow character , or where thick garboards are fitted , the distance is measured from the point where the line of the flat of the bottom continued inwards cuts the side of the keel .
Translation: 当中体部分下部的形状呈凹形结构，或安装有厚舭板时，距离应从船底平板线向内延伸并与龙骨侧边相交的点开始测量。

Query_Text_en: .2 In ships having rounded gunwales , the moulded depth shall be measured to the point of intersection of the moulded lines of the deck and side shell plating , the lines extending as though the gunwale were of angular design .
Translation: 在具有圆弧形舷墙的船舶中，型深应测量至甲板与舷侧外板型线交点处，型线按直角设计延伸。

Query_Text_en: .3 Where the freeboard deck is stepped and the raised part of the deck extends over the point at which the moulded depth is to be determined , the moulded depth shall be measured to a line of reference extending from the lower part of the deck along a line parallel with the raised part .
Translation: 当干舷甲板呈阶梯形且甲板的上层部分延伸超过确定型深的位置时，型深应测量至一条参考线，该参考线从甲板下部沿与上层部分平行的线延伸。

Query_Text_en: 16 Novel life-saving appliance or arrangement is a life-saving appliance or arrangement which embodies new features not fully covered by the provisions of this chapter or the Code but which provides an equal or higher standard of safety .
Translation: 新型救生设备或装置是指具备本章或《规则》的相关规定未完全涵盖的新特征，但能提供同等或更高安全标准的救生设备或装置。

Query_Text_en: 17 Positive stability is the ability of a craft to return to its original position after the removal of a heeling moment .
Translation: 17 正稳性是指船舶在横倾力矩被消除后恢复到其原始位置的能力。

Query_Text_en: 18 Recovery time for a rescue boat is the time required to raise the boat to a position where persons on board can disembark to the deck of the ship .
Translation: 救生艇的回收时间是指将救生艇提升至艇上人员能够登船甲板所需的时间。

Query_Text_en: Recovery time includes the time required to make preparations for recovery on board the rescue boat such as passing and securing a painter , connecting the rescue boat to the launching appliance , and the time to raise the rescue boat .
Translation: 回收时间包括在救援艇上进行回收准备所需的时间，例如传递并固定引缆、将救援艇与吊放设备连接，以及回收救援艇所需的时间。

Query_Text_en: Recovery time does not include the time needed to lower the launching appliance into position to recover the rescue boat .
Translation: 回收时间不包括将发射装置下放至就位以便回收救生艇所需的时间。

Query_Text_en: 19 Rescue boat is a boat designed to rescue persons in distress and to marshal survival craft .
Translation: 救援艇是指专门用于营救遇险人员并引导救生艇筏的救生艇。

Query_Text_en: 20 Retrieval is the safe recovery of survivors .
Translation: 20 救援是指安全救出幸存者。

Query_Text_en: 21 Ro-ro passenger ship means a passenger ship with ro-ro cargo spaces or special category spaces as defined in regulation II-2 \/ 3 .
Translation: 21 滚装客船指配备有滚装货舱或根据第II-2/3条定义的特殊类别舱室的客船。

Query_Text_en: 22 Short international voyage is an international voyage in the course of which a ship is not more than 200 miles from a port or place in which the passengers and crew could be placed in safety .
Translation: 短程国际航行是指在航行过程中，船舶始终距离可使乘客和船员得到安全安置的港口或地点不超过200海里的国际航行。

Query_Text_en: Neither the distance between the last port of call in the country in which the voyage begins and the final port of destination nor the return voyage shall exceed 600 miles .
Translation: 无论是从航行起始国最后一个挂靠港至最终目的港之间的航程距离，还是返航航程，均不得超过600海里。

Query_Text_en: The final port of destination is the last port of call in the scheduled voyage at which the ship commences its return voyage to the country in which the voyage began .
Translation: 最终目的地港口是预定航程中船舶开始返航至起航国的最后一个停靠港。

Query_Text_en: 23 Survival craft is a craft capable of sustaining the lives of persons in distress from the time of abandoning the ship .
Translation: 23. 救生设备是指自弃船之时起能够维持遇险人员生命的救生艇、救助艇或救生筏等设备。

Query_Text_en: 24 Thermal protective aid is a bag or suit made of waterproof material with low thermal conductance .
Translation: 24 热防护装备是一种采用防水且导热性低的材料制成的袋子或防护服。

Query_Text_en: 1 Except as provided in paragraphs 5 and 6 , life-saving appliances and arrangements required by this chapter shall be approved by the Administration .
Translation: 除本章第5款和第6款另有规定外，本章要求配备的救生设备和布置应经主管机关批准。

Query_Text_en: .2 have successfully undergone , to the satisfaction of the Adminiteration , tests which are substantially equivalent to those specified in those recommendations .
Translation: .2 已成功完成经相关管理部门认可的测试，且该测试与上述建议中规定的测试实质等同。

Query_Text_en: .2 have successfully undergone , to the satisfaction of the Adminstriation , evaluation and tests which are substantially equivalent to those recommendations .
Translation: 2. 已成功完成主管部门认可的评估和测试，这些评估和测试实质上等同于相关建议。

Query_Text_en: 4 Procedures adopted by the Administration for approval shall also include the conditions whereby approval would continue or would be withdrawn .
Translation: 4. 管理部门采用的审批程序应包括审批维持或撤销的具体条件。

Query_Text_en: 5 Before accepting life-saving appliances and arrangements that have not been previously approved by the Administration , the Administration shall be satisfied that life-saving appliances and arrangements comply with the requirements of this chapter and the Code .
Translation: 在未获主管机关先前批准的救生设备和装置投入使用前，主管机关应确信此类设备和装置符合本章及《规则》的要求。

Query_Text_en: 6 Life-saving appliances required by this chapter for which detailed specifications are not included in the Code shall be to the satisfaction of the Administration .
Translation: 本章要求配备的救生设备，其详细规格未在本法规中列明的，须经主管机关认可。

Query_Text_en: The Administration shall require life-saving appliances to be subjected to such production tests as are necessary to ensure that the life-saving appliances are manufactured to the same standard as the approved prototype .
Translation: 主管部门应当要求救生设备接受必要的生产检验，以确保其制造标准与经批准的原型一致。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to the Recommendation on testing of life-saving appliances adopted by the Organzation by resolution A. 689 [ 17 ] .
Translation: 参见该组织通过第A.689[17]号决议采纳的《救生设备试验建议》。

Query_Text_en: For life-saving appliances installed on board on or after 1 July 1999 , refer to the Revised Recommendations on testing of life-saving appliances adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization by resolution MSC .81 [ 70 ] .
Translation: 对于1999年7月1日或以后船上安装的救生设备，应参考国际海事组织海上安全委员会以MSC.81(70)号决议通过的《关于救生设备试验的修订建议》。

Query_Text_en: Refer to the Code of Practice for the Evaluation , Testing and Acceptance of Prototype Novel Life-Saving Appliances and Arrangements adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 520 [ 13 ] .
Translation: 参见本组织通过第A.520（13）号决议采纳的《新型样机救生设备及其布置的评估、测试和验收操作守则》。

Query_Text_en: 1 Paragraph 2 applies to all passenger ships and to all cargo ships of 300 gross tonnage and upwards .
Translation: 第二款适用于所有客船以及300总吨及以上的货船。

Query_Text_en: 2.1.1 At least 3 two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus shall be provided on every passenger ship and on every cargo ship of 500 gross tonnage and upwards .
Translation: 2.1.1 每艘客船以及500总吨及以上的货船均应配备至少3台双向甚高频无线电话装置。

Query_Text_en: At least , 2 two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus shall be provided on every cargo ship of 300 gross tonnage and upwards but less than 500 gross tonnage .
Translation: 每艘300总吨及以上但不足500总吨的货船应至少配备2台双向甚高频无线电电话装置。

Query_Text_en: Such apparatus shall conform to performance standards not inferior to those adopted by the Organization . \*
Translation: 此类设备应符合不低于该组织所采用的性能标准。

Query_Text_en: If a fixed two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus is fitted in a survival craft it shall conform to performance standards not inferior to those adopted by the Organization . \*
Translation: 如果救生艇中配备有固定式VHF双向无线电装置，则其性能标准应不低于国际组织所制定的标准。

Query_Text_en: 2.1.2 Two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus provided on board ships prior to 1 February 1992 and not complying fully with the performances standards adopted by the Organization may be accepted by the Administration until 1 February 1999 provided the Administration is satisfied that they are compatible with approved two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus .
Translation: 1992年2月1日之前配备在船舶上的双向VHF无线电话装置，若未完全符合国际组织采纳的性能标准，可由主管机关接受直至1999年2月1日，但需确保其与经批准的双向VHF无线电话装置兼容。

Query_Text_en: At least one radar transponders shall be carried on each side of every passenger ship and of every cargo ship of 500 gross tonnage and upwards .
Translation: 每艘客船以及每艘500总吨及以上的货船应至少配备1台雷达应答器。

Query_Text_en: At least one radar transponder shall be carried on every cargo ship of 300 gross tonnage and upwards but less than 500 gross tonnage .
Translation: 所有300总吨及以上但不满500总吨的货船均应配备至少一台雷达应答器。

Query_Text_en: Such radar transponders shall conform to performance standards not inferior to those adopted by the Organization .
Translation: 此类雷达应答器的性能标准应不低于国际组织所采用的标准。

Query_Text_en: The radar transponders ③ shall be stowed in such locations that they can be rapidly placed in any survival craft other than the liferaft or liferafts required by regulation 31.1.4 .
Translation: 雷达应答器③应存放在可快速将其放入除根据第31.1.4条规定的救生筏以外的任何救生艇筏的位置。

Query_Text_en: Alternatively one radar transponder shall be stowed in each survival craft other than those required by regulation 31.1.4 .
Translation: 除第31.1.4条要求的救生艇外，每一艘其他救生艇应配备一个雷达应答器。

Query_Text_en: On ships carrying at least two radar transponders and equipped with free-fall lifeboats one of the radar transponders shall be stowed in a free-fall lifeboat and the other located in the immediate vicinity of the navigation bridge so that it can be utilized on board and ready for transfer to any of the other survival craft .
Translation: 配备至少两台雷达应答器并设有自由降落式救生艇的船舶，其中一台雷达应答器应存放于自由降落式救生艇内，另一台应置于驾驶台附近，确保其可在船上使用，并随时准备转移至其他救生艇。

Query_Text_en: Not less than 12 rocket parachute flares , complying with the requirements of section 3.1 of the Code , shall be carried and be stowed on or near the navigation bridge .
Translation: 船舶应配备并存放不少于12枚符合本规则第3.1节要求的火箭降落伞火焰信号，存放位置应位于驾驶室或其附近。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to the Performance standards for survival craft two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 809 [ 19 ] , as it may be amended , annex 1 or annex 2 as applicable .
Translation: 参考国际海事组织通过的A.809[19]号决议（如有修订）批准的《救生艇双工信道甚高频无线电话装置性能标准》，适用时应参照相应附件1或附件2。

Query_Text_en: ② Refer to the Performance standards for survival craft radar transponders for use in search and rescue operations adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 802 [ 19 ] , as may by amended .
Translation: 根据国际海事组织通过的A.802（19）号决议采纳的搜救行动中使用的救生艇雷达应答器性能标准，以及可能的修订。

Query_Text_en: ③ One of these radar transponders may be the radar transponder required by re regulation IV/7 .1.3 .
Translation: 这些雷达应答器中的一台可能是根据第IV/7.1.3款规定的要求配备的雷达应答器。

Query_Text_en: 4.1 An emergency means comprised of either fixed or portable equipment or both shall be provided for two-way communications between emergency control stations , muster and embarkation stations and strategic positions on board .
Translation: 4.1 应配备由固定式或便携式设备（或两者组合）组成的应急通信手段，以实现应急控制站、集合站和登乘站以及船上关键位置之间的双向通信。

Query_Text_en: 4.2 A general emergency alarm system complying with the requirements of paragraph 7.2.1 of the Code shall be provided and shall be used for summoning passengers and crew to muster stations and to initiate the actions included in the muster list .
Translation: 船舶应配备符合《规则》第7.2.1款要求的通用应急报警系统，并用于召集乘客和船员前往集合站以及启动应变部署表中规定的行动。

Query_Text_en: The system shall be supplemented by either a public address system complying with the requirements of paragraph 7.2.2 of the Code or other suitable means of communication .
Translation: 该系统应配备符合本规范第7.2.2款要求的公共广播系统，或采用其他适当的通信手段。

Query_Text_en: Entertainment sound systems shall automatically be turned off when the general emergency alarm system is activated .
Translation: 当总体应急报警系统启动时，娱乐音响系统应自动关闭。

Query_Text_en: 4.3 On passenger ships the general emergency alarm system shall be audible on all open decks .
Translation: 4.3 客船上，通用紧急报警系统应在所有露天甲板上能够听到。

Query_Text_en: 4.4 On ships fitted with a marine evacuation system communication between the embarkation station and the platform or the survival craft shall be ensured .
Translation: 4.4 在配备海上撤离系统的船舶上，应确保登乘站与平台或救生艇之间的通信。

Query_Text_en: 5.1 In addition to the requirements of regulation II-2 \/ 40.5 \* or regulation II-2 \/ 41-2 \* , as appropriate , and of paragraph 4.2 , all passenger ships shall be fitted with a public address system .
Translation: 除了适用的II-2章/40.5*或II-2章/41-2*条要求，以及第4.2款的规定外，所有客船应配备公共广播系统。

Query_Text_en: With respect to passenger ships constructed before 1 July 1997 the requirements of paragraphs 5.2 and 5.4 , subject to the provisions of paragraph 5.5 , shall apply not later than the date of the first periodical survey after l July 1997 .
Translation: 对于1997年7月1日前建造的客船，第5.2款和第5.4款的要求应适用，且适用时间不晚于1997年7月后首次定期检验之日，具体需遵循第5.5款的规定。

Query_Text_en: 5.2 The public address system shall be clearly audible above the ambient noise in all spaces , prescribed by paragraph 7.2.2.1 of the Code , and shall be provided with an override function controlled from one location on the navigation bridge and such other places on board as the Administration deems necessary , so that all emergency messages will be broadcast if any loudspeaker in the spaces concerned has been switched off , its volume has been turned down or the public address system is used for other purposes .
Translation: 公共广播系统在按照《规则》第7.2.2.1款规定的所有区域，均需确保其声音清晰高于环境噪音，并应配备由驾驶台一处位置或其他经主管机关认定必要的船上位置控制的覆盖功能，以确保当相关区域内的扬声器被关闭、音量调低或公共广播系统被用于其他用途时，仍能广播所有紧急信息。

Query_Text_en: .2 the public address system and its performance standards shall be approved by the Administration having regard to the room-mendations adopted by the Organization .
Translation: 2. 公共广播系统及其性能标准应由主管机关批准，并应考虑本组织采纳的建议。

Query_Text_en: 5.4 The public address system shall be connected to the emergency source of electrical power required by regulation II-1 \/ 42.2.2 .
Translation: 5.4 公共广播系统应连接至法规II-1/42.2.2要求的应急电源。

Query_Text_en: 5.5 Ships constructed before 1 July 1997 which are already fitted with the public address system approved by the Administration which compiles substantially with those required by sections 5.2 and 5.4 and paragraph 7.2.2.1 of the Code are not required to change their system .
Translation: 1997年7月1日前建造的船舶，若已配备经主管机关批准的公共广播系统，并且该系统基本符合《规则》第5.2和5.4节以及第7.2.2.1款的要求，则无需更换其现有系统。

Query_Text_en: \* These relate to the chapter II-2 in force before 1July 2002 . The equivalent for each in the amended chapter II-2 is 12.3 .
Translation: * 这些内容涉及2002年7月1日之前有效的第II-2章。修订后的第II-2章中对应的条款均为12.3。

Query_Text_en: ② Refer to MSC/Circ .808 , Recommendation on performance standards for public address systems on passenger ships , including cabling .
Translation: ② 参见MSC通函808号：关于客船公共广播系统（包括布线系统）性能标准的建议。

Query_Text_en: .2 so stowed as to be capable of being rapidly cast loose , and not permanently secured in any way .
Translation: .2 存放方式应确保能够迅速解除固定，且未以任何形式永久固定。

Query_Text_en: 1.2 At least one lifebuoy on each side of the ship shall be fitted with a buoyant lifeline complying with the requirements of paragraph 2.1.4 of the Code equal in length to not less than twice the height at which it is stowed above the waterline in the lightest seagoing condition , or 30 m , whichever is the greater .
Translation: 船舶每舷至少应配备1具符合《规则》第2.1.4款要求并配备浮力救生索的救生圈，其长度应不小于存放位置至船舶最轻载航行状态水线间高度的2倍，或30米，取两者中较大者。

Query_Text_en: lifebuoys with lights and those with lights and smoke signals shall be equally distributed on both sides of the ship and shall not be the lifebuoys provided with lifelines in compliance with the requirements of paragraph 1.2 .
Translation: 配备自亮灯的救生圈以及配备自亮灯和烟雾信号的救生圈应均匀分布在船舶两侧，并不得为按照第1.2款要求配备有救生索的救生圈。

Query_Text_en: 1.4 Each lifebuoy shall be marked in block capitals of the Roman alphabet with the name and port of registry of the ship on which it is carried .
Translation: 每个救生圈应使用罗马字母大写正体字标明所配备船舶的船名和注册港。

Query_Text_en: .2 a sufficient number of lifejackets shall be carried for persons on watch and for use at remotely located survival craft stations .
Translation: .2 应为值班人员及偏远救生设备存放点配备足够数量的救生衣。

Query_Text_en: The lifejackets carried for persons on watch should be stowed on the bridge , in the engine control room and at any other manned watch station .
Translation: 值班人员使用的救生衣应存放在驾驶室、机控室以及其他有人值守的值班岗位。

Query_Text_en: 2.2 Lifejackets shall be so placed as to be readily accessible and their position shall be plainly indicated .
Translation: 2.2 救生衣应放置在易于取用的位置，其存放位置应明确标示。

Query_Text_en: Where , due to the particular arrangements of the ship , the lifejackets provided in compliance with the requirements of paragraph 2.1 may become inaccessible , alternative provisions shall be made to the satisfaction of the Administration which , may include an increase in the number of lifejackets to be carried .
Translation: 由于船舶特殊布置导致按照第2.1款要求配备的救生衣可能无法取用时，应采取令主管机关满意的替代措施，其中包括增加需配备的救生衣数量。

Query_Text_en: 2.3 The lifejackets used in totally enclosed lifeboats , except free-fall lifeboats , shall not impede entry into the lifeboat or seating , including operation of the seat belts in the lifeboat .
Translation: 全封闭式救生艇（自由降落式救生艇除外）所使用的救生衣，不得妨碍进入救生艇或就座，包括救生艇内安全带的操作。

Query_Text_en: 2.4 Lifejackets selected for free-fall lifeboats , and the manner in which they are carried or worn , shall not interfere with entry into the lifeboat occupant safety or operation of the lifeboat .
Translation: 选用的自由降落救生艇用救生衣及其携带或穿着方式，不得妨碍进入救生艇、艇员安全或救生艇操作。

Query_Text_en: An immersion suit , complying with the requirements of section 2.3 of the Code or an anti-exposure suit complying with section 2.4 of the Code , of an appropriate size , shall be provided for every person assigned to crew the rescue boat or assigned to the marine evacuation system party .
Translation: 为被指定操作救生艇或参与海上撤离系统工作的每名人员，应配备适当尺寸的符合规则第2.3节要求的浸水服，或符合规则第2.4节要求的防暴露服。

Query_Text_en: If the ship is constantly engaged in warm climates \* where , in the opinion of the Administration thermal protection is unnecessary , this protective clothing need not be carried .
Translation: 如果船舶常年航行于根据主管机关意见无需热防护的温暖气候区域，则无需配备此类防护服。

Query_Text_en: 1 This regulation applies to all ships .
Translation: 本规定适用于所有船舶。

Query_Text_en: 2 Clear instructions to be followed in the event of an emergency shall be provided for every person on board .
Translation: 2. 紧急情况下船上每位人员均应获得需遵循的明确指示。

Query_Text_en: In the case of passenger ships these instructions shall be drawn up in the language or languages required by the ship 's flag State and in the English language .
Translation: 对于客船，本操作指南应使用船旗国所要求的一种或多种语言以及英语制定。

Query_Text_en: 3 Muster lists and emergency instructions complying with the requirements of regulation 37 shall be exhibited in conspicuous places throughout the ship including the navigation bridge , engine-room and crew accommodation spaces .
Translation: 符合第37条规定的应变部署表和应急指南应在全船显眼位置展示，包括驾驶台、机舱和船员生活区。

Query_Text_en: .3 the method of donning lifejackets .
Translation: 救生衣的穿戴方法。

Query_Text_en: 3 use symbols in accordance with the recommendations of the Organization .
Translation: 3. 使用符号应遵循该组织的规范。

Query_Text_en: 2 There shall be a sufficient number of trained persons on board for mustering and assisting untrained persons .
Translation: 船上应配备足够数量的受过训练人员，负责组织和协助未受训人员。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to MSC\/Circ .1046 , Guidelines for the assessment of thermal protection .
Translation: 参考MSC/Circ.1046，《热防护评估指南》。
