Query_Text_en: Refer to the Symbols related to life-saving appliances and arrangements adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 760 [ 18 ] , as amended by resolution MSC .82 [ 70 ] .
Translation: 参阅本组织通过的A.760[18]号决议所采纳的与救生设备和布置有关的标志，并根据MSC.82[70]号决议进行的修正。

Query_Text_en: 3 There shall be a sufficient number of crew members , who may be deck officers or certificated persons , on board for operating the survival craft and launching arrangements required for abandonment by the total number of persons on board .
Translation: 船上应配备足够数量的船员（可以是甲板部船员或持证人员），负责操作弃船时所需的救生设备及释放装置，其数量应满足船上总人数弃船的要求。

Query_Text_en: 4 A deck officer or certificated person shall be placed in charge of each survival craft to be used .
Translation: 4 每艘需使用的救生艇应指派甲板官员或持证人员负责。

Query_Text_en: However , the Administration , having due regard to the nature of the voyage , the number of persons on board and the characteristics of the ship , may permit persons practiced in the handling and operation of liferafts to be placed in charge of life rafts in lieu of persons qualified as above .
Translation: 然而，主管部门在综合考虑航行性质、船上人数及船舶特性后，可允许具备救生筏操作经验的人员负责管理救生筏，替代上述具备资格的人员。

Query_Text_en: A second-in-command shall also be nominated in the case of lifeboats .
Translation: 救生艇也应指定一名副指挥。

Query_Text_en: 5 The person in charge of the survival craft shall have a list of the survival craft crew and shall see that the crew under his command are acquainted with their duties .
Translation: 救生艇负责人应备有救生艇船员名单，并确保所属船员熟悉其职责。

Query_Text_en: In lifeboats the second-in-command shall also have a list of the lifeboat crew .
Translation: 救生艇的副手也应持有一份救生艇船员名单。

Query_Text_en: 6 Every motorized survival craft shall have a person assigned who is capable of operating the engine and carrying out minor adjustments .
Translation: 每艘机动救生艇应指定一名能够操作发动机并进行简单调整的人员。

Query_Text_en: 7 The master shall ensure the equitable distribution of persons referred to in paragraphs 2 , 3 and 4 among the ship 's survival craft .
Translation: 船长应确保第二、三、四段所述人员在船舶救生艇中合理分配。

Query_Text_en: 1 Lifeboats and liferafts for which approved launching appliances are required shall be stowed as close to accommodation and service spaces possible .
Translation: 配备经批准的降落设备的救生艇和救生筏应尽可能靠近居住处所和服务处所存放。

Query_Text_en: 2 Muster stations shall be provided close to the embarkation stations .
Translation: 应在登船点附近设置2个集合站。

Query_Text_en: Each muster station shall have sufficient clear deck space to accommodate all persons assigned to muster at that station , but at least 0.35 m2 per person .
Translation: 每个集合站应配备足够的净甲板空间，以容纳分配到该集合站的所有人员，且每人至少0.35平方米。

Query_Text_en: 3 Muster and embarkation stations shall be readily accessible from accommodation and work areas .
Translation: 3 集合登船站应能方便地从居住区和工作区到达。

Query_Text_en: 4 Muster and embarkation stations shall be adequately illuminated by lighting supplied from the emergency source of electrical power required by regulation II-1 \/ 42 or II-1 \/ 43 , as appropriate .
Translation: 集合站和登乘站应由应急电源（依据法规II-1/42或II-1/43）提供充足的照明，以确保适用的能见度要求。

Query_Text_en: 5 Alleyways , stairways and exits giving access to the muster and embarkation stations shall be lighted .
Translation: 第5条 通往集合和登船站的通道、楼梯间和出口应设置照明。

Query_Text_en: Such lighting shall be capable of being supplied by the emergency source of electrical power required by regulation II-1 \/ 42 or II-1 \/ 43 , as appropriate .
Translation: 此类照明应能够由法规II-1/42或II-1/43所要求的应急电源供电，视情况而定。

Query_Text_en: In addition to and as part of the markings required under regulation II-2 / 28.1.10 , ① routes to muster stations shall be indicated with the muster station symbol , intended for that purpose , in accordance with the recommendations of the Organization .
Translation: 除并作为《国际海上人命安全公约》第II-2章28.1.10条要求的标识外，①通往集合站的路线应按照本组织的建议，采用专门为此设计的集合站标识符号进行标示。

Query_Text_en: 6 Davit-launched and free-fall launched survival craft muster and embarkation stations shall be so arranged as to enable stretcher cases to be placed in survival craft .
Translation: 吊臂式投放和自由下落式救生艇的集合与登乘站应布置妥当，以确保担架病人可被安置于救生艇内。

Query_Text_en: 7 An embarkation ladder complying with the requirements of paragraph 6.1.6 of the Code extending , in a single length , from the deck to the waterline in the lightest seagoing condition under unfavorable conditions of trim of up to 10 and a list of up to 20 either way shall be provided at each embarkation station or at every two adjacent embarkation stations for survival craft launched down the side of the ship .
Translation: 船舶每舷侧降落的救生艇筏的每个登乘站或每两个相邻登乘站应配备符合《规则》第6.1.6款要求的登船梯。该梯道应在船舶最轻载航行状态下，一次性从甲板延伸至水线，并能在吃水差不超过10度、任一侧横倾不超过20度的不利情况下正常使用。

Query_Text_en: However , the Administration may permit such ladders to be replaced by approved devices to afford access to the survival craft when waterborne , provided that there shal1 be at least one embarkation ladder on each side of the ship .
Translation: 主管机关可准许使用经批准的装置替代上述登乘梯，以在救生艇筏处于水中时提供登乘通道，但船舶每一舷应至少设置一个登乘梯。

Query_Text_en: Other means of embarkation enabling descent to the water in a controlled manner may be permitted for the liferafts required by regulation 31.1.4 .
Translation: 根据第31.1.4条规定的救生筏，可允许采用其他登乘方式，只要该方式能使救生筏以受控方式降落至水面。

Query_Text_en: 8 Where necessary , means shall be provided for bringing the davitlaunched survival craft against the ship 's side and holding them alongside so that persons can be safely embarked .
Translation: 必要时，应采取措施确保 davit 吊放式救生艇能够贴近船舷并保持靠泊状态，以便人员安全登乘。

Query_Text_en: \* This relates to the chapter II-2 in force before 1 July 2002 . The equivalent in the amended II-2 is 13.3.2.5.1 .
Translation: * 这与2002年7月1日之前生效的II-2章有关。其在修订后的II-2章中的等效条款为13.3.2.5.1。

Query_Text_en: ② Refer to the Symbols related to life-saving appliances and arrangements adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 760 [ 18 ] , as amended by resolution MSC .82 [ 70 ] , and to the Guidelines for the evaluation , testing and application of low-location lighting on passenger Ships adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 752 [ 18 ] .
Translation: 参照国际海事组织通过A.760(18)号决议（经MSC.82(70)号决议修正）采纳的与救生设备和布置相关的标识符号，以及国际海事组织通过A.752(18)号决议采纳的客船低位照明系统评估、测试和应用指南。

Query_Text_en: Launching stations shall be in such positions as to ensure safe launching having particular regard to clearance from the propeller and steeply overhanging portions of the huh and so that , as far as possible , survival craft , except survival craft specially designed for free-fall launching , can be launched down the straight side of the ship .
Translation: 释放站应设置在能够确保安全释放的位置，特别注意与螺旋桨的净空距离以及船体外悬的陡峭部分，并尽可能使救生设备（专门设计用于自由降落下水的救生设备除外）能够沿船舶的直舷侧进行释放。

Query_Text_en: If positioned forward , they shall be located abaft the collision bulkhead in a sheltered position and , in this respect , the Administration shall give special consideration to the strength of the launching appliance .
Translation: 若设置在船首区域，应将其布置在防撞舱壁后方的受保护位置。在此方面，主管机关应对脱险装置的强度进行特别评估。

Query_Text_en: .5 as far as practicable , in a secure and sheltered position and protected from damage by fire and explosion .
Translation: .5 在可行范围内，应置于安全且有遮蔽的位置，并防止因火灾和爆炸造成的损害。

Query_Text_en: In particular , survival craft on tankers , other than the liferafts required by regulation 31.1.4 , shall not be stowed on or above a cargo tank , slop tank , or other tank containing explosive or hazardous cargoes .
Translation: 特别地，除第31.1.4款要求的救生筏外，油轮上的其他救生设备不得存放在货油舱、残油舱或其他装有易燃易爆货物的舱室上方或其上。

Query_Text_en: 2 Lifeboats for lowering down the ship 's side shall be stowed as far forward of the propeller as practicable .
Translation: 用于从船舷降落的救生艇应尽可能靠近推进器前方的位置存放。

Query_Text_en: On cargo ships of 80 m in length and upwards but less than 120 m in length , each lifeboat shall be so stowed that the after end of the lifeboat is not less than the length of the lifeboat forward of the propeller .
Translation: 长度不小于80米但不足120米的货船上，每艘救生艇的存放位置应确保其尾端距离推进器的前方位置不小于该救生艇自身的长度。

Query_Text_en: On cargo ships of 120 m in length and upwards and passenger ships of 80 m in length and upwards , each lifeboat shall be so stowed that the after end of the lifeboat is not less than 1.5 times the length of the lifeboat forward of the propeller .
Translation: 在长度120米及以上的货船和长度80米及以上的客船上，每艘救生艇的存放位置应确保救生艇的后端距离推进器的前方位置不应小于救生艇长度的1.5倍。

Query_Text_en: Where appropriate , the ship shall be so arranged that lifeboats , in their stowed positions , are protected from damage by heavy seas .
Translation: 在适当情况下，船舶应布置成使救生艇在其存放位置免受大浪损坏。

Query_Text_en: 3 Lifeboats shall be stowed attached to launching appliances .
Translation: 救生艇应存放并连接于释放装置。

Query_Text_en: 4.1 Every liferaft shall be stowed with its painter permanently attached to the ship .
Translation: 4.1 每艘救生筏应存放其系缆永久固定在船上。

Query_Text_en: 4.2 Each liferaft or group of liferafts shall be stowed with a float-free arrangement complying with the requirements of paragraph 4 . l. 6 of the Code so that each floats free and , if inflatable , inflates automatically when the ship sinks .
Translation: 每个救生筏或救生筏组应按照《规则》第4.1.6条的要求配备自由浮离装置并存放，以便在船舶下沉时能够自动浮离，如果是充气式救生筏，还应能自动充气。

Query_Text_en: 4.3 Liferafts shall be so stowed as to permit manual release of one raft or container at a time from their securing arrangements .
Translation: 4.3 救生筏的存放方式应允许通过手动操作逐个解除其系固装置，每次只能释放一个救生筏或容器。

Query_Text_en: 4.4 Paragraphs 4.1 and 4.2 do not apply to life rafts required by regulation 31.1.4 .
Translation: 本条第4.1段和第4.2段不适用于根据第31.1.4条规定配备的救生筏。

Query_Text_en: 5 Davit-launched liferafts shall be stowed within reach of the lifting hooks , unless some means of transfer is provided which is not rendered inoperable within the limits of trim and list prescribed in paragraph 1.2 or by ship motion or power failure .
Translation: davit 吊放的救生筏应存放在吊钩可及范围内，除非提供转移装置且该装置在第1.2款规定的纵倾和横倾范围内、或因船舶运动或电力故障时不会失效。

Query_Text_en: 6 Liferafts intended for throw-overboard launching shall be so stowed as to be readily transferable for launching on either side of the ship unless liferafts , of the aggregate capacity required by regulation 31.1 to be capable of being launched on either side , are stowed on each side of the ship .
Translation: 6. 抛投式救生筏应存放得便于转移到船舶任一侧进行释放，除非船舶两侧已存放符合第31.1条规定的总容量要求且能在任一侧释放的救生筏。

Query_Text_en: .4 if it is also a lifeboat , in compliance with the requirements of regulation 13 .
Translation: .4 若同时作为救生艇时，应符合第13条的规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 The ship 's side shall not have any openings between the embarkation station of the marine evacuation system and the waterline in the lightest seagoing condition and means shall be provided to protect the system from any projections .
Translation: 船舶舷侧在船舶最轻载航行水线与海上撤离系统的登船站之间不得有任何开口，并应采取措施防止系统受到任何突出物的影响。

Query_Text_en: 2 Marine evacuation systems shall be in such positions as to ensure safe launching having particular regard to clearance from the propeller and steeply overhanging positions of the hull and so that , as far as practicable , the system can be launched down the straight side of the ship .
Translation: 海上撤离系统应布置于确保安全撤离的位置，特别考虑与螺旋桨的间距及船体外伸部位的陡峭区域，并尽可能使该系统能够从船舶平直侧舷进行撤离。

Query_Text_en: 3 Each marine evacuation system shall be stowed so that neither the passage nor platform nor its stowage or operational arrangements will interfere with the operation of any other life-saving appliance at any other launching station .
Translation: 每个海上撤离系统的存放位置应确保其通道、平台及其存放或操作布置，均不会妨碍其他放生站内任何其他救生设备的操作。

Query_Text_en: 4 Where appropriate , the ship shall be so arranged that the marine evacuation systems in their stowed positions are protected from damage by heavy seas .
Translation: 在适用情况下，船舶应布置成使海上撤离系统在存放位置时免受巨浪损害。

Query_Text_en: .5 provided for use in conjunction with a marine evacuation system , complying with the requirements of section 6.2 of the Code and stowed for launching directly from the stowed position under unfavorable conditions of trim of up to 10 and list of up to 20 either way .
Translation: 配备用于与海上撤离系统配合使用，符合《规则》第6.2节的要求，并可在吃水倾斜度达10度和任一侧横倾度达20度的不利条件下从存放位置直接释放。

Query_Text_en: 2 Each lifeboat shall be provided with an appliance which is capable of launching and recovering the lifeboat .
Translation: 每一艘救生艇应配备一种能够放艇和回收的装置。

Query_Text_en: In addition there shall be provision for hanging-off the lifeboat to free the release gear for maintenance .
Translation: 此外，应设置吊离救生艇的装置，以便对释放装置进行维护。

Query_Text_en: 3 Launching and recovery arrangements shall be such that the appliance operator on the ship is able to observe the survival craft at all times during launching and for lifeboats during recovery .
Translation: 释放和回收布置应确保船上设备操作员在释放救生艇筏的整个过程中以及在回收救生艇时始终能够观察到救生艇筏。

Query_Text_en: 4 Only one type of release mechanism shall be used for similar survival craft carried on board the ship .
Translation: 船上配备的同类救生设备应仅使用一种类型的释放装置。

Query_Text_en: 5 Preparation and handling of survival craft at any one launching station shall not interfere with the prompt preparation and handling of any other survival craft or rescue boat at any other station .
Translation: 在任何一个放艇站准备和处理救生设备时，不得影响其他放艇站救生设备或救援艇的迅速准备和处理。

Query_Text_en: 6 Falls , where used , shall be long enough for the survival craft to reach the water with the ship in its lightest seagoing condition , under unfavourable conditions of trim of up to 10 and list of up to 20 either way .
Translation: 当使用降落索时，其长度应足以确保救生设备在船舶处于最轻载航行状态，并在不利的纵向倾斜不超过10度和横向倾斜不超过20度的任一侧情况下，仍能顺利降至水面。

Query_Text_en: 7 During preparation and launching , the survival craft , its launching appliance , and the area of water into which it is to be launched shall be adequately illuminated by lighting supplied from the emergency source of electrical power required by regulation II-1 \/ 42 or II-1 \/ 43 , as appropriate .
Translation: 在准备和降落过程中，救生艇、其降落设备及其降落的水域区域应当通过应急电源提供的照明进行充分照明，该应急电源应符合II-1/42或II-1/43法规的要求。

Query_Text_en: 8 Means shall be available to prevent any discharge of water onto survival craft during abandonment .
Translation: 应采取措施防止弃船时海水排入救生艇筏。

Query_Text_en: 9 If there is a danger of the survival craft being damaged by the ship 's stabilizer wings , means shall be available , powered by an emergency source of energy , to bring the stabilizer wings inboard ; indicators operated by an emergency source of energy shall be available on the navigating bridge to show the position of the stabilizer wings .
Translation: 当救生艇存在被船舶稳定翼损坏的危险时，应配备由应急能源驱动的装置以将稳定翼收回；驾驶台上应设有由应急能源供电的指示器，用于显示稳定翼的位置。

Query_Text_en: 10 If partially enclosed lifeboats complying with the requirements of section 4.5 of the Code are carried , a davit span shall be provided , fitted with not less than two lifelines of sufficient length to reach the water with the ship in its lightest seagoing condition , under unfavourable conditions of trim of up to 10 and list of up 20 either way .
Translation: 若配备符合《规则》第4.5节要求的部分封闭式救生艇，应设置吊臂跨度装置，并配备不少于两条长度足够的救生索。该救生索需确保船舶处于最轻载航行状态且在纵向倾斜达10度、任一舷横向倾斜达20度的不利情况下仍能触及水面。

Query_Text_en: 1 The rescue boat embarkation and launching arrangements shall be such that the rescue boat can be boarded and launched in the shortest possible time .
Translation: 救援艇的登乘与降落布置应确保救援艇能在最短时间内完成登乘和降落。

Query_Text_en: 2 If the rescue boat is one of the ship 's survival craft , the embarkation arrangements and launching station shall comply with the requirements of regulations 11 and 12 .
Translation: 如果救助艇属于船舶的救生艇筏之一，则其登乘布置和降落站应符合第11条和第12条的规定。

Query_Text_en: 3 Launching arrangements shall comply with the requirements of regulation 16 .
Translation: 第三条 启动安排应符合第十六条的规定。

Query_Text_en: However , all rescue boats shall be capable of being launched , where necessary utilizing painters , with the ship making headway at speeds up to 5 knots in calm water .
Translation: 然而，所有救生艇均应具备释放能力，必要时需使用牵拉索具，即使船舶在平静水域以不超过5节的速度前进时也不例外。

Query_Text_en: 4 Recovery time of the rescue boat shall be not more than 5 min in moderate sea conditions when loaded with its full complement of persons and equipment .
Translation: 4 在中等海况且满载人员和设备的情况下，救生艇的回收时间不得超过5分钟。

Query_Text_en: If the rescue boat is also a lifeboat , this recovery time shall be possible when loaded with its lifeboat equipment and the approved rescue boat complement of at least six persons .
Translation: 如果救援艇同时作为救生艇使用，其回收时间应能在装载救生艇设备及经批准的至少六人救援艇配员定额时实现。

Query_Text_en: 5 Rescue boat embarkation and recovery arrangements shall allow for safe and efficient handling of a stretcher case .
Translation: 救援艇的登乘和回收安排应确保能够安全、高效地处理担架伤员。

Query_Text_en: Foul weather recovery strops shall be provided for safety if heavy fall blocks constitute a danger .
Translation: 若大量坠落堆积物构成危险，应配备恶劣天气防护装置以确保安全。

Query_Text_en: A line-throwing appliance complying with the requirements of section 7.1 of the Code shall be provided .
Translation: 应配备符合《规则》第7.1节要求的抛绳设备。

Query_Text_en: 2.1 Every crew member with assigned emergency duties shall be familiar with these duties before the voyage begins .
Translation: 所有被分配有应急职责的船员应在航行开始前熟悉其职责。

Query_Text_en: Passengers shall be instructed in the use of the lifejackets and the action to take in an emergency .
Translation: 必须指导乘客正确使用救生衣，并明确应急情况下的行动步骤。

Query_Text_en: 2.3 Whenever new passengers embark , a passenger safety briefing shall be given immediately before sailing , or immediately after sailing .
Translation: 2.3 当有新乘客登船时，应在开航前立即或开航后立即向乘客进行安全简报。

Query_Text_en: The briefing shall include the instructions required by regulations 8.2 and 8.4 , and shall be made by means of an announcement , in one or more languages likely to be understood by the passengers .
Translation: 该说明应包含法规第8.2条和第8.4条要求的内容，并通过公告形式以乘客能够理解的一种或多种语言发布。

Query_Text_en: The announcement shall be made on the ship 's public address system , or by other equivalent means likely to be heard at least by the passengers who have not yet heard it during the voyage .
Translation: 公告应通过船舶公共广播系统发布，或采用其他同等有效的方式，确保航行过程中尚未获知该信息的乘客能够收听。

Query_Text_en: The briefing may be included in the muster required by paragraph 2.2 if the muster is held immediately upon departure .
Translation: 如果集合在启程后立即举行，则简报可计入第二款第2.2项要求的集合程序中。

Query_Text_en: Information cards or poster or video programs displayed on ships video displays may be used to supplement the briefing , but may not be used to replace the announcement .
Translation: 在船舶视频显示器上展示的信息卡、海报或视频节目可作为补充说明材料使用，但不得替代口头广播。

Query_Text_en: 3.1 Drills shall , as far as practicable , be conducted as if there were an actual emergency .
Translation: 演练应尽可能按照实际紧急情况发生时的情形进行。

Query_Text_en: 3.2 Every crew member shall participate in at least one abandon ship drill and one fire drill every month .
Translation: 每名船员每月应至少参加一次弃船演习和一次消防演习。

Query_Text_en: The drills of the crew shall take place within 24 h of the ship leaving a port if more than 25 % of the crew have not participated in abandon ship and fire drills on board that particular ship in the previous month .
Translation: 如果超过25%的船员在过去一个月内未在该艘船舶上参加弃船和消防演习，则船员演习应在船舶离港后24小时内举行。

Query_Text_en: When a ship enters service for the first time , after modification of a major character or when a new crew is engaged , these drills shall be held before sailing .
Translation: 当船舶首次投入使用、完成重大改装或新船员就位时，应在出航前举行这些演习。

Query_Text_en: The Administration may accept other arrangements that are at least equivalent for those classes of ships for which this is impracticable .
Translation: 对于不适用上述规定的船舶类别，主管部门可接受其他等效安排。

Query_Text_en: .9 instruction in the use of radio life-saving appliances .
Translation: .9 无线电救生设备使用须知

Query_Text_en: 3.3.2 Different lifeboats shall , as far as practicable , be lowered in compliance with the requirements of paragraph 3.3.1.5 at successive drills .
Translation: 3.3.2 不同救生艇应尽可能在每次演习中按照第3.3.1.5款的要求进行降放。

Query_Text_en: 3.3.3 Except as provided in paragraphs 3.3.4 and 3.3.5 , each lifeboat shall be launched with its assigned operating crew aboard and manoeuvered in the water at least once every three months during an abandon ship drill .
Translation: 除第3.3.4和3.3.5款另有规定外，每艘救生艇应在弃船演习期间至少每三个月进行一次配备指定船员的降落操作，并在水中实施操纵。

Query_Text_en: 3.3.4 Lowering into the water , rather than launching of a lifeboat arranged for free-fall launching , is acceptable where free-fall launching is impracticalable provided the lifeboat is free-fall launched with its assigned operating crew aboard and manoeuvered in the water at least once every six months .
Translation: 在无法实施自由降落方式的情况下，可采取降放救生艇的方式而非自由降落方式。只要该救生艇每六个月至少有一次载指定操作船员进行自由降落，并在水中进行操纵，此种做法即被视为符合要求。

Query_Text_en: However , in cases where it is impracticable , the Administration may extend this period to 12 months provided that arrangements are made for simulated launching which will take place at intervals of not more than six months .
Translation: 然而，如遇不可行情况，行政主管部门可将期限延长至12个月，但需确保每间隔不超过六个月进行一次模拟发射。

Query_Text_en: 3.3.5 The Administration may allow ships operating on short international voyages not to launch the lifeboats on one side if their berthing arrangements in port and their trading patterns do not permit launching of lifeboats on that side .
Translation: 主管机关可允许从事短程国际航线运营的船舶，在港口泊位安排及航线特点不允许从某一侧释放救生艇的情况下，不从该侧释放救生艇。

Query_Text_en: However , all such lifeboats shall be lowered at least once every three months and launched at least annually .
Translation: 但是，所有此类救生艇应当每三个月至少降下一次，并每年至少进行一次降落部署。

Query_Text_en: 3.3.6 As far as is reasonable and practicable , rescue boats other than lifeboats which are also rescue boats , shall be launched each month with their assigned crew aboard and manoeuvered in the water .
Translation: 3.3.6 在合理可行的情况下，除同时作为救生艇的救援艇外，其他救援艇应每月搭载指定船员下水并进行操纵。

Query_Text_en: In all cases this requirement shall be complied with at least once every three months .
Translation: 在所有情况下，本条款应至少每三个月遵守一次。

Query_Text_en: 3.3.7 If lifeboat and rescue boat launching drills are carried out with the ship making headway , such drills shall , because of the dangers involved , be practiced in sheltered waters only and under the supervision of an officer experienced in such drills . \*
Translation: 如果救生艇和 rescue boat 的放艇演练是在船舶前进时进行的，由于存在危险，此类演练应仅在受保护的水域中开展，并需在熟悉此类演练的资深官员监督下实施。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to the Guidelines on training for the purpose of launching lifeboats and rescue boats from ships making headway through the water adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 624 [ 15 ] .
Translation: 请参阅国际海事组织通过A.624[15]号决议采纳的航行中船舶放艇训练指南。

Query_Text_en: 3.3.8 If a ship is fitted with marine evacuation systems , drills shall include exercising of the procedures required for the deployment of such a system up to the point immediately preceding actual deployment of the system .
Translation: 若船舶配备有海上撤离系统，则演习应包括演练部署该系统所需的程序，直至实际部署前的最后阶段。

Query_Text_en: This aspect of drills should be augmented by regular instruction using the on-board training aids required by regulation 35.4 .
Translation: 演习的这一环节应通过使用根据第35.4条规定配备的船上训练设备进行的定期指导加以强化。

Query_Text_en: Additionally every system party member shall , as far as practicable , be further trained by participation in a full deployment of a similar system into water , either or board a ship or ashore , at intervals of not longer than two years , but in no case longer than three years .
Translation: 此外，系统内每位党员应尽可能每不超过两年接受一次参与类似系统水上部署的进一步培训，培训可在船上或岸上实施，但无论如何最长间隔不得超过三年。

Query_Text_en: This training can be associated with the deployments required by regulation 20.8.2 .
Translation: 本培训可与第20.8.2条规定要求的部署安排相关联。

Query_Text_en: 3.3.9 Emergency lighting for mustering and abandonment shall be tested at each abandon ship drill .
Translation: 3.3.9 用于集合和弃船的应急照明应在每次弃船演习中进行测试。

Query_Text_en: 3.4.1 Fire drills should be planned in such a way that due consideration is given to regular practice in the various emergencies that may occur depending on the type of ships and the cargo .
Translation: 船舶应制定消防演习计划，充分考虑船舶类型和所载货物的不同，定期针对可能发生的各类紧急情况进行演练。

Query_Text_en: .6 checking the necessary arrangements for subsequent abandoning of the ship .
Translation: 6. 检查弃船后续必要安排。

Query_Text_en: 3.4.3 The equipment used during drills shall immediately be brought back to its fully operational condition and any faults and defects discovered during the drills shall be remedied as soon as possible .
Translation: 演习中使用的设备应当立即恢复至完全可用状态，演习中发现的故障和缺陷应尽快修复。

Query_Text_en: 4.1 On-board training in the use of the ship 's life-saving appliances , including survival craft equipment , and in the use of the ship 's fire-extinguishing appliances shall be given as soon as possible but not later than two weeks after a crew member joins the ship .
Translation: 4.1 船上应对船员使用船舶救生设备（包括救生艇属具）及灭火设备进行培训，应在船员上船后尽快开展，最迟不超过两周。

Query_Text_en: However , if the crew member is on a regularly scheduled rotating assignment to the ship , such training shall be given not later than two weeks after the time of first joining the ship .
Translation: 然而，如果船员处于定期轮换部署至船舶的状态，此类培训应在该船员首次登船后两周内完成。

Query_Text_en: Instructions in the use of the ship 's fire-extinguishing appliances , life-saving appliances , and in survival at sea shall be given at the same interval as the drills .
Translation: 船舶灭火设备、救生设备的使用指导以及海上求生的指导应按照与演习相同的间隔进行。

Query_Text_en: Individual instruction may cover different parts of the ship 's life-saving and fire-extinguishing appliances , but all the ship 's lifesaving and fire-extinguishing appliances shall be covered within any period of two months .
Translation: 船舶救生设备和灭火装置的个别培训内容可涉及不同部分，但所有船舶救生设备和灭火装置应在两个月周期内全部覆盖。

Query_Text_en: .4 operation and use of fire-extinguishing appliances .
Translation: 4. 灭火设备的操作与使用

Query_Text_en: 4.3 On-board training in the use of davit-launched life rafts shall take place at intervals of not more than four months on every ship fitted with such appliances .
Translation: 配备此类设备的每艘船舶，应每隔不超过四个月进行一次吊架式救生筏使用培训。

Query_Text_en: Whenever practicable this shall include the inflation and lowering of a liferaft .
Translation: 在实际可行的情况下，应包括救生筏的充气和释放。

Query_Text_en: This liferaft may be a special liferaft intended for training purposes only , which is not part of the ship 's life-saving equipment ; such a special life raft shall be conspicuously marked .
Translation: 本救生筏可能是专为训练目的设计的专用救生筏，其不属于船舶救生设备；此类专用救生筏应当设置显著标识。

Query_Text_en: The date when musters are held , details of abandon ship drills and fire drills , drills of other life-saving appliances and on board training shall be recorded in such log-book as may be prescribed by the Administration .
Translation: 举行集合演习的日期、弃船演习、消防演习的详细情况，以及其他救生设备演习和船上培训的情况，应当按照主管机关规定记录在航海日志中。

Query_Text_en: If a full muster , drill or training session is not held at the appointed time , an entry shall be made in the log-book stating the circumstances and the extent of the muster , drill or training session held .
Translation: 如果未按指定时间举行完整的应急集合、演习或训练，应当在航海日志中记录说明未举行的原因以及实际进行的演习或训练内容及范围。

Query_Text_en: The requirements of paragraphs 3 and 6.2 shall be complied with , as far as is practicable , on ships constructed before l July 1986 .
Translation: 对于1986年7月1日之前建造的船舶，应尽可能在实际可行范围内遵守第3段和第6.2段的要求。

Query_Text_en: 1 Unless expressly provided otherwise , this chapter applies to all ships to which the present regulations apply and to cargo ships of 300 gross tonnage and upwards .
Translation: 除非另有规定，本章适用于本法规适用的所有船舶以及300总吨及以上的货船。

Query_Text_en: 2 This chapter does not apply to ships to which the present regulations would otherwise apply while such ships are being navigated within the Great Lakes of North America and their connecting and tributary waters as far east as the lower exit of the St Lambert Lock at Montreal in the Province of Quebec , Canada . \*
Translation: 本章不适用于按照本法规规定应适用的船舶，当这类船舶在北美五大湖及其连接水道和支流水域（直至加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔的圣 Lambert 水闸下端出口）航行期间。

Query_Text_en: 3 No provision in this chapter shall prevent the use by any ship , survival craft or person in distress , of any means at their disposal to attract attention , make known their position and obtain help .
Translation: 本章任何规定均不得妨碍任何船舶、救生艇或遇险人员利用其可支配的手段引起注意、通报位置及寻求救援。

Query_Text_en: .1 Bridge-to-bridge communications means safety communications between ships from the position from which the ships are normally navigated .
Translation: 桥到桥通信是指船舶在正常航行位置上进行的安全通信。

Query_Text_en: .2 Continuous watch means that the radio watch concerned shall not be interrupted other than for brief intervals when the ship 's receiving capability is impaired or blocked by its own communications or when the facilities are under periodical maintenance or checks .
Translation: 连续值守是指相关无线电值守不得中断，除非因船舶自身通信导致接收能力受损或受阻，或设备处于定期维护检测期间而产生短暂间隔。

Query_Text_en: .3 Digital selective calling [ DSC ] means a technique using digital codes which enables a radio station to establish contact with , and transfer information to , another station or group of stations , and complying with the relevant recommendations of the International Radio Consultative Committee [ CCIR ] .
Translation: 数字选择性呼叫（DSC）是指一种采用数字编码技术实现无线电台与其他无线电台或一组无线电台建立通信联络并传输信息的方法，并符合国际无线电咨询委员会（CCIR）的相关建议。

Query_Text_en: .4 Direct-printing telegraphy means automated telegraphy techniques which comply with the relevant recommendations of the International Radio Consultative Committee [ CCIR ] .
Translation: 直接印字电报是指符合国际无线电咨询委员会（CCIR）相关建议的自动化电报技术。

Query_Text_en: .5 General radiommunications means operational and public correspondence traffic , other than distress , urgency and safety messages , conducted by radio .
Translation: 通用无线电通信是指通过无线电进行的除遇险、紧急和安全信息以外的业务和公共通信业务。

Query_Text_en: 6 Inmarsat  means the Organization established by the Convention on the International Maritime Satellite Organization adopted on 3 September 1976 .
Translation: 国际海事卫星组织指由1976年9月3日通过的《国际海事卫星组织公约》所建立的组织。

Query_Text_en: \* Such ships are subject to special requirements relative to radio for safety purposes , as contained in the relevant agreement between Canada and the United States of America .
Translation: 此类船只在无线电方面须遵守出于安全目的的特殊要求，如加拿大与美利坚合众国相关协议中所载。

Query_Text_en: ② The name of the Committee was changed to ITU Radio communication Sector [ ITU-R ] due to Article l of the International Telecommunication Constitution , Geneva ,1992 .
Translation: 根据1992年《国际电信公约》（日内瓦）第一条，该委员会更名为国际电联无线电通信局[ITU-R]。

Query_Text_en: ② The name of the Organization was changed to International Mobile Satellite Organization [ Inmarsat ] by virtue of amendments to its Convention and Operating Agreement adopted by the 10th [ extraordinary ] Assembly [ 5-9 December 1994 ] .
Translation: 该组织的名称于1994年12月5日至9日召开的第十届特别大会通过对其公约和运营协议的修订后，更名为国际海事卫星组织（Inmarsat）。

Query_Text_en: .7 International NAVTEX service means the co-ordinated broadcast and automatic reception on 518 kHz of maritime safety information by means of narrow-band direct-printing telegraphy using the English language .
Translation: 国际NAVTEX服务是指通过窄带直接打印电传技术，使用英语在518千赫频率上协调广播并自动接收海上安全信息的服务。

Query_Text_en: .8 Locating means the finding of ships , aircraft , units or persons in distress .
Translation: .8 定位是指确定船舶、航空器、单位或遇险人员的位置。

Query_Text_en: .9 Maritime safety information means navigational and meteorological warnings , meteorological forecasts and other urgent safety related messages broadcast to ships .
Translation: 海上安全信息是指向船舶播发的航行和气象警告、气象预报以及其他与安全相关的紧急信息。

Query_Text_en: .10 Polar orbiting satellite service means a service which is based on polar orbiting satellites which receive and relay distress alerts from satellite EPIRBs and which provides their position .
Translation: 极地轨道卫星服务是指基于极地轨道卫星提供的一种服务，能够接收并转发卫星EPIRB发出的遇险警报，并提供其位置信息。

Query_Text_en: .11 Radio Regulations means the Radio Regulations annexed to , or regarded as being annexed to , the most recent International Telecommunication Convention which is in force at any time .
Translation: 无线电规则指现行有效的最新国际电信公约所附的《无线电规则》文本，或视为该公约所附的《无线电规则》文本。

Query_Text_en: .12 Sea area A1 means an area within the radio telephone coverage of at least one VHF coast station in which continuous DSC alerting is available , as may be defined by a Contracting Government .
Translation: 海区A1是指由至少一个甚高频海岸电台提供无线电电话覆盖，并可提供持续数字选择性呼叫报警服务的区域，其范围可由缔约国政府划定。

Query_Text_en: .13 Sea area A2 means an area , excluding sea area A1 , within the radiotelephone coverage of at least one MF coast station in which continuous DSC alerting is available , as may be defined by a Contracting Government .
Translation: A2海区是指不包括A1海区在内的区域，在该区域内至少有一个中频海岸电台提供了无线电电话覆盖，并可进行持续的数字选择性呼叫遇险报警，具体范围可由缔约国政府划定。

Query_Text_en: .14 Sea area A3 means an area , excluding sea areas A1 and A2 , within the coverage of an Inmarsat geostationary satellite in which continuous alerting is available .
Translation: A3海区指除A1和A2海区外，属于国际海事卫星组织静止卫星覆盖范围内的区域，并能够在其中提供持续报警服务。

Query_Text_en: .15 Sea area A4 means an area outside sea areas A1 , A2 and A3 .
Translation: A4海区是指位于A1、A2和A3海区以外的区域。

Query_Text_en: .16 Global maritime distress and safety system [ GMDSS ] identities means maritime mobile services identity , the ship 's call sign , Inmarsat identities and serial number identity which may be transmitted by the ship 's equipment and used to identify the ship .
Translation: 16 全球海上遇险与安全系统（GMDSS）标识指海上移动业务标识、船舶电台呼号、国际海事卫星组织（Inmarsat）标识以及可通过船舶设备传输并用于识别船舶的序列号标识。

Query_Text_en: 2 All other terms and abbreviations which are used in this chapter and which are defined in the Radio Regulations and in the International Convention on Maritime Search and Rescue [ SAR ] ,1979 , as may be amended , shall have the meanings as defined in those Regulations and the SAR Convention .
Translation: 本章中使用的其他术语和缩写词，如在《无线电规则》以及经修正的1979年《海上搜寻救助（SAR）国际公约》中已作定义的，应具有该规则及SAR公约中所规定的含义。

Query_Text_en: .2 the Administration has taken into account the effect such exemptions may have upon the general efficiency of the service for the safety of all ships .
Translation: 主管部门已考虑到此类豁免可能对确保所有船舶安全的服务整体效率所产生的影响。

Query_Text_en: ① Refer to the NAVTEX Manual approved by the Organization [ publication IMO-951E ] .
Translation: 参见本组织批准的NAVTEX手册[出版物IMO-951E]。

Query_Text_en: Refer to resolution A. .801 [ 19 ] concerning provision of radio services for the global maritime distress and safety system [ GMDSS ] .
Translation: 参阅关于全球海上遇险和安全系统（GMDSS）无线电服务提供的A..801 [19]号决议。

Query_Text_en: .2 in exceptional circumstances , for a single voyage outside the sea area or sea areas for which the ship is equipped .
Translation: 在特殊情况下，可允许船舶进行超出其适航海域范围的单次航行。

Query_Text_en: 3 Each Administration shall submit to the Organization , as soon as possible after the first of January in each year , a report showing all exemptions granted under paragraphs 1 and 2 during the previous calendar year and giving the reasons for granting such exemptions .
Translation: 每一缔约方政府应于每年1月1日之后尽早向本组织提交一份报告，列明上一自然年根据第1段和第2段所给予的所有豁免，并说明给予此类豁免的理由。

Query_Text_en: .9 of transmitting and receiving bridge-to-bridge communications .
Translation: 传输和接收船舶间通信。

Query_Text_en: \* It should be noted that ships performing GMDSS functions should use the Guidance for avoidance of false distress alerts adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 814 [ 19 ] .
Translation: 需注意，执行GMDSS功能的船舶应使用国际海事组织通过A.814[19]号决议采纳的《避免误发遇险警报指南》。

Query_Text_en: ② Refer to resolution A. 614 [ 15 ] concerning carriage of radar operating in the frequency band 9,300-9 ,500 MHz .
Translation: 参阅关于9300-9500兆赫兹频段雷达配备的决议A.614[15]。

Query_Text_en: ③ It should be noted that ships may have a need for reception of certain maritime safety information while in port .
Translation: 需注意的是，船舶在港期间可能需要接收特定海上安全信息。

Query_Text_en: 1 Each Contracting Government undertakes to make available , as it deems practical and necessary either individually or in co-operation with other Contracting Governments , appropriate shore-based facilities for space and terrestrial radiocommunication services having due regard to the recommendations of the Organization .
Translation: 缔约国政府承诺提供其认为必要和可行的岸基空间与陆地无线电通信服务设施，可单独或与其他缔约国政府合作建立此类设施，并充分考虑本组织的建议。

Query_Text_en: .5 the maritime mobile service in the bands between 415 kHz and 535 kHz ③ and between 1,605 kHz and 4,000 kHz .
Translation: 5 海上移动业务在415千赫至535千赫③频段以及1,605千赫至4,000千赫频段。

Query_Text_en: 2 Each Contracting Government undertakes to provide the Organization with pertinent information concerning the shore-based facilities in the maritime mobile service , mobile-satellite service and maritime mobile-satellite service , established for sea areas which it has designated off its coasts .
Translation: 各缔约国政府承诺向国际海事组织提供在其沿岸划定海域范围内设立的海上移动业务、移动卫星业务及海上移动卫星业务岸基设施的相关资料。

Query_Text_en: 1 This regulation applies to all ships on all voyages .
Translation: 本规定适用于所有船舶的所有航次。

Query_Text_en: 2 Each Contracting Government undertakes to ensure that suitable arrangements are made for registering global maritime distress and safety system [ GMDSS ] identities and for making information on these identities available to rescue co-ordination centers on a 24-hour basis .
Translation: 各缔约国政府承诺确保已作出适当安排，用于登记全球海上遇险与安全系统（GMDSS）身份标识，并全天候向救援协调中心提供这些身份信息。

Query_Text_en: Where appropriate , international organizations maintaining a registry of these identities shall be notified by the Contracting Government of these assignments .
Translation: 适当时，维护这些身份登记的国际组织应由缔约国政府通知这些指定事项。

Query_Text_en: \* 1 Each Contracting Government is not required to provide all radiocommunication services .
Translation: 每一缔约国政府无须提供所有无线电通信服务。

Query_Text_en: 2 The requirements should be specified for shore-based facilities to cover the various sea areas .
Translation: 应明确岸基设施的各项要求，以覆盖不同海域。

Query_Text_en: ② Refer to resolution A. 801 [ 19 ] concerning provision of radio services for the global maritime and safety system [ GMDSS ] .
Translation: ② 参阅第A.801(19)号决议，该决议涉及全球海上遇险和安全系统（GMDSS）无线电服务的提供事宜。

Query_Text_en: ③ Refer to resolution A. 617 [ 15 ] concerning implementation of the NAVTEX system as a component of the World-Wide Navigational Warning Service .
Translation: ③ 参阅关于将NAVTEX系统作为全球航行警告服务组成部分实施的A.617(15)号决议。

Query_Text_en: The Master Plan of shore-based facilities for the GMDSS based on information provided by Contracting Governments is circulated to all concerned by means of GMDSS circulars .
Translation: 基于缔约国提供的信息，全球海上遇险与安全系统岸基设施的总体规划通过全球海上遇险与安全系统通告分发给所有相关部门。

Query_Text_en: 1 Every ship shall be provided with radio installations capable of complying with the functional requirements prescribed by regulation 4 throughout its intended voyage and , unless exempted under regulation 3 , complying with the requirements of regulation 7 and , as appropriate for the sea area or areas through which it will pass during its intended voyage , the requirements of either regulation 8,9,10 or 11 .
Translation: 每艘船舶在其预定航程中应配备符合第四条所规定功能要求的无线电设备，并且除非经第三条规定予以豁免，还应满足第七条的要求，同时根据其预定航程中将经过的海域情况，适用第八、九、十条或第十一条的相关要求。

Query_Text_en: .5 be clearly marked with the call sign , the ship station identity and other codes as applicable for the use of the radio installation .
Translation: .5 应清晰标注呼号、船舶电台识别号以及根据使用情况所需的其他代码。

Query_Text_en: Portable VHF equipment may be used to meet the latter provision .
Translation: 便携式甚高频设备可被用于满足后者规定。

Query_Text_en: 4 In passenger ships , a distress panel shall be installed at the conning position .
Translation: 4 客船上应在驾驶位置安装应急操作面板。

Query_Text_en: This panel shall contain either one single button which , when pressed , initiates a distress alert using all radiocommunication installations required on board for that purpose or one button for each individual installation .
Translation: 该面板应包含以下任一配置：要么设置一个单一按钮，当被按下时启动船上为此目的配备的所有无线电通信设备发送遇险警报；要么为每个单独的通信设备设置独立按钮。

Query_Text_en: The panel shall clearly and visually indicate whenever any button or buttons have been pressed .
Translation: 当任何按钮被按下时，面板应清晰醒目地予以显示。

Query_Text_en: Means shall be provided to prevent inadvertent activation of the button or buttons .
Translation: 应采取措施防止按钮的意外激活。

Query_Text_en: If the satellite EPIRB is used as the secondary means of distress alerting and is not remotely activated , it shall be acceptable to have an additional EPIRB installed in the wheelhouse near the conning position .
Translation: 如果卫星EPIRB被用作遇险报警的次要手段且无法远程启动，则允许在驾驶室驾驶指挥位置附近加装一个附加的EPIRB。

Query_Text_en: 5 In passenger ships , information on the ship 's position shall be continuously and automatically provided to all relevant radiocommunication equipment to be included in the initial distress alert when the button or buttons on the distress panel is pressed .
Translation: 在客船上，船舶位置信息应持续自动提供给所有相关无线电通信设备，以便在按下紧急按钮面板上的按钮时，该信息能包含在初始遇险警报中。

Query_Text_en: 6 In passenger ships , a distress alarm panel shall be installed at the conning position .
Translation: 在客船上，应在驾驶位置安装遇险警报面板。

Query_Text_en: The distress alarm panel shall provide visual and aural indication of any distress alert or alerts received on board and shall also indicate through which radiocommunication service the distress alerts have been received .
Translation: 遇险报警面板应提供船上接收到的遇险报警的视觉和听觉指示，并应显示所接收遇险报警的无线电通信服务类型。

Query_Text_en: .1.1 DSC on the frequency 156.525 MHz [ channel 70 ] .
Translation: 1.1 使用156.525兆赫频率（第70信道）的数字选择性呼叫（DSC）。

Query_Text_en: .5 a radio facility for reception of maritime safety information by the Inmarsat enhanced group calling system ② if the ship is engaged on voyages in any area of Inmarsat coverage but in which an international NAVTEX service is not provided .
Translation: 配备接收海事卫星增强群呼系统播发的海上安全信息的无线电设备；若船舶航行于任一海事卫星覆盖区域，但该区域未提供国际NAVTEX服务。

Query_Text_en: However , ships engaged exclusively on voyages in areas where an HF direct-printing telegraphy maritime safety information service is provided and fitted with equipment capable of receiving such service , may be exempt from this requirement .
Translation: 然而，专门在设有高频直接打印电报航海安全信息服务海域航行并配备相应接收设备的船舶，可免于满足本要求。

Query_Text_en: .6.5 capable of being activated manually .
Translation: 6.5 可手动启动。

Query_Text_en: \* Certain ships may be exempted from this requirement [ see regulation 9.4 ] .
Translation: 部分船舶可能免于遵守本项规定[见第9.4条]。

Query_Text_en: ③ Refer to the Recommendation on promulgation of maritime safety information adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 705 [ 17 ] .
Translation: 请参阅本组织通过第A.705（17）号决议采纳的《关于海事安全信息发布的建议》。

Query_Text_en: Refer to resolution A. 616 [ 15 ] concerning search and rescue homing capability .
Translation: 参阅关于搜救定位能力的A.616[15]号决议。

Query_Text_en: Subject to the availability of appropriate receiving and processing ground facilities for each ocean region covered by Inmarsat satellites .
Translation: 视每个由国际海事卫星组织卫星覆盖的海洋区域是否具备适当的地面接收和处理设施而定。

Query_Text_en: 2 Every passenger ship shall be provided with means for two-way on-scene radiocommunications for search and rescue purposes using the aeronautical frequencies 121.5 MHz and 123.1 MHz from the position from which the ship is normally navigated .
Translation: 每艘客船应在船舶通常驾驶的位置配备使用121.5兆赫和123.1兆赫航空频率进行搜救目的的双向现场无线电通信设备。

Query_Text_en: .1 on VHF using DSC ;
Translation: .1 通过甚高频无线电使用数字选择性呼叫；

Query_Text_en: .2 through the polar orbiting satellite service on 406 MHz :
Translation: .2 通过406兆赫极地轨道卫星服务：

Query_Text_en: .5.2 the satellite EPIRB , required by regulation 7.1.6 , either by installing the satellite EPIRB close to , or by remote activation from , the position from which the ship is normally navigated .
Translation: 根据第7.1.6条规定，卫星EPIRB的安装位置应符合以下要求：要么将其安装在船舶通常驾驶位置附近，要么通过该位置实现远程启动。

Query_Text_en: 2 The VHF radio installation , required by regulation 7.1.1 , shall also be capable of transmitting and receiving general radiocommunications using radiotelephony .
Translation: 根据第7.1.1条规定要求的甚高频无线电装置，还应能够通过无线电电话方式发送和接收通用无线电通信。

Query_Text_en: 3 Ships engaged on voyages exclusively in sea area A1 may carry , in lieu of the satellite EPIRB required by regulation 7.1.6 , an EPIRB which shall be :
Translation: 仅在A1海区航行的船舶可配备卫星应急定位发射器（EPIRB）的替代装置，该装置应满足以下条件：

Query_Text_en: .5 capable of being activated manually .
Translation: .5 可手动激活。

Query_Text_en: \* This requirement can be met by Inmarsat ship earth stations capable of two-way communications , such as Inmarsat-A , Inmarsat-B and Fleet-77 [ resolutions A. 808 [ 19 ] and MSC .130 [ 75 ] ] or Inmarsat-C [ resolution A. 807 [ 19 ] , as amended ] ship earth stations .
Translation: 配备双向通信功能的国际海事卫星（Inmarsat）船载地球站可以满足本要求，例如Inmarsat-A型、Inmarsat-B型和Fleet-77型【参照A.808[19]号和MSC.130[75]号决议】，或经修订的Inmarsat-C型【参照A.807[19]号决议】船载地球站。

Query_Text_en: Unless otherwise specified , this footnote applies to all requirements for an Inmarsat ship earth station prescribed by this chapter .
Translation: 除非另有规定，本章规定的所有Inmarsat船舶地球站要求均适用本脚注。

Query_Text_en: .2 a radio installation capable of maintaining a continuous DSC watch on the frequency 2187.5 kHz which may be separate from , or combined with , that required by subparagraph .1.1 ; and
Translation: 2. 具备在2187.5千赫频率上持续值守数字选择性呼叫（DSC）功能的无线电设备，该设备可以独立于或合并于本款.1.1项所要求的设备；以及

Query_Text_en: .3.3.2 the satellite EPIRB , required by regulation 7.1.6 , either by installing the satellite EPIRB close to , or by remote activation from , the position from which the ship is normally navigated .
Translation: 根据规定7.1.6的要求，卫星应急定位发射器的安装应满足如下条件：要么将其安装在船舶正常航行操控位置附近，要么通过远程操控方式从该位置启动。

Query_Text_en: 2 It shall be possible to initiate transmission of distress alerts by the radio installations specified in paragraphs 1.1 and 1.3 from the position from which the ship is normally navigated .
Translation: 应能够从船舶通常驾驶的位置，通过本条第1.1款和第1.3款规定的无线电设备启动遇险警报的发送。

Query_Text_en: .1 a radio installation operating on working frequencies in the bands between 1,605 kHz and 4,000 kHz or between 4,000 kHz and 27,500 kHz .
Translation: 工作频率在1605千赫兹至4000千赫兹频段或4000千赫兹至27500千赫兹频段内的无线电设备。

Query_Text_en: .2 an Inmarsat ship earth station .
Translation: 2. 国际海事卫星组织船舶地面站

Query_Text_en: 4 The Administration may exempt ships constructed before 1 February 1997 , which are engaged exclusively on voyages within sea area A2 , from the requirements of regulations 7.1.1.1 and 7.1.2 provided such ships maintain , when practicable , a continuous listening watch on VHF channel 16 . This watch shall be kept at the position from which the ship is normally navigated .
Translation: 行政机关可对1997年2月1日前建造且仅在A2海区航行的船舶，免除其遵守第7.1.1.1和7.1.2款要求的规定。只要此类船舶在可行情况下能够保持在甚高频频道16的持续值守监听，即可适用此豁免。该值守应在船舶正常航行的位置进行。

Query_Text_en: .3 a radio installation capable of maintaining a continuous DSC watch on the frequency 2,187.5 kHz which may be separate from or combined with that required by subparagraph .2.1 ; and
Translation: 3 能够在2187.5千赫频率上持续保持数字选择性呼叫值守的无线电安装设备，该设备可以独立于第.2.1项要求的设备，或与之合并设置；以及

Query_Text_en: .4.3 through the Inmarsat geostationary satellite service , by an additional ship earth station or by the satellite EPIRB required by regulation 7.1.6 , either by installing the satellite EPIRB close to , or by remote activation from , the position from which the ship is normally navigated .
Translation: 通过国际海事卫星静止卫星服务，可采用附加船舶地球站或根据第7.1.6款要求的卫星紧急无线电示位标，通过在通常驾驶船舶的位置附近安装卫星紧急无线电示位标，或通过该位置远程启动的方式实现。

Query_Text_en: at any time , it shall be possible to select any of these DSC distress and safety frequencies .
Translation: 在任何时间，应能够选择这些DSC遇险和安全频率中的任意一个。

Query_Text_en: .4 in addition . ships shall be capable of transmitting and receiving general radiocommunications using radiotelephony or direct printing telegraphy by an MF\/HF radio installation operating on working frequencies in the bands between 1,605 kHz and 4,000 kHz and between 4,000 kHz and 27,500 kHz .
Translation: 船舶应当具备使用中/高频无线电设备（工作频率位于1,605千赫至4,000千赫频段及4,000千赫至27,500千赫频段）通过无线电电话或直接打印电报功能收发一般无线电通信的能力。

Query_Text_en: This requirement may be fulfilled by the addition of this capability in the equipment required by subparagraph .1 .
Translation: 此项要求可通过在第.1款所要求的设备中增加此项功能予以满足。

Query_Text_en: 3 It shall be possible to initiate transmission of distress alerts by the radio installations specified in paragraphs 1.1 , 1.2 , 1.4 , 2.1 and 2.3 from the position from which the ship is normally navigated .
Translation: 应允许通过第1.1、1.2、1.4、2.1和2.3款规定的无线电设备，在船舶通常驾驶的位置启动遇险报警传输。

Query_Text_en: 4 The Administration may exempt ships constructed before 1 February 1997 , and engaged exclusively on voyages within sea areas A2 and A3 , from the requirements of regulations 7.1.1.1 and 7.1.2 provided such ships maintain , when practicable , a continuous listening watch on VHF channel 16 . This watch shall be kept at the position from which the ship is normally navigated .
Translation: 行政部门可对1997年2月1日前建造且仅在A2和A3海区航行的船舶，豁免其遵守第7.1.1.1和7.1.2条款的要求。前提是这些船舶在可行时需在VHF 16频道保持持续值守监听，且该值守监听应保持在船舶正常航行操作的位置。

Query_Text_en: 1 In addition to meeting the requirements of regulation 7 , ships engaged on voyages in all sea areas shall be provided with the radio installations and equipment required by regulation 10.2 , except that the equipment required by regulation 10.2.3.2 shall not be accepted as an alternative to that required by regulation 10.2.3.1 , which shall always be provided .
Translation: 除满足第7条要求外，航行于所有海域的船舶应当配备第10.2条规定的无线电装置和设备，但第10.2.3.2条规定的设备不得作为替代第10.2.3.1条规定的设备，后者必须始终配备。

Query_Text_en: In addition , ships engaged on voyages in all sea areas shall comply with the requirements of regulation 10.3 .
Translation: 此外，航行于所有海域的船舶均应遵守第10.3条的规定。

Query_Text_en: .3 on the distress and safety DSC frequencies 2,187.5 kHz and 8,414.5 kHz and also on at least one of the distress and safety DSC frequencies 4,207.5 kHz ,6,312 kHz ,12,577 kHz or 16,804.5 kHz , appropriate to the time of day and the geographical position of the ship , if the ship , in accordance with the requirements of regulation 10.2.2 or 11.1 . is fitted with an MF\/HF radio installation .
Translation: 若船舶按照第10.2.2条或第11.1条的要求配备了中频/高频无线电装置，则应保持在遇险和安全DSC频率2187.5千赫及8414.5千赫，以及至少一个其他遇险和安全DSC频率（包括4207.5千赫、6312千赫、12577千赫或16804.5千赫）上，具体频率需根据昼夜时段和船舶所处地理位置适当选择。

Query_Text_en: .4 for satellite shore-to-ship distress alerts , if the ship , in accordance with the requirements of regulation 10.1.1 , is fitted with an Inmarsat ship earth station .
Translation: 对于卫星岸对船遇险警报，若船舶按照第10.1.1款的要求配备了海事卫星船站，则适用。

Query_Text_en: 2 Every ship , while at sea , shall maintain a radio watch for broadcasts of maritime safety information on the appropriate frequency or frequencies on which such information is broadcast for the area in which the ship is navigating .
Translation: 船舶在海上航行时，应当保持无线电值守，以接收所在航行区域适用频率上播发的海上安全信息广播。

Query_Text_en: 3 Until 1 February 1999 or until such other date as may be determined by the Maritime Safety Committee , \* every ship while at sea shall maintain , when practicable , a continuous listening watch on VHF channel 16 . This watch shall be kept at the position from which the ship is normally navigated .
Translation: 在可行的情况下，船舶在海上航行时应持续对VHF第16频道保持监听。此项监听需在船舶通常进行操纵的位置实施。此项要求将持续有效直至1999年2月1日，或直至海事安全委员会确定的其他日期为止。

Query_Text_en: 1 There shall be available at all times , while the ship is at sea , a supply of electrical energy sufficient to operate the radio installations and to charge any batteries used as part of a reserve source or sources of energy for the radio installations .
Translation: 船舶在海上航行期间，应始终确保有足够的电力供应，以维持无线电设备的运行并为无线电设备备用电源组成部分的电池充电。

Query_Text_en: 2 A reserve source or sources of energy shall be provided on every ship , to supply radio installations , for the purpose of conducting distress and safety radiocommunications , in the event of failure of the ship ' s main and emergency sources of electrical power .
Translation: 每艘船舶应配备备用能源，以便在船舶主电源和应急电源失效时，为无线电设备供电，以进行遇险和安全无线电通信。

Query_Text_en: .2 6 h on ships not provided with an emergency source of electrical power complying fully with all relevant provisions of regulation II-1 \/ 42 or 43 , including the supply of such power to the radio installations .
Translation: 对于未配备符合第II-1章第42或43条所有相关规定的应急电源（包括向无线电通信设备供电）的船舶，需保障2至6小时的应急电力供应。

Query_Text_en: \* The Maritime Safety Committee decided [ resolution MSC .131 [ 75 ] ] that all GMDSS ships , while at sea , shall continue to maintain , when practicable , continuous listening watch on VHF channel 16 .
Translation: 海上安全委员会通过决议MSC.131[75]决定，所有GMDSS船舶在海上航行时，应继续在适用情况下维持对VHF第16频道的持续监听。

Query_Text_en: ② For guidance , the following formula is recommended for determining the electrical load to be supplied by the reserve source of energy for each radio installation required for distress conditions : 1/2 of the current consumption necessary for transmission + the current consumption necessary for reception + the current consumption of any additional loads .
Translation: 作为指导，确定遇险情况下所需每个无线电设备由备用能源提供的电气负载时，建议采用以下公式：发射所需必要电流消耗量的一半 加上 接收所需必要电流消耗量 再加上 任何附加负载的电流消耗量。

Query_Text_en: The reserve source or sources of energy need not supply independent HF and MF radio installations at the same time .
Translation: 备用电源无需同时为独立的高频和中频无线电装置供电。

Query_Text_en: 3 The reserve source or sources of energy shall be independent of the propelling power of the ship and the ship 's electrical system .
Translation: 备用能源应独立于船舶推进动力和船舶电力系统。

Query_Text_en: .2 whichever of the other radio installations will consume the most power , if only one of the other radio installations can be connected to the reserve source or sources of energy at the same time as the VHF radio installation .
Translation: 在其他无线电设备中，若只能同时将其中一个连接到备用电源并与VHF无线电设备并行运行时，需确定哪台设备将消耗最大功率。

Query_Text_en: 5 The reserve source or sources of energy may be used to supply the electrical lighting required by regulation 6.2.4 .
Translation: 备用能源可作为第6.2.4条规定的所需电力照明的供电来源。

Query_Text_en: .2 the capacity of the battery or batteries shall be checked , using an appropriate method , \* at intervals not exceeding 12 months , when the ship is not at sea .
Translation: .2 当船舶不在海上时，应对电池（组）的容量通过相应方法进行检测，检测间隔不得超过12个月。

Query_Text_en: .5 that when fully charged , the batteries will provide at least the minimum required hours of operation under all weather conditions .
Translation: 在完全充电的情况下，电池在各种天气条件下将至少提供所需的最低运行时长。

Query_Text_en: 8 If an uninterrupted input of information from the ship s navigational or other equipment to a radio installation required by this chapter , including the navigation receiver referred to in regulation l8 , is needed to ensure its proper performance , means shall be provided to ensure the continuous supply of such information in the event of failure of the ship s main or emergency source of electrical power .
Translation: 当本章要求的无线电装置（包括第18条规定的航行接收机）的正常运行需要船舶导航设备或其他设备向其不间断输入信息时，应采取措施确保在船舶主电源或应急电源发生故障时仍能持续提供此类信息。

Query_Text_en: \* One method of checking the capacity of an accumulator battery is to fully discharge and recharge the battery , using normal operating current and period [ e.g. 10 h ] .
Translation: 检查蓄电池容量的一种方法是将其完全放电后，再使用常规运行电流和周期（例如10小时）进行充电。

Query_Text_en: Assessment of the charge condition can be made at any time , but it should be done without significant discharge of the battery when the ship is at sea .
Translation: 对荷电状态的评估可在任何时间进行，但船舶在海上航行时，应确保电池未处于显著放电状态。

Query_Text_en: 1 All equipment to which this chapter applies shall be of a type approved by the Administration .
Translation: 本章适用的所有设备均应为经主管机关批准的类型。

Query_Text_en: Such equipment shall conform to appropriate performance standards not inferior to those adopted by the Organization . \*
Translation: 此类设备必须符合相应的性能标准，其标准不得低于该组织所采用的标准。*

Query_Text_en: .1 Resolution A. 525 [ 13 ] : Performance standards for narrow-band direct-printing telegraph equipment for the reception of navigational and meteorological warnings and urgent information to ships .
Translation: 《关于船舶接收航行及气象警告和紧急信息的窄带直接打印电报设备性能标准决议A.525[13]》

Query_Text_en: .2 Resolution A. 694 [ 17 ] : General requirements for shipborne radio equipment forming part of the global maritime distress and safety system [ GMDSS ] and for electronic navigational aids .
Translation: .2 决议A.694(17)：关于作为全球海上遇险与安全系统（GMDSS）组成部分的船用无线电设备以及电子导航辅助设备的通用要求。

Query_Text_en: .3 Resolution A. 808 [ 19 ] : Performance standards for ship earth stations capable of two-way communications and resolution A. 570 [ 14 ] : Type approval of ship earth stations and MSC .130 [ 75 ] : Performance standards for Inmarsat ship earth stations capable of two-way communications .
Translation: A.808(19)号决议：具备双向通信能力船舶地球站的性能标准；A.570(14)号决议：船舶地球站型式认可标准；以及MSC.130(75)号决议：具备双向通信能力的Inmarsat船舶地球站性能标准。

Query_Text_en: .4 Resolution A. 803 [ 19 ] : Performance standards for shipborne VHF radio installations capable of voice communication and digital selective calling , as amended , and resolution MSC .68 [ 68 ] , annex 1 [ valid for equipment installed on or after 1 January 2000 ] .
Translation: 关于船舶载VHF无线电设备（具备语音通信及数字选择性呼叫功能）性能标准（经修订）以及MSC.68(68)号决议附件1[适用于2000年1月1日及以后安装的设备]的A.803(19)号决议。

Query_Text_en: .5 Resolution A. 804 [ 19 ] : Performance standards for shipborne MF radio installations capable of voice communication and digital selective calling , as amended , and resolution MSC .68 [ 68 ] , annex 2 [ valid for equipment installed on or after 1 January 2000 ] .
Translation: 《A.804(19)号决议》（经修订的船舶中频无线电装置性能标准，适用于具备语音通信和数字选择性呼叫功能的设备）及《MSC.68(68)号决议》附件2[适用于2000年1月1日及以后安装的设备]。

Query_Text_en: .6 Resolution A. 806 [ 19 ] : Performance standards for shipborne MF\/HF radio installations capable of voice communication , narrow-band direct-printing and digital selective calling , as amended , and resolution MSC .68 [ 68 ] , annex 3 [ valid for equipment installed on or after 1 January 2000 ] .
Translation: 第.6号决议A.806[19]：关于具备语音通信、窄带直接打印和数字选择性呼叫功能的船舶载MF/HF无线电设备性能标准（经修订），以及MSC.68[68]号决议附录3[适用于2000年1月1日或之后安装的设备]。

Query_Text_en: .7 Resolution A. 810 [ 19 ] : Performance standards for float-flee satellite emergency position-indicating radio beacons [ EPIRBs ] operating on 406 MHz and MSC .120 [ 74 ] : Adoption of amendments to performance standards for float-free satellite emergency position-indicating radio beacons [ EPIRBs ] operating on 406 MHz [ resolution A. 810 [ 19 ] ] [ see also Assembly resolution A. 696 [ 17 ] : Type approval of satellite emergency position-indicating radio beacons [ EPIRBs ] operating in the COSPAS-SARSAT system ] .
Translation: 关于406兆赫浮离式卫星应急示位标（EPIRBs）性能标准的决议A.810(19)及海上安全委员会第120号决议（74）：通过关于406兆赫浮离式卫星应急示位标（EPIRBs）性能标准修正案的决议[参见大会决议A.696(17)：COSPAS-SARSAT系统中使用的卫星应急示位标（EPIRBs）型式认可]

Query_Text_en: .8 Resolution A. 802 [ 19 ] : Performance standards for survival craft radar transponders for use in search and rescue operations .
Translation: 决议A.802(19)：搜救行动中使用的救生艇雷达应答器性能标准

Query_Text_en: .9 Resolution A. 805 [ 19 ] : Performance standards for float-free VHF emergency position-indicating radio beacons .
Translation: 决议A.805(19)：关于非释放式甚高频紧急位置指示无线电信标的性能标准

Query_Text_en: .10 Resolution A. 807 [ 19 ] : Performance standards for Inmarsat-C ship earth stations capable of transmitting and receiving direct-printing communications , as amended , and resolution MSC .68 [ 68 ] , annex 3 [ valid for equipment installed on or after 1 January 2000 ] , and resolution A. 570 [ 14 ] : Type approval of ship earth stations .
Translation: 经修订的《关于能够发送和接收直接打印通信的Inmarsat-C船用地球站性能标准》（决议A.807(19)），以及《海上安全委员会第68/68号决议》附件3（适用于2000年1月1日及以后安装的设备），和《船用地球站型式认可》（决议A.570(14)）。

Query_Text_en: .11 Resolution A. 664 . [ 16 ] : Performance standards for enhanced group call equipment .
Translation: .11 决议A.664 [16]：增强型群组呼叫设备性能标准。

Query_Text_en: .12 Resolution A. 812 [ 19 ] : Performance standards for float-free satellite emergency position-indicating radio beacons operating through the geostationary Inmarsat satellite system on 1.6 GHz .
Translation: 决议A.812（19号）：通过国际海事卫星组织静止卫星系统在1.6 GHz频段运行的非释放式卫星应急定位无线电信标性能标准。

Query_Text_en: .13 Resolution A. 662 [ 16 ] : Performance standards for float-free release and activation arrangements for emergency radio equipment .
Translation: .13 决议A. 662[16]：应急无线电设备自由释放和激活装置的性能标准。

Query_Text_en: .14 Resolution A. 699 [ 17 ] : System performance standard for the promulgation and co-ordination of maritime safety information using high-frequency narrow-band direct printing .
Translation: 决议A.699[17]：关于使用高频窄带直接打印系统发布和协调航海安全信息的系统性能标准

Query_Text_en: .15 Resolution MSC .148 [ 77 ] : Adoption of the revised performance standards for narrow-band direct-printing telegraph equipment for the reception of navigational and meteorological warnings and urgent information to ships [ NAVTEX ] .
Translation: MSC.148(77)号决议：通过修订后的窄带直接打印电报设备性能标准（用于接收船舶航行和气象警告及紧急信息，即NAVTEX系统）。

Query_Text_en: .16 ResolutionA .811 [ 19 ] : Performance standards for a shipborne integrated radiocommunication system [ IRCS ] when used in the GMDSS .
Translation: A.811(19)号决议：船载综合无线电通信系统（IRCS）在GMDSS中使用时的性能标准。

Query_Text_en: .17 Resolution MSC .80 [ 70 ] , annex 1 : Performance standards for on-scene [ aeronautical ] two-way portable VHF radiotelephone apparatus .
Translation: MSC.80(70)号决议，附件1：现场用航空双向便携式甚高频无线电话设备的性能标准。

Query_Text_en: 1 Equipment shall be so designed that the main units can be replaced readily , without elaborate recalibration or readjustment .
Translation: 设备应设计为能够便捷更换主要部件，且无需进行复杂的重新校准或调整。

Query_Text_en: 2 Where applicable , equipment shall be so constructed and installed that it is readily accessible for inspection and on-board maintenance purposes .
Translation: 在适用情况下，设备的结构和安装方式应便于进行检查和船上维护。

Query_Text_en: 3 Adequate information shall be provided to enable the equipment to be properly operated and maintained , taking into account the recommendations of the Organization . \*
Translation: 应提供足够的信息，以确保设备得到适当的运行和维护，并兼顾组织的建议。\*

Query_Text_en: 4 Adequate tools and spares shall be provided to enable the equipment to be maintained .
Translation: 4. 应配备充足的工具和备件，以确保设备能够得到维护。

Query_Text_en: 5 The Administration shall ensure that radio equipment required by this chapter is maintained to provide the availability of the functional requirements specified in regulation 4 and to meet the recommended performance standards of such equipment .
Translation: 主管部门应确保本章要求的无线电设备得到维护，以保持第四条规定的功能要求的可用性，并符合此类设备的推荐性能标准。

Query_Text_en: 6 On ships engaged on voyages in sea areas A1 and A2 , the availability shall be ensured by using such methods as duplication of equipment , shore-based maintenance or at-sea electronic maintenance capability , or a combination of these , as may be approved by the Administration .
Translation: 在A1和A2海区航行的船舶上，应通过设备冗余、岸基维护或海上电子维护能力，或经主管机关批准的这些方法的组合等方式予以确保。

Query_Text_en: 7 On ships engaged on voyages in sea areas A3 and A4 , the availability shall be ensured by using a combination of at least two methods such as duplication of equipment , shore-based maintenance or at sea electronic maintenance capability , as may be approved by the Administration , taking into account the recommendations of the Organization .
Translation: 在A3和A4海区从事航行的船舶，应通过组合运用至少两种方法（如设备冗余、岸基维护或海上电子维护能力等）予以保障，具体方法需经主管机关批准，并应考虑相关组织的建议。

Query_Text_en: 8 While all reasonable steps shall be taken to maintain the equipment in efficient working order to ensure compliance with all the functional requirements specified in regulation 4 , malfunction of the equipment for providing the general radiocommunications required by regulation 4.8 shall not be considered as making a ship unseaworthy or as a reason for delaying the ship in ports where repair facilities are not readily available , provided the ship is capable of performing all distress and safety functions .
Translation: 所有合理措施应当采取以保持设备处于高效运行状态，确保符合本规则第4条规定的全部功能要求。但若因提供本规则第4.8条要求的通用无线电通信功能而发生设备故障，只要船舶仍具备执行所有遇险和安全功能的能力，则该故障不应视为船舶不适航，也不应成为在缺乏维修设施港口延误船舶的正当理由。

Query_Text_en: 9 Satellite EPIRBs shall be tested at intervals not exceeding 12 months for all aspects of operational efficiency with particular emphasis on frequency stability , signal strength and coding .
Translation: 卫星EPIRB的测试间隔不得超过12个月，需涵盖运行效能的各个方面，尤其注重频率稳定性、信号强度和编码。

Query_Text_en: However , in cases where it appears proper and reasonable , the Administration may extend this period to 17 months .
Translation: 然而，在认为适当合理的情况下，主管部门可将该期限延长至17个月。

Query_Text_en: The test may be conducted on board the ship or at an approved testing or servicing station .
Translation: 测试可在船舶上或经批准的检测或维修站点实施。

Query_Text_en: 1 Every ship shall carry personnel qualified for distress and safety radiocommunication purposes to the satisfaction of the Administration .
Translation: 每艘船舶应当配备符合遇险和安全无线电通信要求的合格人员，以满足主管机关的要求。

Query_Text_en: The personnel shall be holders of certificates specified in the Radio Regulations as appropriate , any one of whom shall be designated to have primary responsibility for radiocommunications during distress incidents .
Translation: 相关人员应持有无线电规则中规定的相应证书，其中一人应被指定在遇险事件期间负责无线电通信的主要责任。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to the Recommendation on general requirements for shipborne radio equipment forming part of the global maritime distress and safety system and for electronic navigational aids adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 694 [ 17 ] and to resolution A. 813 [ 19 ] on general requirements for electromagnetic compatibility [ EMC ] for all electrical and electronic ship 's equipment and to MSC\/Circ .862 : Clarifications of certain requirements in IMO performance standards for GMDSS equipment .
Translation: 参考国际海事组织通过决议A. 694[17]采纳的《作为全球海上遇险和安全系统组成部分的船用无线电设备及电子导航设备一般要求》建议案，以及决议A. 813[19]《有关所有船上电气和电子设备电磁兼容性[EMC]的一般要求》，以及MSC/Circ.862《国际海事组织（IMO）GMDSS设备性能标准中某些要求的澄清说明》。

Query_Text_en: ② Refer to resolution A. 702 [ 17 ] concerning radio maintenance guidelines for global maritime distress and safety system related to sea areas A3 and A4 .
Translation: 参阅关于海区A3和A4相关全球海上遇险和安全系统无线电维护指南的决议A.702(17)。

Query_Text_en: ③ Refer to the STCW Code , chapter IV , section B-IV/2 .
Translation: 参见STCW规则第四章B-IV/2节。

Query_Text_en: 2 In passenger ships , at least one person qualified in accordance with paragraph 1 shall be assigned to perform only radiocommunication duties during distress incidents .
Translation: 在客船中，遇险情况下应指定至少一人专门负责无线电通信工作，该人员应按照第1款规定的资格要求予以配备。

Query_Text_en: A record shall be kept , to the satisfaction of the Administration and as required by the Radio Regulations , of a11 incidents connected with the radiocommunication service which appear to be of importance to safety of life at sea .
Translation: 应按照无线电规则的要求，并满足主管机关的满意，对所有涉及无线电通信服务且被认为对海上人命安全具有重要意义的事件进行记录。

Query_Text_en: All two-way communication equipment carried on board a ship to which this chapter applies which is capable of automatically including the ship 's position in the distress alert shall be automatically provided with this information from an internal or external navigation receiver , if either is installed .
Translation: 本章适用的船舶所配备的所有具备在遇险报警中自动包含船舶位置功能的双向通信设备，若安装有内部或外部导航接收机，则应自动从该类设备获取相关信息。

Query_Text_en: If such a receiver is not installed , the ship 's position and the time at which the position was determined shall be manually updated at intervals not exceeding 4 h , while the ship is under way , so that it is always ready for transmission by the equipment .
Translation: 若未安装此类接收器，则船舶在航行期间应每隔不超过4小时手动更新船舶位置及其确定时间，以确保设备始终处于可传输状态。

Query_Text_en: 2 The Administration may exempt ships constructed before 1 February 1997 , and engaged exclusively on voyages within sea areas A2 , A3 and A4 , from the requirements of regulations 7.1.1.1 and 7.1.2 provided such ships maintain , when practicable , a continuous listening watch on VHF channel 16 . This watch shall be kept at the position from which the ship is normally navigated .
Translation: 行政部门可对1997年2月1日前建造且仅在A2、A3和A4海域航行的船舶，免于遵守第7.1.1.1和7.1.2款规定，但此类船舶在可行情况下须保持对甚高频频道16的持续值守监听。该值守监听应保持在船舶通常航行操控的位置。

Query_Text_en: .2 ships solely navigating the Great Lakes of North America and their connecting and tributary waters as far east as the lower exit of the St. Lambert Lock at Montreal in the Province of Quebec , Canada .
Translation: .2 仅在北美五大湖及其连接水道和支流范围内航行，最东可达加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔市圣 Lambert 水闸下游出口的船舶。

Query_Text_en: However , warships , naval auxiliaries or other ships owned or operated by a Contracting Government and used only on Government non-commercial service are encouraged to act in a manner consistent , so far as reasonable and practicable , with this chapter .
Translation: 缔约国政府所有的或运营的军舰、海军辅助舰艇或其他仅用于政府非商业服务的船舶，应尽量在合理可行的范围内采取与本章规定相一致的行为。

Query_Text_en: 2 The Administration may decide to what extent this chapter shall apply to ships operating solely in waters landward of the baselines which are established in accordance with international law .
Translation: 主管部门可决定本章在多大程度上适用于仅在根据国际法划定的基线内侧水域运营的船只。

Query_Text_en: 3 A rigidly connected composite unit of a pushing vessel and associated pushed vessel , when designed as a dedicated and integrated tug and barge combination , shall be regarded as a single ship for the purpose of this chapter .
Translation: 当推进船与相关的被推船作为刚性连接的复合单元被设计为专用的集成式拖船和驳船组合时，其在本章中应视为一艘船舶。

Query_Text_en: .3 fishing vessels .
Translation: 3艘渔船

Query_Text_en: .3 assembly of the ship has commenced comprising at least 50 tones or 1 % of the estimated mass of all structural material , whichever is 1ess .
Translation: 船舶的组装已开始，且已达到以下两项中的较小值：至少50吨或所有结构材料预估质量的1%。

Query_Text_en: 2 Nautical chart or nautical publication is a special-purpose map or book , or a specially compiled database from which such a map or book is derived , that is issued officially by or on the authority of a Government , authorized Hydrographic Office or other relevant government institution and is designed to meet the requirements of marine navigation .
Translation: 航海图或航海出版物是指由政府、授权水道测量办公室或其他相关政府部门正式发布或授权发布的专门用途的海图或书籍，或是为此类海图或书籍专门编制的数据库，其设计旨在满足航海导航需求。

Query_Text_en: 3 All ships means any ship , vessel or craft irrespective of type and purpose .
Translation: 3. "所有船舶"系指不论类型和用途的任何船舶、船只或水上交通工具。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to appropriate resolutions and recommendations of the International Hydrographic Organization concerning the authority and responsibilities of coastal States in the provision of charting in accordance with regulation 9 .
Translation: 根据第九条的规定，参照国际水道测量组织有关沿海国在提供航海图方面所具有的权限和职责的相应决议和建议。

Query_Text_en: 1 The Administration may grant general exemptions from the requirements of regulations 15 , 17 , 18 , 19 [ except 19 . 2 . 1 . 7 ] , 20 , 22 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 and 28 to ships without mechanical means of propulsion .
Translation: 本行政部门可对无机械推进装置的船舶授予普遍豁免，使其免于遵守第15、17、18、19条（除第19.2.1.7款外）、第20、22、24、25、26、27及28条规章规定的相关要求。

Query_Text_en: 2 The Administration may grant to individual ships exemptions or equivalents of a partial or conditional nature , when any such ship is engaged on a voyage where the maximum distance of the ship from the shore , the length and nature of the voyage , the absence of general navigational hazards , and other conditions affecting safety are such as to render the full application of this chapter unreasonable or unnecessary , provided that the Administration has taken into account the effect such exemptions and equivalents may have upon the safety of all other ships .
Translation: 主管机关可对个别船舶给予部分或有条件的豁免或等效安排，当该船舶从事的航程中，船舶离岸最大距离、航程长度与性质、航行区域内不存在普遍性航行危险以及其他影响安全的因素，使得全面适用本章规定变得不合理或没有必要时，但须以主管机关已充分考虑此类豁免和等效安排可能对其他船舶安全造成的影响为前提。

Query_Text_en: 3 Each Administration shall submit to the Organization , as soon as possible after 1 January in each year , a report summarizing all new exemptions and equivalents granted under paragraph 2 of this regulation during the previous calendar year and giving the reasons for granting such exemptions and equivalents .
Translation: 每一缔约方应于每年1月1日之后尽快向本组织提交一份报告，总结上一自然年度根据本条例第二款批准的所有新的豁免和等效措施，并说明批准这些豁免和等效措施的理由。

Query_Text_en: The Organization shall circulate such particulars to other Contracting Governments for information .
Translation: 本组织应将上述详细情况转发其他缔约国政府供其知悉。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Government shall take all steps necessary to ensure that , when intelligence of any dangers is received from whatever reliable source , it shall be promptly brought to the knowledge of those concerned and communicated to other interested Governments .
Translation: 各缔约国应采取一切必要措施，确保无论何时通过任何可靠来源收到有关危险的情报，均应及时通报有关方面，并将情报通报其他相关缔约国。

Query_Text_en: 1 Contracting Governments undertake to encourage the collection of meteorological data by ships at sea and to arrange for their examination , dissemination and . exchange in the manner most suitable for the purpose of aiding navigation .
Translation: 缔约国政府承诺鼓励船舶在海上收集气象数据，并以最有利于航海安全的方式对其开展分析、传播和交换。

Query_Text_en: Administrations shall encourage the use of meteorological instruments of a high degree of accuracy and shall facilitate the checking of such instruments upon request .
Translation: 行政机关应当鼓励使用高精度气象仪器，并依申请协助对其开展检定。

Query_Text_en: Arrangements may be made by appropriate national meteorological services for this checking to be undertaken , free of charge to the ship .
Translation: 相关国家气象服务部门可负责作出安排，免费为船舶进行此项核查。

Query_Text_en: .1 To warn ships of gales , storms and tropical cyclones by the issue of information in text and , as far as practicable , graphic form , using the appropriate shore-based facilities for terrestrial and space radiocommunications services .
Translation: 通过发布文本信息并尽可能采用图形形式，利用地面和空间无线电通信服务的岸基设施，向船舶预警大风、风暴及热带气旋。

Query_Text_en: .2 To issue , at least twice daily , by terrestrial and space radio-commendation services , ③ as appropriate , weather information suitable for shipping containing data , analyses , warnings and forecasts of weather , waves and ice .
Translation: 通过地面和空间无线电通信服务，每日至少两次发布适合航海的气象信息，视情包含天气、海浪和冰况的数据、分析、警报及预报。

Query_Text_en: Such information shall be transmitted in text and , as far as practicable , graphic form , including meteorological analysis and prognosis charts transmitted by facsimile or in digital form for reconstitution on board the ship 's data processing system .
Translation: 此类信息应以文本形式传输，并尽可能采用图形形式，包括通过传真或数字形式传输的气象分析及预报图，以便在船舶数据处理系统上进行重建。

Query_Text_en: \* Refer to the Guidance on the IMO\/IHO World-Wide Navigational Wanting Service adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 706 [ 17 ] , as amended .
Translation: 参见国际海事组织/国际水道测量组织全球航海警告服务指南，该指南经本组织通过A.706(17)号决议采纳，并依据相关修正案进行更新。

Query_Text_en: ② Refer to the Recommendation on weather routeing adopted by the Organization by resolution A. 528 [ 13 ] .
Translation: 参照本组织通过A.528[13]号决议采纳的《气象导航建议案》。

Query_Text_en: ③ Refer to regulations IV/7 .1.4 and IV/7 .1.5 .
Translation: ③ 参见IV/7.1.4和IV/7.1.5条款。

Query_Text_en: .3 To prepare and issue such publications as may be necessary for the efficient conduct of meteorological work at sea and to arrange , if practicable , for the publication and making available of daily weather charts for the information of departing ships .
Translation: 编制和发布海上气象工作有效开展所需的各类必要出版物，并如条件允许，安排出版并提供每日天气图，供离港船舶参考。

Query_Text_en: .4 To arrange for a selection of ships to be equipped with tested marine meteorological instruments [ such as a barometer , a barograph , a psychomotor and suitable apparatus for measuring sea temperature ] for use in this service , and to take , record and transmit meteorological observations at the main standard times for surface synoptic observations [ i. e. at least four times daily , whenever circumstances permit ] and to encourage other ships to take , record and transmit observations in a modified form , particularly when in areas where shipping is sparse .
Translation: 安排选定船舶配备经过测试的海洋气象仪器（如气压计、气压记录仪、温湿计及适合测量海水温度的装置），以供本服务使用，并在地面天气图观测的主要标准时间进行气象观测、记录及传输（即在条件允许时，至少每日四次）。同时鼓励其他船舶以简化形式开展观测、记录及传输工作，尤其在船舶稀少的海域。

Query_Text_en: .5 To encourage companies to involve as many of their ships as practicable in the making and recording of weather observations ; these observations to be transmitted using the ship 's terrestrial or space radiocommunications facilities for the benefit of the various national meteorological services .
Translation: 鼓励企业尽可能多地将其所属船舶纳入气象观测及记录工作；相关观测数据应通过船舶配备的地面或空间无线电通信设施传输，以供各国气象服务部门使用。

Query_Text_en: .6 The transmission of these weather observations is free of charge to the ships concerned .
Translation: 相关船只可免费获取这些气象观测数据的传输服务。

Query_Text_en: .7 When in the vicinity of a tropical cyclone , or of a suspected tropical cyclone , ships should be encouraged to take and transmit their observations at more frequent intervals whenever practicable , bearing in mind navigational preoccupations of ships ' officers during storm conditions .
Translation: 当船舶处于热带气旋或疑似热带气旋附近海域时，在条件允许的情况下，应鼓励其以更频繁的间隔进行观测并传输数据，同时需注意风暴期间船员对航行安全的关注。

Query_Text_en: .8 To arrange for the reception and transmission of weather messages from and to ships , using the appropriate shore-based facilities for terrestrial and space radiocommunications services .
Translation: 安排船舶与岸基设施之间天气信息的接收和传输，使用适用于地面和空间无线电通信服务的适当岸基设施。

Query_Text_en: .9 To encourage masters to inform ships in the vicinity and also shore stations whenever they experience a wind speed of 50 knots or more [ force 10 on the Beaufort scale ] .
Translation: 敦促船长在遭遇风速达到或超过50节（相当于10级大风）时，及时向附近船只及岸台通报情况。

Query_Text_en: .10 To endeavor to obtain a uniform procedure in regard to the international meteorological services already specified , and as far as practicable , to conform to the technical regulations and recommendations made by the World Meteorological Organization , to which Contracting Governments may refer , for study and advice , any meteorological question which may arise in carrying out the present Convention .
Translation: 努力争取在已规定的国际气象服务方面建立统一程序，并在可行范围内遵循世界气象组织制定的技术规范和建议。缔约国政府可就执行本公约过程中出现的任何气象问题，向该组织咨询并寻求建议。

Query_Text_en: 3 The information provided for in this regulation shall be furnished in a form for transmission and be transmitted in the order of priority prescribed by the Radio Regulations .
Translation: 本规定所要求提供的信息应当以适合传输的形式提供，并按照《无线电规则》规定的优先顺序进行传输。

Query_Text_en: During transmission to all stations of meteorological information , forecasts and warnings , all ship stations must conform to the provisions of the Radio Regulations .
Translation: 在向各气象台发送气象信息、预报和警报过程中，所有船舶电台必须遵守《无线电规则》的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: 4 Forecasts , warnings , synoptic and other meteorological data intended for ships shall be issued and disseminated by the national meteorological service in the best position to serve various coastal and high seas areas , in accordance with mutual arrangements made by Contracting Governments , in particular as defined by the world Meteorological Organization 's system for the preparation and dissemination of meteorological forecasts and warnings for the high seas under the global maritime distress and safety system [ GMDSS ] .
Translation: 为船舶提供的天气预报、警报、地面综合观测及其他气象数据，应由最适合为沿海及公海区域提供服务的国家级气象服务机构，根据缔约国政府之间的相互安排发布和传播，尤其是根据世界气象组织关于全球海上遇险和安全系统（GMDSS）框架下公海气象预报及警报制作与传播的系统规定执行。

Query_Text_en: 1 The Ice Patrol contributes to safety of life at sea , safety and efficiency of navigation and protection of the marine environment in the North Atlantic .
Translation: 冰情巡逻队致力于保障北大西洋海域的海上人命安全、船舶航行安全与效率以及海洋环境保护。

Query_Text_en: Ships transiting the region of icebergs guarded by the Ice Patrol during the ice season are required to make use of the services provided by the Ice Patrol .
Translation: 在冰季期间，航行经过冰山巡逻区域的船舶必须使用冰山巡逻队提供的服务。

Query_Text_en: 2 The Contracting Governments undertake to continue an ice patrol and a service for study and observation of ice conditions in the North Atlantic .
Translation: 缔约国承诺继续开展北大西洋冰情巡逻，并提供冰情监测与研究服务。

Query_Text_en: During the whole of the ice season , i.e. , for the period from 15 February through 1 July of each year , the south-eastern , southern and south-western 1imits of the region of icebergs in the vicinity of the Grand Banks of Newfoundland shall be guarded for the purpose of informing passing ships of the extent of this dangerous region ; for the study of ice conditions in general ; and for the purpose of affording assistance to ships and crews requiring aid within the limits of operation of the patrol ships and aircraft .
Translation: 在冰季期间，即每年2月15日至7月1日，纽芬兰大浅滩附近冰山区域的东南、南及西南界限将受到警戒。此举旨在向过往船只通报这一危险区域的范围；研究冰情总体状况；并在巡逻舰船和飞机的作业范围内为需要援助的船舶和船员提供帮助。

Query_Text_en: During the rest of the year the study and observation of ice conditions shall be maintained as advisable .
Translation: 在年内其余时间，冰情研究与监测应视情持续进行。

Query_Text_en: 3 Ships and aircraft used for the Ice Patrol Service and the study and observation of ice conditions may be assigned other duties provided that such other duties do not interfere with the primary purpose or increase the cost of this service .
Translation: 用于冰情巡逻服务及冰情研究与观测的船舶和航空器，在不影响其主要用途且不增加该服务成本的前提下，可被赋予其他任务。

Query_Text_en: 4 The Government of the United States of America agrees to continue the overall management of the Ice Patrol Service and the study and observation of ice conditions , including the dissemination of information therefrom .
Translation: 美利坚合众国政府同意继续负责冰情巡逻服务的全面管理，并开展冰情研究与观测工作，包括相关信息的发布。

Query_Text_en: 5 The terms and conditions governing the management , operation and financing of the Ice Patrol are set forth in the Rules for the management , operation and financing of the North Atlantic Ice Patrol appended to this chapter , which shall form an integral part of this chapter .
Translation: 关于冰情巡逻队管理、运营及筹资的条款和条件载明于本章所附的《北大西洋冰情巡逻队管理、运营及筹资规则》，该规则构成本章不可分割的组成部分。
