Query_Text_en: what we need to know are more facts such as those to the elucidation of which the present work is devoted .
Translation: 我们需要了解的是更多事实，如本书所致力于阐明的那些事实。

Query_Text_en: It is probable that our final conclusion will be that there was far more intercourse and reaction between the Chinese and their western and southern neighbors than has often been supposed , but nevertheless that the essential style of Chinese thought and culture patterns maintained a remarkable and perennial autonomy .
Translation: 我们最终的结论很可能将是：中国与西方和南部邻国之间的交往和互动远比人们通常认为的要频繁得多，然而中国思想及文化模式的本质特征始终保持着一种显著而持久的自主性。

Query_Text_en: This is the real meaning of the isolation of China ;
Translation: 这才是中国孤立的真正含义。

Query_Text_en: contacts there were , but never abundant enough to affect the characteristic style of the civilisation , and hence of its science .
Translation: 虽然存在接触，但数量从未多到足以影响该文明的特色风格，因此也未影响其科学。

Query_Text_en: What knowledge the ancient peoples of the Mediterranean basin had of China was assembled long ago in the form of citations by Reinaud and Coedfes .
Translation: 地中海盆地古代民族对中国所知，早已被雷纳德和科德夫斯以引文形式汇编整理。

Query_Text_en: Naturally it concerned mostly silk and the trade in silk , and the geographical knowledge which arose directly out of this .
Translation: 自然，这主要涉及丝绸及其贸易，以及由此直接产生的地理知识。

Query_Text_en: But it is worth while to notice that some rumors of Confucianism seem to have reached Europe as early as the +2 nd century .
Translation: 值得注意的是，儒家思想的一些传闻似乎早在公元2世纪就已经传入欧洲。

Query_Text_en: Bardesanes , a Syrian writer who flourished at the end of that century and the beginning of the +3 rd ( a contemporary therefore of such men as Cheng Hsuan and Tshai Yung , scholars of the Late Han and early San Kuo period ) , is quoted by Eusebius as having said : In every country men have instituted different laws , some being committed to writing and some not ;
Translation: 巴拉达尼斯是一位活跃于那个世纪末和3世纪初的叙利亚作家（因此与汉末及三国初期学者郑玄、蔡邕等同属一个时代），优西比乌曾引用他的话说：“每个国家的人民制定了不同的法律，有的以文字形式记载，有的则没有；”

Query_Text_en: I shall tell what I know of them , and what I can remember , beginning where the world begins ( i.e. in the Far East ) .
Translation: 我将讲述我所了解的他们的情况以及我能回忆起来的内容，从世界的起点——即东亚——开始。

Query_Text_en: Among the Seres ( the Chinese ) the laws prohibit murder , prostitution , robbery , and the adoration of images The passage of glittering Mars across the meridian has no power there to bind the will of any man to put another to the sword .
Translation: 在中国人（赛里斯人）的法律中，禁止谋杀、卖淫、抢劫以及偶像崇拜。当发光的火星运行至子午线时，在那里无法迫使任何人产生用剑杀害他人的意愿。

Query_Text_en: Nor can Venus when in conjunction with Mars force any of them to have commerce with each others wives .
Translation: 金星即使与火星 conjunction，也无法强迫他们与彼此的妻子发生关系。

Query_Text_en: Yet Mars is seen there in the heavens every night , and there is no hour either of the day or the night at which a child is not born among the Seres .
Translation: 然而，火星每夜都在天际显现，而赛里斯人中无论昼夜的任何时刻，都不会有无新生儿诞生的时候。

Query_Text_en: This interesting passage was the basis for many repetitions and enlargements .
Translation: 这篇文章为多次引用和扩展奠定了基础。

Query_Text_en: Respect for the law is more potent among the Chinese than the constellation under which the individual is born .
Translation: 在中国人中间，对法律的尊重比个人出生星象更具影响力。

Query_Text_en: The Book of the Laws of the Countries , written apparently by a pupil of Bardesanes , adds that , although the Chinese are not subject to starry influences , there are yet rich and poor among them , sick and healthy , governors and subjects , because these things are given into the power of the rulers .
Translation: 《诸国法典》一书（据推测由巴达萨内斯弟子所著）补充指出，尽管中国人不受星辰影响，但他们之间仍有贫富、病健、官民之别，因为这些皆由统治者掌控。

Query_Text_en: There must surely have been some real transmission here , for a century and a half later , Caesarius , the brother of Gregory of Nyssa , correctly stated that in China custom was followed rather than codified law . In every country , among other peoples as with us , laws of princes exist , whether written or not ;
Translation: 这里必定存在某种真正的传承，因为一个半世纪后，尼撒的格列高利之弟该撒里乌斯曾正确指出：在中国遵循的乃是习俗而非成文法。在每一个国家，无论是其他民族还是我们自己，君主的法律都存在，无论是否成文；

Query_Text_en: in some places they are written , while elsewhere there are customs ( which have the force of law ) .
Translation: 在某些地方以成文形式存在，而在其他地方则存在习惯法（这些习惯具有法律效力）。

Query_Text_en: For those who do not have ( codes of ) laws , ancestral customs predominate .
Translation: 对于缺乏成文法典的国家或社会，祖传习俗占据主导地位。

Query_Text_en: Among such peoples , the first to be mentioned are the Seres ( the Chinese ) who inhabit the ( eastern ) extremity of the earththey have for laws the customs of their fathers which prohibit prostitution , robbery , adultery , the adoration of images and the invocation of go ...
Translation: 在这些民族中，首先应当提及的是居住在地球东方尽头的赛里斯人（即中国人）。他们以祖先的习俗为法律，禁止卖淫、抢劫、通奸、崇拜偶像以及呼求...

Query_Text_en: Among the Seres the laws of their ancestors are more powerful than the fates determined by the stars .
Translation: 在塞里斯人中，祖先的律法比星辰所定的命运更为强大。

Query_Text_en: This was afterwards copied several times , as by George Hamartolos , the Byzantine monkish chronicler , about +840 ; and two other Byzantine writers , Cedrenos and Phrantzes in the +11 th century .
Translation: 此后，这份记载被多次转述，例如拜占庭僧侣编年史家乔治·哈马托洛斯于公元840年左右所作，以及11世纪的两位拜占庭作家策德雷诺斯和弗朗特泽斯均有涉及。

Query_Text_en: Still more remarkable is the rumor of Confucian atheism , which was apparently appealed to by Celsus , the great pagan writer attacked by Origen .
Translation: 更引人注目的是关于儒家无神论的传言，这一传言显然被异教作家塞琉所引用，而塞琉正是被奥利金攻击的对象。

Query_Text_en: The atheism of the Seres is mentioned several times in Origen , s refutation .
Translation: 赛里斯人的无神论在奥利金的驳论中被多次提及。

Query_Text_en: It is of the greatest interest that a hint of Confucian rationalism and scepticism thus reached a world ridden by individual astrology and Gnostic superstition , though the picture of Seric virtue was distinctly idealised .
Translation: 引人注目的是，儒家理性主义与怀疑主义的某些影响传入了一个充斥着个人占星术和诺斯替主义迷信的世界，尽管这种华夏美德的形象被明显理想化了。

Query_Text_en: The transmission of all these ideas may be understood without difficulty , for they occur a couple of centuries after the opening of the Old Silk Road , and we shall shortly examine the records of contemporary Chinese historians which describe the visits of Roman-Syrian merchants to East Asian ports throughout this period .
Translation: 这些思想的传播不难理解，因为它们发生在中国古代丝绸之路开通两百年后。我们接下来将探讨同时代中国史学家的记载，这些记载详细描述了罗马-叙利亚商人在此期间多次到访东亚港口的情况。

Query_Text_en: Before going on , however , to speak of the trade of historical times , and some of the travellers who are known to have gone along them , something may be said concerning exchanges that were more impalpable , either because they took place almost before history begins , or because of their literary or artistic character .
Translation: 在进一步探讨历史时期的贸易以及那些已知曾沿此路线行进的旅行者之前，有必要先简要谈谈那些更为抽象的交流活动。这些交流要么发生于几乎可以追溯到史前时期，要么因其具有文学或艺术性质而显得难以具象化。

Query_Text_en: In the first place , as already suggested , there was a certain continuity between China and Europe in the bronze age , not simply because of the presumed transmission of the technique , but because of an actual correspondence of forms of objects .
Translation: 首先，如前所述，中国与欧洲在青铜时代存在着某种延续性，这不仅是因为假定的技术传播，更是由于实际的器物形态对应。

Query_Text_en: In a series of important papers Janse has demonstrated the essential unity of Europe and China in this respect from before the Shang dynasty ( 1500 ) well into the Chou .
Translation: 在一系列重要论文中，简斯从商朝（公元前1500年）之前一直延伸至周朝，论证了欧洲和中国在这一方面的本质统一。

Query_Text_en: The correspondences described are impressive One paper deals particularly with bronze and iron swords ;
Translation: 所述关联令人印象深刻。其中一篇论文专门探讨了青铜和铁制剑器；

Query_Text_en: and ( d ) scabbard strap attachments or cleats .
Translation: (d) 刀鞘固定带附件或固定座。

Query_Text_en: Certain other types , however , are peculiar either to China or to Europe .
Translation: 然而，其他一些类型则或为中国特有，或为欧洲特有。

Query_Text_en: The annulus pommel continued in use in China in the Han time , as witness the reliefs in the Wu Liang tomb , one of which is reproduced here from the Chin Shih So .
Translation: 汉代继续使用环首，如武梁墓的浮雕所示，其中一幅图即引自《秦石澍》。

Query_Text_en: Another paper was devoted to the curious pieces or ornaments , characteristic both of Chinese bronze age and of the Hallstatt civilisation in Europe .
Translation: 另一篇论文专门探讨了那些既具有中国青铜时代特征又与欧洲哈尔施塔特文明相契合的奇特器物或装饰品。

Query_Text_en: and ( g ) chalices of precious metals with a sphere or ring on the stem .
Translation: (g) 由贵金属制成的圣杯，其杯柄带有球体或环形装饰。

Query_Text_en: Lindblom has added vessels with star lids , the wide distribution of which includes Africa .
Translation: 林德洛姆新增了带有星形盖的容器，其广泛分布范围涵盖了非洲地区。

Query_Text_en: and ( f ) bronze socketed celts .
Translation: 和（f）銎式青铜斧。

Query_Text_en: The last object is a hollow bronze axe , so made that a wooden handle can be fitted into it .
Translation: 最后一个物件是一把空心青铜斧头，其设计使得木柄可以嵌入其中。

Query_Text_en: It was an epoch invention which helped to transform the forested landscape of the Old World .
Translation: 这一划时代发明推动了旧大陆森林覆盖景观的转变。

Query_Text_en: The first metal celts or axes had been solid and fixed like stone ones ;
Translation: 最初的金属斧头或斧头类工具与石制工具一样，同样坚固且固定。

Query_Text_en: then in the Middle East a hole was contrived in them for the shaft to pass through .
Translation: 在中东，人们在它们上面开凿了一个孔洞，以便轴能够通过。

Query_Text_en: But these axes took a lot of metal , available only to big States or in metal areas , and the socketed axe saved no less than half the metal previously necessary .
Translation: 但銎头斧节省的金属量并不亚于此前所需的一半，而这类金属原料仅大国或金属富集区域能够获取。

Query_Text_en: Probably it was invented on the edge of the forest country but not too far from the old metal centres , and spread both east and west . The socketed celt has given rise to controversy ;
Translation: 这种套銎斧的起源可能是在森林地带边缘、距离古老金属工业中心不远的地方被发明出来，随后向东西方传播。套銎斧的起源问题引发了争议；

Query_Text_en: Seligman first thought that it offered definite evidence of an eastward transmission reaching China as late as the 6th century , but later had to admit that such hollow axes were datable in China as far back as the 12th , upon which Shiah pointed out that since the earliest European types can not go back much beyond 1300 , an unlikely speed of diffusion would have to be supposed if it were held that the Chinese types were derived from the west European .
Translation: 塞利格曼最初认为这一发现提供了明确证据，表明相关事物的东传最迟在6世纪已抵达中国，但后来不得不承认中国境内的此类空心斧可追溯至12世纪，对此夏氏指出，鉴于欧洲已知的最早同类器型年代难以早于1300年，若坚持认为中国类型源自西欧，则必须假设一种极不现实的传播速度。

Query_Text_en: The view now generally accepted is that there was a continuity of type from the Severn to the Huang-Ho , but that the point of origin was somewhere in between .
Translation: 目前普遍接受的观点是，从塞文河到黄河在类型上具有连续性，但起源点位于两者之间某处。

Query_Text_en: Another , even stranger , story concerns the ubiquity of the bird , i.e. a bronze or pottery image of a bird mounted on three wheels .
Translation: 另一个甚至更离奇的故事与这种三轮鸟工艺品的无处不在有关，即一种用青铜或陶土制成的鸟形形象，其底部装有三个轮子。

Query_Text_en: Many collections of Chinese antiquities include specimens of these , but they are known from Egypt and from many sites in Europe .
Translation: 许多中国文物收藏中都包含这些文物样本，但它们出土于埃及以及欧洲的许多遗址。

Query_Text_en: Sometimes the latter have several birds perching on a kind of frame like a gun .
Translation: 有时后者会在类似枪形的支架上栖息多只鸟类。

Query_Text_en: These questions remain unanswered , but Laufer has summarised all the information available .
Translation: 这些问题仍未得到解答，但劳弗已汇总了所有现有信息。

Query_Text_en: In these fields we find , therefore , the same situation that we have already encountered , namely , the almost simultaneous appearance of ideas and techniques at both ends of the Old World .
Translation: 因此，在这些领域，我们发现了与之前遇到的相同情况，即旧大陆两端的思想与技术几乎同时出现。

Query_Text_en: Janse emphasises that in those early times there was no barrier of independent national State frontiers to hinder diffusion and exchange across the vast length of the steppes which extend from the Baltic and the Carpathians to the Ordos , and he illustrates this with an excellent map .
Translation: Janse指出，在早期时期并不存在独立民族国家疆界的障碍来阻隔横亘波罗的海、喀尔巴阡山脉至鄂尔多斯广大草原地带的传播与交流，并以一幅详尽的地图对此加以阐释。

Query_Text_en: He also makes the acute observation that from the beginning of both the Hallstatt and the corresponding Chinese cultures there was an association of salt and iron .
Translation: 他还敏锐观察到，从哈尔施塔特文化和相应的中国文化发轫之初，盐与铁便已存在关联。

Query_Text_en: He notes that both were also interested in yellow amber .
Translation: 他指出，两者也都对黄色琥珀感兴趣。

Query_Text_en: From the figures or scenes depicted on these ancient works of art in bronze or precious metals or jade it is not a far cry to questions of folklore and ancient mythology .
Translation: 从青铜、贵金属或玉石等古代艺术品上所描绘的人物或场景，到民间传说和古代神话的问题，其间距离并不遥远。

Query_Text_en: The interesting work of Andersson on hunting magic as seen in the eurasiatic zoo style suggests connections with the earliest Neolithic or Palaeolithic cave paintings , as in the Dordogne .
Translation: 安德森关于狩猎魔法的研究（如欧亚动物园风格所示）表明，其与最早的新石器时代或旧石器时代洞穴壁画存在联系，例如多尔多涅地区的壁画。

Query_Text_en: Przyluski has devoted a fascinating paper to the imipedsdivine beings with mermaid tails , representations of which are found in Gaul as much as in China .
Translation: 普日卢斯基曾撰写了一篇引人入胜的论文，探讨了那些拥有美人鱼尾巴的神灵形象，这类形象在高卢和中国都有所发现。

Query_Text_en: Fu-Hsi , one of the mythical ancestor , was often shown in this form ;
Translation: 伏羲作为神话祖先之一，常以这种形象出现；

Query_Text_en: Bishop draws attention , to the fact that the center of his worship has always been in the Wei valley in the north of China , and I myself had occasion to note the mermaid tail still iconographically prominent when visiting the chief temple of Fu-Hsi at Thienshui in Kansu in 1945 .
Translation: 比ishops指出，其崇拜中心始终位于中国北部的渭河流域，而我自己在1945年造访甘肃天水伏羲主庙时，亦注意到人鱼尾的形象在图像学中仍占显著地位。

Query_Text_en: Armstrong , following the lead of Granet , has investigated , in an interesting series of memoirs , some common themes in Chinese and Western folklore .
Translation: 阿姆斯特朗在格兰特的启发下，通过一系列有趣的研究论文，对中西方民间传说中的共同主题进行了探讨。

Query_Text_en: In the crane dance he sees counterparts of the minotaur in the bull Shen Nung and Chhih-Yu , and of the labyrinth in the underground passages of the tomb of Chhin Shih Huang Ti ;
Translation: 在鹤舞中，他从与牛相关的神农和赤玉形象中看到了米诺陶洛斯的对应物，又从秦始皇陵的地下通道里窥见了迷宫的倒影。

Query_Text_en: finding that the dance itself was part of a cultural pattern of sacrificial and funerary ritual which extended from the Aegean through the Fertile Crescent to China and south Asia .
Translation: 发现该舞蹈本身属于一种从爱琴海经肥沃新月地带延伸至中国和南亚的祭祀与葬礼仪式文化模式。

Query_Text_en: The later association of the crane with Taoist mysticism is well known .
Translation: 鹤与道教神秘主义的联系后来广为人知。

Query_Text_en: Granet had already identified the crane ritual with magic concerning thunder , rain , fertility and reincarnation .
Translation: 格拉内早已指出，鹤仪式与涉及雷、雨、生育和轮回的魔法有关。

Query_Text_en: In two other papers Armstrong concludes that there was a eurasiatic community of ploughing ritual practices , ranging from the Chinese imperial ceremonial ploughing at one end to the triple field depicted on the shield of Achilles in Homers description , or to our own Plough Monday , at the other .
Translation: 阿姆斯特朗在另外两篇论文中得出结论认为，欧亚大陆存在着一个耕作仪式实践共同体，其范围从中国皇帝的仪式性耕作延伸至另一端——荷马史诗中描述的阿基琉斯盾牌上的三田图案，或是我们自己的"犁周一"传统。

Query_Text_en: Then there is the magic connected with the herb Artemisia vulgaris or alba , prominent in the Shih Ching ( Book of Odes ) , widely used not only in China but also in ancient and medieval Europe , and even in Mexico , as a constituent of incense and a powerful demonifuge , in spite of the unimpressive character of the plant .
Translation: 艾蒿（Artemisia vulgaris 或 Artemisia alba）在《诗经》中占有重要地位，不仅在中国，在古代和中世纪的欧洲，甚至墨西哥也被广泛用作熏香成分和强大的驱魔剂，尽管这种植物本身貌不惊人。

Query_Text_en: Another paper elucidates the affinities of Chinese bull ritual and spring ceremonies with parallel rites in ancient Crete and Egypt ;
Translation: 另一篇论文阐明了中国公牛祭祀和春季仪式与古克里特和埃及相应仪式之间的关联。

Query_Text_en: and a sixth compares bird symbolism ( especially that of the goose and swan ) with that of the West .
Translation: 第六部分对比了鸟类象征意义（尤其是鹅和天鹅的象征）与西方的相关象征。

Query_Text_en: Students of comparative folk structure debate whether the Mongol conquests were important in transmission to Europe .
Translation: 比较民俗结构的研究者就蒙古征服是否在向欧洲的传播中起到了重要作用展开了争论。

Query_Text_en: This field should be a fertile source for thought comparisons , as a good deal of work has been done on Chinese folklore and mythology ; though the conclusions are bound to remain somewhat speculative .
Translation: 这一领域本应成为思想比较的沃土，因为已有关于中国民间传说和神话的大量研究成果；不过，相关结论难免会带有一定推测性。

Query_Text_en: Another attempt along the same line has been that of the Indian scholar Coyaji , who has been able to draw striking comparisons between the Persian epic of Firdausi , the Shah and the Chinese epic or legend , the Feng Shen Yen .
Translation: 另一位沿着这一思路进行尝试的学者是印度学者科亚吉，他成功地将菲尔多西的波斯史诗《沙赫名》与中国传说《封神演义》进行了引人注目的比较。

Query_Text_en: The latter was put together by Hsii Chung-Lin in the Ming ( i.e. at some time in the +15 th or +16 th century ) .
Translation: 后者是由奚仲麟在明朝时期（即15世纪或16世纪的某个时期）编纂的。

Query_Text_en: It deals with the overthrow of Chou Hsin , the last Shang emperor , by Wu Wang of the Chou , giving full rein to a rather Buddhist imagination in describing the magic wherewith the spirit of the Chou destroy the monsters which come to the aid of the Shang .
Translation: 该文本讲述了周武王推翻商朝末代君主商纣王的历史事件，通过颇具佛教色彩的想象力，详细描述了周朝先祖借助法术摧毁那些前来援助商朝的怪物的场景。

Query_Text_en: Chou Hsin finally perishes in the flames , and Wu Wang rewards the spiritual beings and loyal ministers who have helped him by endowing them with titles , ranks and fiefs .
Translation: 商纣最终在战火中覆灭，周武王为酬谢助其成就大业的神灵与忠臣，赐予他们爵位、封地和俸禄。

Query_Text_en: But the material of this legend is known to have been of far earlier date .
Translation: 但据知这一传说的素材年代更为久远。

Query_Text_en: Some of its ideas can be found in the I Chou Shu ( Lost Books of Chou ) , a work of which only ten chapters now remain , but which was found during the Chin dynasty when in +281 the tomb of An Li Wang4 ( one of the princes of the feudal State of Wei , who had died in 245 ) was opened .
Translation: 其部分思想可于《逸周书》中窥见。此书现存仅十篇，然于晋朝时期（公元281年）在魏国诸侯安厘王墓中被发现——该诸侯于公元前245年去世，其墓主即为战国时期魏国封君之一。

Query_Text_en: Other books which were found at the same time were the Chu Shu Chi Nien ( Records of the Bamboo Books , already referred to ) , and the Mu Thien Tzu Chuan .
Translation: 同时发现的其他书籍包括《竹书纪年》（即《竹书纪年》，已提及）和《木天禁语》。

Query_Text_en: The magical epic , therefore , in its final state , is derived from pre-Han Taoist and post-Han Buddhist stories .
Translation: 因此，这种魔幻史诗在其最终形态中，源自汉代以前的道教故事和汉代以后的佛教故事。

Query_Text_en: Coyaji now points out parallels of a rather striking nature with the Shah Kaus corresponds to Chou Hsin , Sudabah the wicked empress corresponds to Su Ta-Chi , Syawash the virtuous prince corresponds to Yin Chiao , Rustum to Li Ching , Suhrab to No Chha , Keresasp to the archer Yi , while Paladwands magicians have their due counterparts There are many parallelisms also in cults , as of mountains , rivers , and the mushrooms of immortality for which Barzoe the physician searches .
Translation: 科雅吉现在指出与沙赫·考斯对应周辛、邪恶皇后苏达巴对应苏妲己、贤德王子西亚瓦什对应殷郊、鲁斯塔姆对应李靖、苏哈尔布对应诺查、克瑞萨斯普对应神射手后羿，帕拉万达斯的巫师们同样有其对应角色。在崇拜方面，如山川及巴佐伊医生所寻长生不老的蘑菇等，亦存在诸多平行对应。

Query_Text_en: It would take us too far to follow them further , but the question of the date of the Iranian material remains .
Translation: 继续深入探讨这些内容会过于偏离主题，但伊朗材料的日期问题依然存在。

Query_Text_en: Firdausi of TGs , one of the greatest of Persian poets , wrote the Shah between +990 and +1001 under the first of the Ghaznavid Sultans , c but the saga material he used was much older , and had first been written down in the Middle Persian prose works which Ibn al-Muqaffa had translated into Arabic .
Translation: 菲尔多西（Firdausi）是波斯最伟大的诗人之一，其史诗《沙纳玛》（Shahnameh）创作于公元990年至1001年间，正值伽色尼苏丹国第一任苏丹统治初期。但他所使用的史诗素材更为古老，最初源自中古波斯语散文作品，这些文本曾被伊本·穆格法（Ibn al-Muqaffa）译成阿拉伯语。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , it does not appear to be quite so old as the Chinese .
Translation: 然而，它似乎并不像中国的那样古老。

Query_Text_en: But the subject requires further study and is only mentioned here as an example of possible cultural exchange .
Translation: 但这一问题有待深入研究，此处仅将其作为文化交流的一个可能例证。

Query_Text_en: Another Iranian-Chinese parallel , pointed out by Darmesteter , is that of the blasphemy of a king shooting arrows at Heaven ;
Translation: 达马斯泰特指出的另一例伊朗与中国之间的平行对照，是关于一位国王向天射箭的渎神之举。

Query_Text_en: this seems to have come from Persia and was ascribed to several Chinese rulers , including the last prince of the State of Sung in 286 .
Translation: 这似乎源自波斯，并被归于数位中国统治者，其中包括宋国于286年的末代君主。

Query_Text_en: When one passes from folklore themes to purely artistic motifs the relations between different civilisations seem even harder to trace , at any rate for those who are not art .
Translation: 当从民俗主题转向纯粹艺术主题时，不同文明之间的关系似乎更加难以追溯，至少对于那些不具备艺术素养的人而言更是如此。

Query_Text_en: When Yetts says that the winged animals seen in the Chinese patterned silks found at Loulan and by the Kozlov expedition in Mongolia proclaim their Mesopotamian ancestry a certain hesitation may be excused .
Translation: 当叶特斯指出，在楼兰发现的中国纹样丝绸以及科兹洛夫蒙古考察队发现的翼兽图案表明其美索不达米亚起源时，这种保留态度是可以理解的。

Query_Text_en: There is , however , one interesting case of diffusion which has been rather thoroughly worked out , and which , to a historian of science , is somewhat convincing .
Translation: 不过，有一个扩散现象的有趣案例被研究得相当透彻，对于科学史研究者而言，这一案例具有一定的说服力。

Query_Text_en: I mean the investigation of Reinach on the flying gallop .
Translation: 我指的是雷纳赫关于飞快步的调查研究。

Query_Text_en: It has recently been extended by Rostovtzev .
Translation: 该措施最近由罗索夫采夫延长。

Query_Text_en: and ( d ) flying ( all four legs extended , and all off the ground ) .
Translation: (d) 飞行（四足完全展开且全部离地）。

Query_Text_en: Slow-motion cinematography in our own time proved that not one of the ancient positions except the first actually occurs in nature , but the interest of the matter in the present connection lies in the historico distribution of the last form , the flying gallop .
Translation: 我们这个时代慢动作摄影术证明，除了第一个姿势外，其他古代姿势实际上在自然界中并不存在。但这一问题在当前讨论中的兴趣点在于最后一种形态——飞驰姿势——的历史分布情况。

Query_Text_en: Before the +18 th century , at which time it was brought from China to Europe , this posture had been universally unknown in European artwith one exception , the Mycenaean , Minoan and Phoenician ( c. 1000 ) .
Translation: 在18世纪之前，这种姿势在欧洲艺术中完全不为人知，只有一个例外，即迈锡尼、米诺斯和腓尼基（约公元前1000年）文明。

Query_Text_en: For some reason still obscure , this representation traveled east , and is found in Sassanid Persia , Bactria and China from the 3rd century onwards .
Translation: 出于某种至今仍不明朗的原因，这种表现形式向东方传播，并从3世纪起出现在萨珊波斯、巴克特里亚和中国。

Query_Text_en: Probably the impression of speed which it gives appealed to the Asian horse archers , such as the Parthians and Huns .
Translation: 这种速度感可能吸引了亚洲的骑射民族，例如帕提亚人和匈奴人。

Query_Text_en: In any case , the diffusion of this posture in art is a remarkable example of the contiguity of Chinese and Mediterranean or West Asian , cultures .
Translation: 无论如何，这种艺术造型的传播是中国与地中海地区或西亚文化关联的显著例证。

Query_Text_en: It would take us much too far to go over all that the art historians have discovered about the mutual relations of Chinese art with that of other peoples .
Translation: 要详细阐述艺术史家们关于中国艺术与其他民族艺术相互关系的所有发现，将使我们离题太远。

Query_Text_en: There are reviews dealing with the spread of Scythian and Sarmatian art , with the passage of Greek art embodying Indian content eastwards through Bactria , with the Iranian motif of the grapes and wine , and with the coming of post-Renaissance painting and perspective to China at the time of the Jesuits .
Translation: 有研究涉及斯基泰和萨尔马提亚艺术的传播、希腊艺术经巴克特里亚向东传播过程中融入印度元素的现象、伊朗葡萄与葡萄酒主题的演变，以及耶稣会传教时期文艺复兴后绘画及透视技法传入中国的情况。

Query_Text_en: Conversely , there had been a distinct influence of Chinese culture on the European art of the late Middle Ages and the Renaissance , especially in Italy , whither Marco Polo had returned .
Translation: 相反，中国文化的显著影响曾波及欧洲中世纪末期和文艺复兴时期的艺术领域，尤其是意大利——马可·波罗曾返回过的地方。

Query_Text_en: Stylistic traits , and the actual painting of Asian types of personages , appear in Tuscan pictures of this period .
Translation: 这一时期的托斯卡纳画作中出现了亚洲人物形象的具体描绘以及相应的风格特征。

Query_Text_en: Asian art reached Europe , and Popes were buried in Chinese silks as other men of mark had been in Palmyra more than a thousand years before .
Translation: 亚洲艺术传入欧洲，教皇被安葬在中国丝绸中，正如一千多年前帕尔米拉的显要人物那样。

Query_Text_en: In the eighteenth century the influence of Chinese art on European design and decoration was extremely strong , as may be seen in the monographs of Reichwein and Appleton . Relations between . Chinese and Persian art were always close , especially so between the +12 th and +14 th centuries , when the influence was westwards .
Translation: 18世纪时，中国艺术对欧洲设计与装饰艺术的影响极为显著，如赖兴温和阿普尔顿的专著所示。中国与波斯艺术的关系始终密切，尤其在12世纪至14世纪期间尤为显著，此时影响方向是向西的。

Query_Text_en: A subject not unrelated to the foregoing is the exchange of cultural influences in matters of clothing .
Translation: 与前述议题不无关联的另一个重要议题是服饰领域的文化影响交流。

Query_Text_en: The hennin or tall conical sugarloaf hat with a veil of muslin hanging down from the top , worn by medieval European ladies ( +15 th century ) derived from a fashion which the Buddhist pilgrim Hui-Seng noted when , he visited Bactria in +518 , and which afterwards had a long run in China from the +11 th to the +14 th centuries .
Translation: 中世纪欧洲女士（15世纪）佩戴的高筒糖锥形帽配有一顶从顶部垂下的棉布面纱，其设计源自佛教僧人慧生在公元518年访问巴克特里亚时所见的时尚潮流，并在此后于中国从11世纪至14世纪期间长期流行。

Query_Text_en: It has also been suggested that the crinoline , and the sticking of beauty on the face , were originally Asian .
Translation: 有人还认为，裙撑以及面部贴花最初源自亚洲。

Query_Text_en: Kondakov , too , considers that the scaramangion or long stiff brocade robe worn by Byzantine nobles , was Chinese in origin .
Translation: 孔达科夫也认为，拜占庭贵族所穿的scaramangion（长硬缎袍）源自中国。

Query_Text_en: When at the cave of Tunhuang , I was greatly impressed by the caparisoned horses of the Northern Wei dynasty ( c. +450 ) and their armored riders , astonishingly reminiscent of the knights of medieval Europe a thousand years later .
Translation: 在敦煌洞窟中，北魏时期（约公元450年）装饰华丽的战马及其身着铠甲的骑士给我留下了深刻印象，它们的形象惊人地让人联想到一千多年后中世纪欧洲的骑士。

Query_Text_en: It is also likely that philological studies will throw some light on ancient cultural exchanges .
Translation: 语文学研究也很有可能阐明古代文化交流的情况。

Query_Text_en: Mutual borrowing of words between the Indo-European and the Sino-Thai groups of languages must have occurred , though the number of well cases , as Forrest says in his new review , seems exceedingly small .
Translation: 印欧语系与汉泰语族语言之间必定发生过相互借用词语的现象，不过正如福雷斯特在其新近综述中所指出的，这类明确的例证数量似乎极为有限。

Query_Text_en: However , there are papers by Hirth , Conrady and H. Jensen , which are worth looking into .
Translation: 不过，赫思特、康拉迪和H·延森等人撰写的相关论文值得深入探讨。

Query_Text_en: For example , it is now generally accepted that the word lo ( anciently lak ) , which meant various kinds of fermented milk products , was a loan from the Indo-European root glakt ( Lat . lac ; lactic , galactic ) .
Translation: 例如，目前人们普遍认为，表示各种发酵乳制品的词汇"lo"（古时拼写为lak）源自印欧语根词glakt（拉丁语lac；派生词包括lactic乳酸的、galactic银河的）。

Query_Text_en: Milk was as foreign to autochthonous Chinese diet as it was basic to that of all the nomadic peoples .
Translation: 牛奶对中原地区的传统饮食而言是陌生的，而对所有游牧民族的饮食结构而言却是基本组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Our own impression of such studies is that they are most valuable when they have some direct relation with a concrete piece of technology , the movements of which can be traced by means of epigraphic illustrations and literary evidenced Otherwise they are liable to remain rather speculative .
Translation: 我们对这类研究的看法是，当它们与具体技术实例存在直接关联时最有价值，因为可以通过铭刻图示和文献证据追踪这些技术的发展轨迹。否则，这类研究容易停留在较为推测性的层面。

Query_Text_en: Before going further , a short digression on the names by which China was known in the West seems indispensable .
Translation: 在继续之前，对中国在西方所熟知的名称进行简短的探讨似乎是必要的。

Query_Text_en: There is no doubt that the origin of the word Seres is ssu , silk , transmitted to Europe as Gr . ser , and that it therefore dates from approximately the beginning of the silk trade , here the word did not mean the Chinese , but only Siberian tribes who acted as middlemen , and in its proper application to China is not found before the time of Julius Caesar and Augustus .
Translation: 无可争议的是，"Seres"一词源自古汉语"丝"（ssu），传入欧洲后成为希腊语中的ser，因此其起源可追溯至丝绸贸易开始时期左右。这个词最初并不指代中国人，而仅指作为中间商的西伯利亚部落，直到凯撒和奥古斯都时期才正式用于指代中国。

Query_Text_en: This seems to show that some silk was finding its way to the West , through many intermediate hands , before Chang Chhien 's journey and the opening of the Old Silk Road .
Translation: 这似乎表明，在张骞出使和丝绸之路开通之前，丝绸已通过众多中间商之手传入西方。

Query_Text_en: The glory of the First Unification took the name of the 3rd Chhin dynasty to India , giving rise to the Sanskrit forms Clnasthana and Mahacmasthana , whence derived Sina in Latin , and Thinae or olv ( as in the Periplus ) , Byzantine Tzinista ( as in Cosmas ) , al-Sin in Arabic , and our own common word China .
Translation: 首次统一的辉煌使第三秦朝之名传入印度，由此衍生出梵语形式的Clnasthana和Mahacmasthana，进而衍生出拉丁语中的Sina，以及《航海记》中记载的Thinae或oliv、拜占庭时期的Tzinista（如科斯马斯所述）、阿拉伯语中的al-Sin，以及我们今天通用的“中国”一词。

Query_Text_en: We summarise advances in the epidemiology , presentation , pathogenesis , diagnosis , and management of acute aortic dissection .
Translation: 我们总结了急性主动脉夹层在流行病学、临床表现、发病机制、诊断和治疗方面的进展。

Query_Text_en: Improved understanding of this problem has been assisted not only by establishment of an international registry but also by progress in molecular biology and genetics of connective-tissue diseases .
Translation: 对这一问题的认识提升不仅得益于国际登记制度的建立，还受益于结缔组织疾病分子生物学和遗传学领域的进展。

Query_Text_en: Advances in endovascular products and techniques have provided new treatment options .
Translation: 血管内产品和技术的进展为治疗提供了新的选择。

Query_Text_en: Open surgical repair remains the main treatment for dissection in the ascending aorta , whereas endovascular treatment is increasingly being used in dissection that is limited to other parts of the aorta .
Translation: 开放手术修复仍是升主动脉夹层的主要治疗方法，而血管内治疗则越来越多地用于局限于主动脉其他部位的夹层。

Query_Text_en: Aortic dissection is a potentially critical break in the lining of the main arterial outflow from the heart .
Translation: 主动脉夹层是心脏发出的主要动脉内层可能出现的潜在严重破裂。

Query_Text_en: The emergency nature of this problem does not easily lend itself to study by randomised controlled trials .
Translation: 这一问题的紧急性质使其难以通过随机对照试验进行研究。

Query_Text_en: The establishment of an international registry and improved understanding of molecular biology and genetics of aortic disease have , however , led to substantial advances in the understanding of this disease [ panel 1 ] .
Translation: 然而，国际登记系统的建立以及对主动脉疾病分子生物学和遗传学的深入理解，已带来了对该疾病认识的重大进展[图1]。

Query_Text_en: The aim of this Seminar is to provide a comprehensive review of acute aortic dissection , concentrating on developments since the last Seminar on this topic in The Lancet .
Translation: 本次研讨会旨在对急性主动脉夹层进行全面回顾，重点探讨自《柳叶刀》上一次就此主题举办研讨会以来的最新进展。

Query_Text_en: Population-based studies suggest an incidence of acute aortic dissection of about three cases per 100 000 people per year .
Translation: 基于人群的研究表明，急性主动脉夹层的年发病率约为每10万人中3例。

Query_Text_en: Clouse and colleagues studied presentation of acute aortic dissection during 14 years in Olmsted County , MN , USA .
Translation: 克劳斯及其同事对美国明尼苏达州奥姆斯特德县14年间急性主动脉夹层的发病情况进行了研究。

Query_Text_en: They estimated that the incidence of acute aortic dissection in the County was 3.5 cases per 100 000 people per year between 1980 and 1994 . In a community-based study of three small towns in western Hungary [ Sumeg , Tapolca , and Keszthely ] between 1971 and 1998 , Meszaros and colleagues reported that 84 patients had acute aortic dissection , with an incidence of about 2.9 cases per 100 000 people per year .
Translation: 他们估计，在1980年至1994年间，该县急性主动脉夹层的发病率为每年每10万人3.5例。在匈牙利西部三个小镇（Sumeg、Tapolca和Keszthely）开展的基于社区的研究中，梅扎罗斯及其团队于1971年至1998年间报告了84例急性主动脉夹层病例，发病率为每年每10万人约2.9例。

Query_Text_en: A population-based study reported the combined incidence of aortic dissection and aneurysm .
Translation: 一项基于人群的研究报告了主动脉夹层和动脉瘤的合并发病率。

Query_Text_en: This study is of interest since it was done in Sweden , where excellent maintenance of databases and registries combined with a high rate of post-mortem examination in unexplained deaths suggests improved ascertainment of cases .
Translation: 这项研究值得关注，因为它是在瑞典进行的。该国数据库和登记系统的良好维护与在不明死因案件中进行尸检的高比率相结合，表明病例确认的准确性有所提高。

Query_Text_en: Between 1987 and 2002 , 4425 cases of aortic dissection were identified within a population of about 8.7 million , which equates to 3.4 per 100 000 people per year .
Translation: 在1987年至2002年间，约870万人口中共确诊4425例主动脉夹层病例，相当于每年每10万人中约3.4例。

Query_Text_en: The yearly incidence of aortic dissection and aneurysm combined increased by 50 % in men and 30 % in women during these 16 years .
Translation: 在过去的16年间，男性和女性的主动脉夹层与动脉瘤年合并发病率分别上升了50%和30%。

Query_Text_en: The reasons for this increase are unknown but might relate to improved identification of cases , with enhanced imaging or increasing age of the population , or both .
Translation: 此次增长的具体原因尚不清楚，但可能与病例识别能力的提升、影像技术的改进或人口老龄化有关，或两者兼而有之。

Query_Text_en: Overall about 20 % of patients died before reaching hospital , 30 % during hospital admission , and a further 20 % over the next 10 years .
Translation: 总体而言，约20%的患者在抵达医院前死亡，30%在住院期间死亡，另有20%在随后的十年中死亡。

Query_Text_en: Both circadian and seasonal variations in the frequency of aortic dissection have been recorded .
Translation: 主动脉夹层发生频率的昼夜节律和季节性变化已被记录。

Query_Text_en: Peak frequency has been reported to be between 0800 h and 0900 h and during the winter months .
Translation: 据报道，峰值频率出现在08:00至09:00时以及冬季期间。

Query_Text_en: A similar morning peak has been noted in other acute cardiovascular presentation and has been linked to circadian variation in blood pressure .
Translation: 类似晨峰现象在其他急性心血管表现中也被观察到，并与血压的昼夜节律变化相关。

Query_Text_en: Information about the mechanisms that underlie acute dissection comes from many sources , and we will discuss findings from case series , imaging studies , post-mortem studies , and pathological examinations of surgical biopsy samples , genetic studies , animal models , and in-vitro studies .
Translation: 关于急性剥离的发病机制研究，其相关信息涉及多个研究渠道。我们将讨论病例系列分析、影像学研究、尸检研究、手术活检样本病理检查、遗传学研究、动物模型实验以及体外研究等领域的研究成果。

Query_Text_en: We have focused on investigations reported since 2003 [ 22 of the 29 studies ] .
Translation: 我们聚焦于自2003年以来报告的研究调查（29项研究中的22项）。

Query_Text_en: The relation between aortic aneurysm and dissection has caused substantial confusion .
Translation: 主动脉瘤与夹层之间的关系已经造成了重大混淆。

Query_Text_en: Since pre-existing medial degeneration is an important risk factor for acute aortic dissection , patients could have a thoracic aneurysm before dissection .
Translation: 既存的中膜退化是急性主动脉夹层的重要风险因素，患者可能在夹层形成前已存在胸主动脉瘤。

Query_Text_en: However , in most cases , [ more than 80 % ] acute dissection develops in the absence of a pre-existing aneurysm .
Translation: 然而，在大多数情况下（超过80%），急性剥离是在没有原有动脉瘤的情况下发生的。

Query_Text_en: After the development of acute dissection , the false lumen might expand later to form an aneurysm as a complication of the dissection .
Translation: 急性夹层发生后，假腔可能会在后期扩张并发展为动脉瘤，作为夹层的一种并发症。

Query_Text_en: The International Registry of Acute Aortic Dissection [ IRAD ] has obtained contemporary data for the characteristics of large numbers of patients who present with acute aortic dissection .
Translation: 国际急性主动脉夹层登记处（IRAD）已获取了大量急性主动脉夹层患者的临床特征最新数据。

Query_Text_en: Table 1 shows comorbidities identified in patients who present with aortic dissection in the ascending aorta [ type A ] or more distal aorta [ type B ] in publications from IRAD .
Translation: 表1显示，在IRAD的出版物中，对就诊时伴有升主动脉夹层（A型）或远端主动脉夹层（B型）的患者所识别出的合并症。

Query_Text_en: The most commonly associated factors are a history of hypertension , old age , atherosclerosis , and previous cardiovascular surgery , especially previous repair of aortic aneurysm or dissection .
Translation: 最常见的相关因素包括高血压病史、高龄、动脉粥样硬化以及既往心血管手术史，尤其是既往主动脉瘤或夹层的修复手术。

Query_Text_en: To truly assess whether these features present in patients with aortic dissection are risk factors , we would need large community-based disease and control groups , but no such population studies exist .
Translation: 要真正评估主动脉夹层患者中出现的这些特征是否为风险因素，我们需要基于社区的大规模疾病组和对照组，但目前尚无此类人群研究。

Query_Text_en: The risk factors most probably relate to a combination of inherited and acquired weakening of the aortic media and intimal disease .
Translation: 风险因素很可能与遗传性和获得性因素导致的主动脉中层结构减弱及内膜疾病综合作用相关。

Query_Text_en: Marfan s syndrome is an important risk factor for aortic dissection especially in young patients [ table 1 ] .
Translation: 马凡综合征是主动脉夹层的重要危险因素，尤其是在年轻患者中[表1]。

Query_Text_en: Other inherited disorders , including Ehlers-Danlos syndrome type IV , Turner s syndrome , and less well known connective-tissue diseases , have been associated with aortic dissection but were not studied in the IRAD registry .
Translation: 其他遗传性疾病，包括Ehlers-Danlos综合征IV型、特纳综合征以及相对鲜为人知的结缔组织疾病，均与主动脉夹层相关，但未在IRAD注册中心的研究中进行探讨。

Query_Text_en: Bicuspid aortic valve was identified in a few patients in IRAD [ table 1 ] and might explain the increased risk of dissection in patients with Turner s syndrome .
Translation: 在IRAD研究中发现少数患者存在二叶式主动脉瓣（表1），这可能解释了特纳综合征患者主动脉夹层风险升高的现象。

Query_Text_en: Aortic vasculitis , such as Takayasu s or giant-cell arteritis , has also been associated with dissection .
Translation: 主动脉血管炎（例如Takayasu动脉炎或巨细胞动脉炎）也与夹层有关联。

Query_Text_en: Substantial advances have been made in the understanding of Marfan and related syndromes , which has implications for the understanding of aortic dissection in general .
Translation: 在马凡氏综合征及相关综合征的认识方面已取得实质性进展，这为深入理解主动脉夹层的发病机制提供了重要启示。

Query_Text_en: Classic Marfan s syndrome is inherited in an autosomal dominant way with variable penetrance and results from mutations in the gene for fibrillin 1 . Fibrillin 1 deficiency was traditionally thought to lead to structural weakening of the extracellular matrix at several sites including the aorta .
Translation: 经典马凡综合征以常染色体显性方式遗传，外显率不等，由原纤维蛋白1基因的突变引起。传统观点认为，原纤维蛋白1的缺乏会导致包括主动脉在内的多个部位的细胞外基质结构减弱。

Query_Text_en: Studies from mice models of Marfan s syndrome , however , suggest that fibrillins have pleiotropic functions in the extracellular matrix , including control of production and destruction of other matrix elements through their ability to interact with vascular smooth-muscle cells and modulate cytokine activity .
Translation: 然而，马凡综合征的小鼠模型研究显示，纤连蛋白在细胞外基质中具有多种功能，其可通过与血管平滑肌细胞相互作用以及调节细胞因子活性，从而控制其他基质成分的生成与破坏。

Query_Text_en: Thus in some types of fibrillin 1 mutations in mice , the aorta is normal at birth , but gradual loss of fibrillin 1 results in a secondary phenotypical change in the vascular smooth muscles , release of matrix-degrading enzymes , and inflammation .
Translation: 因此，在小鼠某些类型的纤维蛋白原1基因突变中，主动脉在出生时正常，但纤维蛋白原1的逐渐减少会导致血管平滑肌出现继发性表型变化、基质降解酶的释放以及炎症。

Query_Text_en: Genetic variation in fibrillin 1 can also improve the availability of the transforming growth factor [ TGF ] group of cytokines because of its effect on the function of latent TGF - binding protein .
Translation: 原纤维蛋白1基因的变异还可通过影响潜伏转化生长因子结合蛋白的功能，提高转化生长因子（TGF）类细胞因子的可利用性。

Query_Text_en: Mutations in receptors 1 and 2 for TGF have been described in other connective-tissue disorders associated with aortic aneurysm and dissection , including a Marfan-like syndrome and Loeys-Dietz syndrome , suggesting that TGF has a more general role in weakening of the aorta .
Translation: TGF受体1和2的基因突变已在其他与主动脉瘤和夹层相关的结缔组织疾病中被描述，其中包括马凡氏样综合征和洛伊兹-戴茨综合征，这表明TGF在主动脉结构弱化中可能具有更普遍的作用。

Query_Text_en: Ehlers-Danlos syndrome type IV is a rare autosomaldominant inherited defect in synthesis of type III procollagen [ COL3A1 ] .
Translation: Ehlers-Danlos综合征IV型是一种罕见的常染色体显性遗传疾病，其缺陷在于III型前胶原（COL3A1）的合成过程。

Query_Text_en: About 40 % of patients with Ehlers-Danlos syndrome type IV have dissection and rupture of different arteries by 40 years of age .
Translation: 大约40%的Ehlers-Danlos综合征IV型患者到40岁时会发生不同动脉的夹层和破裂。

Query_Text_en: Similar to fibrillin , the defect in type III collagen probably affects the incorporation of other microfibril components within the aortic media , such as type I collagen , and interaction with vascular smooth-muscle cells .
Translation: 类似于纤维蛋白，III型胶原蛋白的缺陷可能会影响主动脉中层中其他微原纤维成分（例如I型胶原蛋白）的整合，以及与血管平滑肌细胞的相互作用。

Query_Text_en: The structural change in elastic arteries resulting from a deficiency of type III collagen also leads to increased circumferential stress , which could be important in promoting dissection .
Translation: 由于III型胶原蛋白缺乏导致的弹性动脉结构改变也会引发环向应力升高，这可能在促进夹层形成中起重要作用。

Query_Text_en: About 1 % of the population has a bicuspid rather than a tricuspid aortic valve .
Translation: 人群中约有1%的人具有二叶式而非三叶式主动脉瓣。

Query_Text_en: The association between bicuspid aortic valve and aortic dilatation and dissection has been linked to an acquired deficiency of aortic fibrillin , apoptosis of vascular smooth-muscle cells , and upregulation of matrix metalloproteinase .
Translation: 二叶式主动脉瓣与主动脉扩张及夹层之间的关联归因于获得性主动脉纤维连接蛋白缺乏、血管平滑肌细胞凋亡以及基质金属蛋白酶的表达上调。

Query_Text_en: Echocardiography studies of relatives of patients with bicuspid aortic valves showed a rate of about 30 % of valvular or other cardiovascular anomalies , favoring a substantial genetic role in their development .
Translation: 二叶式主动脉瓣患者亲属的超声心动图检查结果显示，约30%存在瓣膜或其他心血管异常，这表明遗传因素在其发病机制中起重要作用。

Query_Text_en: No clear candidate genes have been identified .
Translation: 尚未确定明确的候选基因。

Query_Text_en: There also seems to be a genetic basis for aortic dissection that is not associated with a recognized connective-tissue deficiency syndrome .
Translation: 主动脉夹层似乎也存在遗传基础，且这种基础与已知的结缔组织缺乏综合征无关。

Query_Text_en: Up to 19 % of patients who present with a thoracic aneurysm or dissection have a first-degree relative with a similar history .
Translation: 在就诊时患有胸主动脉瘤或夹层的患者中，最高可达19%的人群具有一级亲属存在类似病史。

Query_Text_en: Such familial thoracic aortic aneurysm and dissection seem to result from many genetic abnormalities , and linkage studies have suggested that genes present at various chromosome locations , including 3p24-25 , 5q13-14 , and 16p12.2-p13 .13 , have a role .
Translation: 这类家族性胸主动脉瘤和夹层似乎源于多种遗传异常，连锁研究结果表明，位于3p24-25、5q13-14和16p12.2-p13.13等不同染色体位置的基因可能起作用。

Query_Text_en: One of the genetic mutation sites identified within 3p24-25 is TGF receptor 2 , which further strengthens the association between TGF and aortic dissection .
Translation: 在3p24-25区域内发现的基因突变位点之一是TGF受体2，这进一步强化了TGF与主动脉夹层之间的关联。

Query_Text_en: The findings of histological examination of biopsies of aortic dissection partly depend on the predisposing risk factors .
Translation: 主动脉夹层活检的组织学检查结果部分取决于易感危险因素。

Query_Text_en: Cystic medial necrosis is a hallmark histological finding , especially in patients with a pre-existing aneurysm .
Translation: 囊性中层坏死是典型的组织学特征，尤其是在已有动脉瘤的患者中。

Query_Text_en: Microscopic features include decreased vascular smooth-muscle cells , mucoid deposition , elastin deficiency , and fragmentation .
Translation: 显微特征包括血管平滑肌细胞减少、粘液样沉积、弹性蛋白缺乏及碎片化。

Query_Text_en: Elastin fragmentation and loss of vascular smooth-muscle cells are similar to findings seen in abdominal aortic aneurysm , but inflammation is not a central feature , suggesting that the pathological changes are distinct .
Translation: 弹性蛋白碎片化及血管平滑肌细胞丢失与腹主动脉瘤中观察到的病理表现相似，但炎症并非主要特征，表明其病理变化存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Deficiencies of fibulin 5 have been noted in the aorta of patients with dissection in whom inherited connective-tissue disease has been excluded , suggesting the general importance of deficiency in microfibrillar components in stimulation of the extracellular remodelling .
Translation: 在排除遗传性结缔组织疾病的情况下，发现主动脉夹层患者的主动脉中存在纤维蛋白5缺乏现象，这表明微纤维成分缺乏在刺激细胞外重塑中具有普遍重要性。

Query_Text_en: The increasing use of high-resolution imaging to assess the aorta has led to the identification of a range of intimal and intramural pathological changes that have been related to dissection , including intramural hematoma and atherosclerotic ulcers .
Translation: 高分辨率成像技术在主动脉评估中的广泛应用，使得一系列与夹层相关的内膜和中膜病理变化得以识别，包括中膜血肿和动脉粥样硬化性溃疡等。

Query_Text_en: Histological examination of aortic ulcers shows noticeable intimal atherosclerosis , which is not a constant finding in biopsy samples from aortic dissection .
Translation: 组织学检查显示，主动脉溃疡存在明显的内膜动脉粥样硬化，而这一病理改变并非在主动脉夹层的活检样本中均可观察到。

Query_Text_en: Further information from natural history studies with serial imaging should provide better insight into the relation of these pathological changes .
Translation: 来自自然史研究的连续成像所提供的更多信息，将有助于更深入地认识这些病理变化之间的关系。

Query_Text_en: The studies outlined suggest that aortic dissection is the end process of an array of different pathological processes , many of which promote weakening of or increased stress on , the aortic wall , or both .
Translation: 研究结果表明，主动脉夹层是多种不同病理过程的最终阶段，其中许多病理过程会促进主动脉壁的薄弱或应力增加，或两者兼而有之。

Query_Text_en: The sequence of events might begin with a tear in a damaged intima .
Translation: 这一系列事件可能始于受损内膜的撕裂。

Query_Text_en: Atherosclerotic ulcers could be an evolving stage in the development of such a tear .
Translation: 动脉粥样硬化性溃疡可能是此类撕裂发展过程中的一个演变阶段。

Query_Text_en: Alternatively , disruption of a vasa vasorum might result in an intramural hematoma , which later ruptures into the aortic lumen .
Translation: 瓦瑟血管受损可能导致壁内血肿，该血肿随后破裂进入主动脉管腔。

Query_Text_en: As recognition emerges that atherosclerotic ulcer , intramural hematoma , and dissection might be related , a report from an international task force on aortic dissection has lent support to a classification that combines these entities [ panel 2 ] .
Translation: 随着人们认识到动脉硬化性溃疡、中膜血肿和夹层可能存在关联，一份关于主动脉夹层的国际工作组报告支持了将这些病变合并分类的体系（图2）。

Query_Text_en: Many dissections probably develop without involvement of an intimal ulcer or intramural hematoma .
Translation: 许多夹层可能在没有内膜溃疡或壁内血肿的情况下发生。

Query_Text_en: The exact sequence of events associated with the development of aortic dissection is still controversial , including the relation between penetrating atherosclerotic ulcer , intramural hematoma , and classic aortic dissection .
Translation: 目前，与主动脉夹层发展相关的事件确切顺序仍存在争议，包括穿透性动脉粥样硬化溃疡、夹层内膜下血肿与经典型主动脉夹层之间的关系。

Query_Text_en: Once a dissection path is started , blood can travel for a variable distance in an antegrade or retrograde manner , or both before re-entering the arterial lumen .
Translation: 一旦夹层裂口形成，血液可在顺行或逆行方向，或两者兼而有之的情况下，在重新进入动脉管腔前流动一段可变距离。

Query_Text_en: The extent of dissection is crucial to define the outcome of this process and thus the treatments needed .
Translation: 分析的深度对于界定这一过程的结果至关重要，因此也决定了所需采取的应对措施。

Query_Text_en: Accordingly , the staging of dissection has developed as an important means to define initial treatment plans .
Translation: 因此，分期已成为制定初始治疗方案的重要手段。

Query_Text_en: Several systems -- including the Stanford and De Bakey classifications -- have been developed .
Translation: 包括斯坦福分类法和德贝基分类法在内的数种分类系统已被开发。

Query_Text_en: Unlike the recently developed Svensson classification , the other two systems provide information about the extent of the dissection rather than the underlying pathological process [ panel 2 ] .
Translation: 与新近发展的Svensson分型不同，其他两种系统提供的是剥离范围的信息，而非其根本病理机制[图2]。

Query_Text_en: Since the main consideration in the staging of aortic dissection is whether the ascending aorta is affected , the Stanford system is preferred by many general physicians as a simple guide to whether urgent surgical treatment is needed [ figure 1 ] .
Translation: 由于在主动脉夹层分型中，主要考虑的是升主动脉是否受累，因此许多内科医生倾向于使用斯坦福分型系统作为判断是否需要紧急手术治疗的简单指南（图1）。

Query_Text_en: The most appropriate classification system depends on how it is being used [ eg , clinical stage or research ] , which is still controversial .
Translation: 最合适的分类系统取决于其具体用途（例如临床阶段或研究），这一点仍存在争议。

Query_Text_en: In an established aortic dissection the principal complications are aortic rupture , cardiac failure [ aortic regurgitation , acute myocardial infarction , or tamponade ] , and end-organ ischemia [ figure 1 ] .
Translation: 在已确诊的主动脉夹层中，主要并发症包括主动脉破裂、心力衰竭（主动脉反流、急性心肌梗死或心包填塞）以及器官缺血（见图1）。

Query_Text_en: The aorta gives rise to many important branches that supply oxygenated blood to the heart [ coronary arteries ] , arms [ subclavian arteries ] , brain [ carotid and vertebral arteries ] , spinal cord [ lumbar arteries ] , viscera [ coeliac and mesenteric arteries ] , kidneys [ renal arteries ] , and legs [ iliac arteries ] .
Translation: 主动脉分出许多重要分支，为心脏[冠状动脉]、上肢[锁骨下动脉]、大脑[颈动脉和椎动脉]、脊髓[腰动脉]、内脏[腹腔动脉和肠系膜动脉]、肾脏[肾动脉]以及下肢[髂动脉]输送富含氧气的血液。

Query_Text_en: These branch arteries can become poorly perfused as a result of fixed obstructions to their origin , as would happen if the arterial vessel was avulsed and thrombosed during dissection [ static malperfusion ] .
Translation: 分支动脉由于其起源处存在固定阻塞而导致灌注不足，例如动脉血管在剥离过程中发生撕脱和血栓形成时的情况[静态灌注不足]。

Query_Text_en: Alternatively , if a branch is perfused by the true or false lumen at the site of an established dissection , the supply to that branch will be affected dynamically by changes in the lumen .
Translation: 若在已形成的夹层部位，某分支血管由真腔或假腔供血，则该分支的血供会因管腔变化而动态受到影响。

Query_Text_en: Thus , high pressure within a false lumen , for example , could compress the true lumen and induce ischemia of organs fed from it .
Translation: 因此，假腔内的高压可能会压迫真腔，并导致由真腔供血的器官缺血。

Query_Text_en: Collapse of the true lumen can be a particular issue for coronary artery perfusion , which mainly takes place during diastole .
Translation: 真腔塌陷可能是冠状动脉灌注的一个突出问题，而这种情况主要发生在心室舒张期。

Query_Text_en: Understanding the mechanisms for this process has become increasingly important with the developing array of potential interventional treatments .
Translation: 随着潜在干预治疗手段的不断发展，理解这一过程的机制变得愈发重要。

Query_Text_en: In-vitro studies with plastic models , animal aortas , and post-mortem human aortas , combined with imaging and manometric studies in patients , have provided information about the mechanisms underlying malperfusion and factors that affect the outcome of the true and false lumen .
Translation: 体外研究（包括塑料模型、动物主动脉和尸体人体主动脉）结合患者的影像和测压研究结果，为低灌注的机制以及影响真假腔结局的因素提供了信息。

Query_Text_en: These studies have shown that the effect of dissection on perfusion to a branch artery is complex , dependent on whether the artery is perfused by the false or true lumen , relative collapse of the true lumen , and relation of the intimal flap to the branch artery .
Translation: 这些研究表明，剥离对分支动脉灌注的影响较为复杂，这取决于动脉是否由假腔或真腔供血、真腔的相对塌陷程度，以及内膜瓣与分支动脉的位置关系。

Query_Text_en: These findings have helped to promote the notion that expansion of the true lumen is enhanced by reducing inflow to the false lumen .
Translation: 这些发现有助于强化这样一种观点，即减少假腔的血流流入能够增强真腔的扩张。

Query_Text_en: Static obstruction of aortic branches can take place when dissection is associated with the origin of a branch vessel or extends into the artery , which might result in thrombosis of the vessel .
Translation: 当夹层累及分支血管的起始部或延伸至动脉内时，可能导致该血管发生血栓形成。

Query_Text_en: CT and MR angiography can be used to assess whether the branch arteries are being fed by the false or true lumen , and to identify collapse of the true lumen and thrombosis of the branch artery .
Translation: CT和磁共振血管造影可用于评估分支动脉是由假腔还是真腔供血，并识别真腔塌陷和分支动脉血栓形成。

Query_Text_en: Imaging findings could thus guide the interventionalist in maneuvers that are likely to be successful in achieving revascularisation , dependent on the mechanism of ischemia .
Translation: 因此，影像学检查结果能够指导介入治疗医师选择更有可能成功实现血管重建的介入操作，具体取决于缺血机制。

Query_Text_en: Table 2 shows the main presenting symptoms of acute aortic dissection .
Translation: 表2显示了急性主动脉夹层的主要临床表现。

Query_Text_en: Although patients usually present with chest pain , which might be described as sharp , tearing , or ripping , the presentation is diverse and about 10 % do not complain of pain .
Translation: 虽然患者通常以胸痛为症状出现，其疼痛可能被描述为尖锐、撕裂样或布撕样，但临床表现多样，约10%的患者不会诉说疼痛。

Query_Text_en: Hypotension or shock is seen in about a quarter of patients with acute type A dissection at presentation , whereas hypertension is a more common finding in those who have type B dissection .
Translation: 在急性A型夹层患者初次就诊时，约四分之一会出现低血压或休克表现，而高血压则在B型夹层患者中更为常见。

Query_Text_en: Other findings from patient history or examination -- such as migratory pain , absence of pulses , neurological deficit , aortic regurgitation , cardiac failure , and acute abdominal signs -- are less commonly present [ table 2 ] .
Translation: 病史或检查中发现的其他异常表现——例如游走性疼痛、脉搏缺失、神经功能缺损、主动脉反流、心力衰竭和急性腹症——较少出现[表2]。

Query_Text_en: Additional symptoms can relate to underlying connective-tissue disease , such as palate or uvula abnormalities , skin laxity , skeletal abnormalities , and lens dislocation .
Translation: 其他症状可能与潜在的结缔组织疾病相关，如腭或悬雍垂异常、皮肤松弛、骨骼异常和晶状体脱位。

Query_Text_en: Patients with acute aortic dissection commonly present with chest pain alone , and since about 8 % of visits to emergency departments are for this symptom , diagnosis on the basis of history and examination is not straightforward .
Translation: 急性主动脉夹层患者通常仅表现为胸痛。由于约8%的急诊科就诊病例是因这一症状就诊，仅凭病史和体格检查进行诊断并不容易明确。

Query_Text_en: Early accurate diagnosis is important because urgent surgical intervention might be needed .
Translation: 早期准确诊断很重要，因为可能需要紧急外科手术干预。

Query_Text_en: Thus rapid , cheap , accurate non-invasive tests , which can be done at the bedside , are ideal for initial diagnosis .
Translation: 因此，快速、廉价、准确的无创检测可在床边进行，是初步诊断的理想选择。

Query_Text_en: Various investigations -- including blood assays , electrocardiogram [ ECG ] , chest radiography , CT , and echocardiogram -- are done in most patients who present with suspected acute aortic dissection .
Translation: 在大多数疑似急性主动脉夹层患者中，会进行包括血液检测、心电图（ECG）、胸部X光检查、CT扫描和超声心动图等各项检查。

Query_Text_en: Unfortunately , the sensitivity and specificity of ECG and chest radiography is too low to definitively establish or exclude the diagnosis [ table 2 ] .
Translation: 心电图和胸部X线检查的敏感性和特异性均较低，无法明确确立或排除该诊断[表2]。

Query_Text_en: The development of a blood test or biomarker to aid in the diagnosis of aortic dissection is of increasing interest .
Translation: 开发用于辅助诊断主动脉夹层的血液检测或生物标志物正日益受到关注。

Query_Text_en: Promising initial findings have been reported for some novel markers including elastin fragments , D dimers , and smooth-muscle myosin heavy-chain protein .
Translation: 初步研究结果显示，包括弹性蛋白片段、D-二聚体和平滑肌肌球蛋白重链蛋白在内的新型标志物颇具潜力。

Query_Text_en: For example , smooth-muscle myosin heavy-chain protein was reported to have a sensitivity of 98 % and a specificity of 83 % for diagnosis of acute aortic dissection .
Translation: 例如，据报道，平滑肌肌球蛋白重链蛋白在诊断急性主动脉夹层中的灵敏度和特异性分别为98%和83%。

Query_Text_en: Since aortic dissection is a rare but potentially lethal cause of chest pain , any test needs to be nearly 100 % sensitive , ideally also with good specificity .
Translation: 由于主动脉夹层是导致胸痛的罕见但可能致命的原因，任何检测手段的灵敏度均需接近100%，理想情况下还应具备良好的特异性。

Query_Text_en: Large , multicentre prospective studies are underway to explore the diagnostic accuracy of various biomarkers before their role in diagnosis can be defined .
Translation: 在明确其诊断作用之前，大型多中心前瞻性研究正在进行中，以探索各种生物标志物的诊断准确性。

Query_Text_en: How important such biomarkers will become in diagnosis , when they should be measured , and what role they will have in prediction of outcome is unknown .
Translation: 关于这些生物标志物在诊断中的重要性、何时进行测量以及在预测结果方面将发挥何种作用，目前尚不清楚。

Query_Text_en: CT angiography or echocardiography is usually needed in patients in whom acute aortic dissection is clinically suspected on the basis of presentation and initial investigations .
Translation: 在临床上根据患者的临床表现和初步检查结果怀疑急性主动脉夹层的患者中，通常需要进行CT血管造影或超声心动图检查。

Query_Text_en: A systematic review of the diagnostic accuracy of transoesophageal echocardiography , CT angiography , and MRI reported a mean sensitivity and specificity of more than 95 % for all three investigations .
Translation: 一项系统综述显示，经食管超声心动图、CT血管造影和磁共振成像三种检查方法的平均灵敏度和特异性均超过95%。

Query_Text_en: Important findings include the extent of the dissection , the size of the true and false lumen , localisation of the intimal tear , the involvement of aortic branches , the presence and extent of aortic regurgitation , and the presence of periaortic hematoma , mediastinal hematoma , or effusion .
Translation: 重要发现包括夹层的范围、真腔和假腔的大小、内膜撕裂的位置、主动脉分支受累情况、主动脉反流的存在及其程度，以及是否存在主动脉旁血肿、纵隔血肿或积液。

Query_Text_en: The choice of imaging method depends on patients presentation , local availability of imaging equipment , and staff expertise in interpretation of the imaging .
Translation: 影像检查方法的选择取决于患者的临床表现、当地影像设备的可及性以及工作人员对影像的解读能力。

Query_Text_en: CT angiography can be rapidly done ; is available in most hospitals ; and provides important information about the extent of dissection , relation between the true and false lumen , and aortic branch compromise [ figure 2 ] .
Translation: CT血管造影可快速完成；在大多数医院均可开展；并能提供有关夹层范围、真腔与假腔关系以及主动脉分支受累情况的重要信息[图2]。

Query_Text_en: Thus , CT angiography is often done in patients in whom a dissection is diagnosed by echocardiography before making any management decision .
Translation: 因此，在通过超声心动图诊断出夹层的患者中，通常会在做出任何治疗决策前进行CT血管造影。

Query_Text_en: The introduction of 64-slice multidetector CT with ECG gating has allowed the simultaneous imaging of the aorta and coronary and pulmonary arteries , with the potential to accurately diagnose coronary atherosclerosis , pulmonary embolism , and aortic dissection in one method .
Translation: 64排螺旋CT结合心电门控技术的应用，使得同时对主动脉、冠状动脉及肺动脉进行成像成为可能，可通过单一方法实现对冠状动脉粥样硬化、肺栓塞和主动脉夹层的精准诊断。

Query_Text_en: Thus , CT will probably remain the first choice for diagnostic testing in most centres .
Translation: 因此，在大多数医疗机构中，CT可能仍将保持作为诊断检测的首选方法。

Query_Text_en: Serial follow-up imaging is important in patients with aortic dissection , and MRI has the advantage of avoiding ionising radiation .
Translation: 在主动脉夹层患者中，定期随访影像学检查至关重要，而MRI在避免电离辐射方面具有优势。

Query_Text_en: Guidelines recommend the use of echocardiography or CT , or both , in the initial imaging of patients suspected to have acute aortic dissection , whereas MRI is favored for the assessment of chronic dissection .
Translation: 指南建议对疑似急性主动脉夹层患者进行初始影像学检查时使用超声心动图或计算机断层扫描（CT），或两者联合应用，而磁共振成像（MRI）更适用于慢性夹层的评估。

Query_Text_en: Contrast angiography is recommended in patients in whom visceral malperfusion is suspected or percutaneous interventions are being considered .
Translation: 对于怀疑存在内脏缺血或考虑进行经皮介入治疗的患者，建议进行对比剂血管造影。

Query_Text_en: In practice , angiography might form part of concurrent endovascular therapy .
Translation: 在实践中，血管造影可能成为同时进行的血管内治疗的一部分。

Query_Text_en: In 2001 , the European Society of Cardiology published guidelines for the diagnosis and management of aortic dissection that were based on a task force of 11 representatives of appropriate international societies .
Translation: 2001年，欧洲心脏病学会发布了关于主动脉夹层诊断和治疗的指南，该指南基于由11位相关国际学术组织代表组成的专家工作组制定。

Query_Text_en: These guidelines remain the only society-based consensus document for the management of aortic dissection [ figure 3 and panel 3 ] , although the American College of Cardiology and American Heart Association Task Force on Practice Guidelines is developing a guideline for management of thoracic aortic diseases .
Translation: 这些指南仍然是目前针对主动脉夹层管理唯一基于专业学会共识的规范性文件[图3和小组3]，尽管美国心脏病学会与美国心脏协会实践指南制定工作组正在制定胸主动脉疾病管理指南。

Query_Text_en: After initial management and imaging , patients with type B aortic dissection are usually managed medically in an intensive-care unit .
Translation: 在初步处理和影像学检查后，B型主动脉夹层患者通常在重症监护病房接受内科治疗。

Query_Text_en: Exceptions include patients with signs of aortic rupture , evidence of substantially impaired perfusion of gastrointestinal tract or legs , and uncontrolled hyper tension despite medical treatment ; percutaneous or open surgical intervention is commonly recommended for these patients .
Translation: 例外情况包括存在主动脉破裂迹象、肠道或下肢灌注明显受损的证据，以及尽管接受药物治疗仍无法控制的高血压患者；这些患者通常建议采取经皮或开放手术治疗。

Query_Text_en: A priority in medical management is to maintain systolic blood pressure between 100 mm Hg and 120 mm Hg in an attempt to stabilise the dissection and discourage aortic rupture .
Translation: 医学管理中的优先任务是将收缩压维持在100毫米汞柱至120毫米汞柱之间，以稳定夹层并防止主动脉破裂。

Query_Text_en: Close monitoring for signs of aortic rupture or malperfusion , including repeat imaging , is important . blockers -- such as propranolol , metoprolol , labetolol , and esmolol -- are usually preferred to control initial blood pressure .
Translation: 密切监测主动脉破裂或灌注不足的征兆（包括重复影像学检查）非常重要。β受体阻滞剂——例如普萘洛尔、美托洛尔、拉贝洛尔和艾司洛尔——通常被首选用于控制初始血压。

Query_Text_en: In patients with asthma , calcium-channel blockers , such as verapamil or diltiazem , might be preferred .
Translation: 对于哮喘患者而言，钙通道阻滞剂（如维拉帕米或地尔硫卓）可能是更优选的药物。

Query_Text_en: In refractory hypertension , sodium nitroprusside often proves effective , although some physicians believe this complication to be an indication for surgical intervention .
Translation: 在顽固性高血压中，硝普钠通常被证明有效，尽管有些医生认为这种情况是手术治疗的指征。

Query_Text_en: Surgical resection of the ascending aorta is standard management of type A dissection .
Translation: 升主动脉切除术是A型夹层的标准治疗方案。

Query_Text_en: In case series of patients , only those with several comorbidities and who are moribund or refusing surgery are typically treated medically alone , with reported in-hospital mortality for these patients of about 50 % by 30 days .
Translation: 在针对一系列患者的治疗中，通常仅有那些存在多种合并症、处于临终状态或拒绝手术的患者会单独接受药物治疗，这些患者的住院死亡率在30天内报告约为50%。

Query_Text_en: 18 % of patients with type A dissection in IRAD , for example , were treated medically , because of comorbidities [ 33 % ] , patient or family choice [ 25 % ] , advanced age [ 21 % ] , or the presence of intramural hematoma alone on imaging [ 21 % ] .
Translation: 例如，在IRAD研究中，18%的A型夹层患者因合并症（占33%）、患者或家属选择（25%）、高龄（21%）或影像学仅显示夹层血肿（21%）等原因而接受药物治疗。

Query_Text_en: Repair or replacement of the aortic valve is also needed if substantial pre-existing pathological change of the aortic root or valves exists .
Translation: 若主动脉根部或瓣膜存在显著的原有病理性改变，则也需要进行主动脉瓣的修复或更换。

Query_Text_en: Depending on the anatomy and state of the coronary ostia , reconstruction of the coronary arteries is sometimes necessary when aortic-valve replacement is needed .
Translation: 根据冠状动脉开口的解剖结构和状态，当需要进行主动脉瓣置换时，有时需对冠状动脉进行重建。

Query_Text_en: Not surprisingly , many surgical approaches are used in large multicentre series .
Translation: 不足为奇的是，许多外科手术方法在大规模多中心系列研究中被采用。

Query_Text_en: IRAD reported the results of surgical repair of acute type A dissection in 682 patients treated at 18 tertiary centres in six countries .
Translation: 国际主动脉夹层注册研究（IRAD）报告了六个国家18个三级医疗中心收治的682例急性A型夹层患者手术修复结果。

Query_Text_en: Techniques used included right hemiarch replacement [ 27 % ] , aortic-valve replacement [ 24 % ] , and coronary arteries bypass [ 15 % ] .
Translation: 所采用的技术包括右半胸主动脉置换（27%）、主动脉瓣置换（24%）和冠状动脉搭桥（15%）。

Query_Text_en: One of the controversies in elective surgical repair of ascending aortic aneurysms is whether to repair the aortic valve or to replace it .
Translation: 在升主动脉瘤择期手术修复中，是否修复主动脉瓣还是进行置换是一个争议点。

Query_Text_en: Preservation of the patient s native aortic valve has the major advantage of avoiding the need for long-term anticoagulation , but the frequency of late reoperation can be high .
Translation: 保留患者的自身主动脉瓣具有避免长期抗凝治疗的主要优势，但远期再次手术的发生率可能较高。

Query_Text_en: In view of the complex nature of the surgery to resuspend the aortic valve , valve-sparing surgery was done in only 9 % of patients with acute dissection in IRAD .
Translation: 鉴于重新悬吊主动脉瓣手术的复杂性，在国际主动脉夹层登记研究中，仅对9%的急性夹层患者实施了保留瓣膜手术。

Query_Text_en: Another controversy in surgical management of type A dissection is the extent of distal resection to be done .
Translation: 在A型夹层外科治疗中，另一个争议点在于远端切除的范围应达到何种程度。

Query_Text_en: The dissection frequently extends beyond the ascending aorta and arch , and thus the false lumen might remain patent after ascending aortic replacement .
Translation: 夹层常会扩展至升主动脉和弓部以外，因此在进行升主动脉置换术后，假腔可能仍然保持开放。

Query_Text_en: With the substantial mortality and morbidity associated with resection of large parts of the aorta , there is increasing interest in combining open surgical repair of the ascending aorta with endovascular stent grafting .
Translation: 由于切除大段主动脉相关的高死亡率和发病率，人们越来越倾向于将升主动脉开放手术修复与血管内支架植入术相结合。

Query_Text_en: These procedures might be combined or staged ; however , the exact role of this combined procedure in management is unclear .
Translation: 这些程序可能被合并或分阶段实施；但合并后的程序在管理中的具体作用尚不明确。

Query_Text_en: Overall in-hospital mortality after conventional surgical treatment of type A dissection in a report from IRAD was 24 % .
Translation: 根据IRAD报告，A型夹层患者在接受传统手术治疗后的院内死亡率为24%。

Query_Text_en: Table 3 shows the risk predictors of outcome for patients with type A dissection [ overall and those undergoing surgery ] compared with those for type B dissection .
Translation: 表3对比了A型夹层患者（包括整体情况及接受手术的患者）与B型夹层患者的预后风险预测因素。

Query_Text_en: Patients who were unstable before operation because of shock , tamponade , stroke , or myocardial , renal , or mesenteric ischemia had a 30 % mortality , compared with 15 % for stable patients .
Translation: 术前因休克、心脏压塞、中风或心肌、肾、肠系膜缺血而不稳定的患者死亡率为30%，而稳定患者的死亡率为15%。

Query_Text_en: Similar in-hospital mortalities of 20-30 % have been reported in other surgical series , and about 55 % of patients return to independent living .
Translation: 其他外科病例系列报告的住院死亡率相似，约为20%-30%，约55%的患者能够恢复独立生活能力。

Query_Text_en: Because of the poor outcomes associated with resection of the descending aorta for acute type B dissection and the reasonable overall results for medical treatment , open surgery has been reserved for patients with complications including aortic rupture and malperfusion of mesenteric arteries , renal arteries , or arteries of the legs .
Translation: 由于针对急性B型主动脉夹层进行降主动脉切除的治疗效果不佳，且药物治疗的整体效果尚可，因此开胸手术目前仅用于出现主动脉破裂或肠系膜动脉、肾动脉或下肢动脉灌注不足等并发症的患者。

Query_Text_en: Resection of the whole aortic area involved in the dissection is usually impossible ; thus , patients generally still have perfusion of the false lumen after resection .
Translation: 通常无法切除整个涉及夹层的主动脉区域，因此患者在手术后仍可能存在假腔的血流灌注。

Query_Text_en: The European Society of Cardiology s guidelines recommend surgery when aortic rupture is suspected or when shown by the clinical picture or imaging findings of periaortic hematoma or acute aortic expansion .
Translation: 欧洲心脏病学会指南建议，当怀疑存在主动脉破裂，或临床表现或影像学检查结果提示存在主动脉旁血肿或急性主动脉扩张时，应采取手术治疗。

Query_Text_en: In a report from IRAD of 476 patients who presented with type B dissection to 18 referral centres , 11 % underwent surgery .
Translation: 根据IRAD的一份报告，在18家转诊中心接诊的476例B型夹层患者中，11%接受了手术治疗。

Query_Text_en: Indications for surgery [ several in a third of patients ] included aortic rupture [ 23 % ] , ischemia of the viscera [ 24 % ] or limbs [ 16 % ] , extension of the dissection [ 52 % ] , refractory pain [ 41 % ] , and uncontrollable hypertension [ 16 % ] .
Translation: 手术指征（其中三分之一的患者存在多种指征）包括主动脉破裂（23%）、内脏缺血（24%）或肢体缺血（16%）、夹层扩展（52%）、难治性疼痛（41%）以及无法控制的高血压（16%）。

Query_Text_en: In-hospital deaths of about 13 % have been reported with a general strategy of primary medical therapy , with surgery reserved for patients who develop complications [ table 4 ] .
Translation: 采用以主要药物治疗为主的常规策略时，住院死亡率约为13%；手术仅用于出现并发症的患者（见表4）。

Query_Text_en: Table 3 shows risk predictors of outcome of surgery .
Translation: 表3显示了手术结果的风险预测因素。

Query_Text_en: The success of endovascular treatments in managing disease of the coronary artery , abdominal aorta , and arteries of the legs has encouraged the increasing use of catheter-based therapies in the treatment of aortic dissection .
Translation: 冠状动脉、腹主动脉及下肢动脉疾病血管内治疗的成功应用，推动了导管疗法在主动脉夹层治疗中的广泛应用。

Query_Text_en: Two main approaches have been developed that are complementary to each other .
Translation: 两种主要方法已经形成，彼此相辅相成。

Query_Text_en: First , covered stents can be directed at the entry site of the dissection .
Translation: 首先，覆膜支架可被定位在夹层的入口部位。

Query_Text_en: Second , bare-metal stents , balloons , and fenestration techniques can be directed at the branch vessels and false lumen .
Translation: 其次，裸金属支架、球囊和分窗技术可定向应用于分支血管及假腔。

Query_Text_en: One of the guiding principles of open surgical repair of type A dissection is the need to resect the intimal tear , thereby potentially eliminating entry of blood into the false lumen , reversing collapse of the true lumen , and thus eliminating dynamic obstruction of aortic branches and stabilising the dissection .
Translation: 主动脉A型夹层开胸手术修复的基本原则之一是需切除内膜破口，从而可能阻断血液进入假腔，逆转真腔塌陷，进而消除主动脉分支的动态阻塞并稳定夹层进程。

Query_Text_en: After initial experiments in animal and in-vitro models , the use of covered stents originally designed for the treatment of aortic aneurysm was investigated in human patients .
Translation: 在动物和体外模型的初步实验后，原本设计用于治疗主动脉瘤的覆膜支架被应用于人体患者的研究。

Query_Text_en: One or more covered stents are placed over the intimal tear through which blood flows to the false lumen .
Translation: 一个或多个覆膜支架被放置于内膜撕裂处，血液通过该处流向假腔。

Query_Text_en: Additional stents are often used to hold open the true lumen , cover additional entry sites [ figure 4 ] , and promote thrombosis of the false lumen .
Translation: 额外的支架常被用于撑开真腔、覆盖其他入口部位（图4），并促进假腔血栓形成。

Query_Text_en: The aim is to direct flow into the true lumen and promote favourable remodelling of the aorta .
Translation: 旨在引导血流进入真腔，并促进主动脉的良好重塑。

Query_Text_en: This approach is being increasingly used in patients with type B dissection .
Translation: 这种方法在B型夹层患者中越来越多地被采用。

Query_Text_en: Table 5 lists some examples of the results of stent grafts , mainly used in patients with complications of type B dissection , which are now also being used to treat those without complications .
Translation: 表5列举了支架移植物的一些应用结果，其主要用于伴有B型夹层并发症的患者，目前也开始用于治疗无并发症患者。

Query_Text_en: The early results of these techniques are encouraging , with successful exclusion of blood from the false lumen and remodelling of the aorta reported during 12-24 months .
Translation: 这些技术的早期应用结果显示效果令人鼓舞，在12至24个月内成功实现了假腔血流阻断和主动脉重塑。

Query_Text_en: The characteristics of grafts placed in the proximal thoracic aorta need to be quite different from those in the abdominal aorta .
Translation: 植入近端胸主动脉的移植物特性需显著不同于腹主动脉中的特性。

Query_Text_en: Improved flexibility and fixation are important for stents placed near the aortic arch .
Translation: 对于放置在主动脉弓附近的支架而言，改进的柔韧性和固定性非常重要。

Query_Text_en: A range of covered stents are under investigation with new devices under development .
Translation: 一系列药物洗脱支架正在接受评估，与此同时新型设备正处于研发阶段。

Query_Text_en: Two systematic reviews have assessed the results of stent grafts in the management of type B dissection .
Translation: 两项系统综述评估了支架移植术在B型夹层治疗中的应用效果。

Query_Text_en: Both reports included patients with acute and chronic dissection in which the indications and results of intervention might be quite different .
Translation: 两份报告均纳入了急性期和慢性期夹层患者，其中干预的指征和结果可能存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Reported overall outcomes from both reviews were similar , with 5 % in-hospital mortality , 2 % stroke , and 1 % paraplegia .
Translation: 两项审查报告的总体结果基本一致，具体包括住院死亡率为5%、中风比例为2%以及截瘫发生率为1%。

Query_Text_en: Overall , 11 % had major inpatient complications [ lifethreatening or needing major intervention ] .
Translation: 总体来看，11%的病例存在严重住院并发症（危及生命的或需要重大干预措施的）。

Query_Text_en: The results might be less favourable in patients with acute dissection than in those with chronic dissection [ table 5 ] .
Translation: 与慢性夹层患者相比，急性夹层患者的结果可能不太理想（见表5）。

Query_Text_en: Many investigators have reported the serious complication of transformation to type A dissection after stent-graft placement for type B dissection , with an estimated rate of 2 % . Aorto-oesophageal fistula has also been reported after placement of a stent graft in the thoracic aorta .
Translation: 许多研究者报告了在胸主动脉夹层B型采用支架移植物置入术后发生转变为主动脉夹层A型的严重并发症，其估计发生率为2%。胸主动脉置入支架移植物后亦曾出现过主动脉食管瘘的病例。

Query_Text_en: Long-term reports of follow-up after stent placement have been scarce [ table 5 ] .
Translation: 支架置入后的长期随访报告鲜见[表5]。

Query_Text_en: In a systematic review over a mean follow-up of 20 months , 12 % of patients needed re-intervention , and aortic rupture occurred in 2 % .
Translation: 在一项平均随访期为20个月的系统综述中，12%的患者需要再次接受治疗，主动脉破裂的发生率为2%。

Query_Text_en: Survival at 1 year was 90 % .
Translation: 一年生存率达到90%。

Query_Text_en: These findings emphasise the need for extended follow-up and imaging after endovascular therapy .
Translation: 这些研究结果强调了在血管内治疗后进行延长随访和影像学检查的必要性。

Query_Text_en: The fairly favourable in-hospital results have encouraged the use of covered stents for uncomplicated type B dissection , although this practice remains controversial .
Translation: 相当有利的院内治疗结果推动了覆膜支架在无并发症的B型夹层中的应用，尽管这一做法仍存在争议。

Query_Text_en: The INvestigation of STEnt grafts in patients with type B Aortic Dissection [ INSTEAD ] trial was designed to compare covered stents with medical therapy alone for uncomplicated type B dissection .
Translation: 《带膜支架与单纯药物治疗在无并发症B型主动脉夹层患者中的比较研究》（INSTEAD试验）旨在比较带膜支架与单纯药物治疗在无并发症B型主动脉夹层患者中的应用效果。

Query_Text_en: Preliminary results suggested equivalent mortality in patients with uncomplicated acute type B dissection who were treated medically or by endovascular stents and medical therapy at 1 year .
Translation: 初步研究结果显示，在无并发症的急性B型主动脉夹层患者中，单纯药物治疗与内血管支架联合药物治疗的一年期死亡率相当。

Query_Text_en: Many questions remain about the use of stent-graft combinations in aortic dissection [ panel 4 ] .
Translation: 关于主动脉夹层中支架移植物组合的使用仍存在许多疑问[图4]。

Query_Text_en: A range of complementary endovascular techniques have also been described for managing patients with malperfusion secondary to aortic dissection .
Translation: 针对由主动脉夹层引发的低灌注患者，还报道了一系列互补性血管内技术用于治疗。

Query_Text_en: Dynamic obstruction of branch arteries can result from high pressure within the aortic false lumen .
Translation: 主动脉假腔内的高压可能导致分支动脉发生动态阻塞。

Query_Text_en: Both balloondirected and guidewire-directed scissor techniques have been reported to successfully widen the re-entry site and expand the true lumen resolving dynamic branch stenosis .
Translation: 球囊导向和导丝导向剪切技术已被证实能够成功扩大再入点并扩张真实腔以缓解动态分支狭窄。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , bare-metal stents have been used to open branch arteries occluded or narrowed by dynamic or static obstruction in dissection .
Translation: 类似地，裸金属支架被用于开通因夹层病变中动态或静态阻塞而发生阻塞或狭窄的分支动脉。

Query_Text_en: The indication and value of these procedures is controversial .
Translation: 这些程序的指标和价值存在争议。

Query_Text_en: The techniques , however , add important percutaneous methods with potential to improve outcome in severely ill patients who might have few other options .
Translation: 然而，这些技术为危重病患增添了重要的经皮治疗手段，具有改善预后的潜力，尤其适用于那些可能缺乏其他治疗选择的患者。

Query_Text_en: Many patients who present with acute aortic dissection are young , with about 60 % younger than 70 years [ table 1 ] .
Translation: 许多就诊时患有急性主动脉夹层的患者年龄较轻，其中约60%不足70岁[表1]。

Query_Text_en: Aortic rupture of the weakened dilated false lumen , recurrent dissection , and refractory hypertension are the main concerns during long-term follow-up .
Translation: 在长期随访期间，主动脉假腔扩张弱化引发的破裂、复发性夹层分离以及难治性高血压是主要关注点。

Query_Text_en: Clear data for the risk of these problems over the subsequent 10-20 years after initial management are scarce because of the shortage of large prospective series reporting extended follow-up and difficulties with ascertainment of cause of death .
Translation: 由于缺乏报告长期随访结果的大规模前瞻性系列研究以及难以确定死亡原因，初始管理后10至20年间这些问题风险的明确数据较为匮乏。

Query_Text_en: Estimates of 10-year survival in studies with mean follow-up of about 5 years varied substantially between 35 % and 70 % .
Translation: 在平均随访约5年的研究中，10年生存率的估计值在35%至70%之间存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: For patients with type A dissection , long-term outcome is less favourable for those with a history of previous cardiac surgery or atherosclerosis .
Translation: 对于主动脉A型夹层患者，既往有心脏手术史或动脉粥样硬化病史者的长期预后较差。

Query_Text_en: However , for patients with type B dissection , long-term outcome is least favourable for women , those with pre-existing aortic aneurysm or atherosclerosis , and those who develop renal failure or shock while they are in hospital .
Translation: 然而，对于B型夹层患者而言，女性患者、既往存在主动脉瘤或动脉粥样硬化病史者，以及在住院期间出现肾衰竭或休克的患者，其长期预后最为不理想。

Query_Text_en: Partial thrombosis of the false lumen has also been related to poor outcome for type B dissection but not for involvement of the aortic arch .
Translation: 假腔的部分血栓形成与B型夹层的不良预后相关，但与累及主动脉弓无关联。

Query_Text_en: On the basis of the data from patients with Marfan s syndrome , long-term blockade is usually recommended in patients with aortic dissection to maintain blood pressure less than 130\/80 mm Hg .
Translation: 基于马凡综合征患者的数据，通常建议对主动脉夹层患者进行长期阻断治疗以保持血压低于130/80毫米汞柱。

Query_Text_en: Clinical trials investigating angiotensin II blockers are underway because of benefits noted in mice models .
Translation: 由于在小鼠模型中观察到了益处，针对血管紧张素Ⅱ受体拮抗剂的临床试验正在开展。

Query_Text_en: Results from a controlled trial in patients with hypertension noted that the frequency of aortic dissection was reduced in patients who were randomly assigned to receive valsartan compared with non-angiotensin II blockade [ odds ratio 0.19 , 95 % CI 0.04-0 .88 ] .
Translation: 在高血压患者中进行的一项对照试验结果显示，随机分配接受缬沙坦治疗的患者与未接受血管紧张素II受体阻滞剂治疗的患者相比，主动脉夹层的发生率显著降低（比值比0.19，95%可信区间0.04-0.88）。

Query_Text_en: These findings suggest that pathways that block angiotensin II can help to prevent aortic dissection .
Translation: 这些研究结果表明，阻断血管紧张素II的途径有助于预防主动脉夹层。

Query_Text_en: Repeat imaging at 1 , 3 , 6 , and 12 months and then every year has been recommended .
Translation: 建议在1、3、6和12个月时进行重复影像检查，之后每年一次。

Query_Text_en: Surgical repair has been recommended if maximum aortic diameter exceeds 5 cm [ ascending aorta ] or 6 cm [ descending aorta ] , but the decision needs to take into account the risks of surgery in the individual patient .36 Surgical risk will depend on the comorbidities of the patient , the extent of the procedure needed to achieve repair -- eg , endovascular versus widespread aortic replacement and aortic branch revascularisation -- and the estimated risk of aortic rupture or dissection .
Translation: 当主动脉直径超过5厘米（升主动脉）或6厘米（降主动脉）时，建议采取手术修复，但需结合患者个体情况评估手术风险。手术风险取决于患者的合并症、修复所需手术范围——例如血管内手术与广泛主动脉置换和分支血管重建——以及主动脉破裂或夹层的估计风险。

Query_Text_en: A family history of dissection , for example , has been suggested as a reason for intervention at a smaller aortic diameter .
Translation: 例如，主动脉夹层的家族史已被提议作为在较小的主动脉直径时即采取干预措施的一个依据。

Query_Text_en: Data from the IRAD emphasise that patients who have small-diameter aortas can also have aortic dissection ; 40 % of them have ascending aortas that measure less than 5.0 cm at presentation .
Translation: IRAD的数据强调，即使主动脉管径较小的患者也可能发生主动脉夹层；其中40%的患者在就诊时升主动脉测量值小于5.0厘米。

Query_Text_en: Patients [ and their families ] should be carefully instructed to maintain drug regimens , complete follow-up testing and visits , avoid sudden isometric exercises or activities that lead to thoracic trauma , and to have a strategy if recurrent symptoms develop .
Translation: 患者及家属应严格遵医嘱维持药物治疗方案，按时完成随访检查及复诊，避免进行突然的等长运动或可能导致胸部外伤的活动，并在出现复发症状时及时制定应对方案。

Query_Text_en: Revolutionary techniques in molecular and genetic biology will hopefully also identify a range of targets for aortic dissection associated with other risk factors such as hypertension .
Translation: 分子和遗传生物学领域的革命性技术有望识别出与高血压等其他危险因素相关的主动脉夹层的一系列治疗靶点。

Query_Text_en: The development of techniques and devices to deliver aortic repair via endovascular routes also promises to change acute and chronic management of patients after acute aortic dissection .
Translation: 通过血管内途径进行主动脉修复的技术和设备的发展，也有望改变急性主动脉夹层患者在急性和慢性期的管理。

Query_Text_en: Aortic dissection is still a highly lethal disease , which requires physician awareness and appropriate urgent management .
Translation: 主动脉夹层仍然是致死率极高的疾病，需要提高医生的认识并采取恰当的紧急处理措施。

Query_Text_en: Ischemia of branches being fed by the true lumen is most likely when a dissection affects a wide circumferential extent of the aorta and when there is an increased pressure within the false lumen . This pressure is due to a fairly large entry site compared with a smaller exit site for blood perfusing the false lumen .
Translation: 当夹层广泛影响主动脉的圆周区域且假腔内压力升高时，真腔供血的分支最易发生缺血。这种压力升高是由于假腔的入口相对较大，而血液灌注假腔的出口较小所致。

Query_Text_en: MRI was slightly better than were the other two at showing aortic dissection in a patient at high pretest probability , whereas CT was better at correctly excluding an aortic dissection in a patient at low pretest probability . In addition to assisting in the diagnosis of aortic dissection , the results of imaging can help to plan management .
Translation: 在高概率患者中显示主动脉夹层方面，MRI略优于其他两种方法，而CT在低概率患者中正确排除主动脉夹层方面表现更佳。除辅助诊断主动脉夹层外，影像结果还可用于制定治疗方案。

Query_Text_en: No randomised trials have been reported to guide management of aortic dissection . Thus clinical pathways are based on results reported in case series and registries , consensus documents , systematic reviews , and local expertise .
Translation: 目前尚无随机试验结果可用于指导主动脉夹层的治疗。因此，临床路径主要基于病例系列和登记研究的报告结果、共识文件、系统综述以及本地专家经验。
