Query_Text_en: Study participants were evaluated in three different wards of a single referral center [ University Hospital of Modena , Italy ] during a 12-month period [ May 2006 to May 2007 ] .
Translation: 研究参与者在意大利摩德纳大学医院的三个不同科室接受了评估，评估期为2006年5月至2007年5月的12个月。

Query_Text_en: Any consecutive patient with a clinical indication to be tested for LTBI who provided written informed consent was enrolled in the study .
Translation: 所有有临床指征需进行潜伏性结核感染检测且签署书面知情同意书的连续入组患者均被纳入本研究。

Query_Text_en: and patients with HMs [ the HM group ] were enrolled at the hematology clinic .
Translation: 在血液科门诊，患有血液系统疾病的患者（HM组）被纳入研究。

Query_Text_en: To provide a real-life assessment of patients based on routine clinical practice , no other exclusion criteria were defined , and no patients refused to participate in the study .
Translation: 为了基于常规临床实践对患者进行真实世界评估，本研究未设定其他排除标准，且没有患者拒绝参与。

Query_Text_en: The research protocol was approved by the local ethics committee .
Translation: 该研究方案已获当地伦理委员会批准。

Query_Text_en: TST was performed using 5 international units of purified protein derivative [ Biocine Test ; Chiron ; Siena , Italy ] immediately after drawing blood samples for IGRA and was read 72 h later .
Translation: 结核菌素皮肤试验（TST）使用意大利西耶纳Chiron公司生产的Biocine Test纯蛋白衍生物（5国际单位）在采集干扰素-γ释放试验（IGRA）血液样本后立即进行，并于72小时后读取结果。

Query_Text_en: A TST result was considered positive if the skin induration was 10 mm in patients in the LTC and HM groups , and 5 mm in the HIV group .
Translation: 对于长期护理机构（LTC）组和医院医疗（HM）组患者，若皮肤硬结直径分别达到或超过10毫米则视为阳性结果，而艾滋病（HIV）组患者达到或超过5毫米即判定为阳性。

Query_Text_en: Blood samples were processed according to the manufacturer 's instructions within 4 h from blood drawing by trained technicians blinded to clinical and demographic identifiers .
Translation: 血液样本由经过培训且对临床和人口统计信息不知情的技术人员在采血后4小时内按照生产商的说明进行处理。

Query_Text_en: Bonferroni correction was used for multiple comparisons .
Translation: 在多重比较中采用了邦费罗尼校正方法。

Query_Text_en: Results were considered statistically significant when the p value was [ 0.05 .
Translation: 当p值为0.05时，结果被认为具有统计学显著性。

Query_Text_en: This measure provides values from +1 [ perfect agreement ] to 0 [ no agreement above that expected by chance ] to -1 [ complete disagreement ] .
Translation: 该指标的取值范围从+1（完全一致）到0（与偶然预期无显著差异）再到-1（完全相反）。

Query_Text_en: Analyses were performed using a statistical software package [ Stata , version 10.0 ; Stata Corp ; College Station , TX ] .
Translation: 本研究采用统计软件包Stata（版本10.0，Stata公司，得克萨斯州学院站）进行分析。

Query_Text_en: Three hundred sixty-nine participants were enrolled in the protocol .
Translation: 共有369名参与者被纳入该方案中。

Query_Text_en: Fourteen patients [ 3.8 % ] were excluded from further analysis because IGRA results [ TS . TB , 11 patients ; QFT-IT , 3 patients ] were deemed invalid due to high negative control values .
Translation: 由于干扰素释放试验结果因阴性对照值过高而被认为无效，14例患者（3.8%）被排除在进一步分析之外，其中TS.TB检测11例，QFT-IT检测3例。

Query_Text_en: For 24 patients [ 6.5 % ] , TST results [ LTC group , 6 patients ; HM group , 1 patient ; HIV group , 17 patients ] were not read within the allotted time limit and were thus excluded , leaving 331 subjects for statistical analyses .
Translation: 对于24名患者[6.5%]，其TST结果[ LTC组6名患者；HM组1名患者；HIV组17名患者]未在规定时间内完成读取，因此被排除，最终剩余331名受试者纳入统计分析。

Query_Text_en: The mean age was 51.4 years , most patients were white , and a few had been vaccinated with BCG [ Table 1 ] .
Translation: 平均年龄为51.4岁，大多数患者为白人，少数接种过卡介苗[表1]。

Query_Text_en: Overall , 24 QFT-IT results [ 7.2 % ] and 2 TS . TB results [ 0.6 % ; p [ 0.001 ] were indeterminate owing to low positive control values ; 21 of the indeterminate QFT-IT results [ 87.5 % ] were negative using both TST and TS . TB .
Translation: 总体而言，24例QFT-IT检测结果（占7.2%）和2例TS.TB检测结果（占0.6%，p值为0.001）因阳性对照值过低而无法确定结果；在这些无法确定的QFT-IT检测结果中，有87.5%（21例）在采用TST和TS.TB检测时呈阴性结果。

Query_Text_en: Compared with TS . TB , there were significantly more indeterminate QFT-IT results in both the LTC and HIV groups [ p = 0.009 and p = 0.008 , respectively ] , but not in the HM group [ Table 2 ] .
Translation: 与TS.TB相比，LTC组和HIV组的QFT-IT不确定结果显著更多（p值分别为0.009和0.008），但在HM组中未观察到这种情况（表2）。

Query_Text_en: Blood lymphocyte counts on the day of IGRA testing were available for 303 patients .
Translation: 在进行干扰素释放试验（IGRA）检测当天，303名患者的血液淋巴细胞计数数据可获得。

Query_Text_en: Median lymphocyte counts were significantly lower in patients with indeterminate QFT-IT results [ 1,200 cells\/mL vs 1,820 cells\/mL in patients with determinate QFT-IT results ; p = 0.001 ] .
Translation: QFT-IT检测结果不确定患者的中位淋巴细胞计数显著低于检测结果确定的患者[1,200细胞/毫升 vs 1,820细胞/毫升；p=0.001]。

Query_Text_en: In the LTC group , indeterminate QFT-IT results were significantly associated with a higher median model for end-stage liver disease score [ 21 vs 13 , respectively ; p = 0.002 ] .
Translation: 在LTC组中，不确定的QFT-IT检测结果与更高的终末期肝病模型评分中位数显著相关（分别为21分和13分；p=0.002）。

Query_Text_en: Quantitative responses of IGRA , expressed as international units of IFN - or as spot-forming units [ SFUs ] , showed good correlation with the size of the TST skin induration , expressed in millimeters [ Fig 1 ] .
Translation: IGRA（干扰素释放试验）的定量反应结果以干扰素（IFN）的国际单位或斑点形成单位（SFU）表示，与以毫米为单位的TST（结核菌素皮肤试验）皮肤硬结大小呈良好相关性（图1）。

Query_Text_en: Overall , however , both TS . TB [ 18.4 % ] and QFT-IT [ 15.1 % ] identified more positive results than did TST [ 10.9 % ; p [ 0.001 vs TS . TB ; p = 0.033 vs QFT-IT ] .
Translation: 总体而言，TS.TB[18.4%]和QFT-IT[15.1%]检出的阳性结果均多于TST[10.9%；与TS.TB相比p=0.001，与QFT-IT相比p=0.033]。

Query_Text_en: Significantly fewer persons were identified as latently infected by any test in the HIV group , compared with the LTC and HM groups [ TST , p = 0.042 ; TS . TB , p [ 0.001 ; QFT-IT , p [ 0.001 ] .
Translation: 与LTC组和HM组相比，HIV组通过任何检测方法被识别为潜伏感染的人数显著更少（TST，p=0.042；TS.TB，p<0.001；QFT-IT，p<0.001）。

Query_Text_en: Considering those patients with at least one positive test result to be infected , LTBI prevalence was significantly lower in the HIV group [ 9.5 % ] than in the LTC group [ 35.8 % ; p [ 0.001 ] and HM group [ 29.5 % ; p [ 0.001 ] .
Translation: 将至少有一次检测结果呈阳性的患者视为感染者，HIV组的潜伏性结核感染患病率（9.5%）显著低于LTC组（35.8%；p<0.001）和HM组（29.5%；p<0.001）。

Query_Text_en: Concordance among tests was substantial , ranging from 80.6 % [ TST vs TS . TB in LTC ] to 95.4 % [ TST vs QFT-IT in HIV ] [ Table 3 ] .
Translation: 检测结果的一致性显著，范围从80.6%（TST与TS.TB在长期护理机构中的比较）到95.4%（TST与QFT-IT在HIV患者中的比较）（见表3）。

Query_Text_en: However , agreement between tests across different groups was moderate , with the statistic ranging from 0.40 to 0.65 .
Translation: 然而，不同组别间的测试结果一致性中等，统计量范围在0.40至0.65之间。

Query_Text_en: In the HIV group , agreement between TS . TB and either TST [ = 0.16 ] or QFT-IT [ = 0.19 ] was slight [ Table 3 ] .
Translation: 在HIV感染组中，TS.TB与TST（=0.16）或QFT-IT（=0.19）之间的一致性仅为轻微级别（表3）。

Query_Text_en: In the 12 BCG-vaccinated individuals , agreement among all three tests was complete [ = 1.00 ] .
Translation: 在12名卡介苗接种者中，三项检测结果完全一致（=1.00）。

Query_Text_en: Highly discordant results , that is , those clearly negative with one IGRA and clearly positive with another , were found in all groups and represented 12.1 % of the whole population [ Table 4 ] .
Translation: 在所有组别中均发现了高度不一致的结果，即在一种干扰素释放试验（IGRA）中呈现明显阴性而在另一种试验中呈现明显阳性的情况，此类结果占总人群的12.1%（见表4）。

Query_Text_en: Patients with a positive TST and a negative IGRA [ without a history of BCG vaccination ] were also represented in all groups [ LTC patients : TS . TB , 5 patients ; QFT-IT , 4 patients ; HIV patients : TS . TB , 5 patients ; QFT-IT , 3 patients ; HM : TS . TB , 1 patient ; QFT-IT , 0 patients ] .
Translation: 在所有组别中均有无卡介苗接种史的阳性TST及阴性IGRA患者（长期护理机构患者：TST组5例，QFT-IT组4例；HIV患者：TST组5例，QFT-IT组3例；住院患者：TST组1例，QFT-IT组0例）。

Query_Text_en: Overall , the fraction of tests with borderline results [ ie , close to the cutoff for a positive test result ] was higher for TS . TB [ 18 tests with 4 to 5 SFUs ] than for QFT-IT [ 8 tests with 0.20 to 0.34 international units of IFN - ] [ Table 4 ] .
Translation: 总体而言，检测结果接近阳性临界值（即介于阳性判定阈值附近的临界结果）的占比在TS.TB检测中更高。TS.TB检测中有18例结果介于4至5 SFU之间，而QFT-IT检测中则有8例结果介于0.20至0.34国际单位干扰素-γ（IFN-γ）之间（表4）。

Query_Text_en: We obtained at least three important results .
Translation: 我们取得了至少三项重要成果。

Query_Text_en: Therefore , a differential application of TST and IGRA among immunosuppressed patients might be beneficial .
Translation: 因此，在免疫抑制患者中对结核菌素皮肤试验（TST）和干扰素γ释放试验（IGRA）进行差异化应用可能是有益的。

Query_Text_en: For example , in solid organ transplantation candidates , in whom the TST is still recommended as a standard of care , both TS . TB and QFT-IT could replace the TST .
Translation: 例如，在实体器官移植候选者中，虽然TST仍被推荐作为标准护理，但TS.TB和QFT-IT检测均可替代TST。

Query_Text_en: However , the lower rate of positive results with all three tests in HIV-infected individuals , which is well explained by the impaired IFN - - secreting capacity of MTB-specific CD4 T cells in HIV infection , coupled with the significant discordance among tests [ previously reported in various populations of HIV-infected patients in low - and high-incidence settings ] , would support an integrated diagnostic approach based on all three assays .
Translation: 然而，HIV感染者中三种检测的阳性率较低，这一现象可通过HIV感染导致的结核分枝杆菌特异性CD4 T细胞干扰素γ分泌能力受损得到合理解释。加上不同检测方法之间存在显著不一致（此前已在低流行率和高流行率环境中的不同HIV患者群体中有所报道），这将支持采用基于三种检测方法的整合诊断方案。

Query_Text_en: However , in the particular group of HIV-infected persons included in our study , the lower rates of positive test results may simply reflect a higher degree of immunosuppression and therefore reduced reactivity to the assays
Translation: 在我们研究中的特定HIV感染者群体中，较低的阳性检测率可能仅仅反映了更高的免疫抑制程度，因此导致对检测方法的反应能力降低。

Query_Text_en: Our second important result is that the diagnostic agreement among different tests varied across groups of immunocompromised patients .
Translation: 我们的第二个重要发现是，不同检测方法的诊断结果一致性在免疫缺陷患者的不同组别中存在差异。

Query_Text_en: Previous studies have found that agreement of IGRA with the TST and agreement between QFT and TS . TB may vary from poor to substantial .
Translation: 先前的研究发现，IGRA与TST的一致性以及QFT与TS.TB之间的一致性可能从较差到高度不等。

Query_Text_en: In the present study , we showed that , among HIV-infected individuals , TS . TB detected a largely different fraction of persons infected by MTB , compared to TST and QFT-IT .
Translation: 在本研究中，我们发现，在HIV感染者中，TS.TB检测到的结核分枝杆菌（MTB）感染者比例与TST和QFT-IT检测结果存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Similar results were recently reported in a smaller sample of HIV-infected adults and children in an area in which the disease is endemic .
Translation: 最近在艾滋病流行地区的一项研究中，对较小规模的感染艾滋病成人和儿童群体进行分析后，也报告了类似结果。

Query_Text_en: Because identification and treatment of persons coinfected with MTB and HIV are a priority for TB control , these results could be clinically relevant .
Translation: 由于结核分枝杆菌和HIV共感染者的识别与治疗是结核病防控工作的优先事项，因此这些研究结果可能具有临床意义。

Query_Text_en: To date , few studies are available on the value of IGRA in predicting the reactivation of TB in high-risk groups .
Translation: 迄今为止，关于干扰γ释放试验（IGRA）在预测高危人群结核病复燃方面的价值，相关研究很少。

Query_Text_en: Among adult and pediatric contacts of persons with active TB , the IGRA showed a better [ or equivalent ] positive predictive value than the TST for incident TB cases .
Translation: 在活动性结核病患者的成人和儿童接触者中，干扰素γ释放试验对新发结核病病例的阳性预测值优于或相当于结核菌素皮肤试验。

Query_Text_en: Unfortunately , only a small fraction of the subjects enrolled in the Gambian study were tested for HIV coinfection .
Translation: 不幸的是，参与冈比亚研究的受试者中仅有少数接受了HIV合并感染检测。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , those results lend support to the concept that discordant results in specific risk groups are more likely due to the effects of different impairment of the immune response within the same risk groups on the sensitivity of the assays than to false-positive results due to the technical features of the assays .
Translation: 然而，这些结果支持这样一种观点：特定风险群体中出现的不一致结果，更可能归因于同一风险群体内部免疫反应受损程度不同对检测灵敏度的影响，而非因检测技术特性导致的假阳性结果。

Query_Text_en: In addition , we have reported that about a third of discordant results were unlikely to be caused by inaccurate cutoff values , as suggested by others , because they were definitely positive with one assay and clearly negative with the other .
Translation: 此外，我们报告指出，大约三分之一的不一致结果不太可能如其他研究者所提出的那样是由临界值不准确所致，因为这些样本在一种检测方法中呈明确阳性，而在另一种方法中则呈明显阴性。

Query_Text_en: These findings support the hypothesis that QFT-IT and TS . TB , based on some methodological differences ,4 might measure slightly different immunologic phenomena .
Translation: 这些研究结果支持了这样一种假设：基于某些方法学上的差异，QFT-IT和TS.TB可能测量的是略有不同的免疫学现象。

Query_Text_en: This conclusion is also supported by studies that have reported a different performance [ and , most likely , different sensitivities ] of the TST and IGRA in patients undergoing screening for LTBI and immunosuppressive treatments for cancer or in patients with autoimmune diseases before antitumor necrosis factor-therapies .
Translation: 这一结论也得到了相关研究的支持，这些研究指出在潜伏性结核感染筛查中接受免疫抑制治疗的癌症患者，或在抗肿瘤坏死因子治疗前的自身免疫疾病患者中，结核菌素皮肤试验与干扰素-γ释放试验的检测表现存在差异（很可能其敏感性亦不同）。

Query_Text_en: All these data suggest again that , in the absence of prospective studies , a combined approach aimed to maximize the efficacy of screening procedures might be preferable in severely immunocompromised patients who have an increased risk of reactivation and development of severe forms of TB .
Translation: 所有数据再次表明，在缺乏前瞻性研究的情况下，对于存在结核病复发及严重形式发展高风险的严重免疫抑制患者，采用旨在最大限度提高筛查程序有效性的综合方法可能是更优的选择。

Query_Text_en: interestingly , not all indeterminate QFT-IT results were negative with either TS . TB or TST , suggesting that individuals with an indeterminate QFT-IT result might still be infected .
Translation: 值得注意的是，并非所有QFT-IT检测结果不确定的样本在TS、TB或TST检测中均为阴性，这表明QFT-IT检测结果不确定的个体仍可能存在感染。

Query_Text_en: As previously reported for the gold version of the QFT , advanced liver disease is significantly associated also with indeterminate results of the QFT-IT .
Translation: 正如之前对QFT金标准版本所报告的那样，晚期肝病同样与QFT-IT的不确定检测结果显著相关。

Query_Text_en: We have also reported here an association with lower peripheral blood lymphocyte counts .
Translation: 本研究还报告了与较低的外周血淋巴细胞计数的关联。

Query_Text_en: However , technical errors were more frequent with TS . TB than with QFT-IT , reflecting the higher complexity of the enzyme-linked immunospot assay compared with the enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay .
Translation: 然而，在TS.TB检测中，技术性错误的发生频率比QFT-IT检测更高，这反映了酶联免疫斑点试验相较于酶联免疫吸附试验具有更高的复杂性。

Query_Text_en: Both the QFT-IT and TS . TB have been recently approved for clinical use by the US Food and Drug Administration , and both tests have been included in guidelines published in several countries , including the United States , Canada , the United Kingdom , France , Italy , Germany , Switzerland , and Australia .
Translation: QFT-IT和TS.TB检测方法最近已获美国食品药品监督管理局批准用于临床使用，并已被包括美国、加拿大、英国、法国、意大利、德国、瑞士和澳大利亚在内的多个国家发布的指南纳入。

Query_Text_en: These guidelines provide clinicians with various application strategies , although without strong evidence of their efficacy .
Translation: 这些指南为临床医生提供了多种应用策略，但缺乏充分证据证明其疗效。

Query_Text_en: However , in particular for TB , there is a need for infield studies of the diagnostic accuracy of newer tools in high-risk populations .
Translation: 然而，特别是针对结核病（TB），有必要在高危人群中开展新型诊断工具的现场研究以评估其诊断准确性。

Query_Text_en: Our study shows for the first time that the performance of IGRA , both in terms of rates of positive results and in diagnostic agreement , varies greatly across different categories of patients who are at increased risk of TB reactivation .
Translation: 本研究首次表明，干扰素释放试验（IGRA）的检测性能——无论是阳性结果率还是诊断一致性——在不同结核病复燃高风险患者类别中存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Because of the importance of targeting such high-risk groups for effective TB control , we advise caution when interpreting the results of IGRA among immunosuppressed patients .
Translation: 鉴于针对此类高危人群进行有效结核病控制的重要性，我们建议在解读免疫抑制患者的IGRA检测结果时保持谨慎。

Query_Text_en: DURINGOCTOBER2003 ? FEBRUARY 2004 , eight cases [ seven confirmed cases and one possible ] of Legionnaires disease [ LD ] were identified among guests at a hotel in Ocean City , Maryland .
Translation: 2003年10月?2004年2月期间，马里兰州奥伊琴城一家酒店的客人中发现了8例军团病（LD）病例【其中包括7例确诊病例和1例疑似病例】。

Query_Text_en: This report summarizes the subsequent investigation conducted by the Worcester County Health Department [ WCHD ] , Maryland Department of Health and Mental Hygiene [ DHMH ] , and CDC , which implicated the potable hot water system of the hotel as the most likely source of infection .
Translation: 该报告总结了马萨诸塞州伍斯特县卫生局（WCHD）、马里兰州卫生与精神卫生部（DHMH）以及疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）开展的后续调查，调查结果将酒店的饮用水热水系统认定为最可能的感染源。

Query_Text_en: The detection of this outbreak underscores the importance of enhanced , state-based surveillance for timely detection of travel-associated LD and implementation of control measures .
Translation: 此次疫情的发现凸显了强化国家层面监测体系的重要性，以实现对与旅行相关的莱姆病（LD）的及时发现并落实防控措施。

Query_Text_en: On December 1 , 2003 , a local health department [ LHD ] notified DHMH of two LD cases in Maryland residents who had stayed at hotel A during the 2 - to 10-day incubation period .
Translation: 2003年12月1日，地方卫生部门（LHD）向马里兰州卫生与精神卫生部（DHMH）通报了两例马里兰州居民感染LD病例，这些病例的患者曾在该疾病2至10天潜伏期内入住酒店A。

Query_Text_en: The two patients had stays in hotel A of 3 and 4 days ; their onsets of illness occurred 8 and 5 days , respectively , after leaving hotel A.
Translation: 两位患者在A酒店分别住了3天和4天；他们离开A酒店后，发病时间分别发生在第8天和第5天。

Query_Text_en: Both patients had radiographically confirmed pneumonia and positive Legionella urinary antigen tests that were consistent with L. pneumophila serogroup 1 [ Lp1 ] infection .
Translation: 两名患者经放射学确诊为肺炎，且军团菌尿抗原检测呈阳性，检测结果与嗜肺军团菌1型（Lp1）感染相符。

Query_Text_en: The two patients had stayed at hotel A within 1 day of each other and were linked epidemiologically through travel information collected by LHDs in Maryland by using the DHMH report form for LD .
Translation: 这两名患者曾在同一天内入住酒店A，并通过马里兰州地方卫生部门利用马里兰州卫生与精神卫生署的莱姆病报告表格收集的旅行信息，建立了流行病学关联。

Query_Text_en: This form collects information regarding location , accommodations , and dates of travel for the 10 days preceding illness .
Translation: 该表格收集患病前10天内的地点、住宿及出行日期等信息。

Query_Text_en: Review of LD case report forms revealed six additional LD patients with reported travel to Ocean City during the preceding year ; however , none had stayed at hotel A.
Translation: 对莱姆病病例报告表的审查显示，过去一年中有六例新增患者报告称曾前往海洋城旅行；然而，这些患者均未入住酒店A。

Query_Text_en: After environmental inspections and water sampling of hotel A by WCHD , multiple samples from multiple sites in the hotel revealed the presence of Lp1 .
Translation: 在WCHD对A酒店开展环境检查和水样采集后，酒店内多个地点采集的多个样本中检出Lp1。

Query_Text_en: On January 26 , 2004 , hotel A attempted remediation by superheating water systems , flushing all water taps , and hyperchlorinating the cooling tower .
Translation: 2004年1月26日，A酒店尝试通过超高温加热供水系统、冲洗所有水龙头以及对冷却塔实施超氯处理来进行补救。

Query_Text_en: Showers and faucets were reportedly disinfected , and shower heads and sink aerators were replaced in rooms where patients had stayed .
Translation: 据报道，患者居住过的病房内淋浴设施和水龙头已进行消毒处理，淋浴喷头和水龙头气孔器也已更换。

Query_Text_en: After the initial cases were identified , enhanced surveillance was conducted , including postings on the CDC Epidemic Information Exchange [ Epi-X ] and a rapid review of all DHMH case report forms for LD .
Translation: 在发现初始病例后，开展了加强监测，包括在疾控中心流行病信息交换系统（Epi-X）发布信息，并对马里兰卫生与精神卫生部（DHMH）的莱姆病病例报告表进行了快速审查。

Query_Text_en: In February 2004 , two additional LD patients were identified , including one person who had stayed at hotel A after remediation .
Translation: 2004年2月，发现2例新增LD患者，其中一人曾在酒店A整改后入住。

Query_Text_en: On the basis of this finding and the potential for ongoing but undetected transmission of Legionella , CDC was invited to join the investigation .
Translation: 基于这一发现以及军团菌可能存在持续但未被发现的传播风险，疾控中心被邀请加入调查。

Query_Text_en: To identify additional cases , neighboring jurisdictions , acute care hospital emergency departments , and all LHDs in Maryland were notified .
Translation: 为识别更多病例，邻近地区、急症护理医院急诊科以及马里兰州所有地方卫生部门均被通知。

Query_Text_en: Press releases and hotel A guest notifications were issued by DHMH , WCHD , and hotel A.
Translation: DHMH、WCHD和酒店A发布了新闻稿及酒店A的通知。

Query_Text_en: A confirmed case of LD was defined as radiographically confirmed pneumonia with laboratory evidence of Legionella infection in a resident or visitor to Ocean City during October 2003 ? February 2004 , whose illness began within 10 days of time spent in Ocean City .
Translation: 确认的LD病例被定义为：在2003年10月至2004年2月期间于海洋城居住或访问过的居民或访客中，该病例具有影像学确诊的肺炎和实验室证据的军团菌感染，同时其病症开始于逗留海洋城后的10天内。

Query_Text_en: Laboratory confirmation included identification of Legionella by culture , direct fluorescent antibody testing , urine antigen assay , or an increase in antibody titer indicating recent infection .
Translation: 实验室确认包括通过培养方法检测到军团菌，或通过直接荧光抗体检测、尿抗原检测，以及抗体滴度升高表明近期感染等检测手段。

Query_Text_en: Possible LD cases were defined similarly but without laboratory confirmation of Legionella infection or other infectious etiology .
Translation: 可能的LD病例定义方式与之类似，但无需通过实验室确诊军团菌感染或其他感染性病因。

Query_Text_en: Enhanced surveillance identified approximately 50 ill persons with exposure to hotel A.
Translation: 通过加强监测，发现了约50名与酒店A有关联的患病人员。

Query_Text_en: Further investigation resulted in identification of three additional confirmed cases and one possible case , for overall totals of seven con - firmed and one possible case of LD during October 2003 ? February 2004 .
Translation: 进一步调查确认了三例新增确诊病例和一例疑似病例，使得2003年10月至2004年2月期间莱姆病（LD）的总确诊病例达到七例，疑似病例一例。

Query_Text_en: Underlying medical conditions associated with increased risk for LD included smoking [ five patients ] , diabetes [ four patients ] , and an immuno compromised condition [ one patient ] .
Translation: 与LD风险增加相关的基础疾病包括吸烟（5例）、糖尿病（4例）和免疫缺陷状况（1例）。

Query_Text_en: A review of possible exposures at hotel A among the patients with confirmed LD revealed that all had showered or bathed in their respective rooms , and one had used the whirlpool spa .
Translation: 对酒店A患者中确诊淋病病例的可能暴露情况进行回顾分析发现，所有患者均曾在自己房间内淋浴或泡澡，其中一人曾使用过温泉浴池。

Query_Text_en: Six patients reported exposure to the swimming pool and whirlpool area .
Translation: 六名患者报告称曾接触过泳池及温泉浴池区域。

Query_Text_en: No other common sources of exposure linking all cases were identified .
Translation: 未发现其他与所有病例存在关联的共同暴露源。

Query_Text_en: During December 2003 ? February 2004 , WCHD , DHMH , and CDC conducted three environmental inspections and four rounds of water testing at hotel A.
Translation: 2003年12月至2004年2月期间，WCHD、DHMH及CDC在酒店A进行了三轮环境检查和四次水质检测。

Query_Text_en: The hotel remained open during the inspections and testing .
Translation: 酒店在检查和测试期间持续营业。

Query_Text_en: The rooms in which the seven confirmed patients stayed were located in different areas and on different floors of the hotel .
Translation: 七名确诊患者所住的房间分布在酒店的不同区域和楼层。

Query_Text_en: During all rounds of testing , water temperatures in multiple locations were in an ideal range for growth and amplification of Legionella [ 77 F ? 108 F [ 25 C ? 42 C ] ] .
Translation: 在所有测试阶段中，多个地点的水温均处于适合Legionella繁殖与扩增的理想范围（华氏77度至108度[摄氏25度至42度]）。

Query_Text_en: Lp1 was recovered from multiple sites in hotel A , including the hot water storage tank ; cooling tower ; multiple hot water heaters ; and showers and faucets in rooms occupied by patients and well guests .
Translation: 酒店A的多个地点检出LP1，包括热水储水罐、冷却塔、多个热水加热器，以及患者和健康客人居住的房间内的淋浴和水龙头。

Query_Text_en: All environmental Lp1 isolates were the same monoclonal antibody type 1,2,5 , [ testing for type 6 was not conducted ] .
Translation: 所有环境中的Lp1分离株均为同一单克隆抗体类型1、2、5，[未对类型6进行检测]。

Query_Text_en: Despite isolation of Lp1 from sites in hotel A , cultured isolates from patients were not available to link with environmental isolates through use of monoclonal antibody testing .
Translation: 尽管从酒店A的地点分离出了Lp1，但患者样本的培养分离株无法通过单克隆抗体检测与环境分离株建立关联。

Query_Text_en: In March 2004 , given the apparent inadequacy of the initial remediation , the potable water system was hyperchlorinated , and a postremediation plan for water testing for Legionella was instituted .
Translation: 鉴于初步补救措施明显不足，2004年3月，饮用水系统接受了超氯化处理，并制定了针对军团菌的水质检测后续整治计划。

Query_Text_en: Since the hyperchlorination treatment , no further cases of LD associated with hotel A have been identified .
Translation: 自实施超氯化处理以来，未再发现与酒店A有关联的LD病例。

Query_Text_en: During post-remediation follow-up testing , one Lp1 isolate from the cooling tower was identified at a low level , and the cooling tower was hyperchlorinated .
Translation: 在修复后的后续检测期间，从冷却塔中检测到一株低水平的Lp1分离株，随后对该冷却塔进行了超氯化处理。

Query_Text_en: DHMH continues to monitor for additional cases associated with hotel A and for all travel-associated LD cases .
Translation: DHMH继续监测与酒店A相关的新增病例以及所有与旅行相关的LD病例。

Query_Text_en: In this report , the exposure of patients to the hotel s potable water sys - tem , the lack of other epidemiologic links , and the recovery of Legionellae from multiple points in the system suggest that the hotel potable water system was the source of the outbreak .
Translation: 本报告指出，患者接触酒店饮用水系统的情况、缺乏其他流行病学关联以及从系统多个点检出军团菌，表明该酒店的饮用水系统是本次疫情的爆发源。

Query_Text_en: Approximately 8 million visitors travel to Ocean City each year ; therefore , a link between the first two cases was not immediately evident .
Translation: 每年约有800万游客前往海洋城，因此前两起案例之间的关联性起初并不明显。

Query_Text_en: Available data were searched to identify additional cases associated with the hotel or travel to Ocean City .
Translation: 对现有数据进行了筛查，以发现与该酒店或前往海洋城旅行有关联的新增病例。

Query_Text_en: Active surveillance activities led to more rapid identification of other cases .
Translation: 主动监测活动促使其他病例得以更快识别。

Query_Text_en: The retrospective identification of these cases prompted further investigation and subsequent control and remediation efforts at hotel A.
Translation: 这些案例的追溯识别促使A酒店展开了进一步调查，并采取了后续的控制和整治措施。

Query_Text_en: In 2003 , DHMH began conducting enhanced surveillance because of increased reports of LD .
Translation: 由于莱姆病报告增加，马里兰州卫生与精神卫生部自2003年起开始实施强化监测。

Query_Text_en: All patients reported to DHMH are administered a follow-up questionnaire by local or state health departments .
Translation: 上报至DHMH的所有患者均由地方或州卫生部门进行后续问卷调查。

Query_Text_en: The questionnaire identifies travel that preceded the illness , including location , accommodations , dates , and information about exposures to common sources for infection , such as whirlpool spas and cooling towers .
Translation: 该问卷调查了解患病前的旅行情况，包括旅行地点、住宿信息、日期以及接触常见感染源的情况，例如按摩池和冷却塔等。

Query_Text_en: Surveillance data submitted to CDC indicate that approximately 21 % of LD cases each year are travel associated .
Translation: 提交给疾病预防控制中心的监测数据显示，每年约有21%的LD病例与旅行相关。

Query_Text_en: However , several factors hinder identification of travel-associated clusters of the disease .
Translation: 然而，有几个因素阻碍了对与旅行相关的疾病聚集现象的识别。

Query_Text_en: The LD incubation period is long enough for persons to disperse from the point source of infection .
Translation: LD的潜伏期足够长，足以使感染者从感染源点扩散开来。

Query_Text_en: In addition , LD can be treated successfully with empiric antibiotics , which obviates the need for confirmatory testing .
Translation: 此外，莱姆病可成功使用经验性抗生素治疗，从而无需进行确认性检测。

Query_Text_en: When diagnostic testing is performed , isolation of the organism is rare , preventing comparison of environmental isolates with clinical isolates .
Translation: 当进行诊断检测时，病原体的分离较为罕见，这阻碍了环境分离株与临床分离株的对比。

Query_Text_en: Improved national surveillance for travel-associated LD might help detect clusters of the disease .
Translation: 加强国家对与旅行相关的LD的监测可能有助于发现该疾病的聚集性病例。

Query_Text_en: Surveillance for LD in the United States consists of two systems , a national , paper-based system and an electronic system reported through the National Electronic Telecommunications System for Surveillance .
Translation: 美国的LD监测系统由两个系统组成，一个是全国性的纸质系统，另一个是通过国家监测电子通讯系统上报的电子系统。

Query_Text_en: Only the paper case - report form collects information on location of travel and lodging .
Translation: 只有纸质版案例报告表会收集旅行和住宿地点的信息。

Query_Text_en: Although the paper case-report form is useful for tracking overall trends , a lack of timeliness and sensitivity , often resulting in an inability to link cases , limits its usefulness in identifying clusters .
Translation: 虽然纸质病例报告表在追踪整体趋势方面很有用处，但由于缺乏及时性和敏感性，常常导致无法关联病例，这限制了其在识别病例聚集现象方面的实用性。

Query_Text_en: The European Working Group for Le-gionella Infections , established in 1986 , has developed a successful surveillance system for identifying clusters of travel - associated LD . The European Surveillance Scheme for Travel-Associated Le - gionnaires Disease , which consists of 36 collaborating countries , compiles case data electronically and cross-checks travel accommodations with other cases to identify clusters .
Translation: 欧洲军团菌感染工作组成立于1986年，成功建立了识别旅行相关军团病聚集病例的监测系统。该工作组下属的欧洲旅行相关军团病监测方案由36个成员国协作开展，通过电子化收集病例数据并与其它病例的旅行住宿信息进行交叉核对，以识别病例聚集现象。

Query_Text_en: During 2000-2002 , a total of 113 travel-associated LD clusters were reported , with the majority linked to hotels .
Translation: 在2000年至2002年间，共报告了113起与旅行相关的LD聚集病例，其中大多数病例与酒店有关联。

Query_Text_en: Since introduction of the European group s guidelines in July 2002 , all LD clusters are investigated , and remediation and control measures are instituted when necessary .
Translation: 自2002年7月引入欧盟组织的指导原则以来，所有LD集群均会接受调查，并在必要时采取补救和管控措施。

Query_Text_en: The European and DHMH programs demonstrate how timely , sensitive surveillance can identify clusters of travel-associated LD .
Translation: 欧洲和DHMH项目展示了及时、灵敏的监测如何能够识别与旅行相关的LD病例聚集。

Query_Text_en: Prompt recognition and investigation of clusters can implicate a point source for infection and guide remediation and control efforts .
Translation: 及时识别和调查聚集性病例可以确定感染源，并指导防控工作。

Query_Text_en: Recognizing the benefits of enhanced surveillance , CDC plans to work with state health departments on new strategies to improve surveillance for travel-associated LD at the national , state , and local levels .
Translation: 疾控中心认识到加强监测的重要性，计划与各州卫生部门合作制定新策略，以在国家、州和地方各级层面改进对旅行相关LD的监测工作。

Query_Text_en: The median length of stay at hotel A was 3 nights [ range : 1-4 nights ] .
Translation: 酒店A的中位数停留天数为3晚[范围：1至4晚]。

Query_Text_en: Symptom onset occurred a median of 7.5 days [ range : 4-9 days ] after leaving hotel A.
Translation: 在离开酒店A之后，症状出现的中位时间为7.5天[范围：4-9天]。

Query_Text_en: The median age of the eight patients was 63 years [ range : 37-70 years ] , and six [ 75 % ] patients were men .
Translation: 八例患者的中位年龄为63岁[范围：37至70岁]，其中6例（75%）为男性患者。

Query_Text_en: Five cases were confirmed by urine antigen testing and two by serology . Seven patients were hospitalized ; none died .
Translation: 五例通过尿抗原检测确诊，两例通过血清学检测确诊。7名患者住院治疗，无人死亡。

Query_Text_en: After the third and fourth cases of LD were identified , a second superheating remediation was conducted at hotel A in February 2004 . In addition , shower necks and faucets in all hotel rooms and condominiums were reportedly disinfected with a bleach solution . The whirlpool spa sand filter was cleaned .
Translation: 在确认第三和第四例LD后，2004年2月于酒店A进行了第二次超高温整治。此外，据报道，所有酒店客房和公寓的淋浴喷头及水龙头均使用漂白剂溶液进行了消毒处理。按摩浴缸的砂滤系统也得到了清理。

Query_Text_en: CDC Editorial Note : Hotels have been common locations for LD outbreaks since the disease was first recognized among hotel guests in Philadelphia in 1976 .
Translation: 疾控中心编辑注释：自1976年该疾病首次在费城酒店客人中被发现以来，酒店一直是LD疫情的常见发生地。

Query_Text_en: However , studies evaluating associations between the heterozygous form PiMZ with emphysema and impaired lung function have provided conflicting results .
Translation: 然而，对杂合型PiMZ与肺气肿及肺功能受损之间关联进行评估的研究结果存在矛盾。

Query_Text_en: Study objective The goal of this study was to determine if the phenotype PiMZ is associated with an accelerated decline in diffusing capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide [ DLCO ] .
Translation: 本研究的目的是确定PiMZ表型是否与一氧化碳肺扩散能力（DLCO）的加速下降相关。

Query_Text_en: Design and methods The Tucson Epidemiologic Study of Airway Obstructive Disease is a prospective , population-based cohort study initiated in 1972 .
Translation: 研究设计与方法 图森呼吸道阻塞性疾病的流行病学研究是一项于1972年启动的前瞻性、基于人群的队列研究。

Query_Text_en: Participants completed standardized questionnaires in up to 12 periodic surveys and DLCO assessments in up to 4 surveys .
Translation: 参与者在多达12次的定期调查中完成了标准化问卷，并在多达4次的调查中进行了DLCO评估。

Query_Text_en: Random-effects models were used to determine the effects of 1-antitrypsin phenotypes on percentage of predicted [ % predicted ] DLCO levels among 1,075 subjects 18 years old .
Translation: 采用随机效应模型分析了1,075名18岁受试者中α1-抗胰蛋白酶表型对一氧化碳弥散量（DLCO）水平预测值百分比的影响。

Query_Text_en: Results % predicted DLCO declined more rapidly in subjects who smoked compared to nonsmoking subjects .
Translation: 与非吸烟受试者相比，吸烟受试者的%预测一氧化碳弥散量下降速度更快。

Query_Text_en: Additionally , in smokers , the PiMZ phenotype was associated with borderline % predicted DLCO deficits at age 40 years [ 8.6 % ; p = 0.075 ] and significant % predicted DLCO deficits at age 60 years [ 15.2 % ; p = 0.001 ] and 80 years [ 21.9 % ; p = 0.003 ] , as compared with the PiMM phenotype .
Translation: 与PiMM表型相比，在吸烟者中，PiMZ表型与40岁时预测DLCO百分比缺陷呈临界相关（8.6%；p=0.075），并在60岁时（15.2%；p=0.001）和80岁时（21.9%；p=0.003）显示出显著的预测DLCO百分比缺陷。

Query_Text_en: Conclusions DLCO may be a more sensitive indicator of the long-term effects of intermediate levels of 1-antitrypsin on lung function especially in subjects who smoke .
Translation: 结论：DLCO可能是评估α1-抗胰蛋白酶中等水平对肺功能长期影响的更敏感指标，尤其是在吸烟者中。

Query_Text_en: Its major function is to inhibit neutrophil elastase in the lung .
Translation: 其主要功能是在肺部抑制中性粒细胞弹性蛋白酶。

Query_Text_en: An accelerated decline in multiple measures of lung function has been demonstrated in patients with the homozygous deficient allele [ PiZZ ] of 1-antitrypsin , especially in those individuals who have smoked .
Translation: 已证实，α1-抗胰蛋白酶纯合缺陷等位基因[PiZZ]患者的多项肺功能指标呈加速下降趋势，尤其是在吸烟者中。

Query_Text_en: These changes have been noted in measures such as FEV1 , FVC , diffusing capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide [ Dlco ] , lung density imaged by high-resolution CT [ HRCT ] , and overall health status .
Translation: 这些变化已在包括第一秒用力呼气量（FEV1）、用力肺活量（FVC）、一氧化碳肺扩散能力（DLco）、高分辨率CT（HRCT）成像的肺密度以及整体健康状况在内的多项指标中被观察到。

Query_Text_en: However , whether the heterozygous PiMZ phenotype is an independent risk factor for the development of COPD and accelerated decline of lung function remains controversial .
Translation: 然而，杂合子PiMZ表型是否为慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）发生及肺功能加速下降的独立危险因素，目前仍存在争议。

Query_Text_en: In some studies , subjects with the PiMZ phenotype have been found to have an increased risk for emphysema , COPD , decline in FEV1 , and hospital admission due to altered levels of antiprotease .
Translation: 在一些研究中，发现PiMZ表型人群由于抗蛋白酶水平异常，患肺气肿、慢性阻塞性肺病、FEV1指标下降以及因住院治疗的风险增加。

Query_Text_en: Other studies have found no association between spirometry parameters , emphysema , or COPD , and the PiMZ phenotype .
Translation: 其他研究未发现肺功能参数、肺气肿或慢性阻塞性肺疾病与PiMZ表型之间存在关联。

Query_Text_en: Dlco is an overall measurement of the gas exchange capacity of the lung and , along with HRCT , has been shown previously to be a highly sensitive measure for progression of emphysema in homozygous PiZZ patients .
Translation: DLCO是肺部气体交换能力的综合评估指标，此前已被证实与高分辨率计算机断层扫描（HRCT）联合使用时，是评估纯合子PiZZ型患者肺气肿进展的高度敏感的检测指标。

Query_Text_en: The aim of the present study was to determine whether , in a prospective cohort study , PiMZ subjects had lower Dlco levels or more rapid rates of decline than subjects with other 1 - antitrypsin phenotypes .
Translation: 本研究旨在通过前瞻性队列研究确定，PiMZ表型受试者的一氧化碳弥散量水平是否低于其他一抗胰蛋白酶表型受试者，或其下降速率是否更快。

Query_Text_en: Data for the present study were collected as part of the Tucson Epidemiologic Study of Airway Obstructive Disease [ TESAOD ] .
Translation: 本研究的数据来源于图森呼吸道阻塞性疾病流行病学研究（TESAOD）。

Query_Text_en: Briefly , subjects were selected from a random , stratified cluster sample of white , non-Mexican-American households .
Translation: 简言之，调查对象选取自一个随机分层聚类样本，该样本涵盖非墨西哥裔白人美国家庭。

Query_Text_en: Details of the study design have been published previously .
Translation: 研究设计的详细内容此前已发表。

Query_Text_en: The sampling frame consisted of census blocks stratified on the basis of ethnic group , age of the head of household , and socioeconomic status based on 1970 census data .
Translation: 抽样框由根据民族、户主年龄及基于1970年人口普查数据的社会经济地位分层的普查区构成。

Query_Text_en: Subjects were enrolled between 1972 and 1973 .
Translation: 研究对象于1972年至1973年期间被招募。

Query_Text_en: There were 12 periodic follow-up surveys obtained approximately 1.5 to 2 years apart for a total of 20 years .
Translation: 共进行了12次定期跟踪调查，每隔约1.5至2年进行一次，历时20年。

Query_Text_en: During each survey , subjects completed standardized respiratory questionnaires .
Translation: 在每次调查中，参与者完成了标准化呼吸系统问卷。

Query_Text_en: Spirometric and flow-volume data were obtained during each survey with a pneumotachograph using American Thoracic Society criteria , with the exception of survey 4 .
Translation: 在每次调查中通过肺量计收集了肺容量及流速-容量数据，除第四次调查外均采用美国胸科学会标准。

Query_Text_en: Single-breath Dlco measurements were obtained during surveys 6 , 7 , 8 , and 12 .
Translation: 在第6、7、8和12次调查期间获得了单次呼吸Dlco测量值。

Query_Text_en: However , for the present study measurements from survey 6 were not included because of changes in instrumentation during the course of that survey that could affect homogeneity of results with subsequent surveys .
Translation: 在本次研究中，第六次调查的测量数据未被纳入，因为在此次调查过程中仪器设备的变动可能影响后续调查结果的一致性。

Query_Text_en: Subjects who were unable to be tested during survey 7 were tested during survey 8 , which was considered a catch-up survey for Dlco .
Translation: 在第七次调查中未能接受检测的受试者在第八次调查中接受了检测，此次调查被视为对Dlco的补测调查。

Query_Text_en: An automated system was used [ model DS ; W.E. Collins ; Braintree , MA ] .
Translation: 采用了一套自动化系统[型号DS；W.E. Collins公司；马萨诸塞州布兰特里市]。

Query_Text_en: The washout volume was 1.0 L , except for participants with a vital capacity 2.0 L , for whom a washout volume of 500 mL was used .
Translation: 冲洗体积为1.0升，但肺活量为2.0升的参与者除外，这些受试者的冲洗体积使用了500毫升。

Query_Text_en: The test gas was 0.3 % carbon monoxide , 10 % helium , and balance nitrogen .
Translation: 测试气体由0.3%一氧化碳、10%氦气和余量氮气组成。

Query_Text_en: At least two Dlco maneuvers were performed with an interval of at least 4 min between tests .
Translation: 至少完成两次Dlco测试，且两次测试之间的间隔期不得少于4分钟。

Query_Text_en: The mean Dlco value from the two that matched within 2 mL\/min\/mm Hg was reported .
Translation: 在2毫升/分钟/毫米汞柱范围内的两个匹配值的平均Dlco值被报告。

Query_Text_en: Maneuvers with a breath-holding time 9 s or 11 s were also excluded .
Translation: 屏息时间为9秒或11秒的操作也被排除。

Query_Text_en: Smokers were asked to abstain from smoking for 4 h prior to their clinic visit .
Translation: 要求吸烟者在就诊前4小时禁烟。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of these analyses , Dlco measurements were normalized for age , sex , hemoglobin , and height utilizing the prediction equations of Crapo and Morris in accordance to American Thoracic Society recommendations , and percentage of predicted [ % predicted ] values of Dlco were determined .
Translation: 在这些分析中，Dlco测量值根据年龄、性别、血红蛋白水平和身高进行了标准化处理，采用了Crapo和Morris的预测方程并遵循美国胸科学会的指导原则，最终确定了Dlco的预测百分比值（% predicted）。

Query_Text_en: FEV1 values from the same surveys were also evaluated and were normalized using the prediction equations from Knudson et al to obtain % predicted FEV1 values .
Translation: 来自同一项调查的FEV1值也进行了评估，并采用Knudson等人的预测方程进行标准化处理，以获得%预测FEV1值。

Query_Text_en: The % predicted values of Dlco and FEV1 were both considered as outcome variables in this study .
Translation: 在这项研究中，Dlco和FEV1的%预测值均被作为结局变量。

Query_Text_en: 1-Antitrypsin phenotypes were determined by discontinuous acid starch-gel electrophoresis followed by crossed immunoelectrophoresis in agarose gel [ ie , the method of Fagerhol and Laurell ] .
Translation: α1-抗胰蛋白酶表型通过不连续酸性淀粉凝胶电泳后，再在琼脂糖凝胶中进行交叉免疫电泳确定[即Fagerhol和Laurell的方法]。

Query_Text_en: For the present study , we selected 1,075 subjects who were 18 years of age at any Dlco measurement and who had 1-antitrypsin assessments .
Translation: 在本研究中，我们选取了1,075名在任何一次Dlco检测时年龄为18岁并接受了α1-抗胰蛋白酶检测的受试者。

Query_Text_en: Subjects were current smokers if they reported smoking at least one cigarette per day , ex-smokers , or nonsmokers .
Translation: 受试者被归类为当前吸烟者，若其报告每日至少吸一支烟；其余则为曾经吸烟者或非吸烟者。

Query_Text_en: Smoking was dichotomized into ever-smokers [ current smokers and ex-smokers ] and nonsmokers .
Translation: 吸烟被分为既往吸烟者（包括现吸烟者和曾经吸烟者）和非吸烟者。

Query_Text_en: Data were evaluated cross-sectionally and longitudinally .
Translation: 数据从横断面和纵向两个角度进行了评估。

Query_Text_en: The Student t test and one-way analysis of variance were used to compare differences in mean values of continuous variables by gender and by the different phenotypes , PiMM , PiMS , and PiMZ .
Translation: 采用学生t检验和单因素方差分析，按性别及不同表型（PiMM、PiMS和PiMZ）比较连续变量均值的差异。

Query_Text_en: Independent multivariate mixed-effects linear regression models were fitted to evaluate mean differences in longitudinal outcome values associated with the 1-antitrypsin phenotypes .
Translation: 研究采用独立多元混合效应线性回归模型，评估α1-抗胰蛋白酶表型与纵向结果值平均差异的关系。

Query_Text_en: In each of these models , the outcome or dependent variables , % predicted Dlco , and % predicted FEV1 were fitted independently .
Translation: 在这些模型中，每个模型分别对结果变量或因变量、一氧化碳扩散能力（DLCO）的预测百分比以及一秒用力呼气量（FEV1）的预测百分比进行了独立拟合。

Query_Text_en: Participants were classified into six groups based on smoking status [ smokers or nonsmokers ] used as a time-dependent variable and their 1-antitrypsin phenotypes , PiMM , PiMS , and PiMZ .
Translation: 参与者根据吸烟状态[吸烟者或非吸烟者]（作为时依变量）和其α1-抗胰蛋白酶表型（PiMM、PiMS和PiMZ）被分为六组。

Query_Text_en: An interaction term between the 1-antitrypsin phenotype\/smoke variable and age was entered as a predictor variable in the mixed-effects models using nonsmoker PiMM as the reference category to test for differences in the rate of decline between phenotypes .
Translation: 在混合效应模型中，将α₁-抗胰蛋白酶表型/吸烟变量的交互作用项作为预测变量引入，并以非吸烟者PiMM表型为参考类别，以检验不同表型间衰退速率的差异。

Query_Text_en: Subjects were fitted as random effects to account for intrasubject serial correlation that results from the longitudinal lung function assessments .
Translation: 受试者被作为随机效应纳入模型，以解释由纵向肺功能评估所导致的组内序列相关。

Query_Text_en: Age and sex were included as fixed effects in the models .
Translation: 年龄和性别被作为固定效应纳入模型。

Query_Text_en: Linear contrast of coefficients were used to test mean differences between PiMM and PiMZ phenotypes among smokers and nonsmokers at different ages .
Translation: 系数的线性对比被用于检验不同年龄段吸烟者和非吸烟者中PiMM与PiMZ表型的均值差异。

Query_Text_en: A significance level of 0.05 was used for all statistical tests .
Translation: 所有统计检验均采用0.05的显著性水平。

Query_Text_en: The TESAOD was approved by the institutional review board , and informed written consent was obtained from all subjects at the time of their enrollment into the study .
Translation: 本研究经伦理审查委员会批准，所有受试者入组时均签署了知情同意书。

Query_Text_en: Descriptive characteristics are presented in Table 1 .
Translation: 表1列出了描述性特征。

Query_Text_en: There were significantly more male smokers than female smokers for surveys 7 and 12 .
Translation: 在第7次和第12次调查中，男性吸烟者人数显著多于女性吸烟者。

Query_Text_en: Data for survey 8 showed no significant differences possibly because of the small sample size for this survey .
Translation: 第八次调查的数据未显示显著差异，可能由于此次调查样本量较小所致。

Query_Text_en: No difference was seen in smoking by 1-antitrypsin phenotype for any of the surveys .
Translation: 在任何一项调查中，吸烟情况在α1-抗胰蛋白酶表型之间均未见显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Table 2 shows that , in cross-sectional analyses , there were no significant differences in % predicted Dlco for male or female subjects who did not smoke .
Translation: 表2显示，在横断面分析中，不吸烟的男性或女性受试者的预测DLCO百分比无显著差异。

Query_Text_en: These differences were significant for surveys 7 and 12 .
Translation: 对于第7次和第12次调查，这些差异具有显著性。

Query_Text_en: % predicted Dlco values were significantly lower for smokers with the PiMZ phenotype compared to smokers with the PiMM phenotype only in survey 8 [ p = 0.03 ] , while borderline significant for survey 12 [ p = 0.07 ] .
Translation: 与仅具有PiMM表型的吸烟者相比，具有PiMZ表型的吸烟者的预测一氧化碳弥散能力值在第8次调查中显著较低（p=0.03），而在第12次调查中仅呈现临界显著（p=0.07）。

Query_Text_en: Mean % predicted Dlco values for subjects who smoked and had the PiMS phenotype were 93 % for survey 7 , 67 % for survey 8 , and 96 % for survey 12 .
Translation: 吸烟且具有PiMS表型的受试者在第7次调查中的DLCO预测值百分比为93%，第8次为67%，第12次为96%。

Query_Text_en: No differences were seen for % predicted FEV1 and gender in subjects who did not smoke except for survey 12 , in which female subjects had significant higher values than male subjects .
Translation: 除第12次调查外，非吸烟者的FEV1预测百分比值和性别之间未见差异，而在第12次调查中，女性受试者的数值显著高于男性。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , no significant differences were seen for % predicted FEV1 and 1-antitrypsin phenotypes for either subjects who smoked or did not smoke .
Translation: 无论是吸烟者还是非吸烟者，其预测FEV1百分比及α1-抗胰蛋白酶表型均未观察到显著差异。

Query_Text_en: A steeper decline of % predicted Dlco was also seen for subjects with the PiMM phenotype who smoked [ -0.17 % ; p = 0.004 ] .
Translation: 对于吸烟的PiMM表型受试者，也观察到预测DLCO百分比更大幅度的下降[-0.17%; p=0.004]。

Query_Text_en: Linear contrasts were used to test the mean differences of % predicted Dlco at different ages [ 20 , 40 , 60 , and 80 years ] between the groups of subjects with the PiMM and the PiMZ phenotypes within smoking categories [ Fig 1 ] .
Translation: 在不同吸烟类别中，对携带PiMM和PiMZ表型的受试者组群间%预测DLCO在不同年龄（20、40、60和80岁）时的平均差异进行了线性对比分析检验（图1）。

Query_Text_en: No significant differences were found for the PiMZ phenotype as contrasted with the PiMM phenotype among nonsmokers at any age .
Translation: 在任何年龄段的非吸烟者中，PiMZ表型与PiMM表型之间未发现存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: However , among smokers , the PiMZ phenotype was associated with borderline significant % predicted Dlco deficits at age 40 years [ 8.6 % ; p = 0.075 ] and significant % predicted Dlco deficits at ages 60 years [ 15.2 % ; p = 0.001 ] and 80 years [ 21.9 % ; p = 0.003 ] , as compared with the PiMM phenotype .
Translation: 然而，在吸烟者中，与PiMM表型相比，PiMZ表型在40岁时的预测DLCO值缺陷百分比接近显著（8.6%；p=0.075），而在60岁（15.2%；p=0.001）和80岁时（21.9%；p=0.003）则显示出显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Results on linear contrasts between PiMZ smokers with ] 20 pack-years and PiMM smokers with ] 20 pack-years were similar to those obtained utilizing the dichotomized smoke variable .
Translation: 对吸烟量超过20包年的PiMZ基因型吸烟者与PiMM基因型吸烟者进行的线性对比结果，与利用二分法吸烟变量所得结果相似。

Query_Text_en: We also evaluated the effect of 1-antitrypsin phenotypes on Dlco [ mL\/min\/mm Hg ] and found that mixed models and linear contrast analyses showed similar results as those obtained using % predicted Dlco .
Translation: 我们还评估了α1-抗胰蛋白酶表型对DLCO[mL/(min·mmHg)]的影响，并发现混合效应模型和线性对比分析的结果与使用%预测DLCO得出的结果相似。

Query_Text_en: Models evaluating association between % predicted FEV1 and 1-antitrypsin showed no significant differences between PiMZ or PiMS phenotypes [ results not shown ] .
Translation: 模型分析预测值百分比的一秒钟用力呼气容积（FEV1）与α1-抗胰蛋白酶之间的关联性后发现，PiMZ表型或PiMS表型之间未呈现显著差异[结果未显示]。

Query_Text_en: The results of this study showed that adult smokers with the PiMZ phenotype had a greater decrease in Dlco than nonsmokers with the PiMM phenotype .
Translation: 该研究结果显示，具有PiMZ表型的成年吸烟者Dlco水平下降幅度大于具有PiMM表型的非吸烟者。

Query_Text_en: In addition , older adult smokers [ age 60 years ] with the PiMZ phenotype had lower Dlco values than those with the PiMM phenotype .
Translation: 此外，具有PiMZ表型的60岁老年吸烟者（年龄60岁）的DLco值低于具有PiMM表型的个体。

Query_Text_en: The distribution of 1-antitrypsin alleles has been found constant in different populations , with the most common being the PiMM [ 88 to 90 % ] , PiMS [ 4 to 8 % ] , and PiMZ [ 2 to 4 % ] .
Translation: 研究发现，不同人群中α1-抗胰蛋白酶等位基因分布相对稳定，最常见的基因型为PiMM（88%至90%）、PiMS（4%至8%）和PiMZ（2%至4%）。

Query_Text_en: 1-Antitrypsin serum concentrations levels for those with the PiMM phenotype are considered normal and have not been found to be associated with lung function impairment .
Translation: PiMM表型个体的抗胰蛋白酶血清浓度水平被认为处于正常范围，且尚未发现其与肺功能损伤存在关联。

Query_Text_en: However , it is well known that subjects with the homozygous Z allele have lower serum levels of 1-antitrypsin and an increased risk for emphysema .
Translation: 然而，众所周知，携带纯合子Z等位基因的人群α1-抗胰蛋白酶血清水平较低，并且患肺气肿的风险增加。

Query_Text_en: Severe 1-antitrypsin deficiency when coupled with smoking is responsible for approximately 2 % of all emphysema cases .
Translation: 严重的α1-抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症与吸烟共同作用，导致了大约2%的所有肺气肿病例。

Query_Text_en: Whether individuals with the heterozygous allele PiMZ and intermediate levels of 1-antitrypsin are at increased risk for lung disease and accelerated decline of lung function remains unclear .
Translation: 携带PiMZ杂合子等位基因且α1-抗胰蛋白酶水平处于中等的个体是否面临更高的肺病风险以及肺功能加速下降，目前尚不明确。

Query_Text_en: As a lung function test , the single-breath Dlco is used as one measure of gas exchange across the alveolar capillary interface .
Translation: 作为肺功能检测的一种，单次呼吸Dlco被用作评估肺泡毛细血管膜气体交换能力的指标。

Query_Text_en: While it may also be influenced by a number of other variables , it is also commonly used as an indictor of early emphysematous changes .
Translation: 虽然它可能还受到其他变量的影响，但也常被用作早期肺气肿性改变的指标。

Query_Text_en: Several structural and functional properties influence the capacity of the lung to exchange gas across the alveolar-capillary interface , including the thickness and integrity of the alveolar-capillary membrane , the volume of blood in the capillary , and hemoglobin concentration and binding properties .
Translation: 肺部进行气体交换的能力受到多个结构和功能特性的影响，包括肺泡-毛细血管膜的厚度和完整性、毛细血管内的血量，以及血红蛋白浓度及其结合特性等。

Query_Text_en: In subjects with 1-antitrypsin deficiency , the elastin fiber is degraded by elastase , resulting in destruction of the alveolar tissue .
Translation: 在α1-抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症患者中，弹性蛋白纤维被弹性蛋白酶降解，导致肺泡组织遭到破坏。

Query_Text_en: Decreases of Dlco are seen when there is disruption at this interface , either by fibrosis or membrane interruption as may occur in emphysema .
Translation: 当肺泡毛细血管膜结构受损时（无论是由纤维化导致还是膜结构损伤，如肺气肿时可能出现的情况），均会导致Dlco水平下降。

Query_Text_en: Coupled with HRCT , Dlco may be more sensitive to lung abnormalities due to decreased levels of 1-antitrypsin than spirometry measures alone .
Translation: 结合高分辨率CT检查，肺一氧化碳弥散量可能比单独肺活量测定更能敏感地反映由α1-抗胰蛋白酶水平降低引发的肺部异常。

Query_Text_en: These subjects who received no 1 - antitrypsin augmentation therapy completed three pulmonary annual assessments in a 2-year period .
Translation: 这些未接受α1-抗胰蛋白酶增强治疗的受试者在两年期间完成了三次肺部年度评估。

Query_Text_en: The authors found that change in the lung density of the upper zone assessed by quantitative HRCT and change in Dlco were more sensitive than other lung function parameters including FEV1 to evaluate the progression of emphysematous changes .
Translation: 研究者发现，通过定量高分辨率CT评估的上叶肺密度变化以及一氧化碳弥散量（DLco）的变化，相较于包括一秒用力呼气量（FEV1）在内的其他肺功能参数，在评估肺气肿病变进展方面具有更高的敏感性。

Query_Text_en: Previous studies have found differences in Dlco values between male and female subjects .
Translation: 先前的研究发现，男性和女性受试者的Dlco值存在差异。

Query_Text_en: Utilizing the TESAOD data , Knudson et al and Sherrill et al found lower Dlco and Dlco\/alveolar volume for female subjects than male subjects , with male subjects having steeper rates of decline than female subjects , and subjects who smoked having lower levels of Dlco than never-smokers .
Translation: 利用TESAOD数据，Knudson等人和Sherrill等人发现女性受试者的Dlco（一氧化碳弥散能力）和Dlco/肺泡容积比值均低于男性受试者，且男性受试者的下降速率比女性更快。此外，吸烟者受试者的Dlco水平也明显低于从不吸烟者。

Query_Text_en: In the present study , we found that % predicted Dlco , which is adjusted for gender , was lower for male smokers than female smokers .
Translation: 本研究发现，经性别校正后的预测一氧化碳扩散能力百分比显示，男性吸烟者的该指标低于女性吸烟者。

Query_Text_en: This difference may be explained by the larger number of pack-years among male smokers than female smokers .
Translation: 这一差异可能归因于男性吸烟者的包年数更多。

Query_Text_en: Carbon monoxide back pressure or carboxyhemoglobin levels were not measured ; therefore , it is possible that the values for smokers were underestimated .
Translation: 一氧化碳回压或碳氧血红蛋白水平未进行测量，因此可能导致吸烟者的数值被低估。

Query_Text_en: However , we adjusted for smoking in our regression models , and more than half of the smoking group was comprised of former smokers .
Translation: 不过，我们在回归模型中对吸烟因素进行了校正，且吸烟组中超过半数为既往吸烟者。

Query_Text_en: We acknowledge that our study included a small sample of subjects with the PiMZ phenotype , which may have influenced our results .
Translation: 我们承认，本研究纳入的PiMZ表型受试者样本量较小，这可能影响了研究结果。

Query_Text_en: This is a limitation common to most population-based studies because of the low expected frequency of the PiMZ phenotype .
Translation: 这是基于人群的研究普遍存在的一个局限性，由于PiMZ表型的预期频率较低。

Query_Text_en: When we reanalyzed the data after removing observations from survey 8 [ in which sample size was particularly small ] , results yielded no appreciable differences [ data not shown ] .
Translation: 在排除样本量特别小的第八次调查观测数据后，我们重新分析数据的结果未显示显著差异（数据未展示）。

Query_Text_en: In addition , our predicted Dlco values were not adjusted for individual hemoglobin concentration , and therefore effects on Dlco values for those subjects with decreased or increased hemoglobin values were not accounted .
Translation: 此外，我们的预测DLCO值未根据个体血红蛋白浓度进行调整，因此未考虑血红蛋白水平降低或升高的受试者DLCO值可能受到的影响。

Query_Text_en: The lack of hemoglobin adjustment is a limitation in our study .
Translation: 本研究未对血红蛋白进行调整是一个局限性。

Query_Text_en: However , it would seem improbable that there would be any systemic bias in hemoglobin concentration in our randomly selected community sample .
Translation: 然而，在我们随机选取的社区样本中，血红蛋白浓度存在系统性偏差的可能性似乎微乎其微。

Query_Text_en: Using the same cohort of the TESAOD study , we have previously shown that subjects with the PiMZ phenotype were not at increased risk for a diagnosis of COPD or showing an accelerated decline of FEV1 .
Translation: 在TESAOD研究的同一研究队列中，我们此前已表明，具有PiMZ表型的研究对象罹患慢性阻塞性肺病的风险并未增加，也未出现一秒钟用力呼气量加速下降的情况。

Query_Text_en: Those findings were confirmed in the current study , in which , despite the effects of the PiMZ phenotype on Dlco , no association between 1-antitrypsin phenotypes and % predicted FEV1 was found .
Translation: 本研究证实了上述发现，其中尽管PiMZ表型对DLco存在影响，但未发现α1-抗胰蛋白酶表型与预测FEV1%之间存在关联。

Query_Text_en: The presence of impaired lung diffusion without abnormal spirometry in these subjects may suggest a subclinical lung disease .
Translation: 这些受试者存在肺弥散功能障碍但肺功能spirometry检查无异常，这可能提示存在亚临床肺部疾病。

Query_Text_en: In the present study , smokers with the PiMZ phenotype were at greater risk of lung function abnormality assessed by Dlco by the time they reached middle to late adult life .
Translation: 在本研究中，携带PiMZ表型的吸烟者到中晚年阶段时，其通过DLCO评估的肺功能异常风险显著升高。

Query_Text_en: Therefore , our findings suggest that Dlco may be a more sensitive parameter than FEV1 in determining early subclinical effects of intermediate levels of 1-antitrypsin in lung function , especially in subjects who smoke .
Translation: 因此，我们的研究结果表明，在评估中等水平α1-抗胰蛋白酶对肺功能的早期亚临床效应方面，一氧化碳弥散能力（DLco）可能比第一秒用力呼气量（FEV1）更为敏感，尤其是吸烟者。

Query_Text_en: Rationale : Identification of risk factors for lung cancer can help in selecting patients who may benefit the most from smoking cessation interventions , early detection , or chemoprevention .
Translation: 肺癌风险因素的识别有助于筛选出最可能从戒烟干预措施、早期检测或化学预防中获益的患者。

Query_Text_en: Objective : To evaluate whether the presence of emphysema on low-radiation-dose CT [ LDCT ] of the chest is an independent risk factor for lung cancer .
Translation: 评估胸部低剂量CT（LDCT）显示的肺气肿是否为肺癌的独立危险因素。

Query_Text_en: Methods : The study used data from a prospective cohort of 1,166 former and current smokers participating in a lung cancer screening study .
Translation: 方法：本研究采用的数据来自一项肺癌筛查研究中1166名前吸烟者和现吸烟者组成的前瞻性队列。

Query_Text_en: All individuals underwent a baseline LDCT and spirometry followed by yearly repeat LDCT studies .
Translation: 所有受试者均接受了基线低剂量螺旋CT检查和肺功能测试，并随后每年进行一次重复低剂量螺旋CT检查。

Query_Text_en: The incidence density of lung cancer among patients with and without emphysema on LDCT was estimated .
Translation: 通过低剂量计算机断层扫描（LDCT），对有肺气肿和无肺气肿患者的肺癌发病率密度进行了估算。

Query_Text_en: Stratified and multiple regression analyses were used to assess whether emphysema is an independent risk factor for lung cancer after adjusting for age , gender , smoking history , and the presence of airway obstruction on spirometry .
Translation: 分层及多元回归分析被用于在校正年龄、性别、吸烟史以及肺功能检测中气道阻塞存在情况等因素后，评估肺气肿是否为肺癌的独立危险因素。

Query_Text_en: Results : On univariate analysis , the incidence density of lung cancer among individuals with and without emphysema on LDCT was 25.0 per 1,000 person-years and 7.5 per 1,000 person-years , respectively [ risk ratio [ RR ] , 3.33 ; 95 % confidence interval [ CI ] , 1.41 to 7.85 ] .
Translation: 在单变量分析中，低剂量CT（LDCT）显示肺气肿人群与无肺气肿人群的肺癌发病率分别为每千人年25.0例和7.5例[风险比（RR）为3.33；95%置信区间（CI）为1.41至7.85]。

Query_Text_en: Emphysema was also associated with increased risk of lung cancer when the analysis was limited to individuals without airway obstruction on spirometry [ RR , 4.33 ; 95 % CI , 1.04 to 18.16 ] .
Translation: 当分析仅限于肺功能测定未显示气道阻塞的个体时，肺气肿也与肺癌风险增加相关[RR=4.33；95%CI为1.04至18.16]。

Query_Text_en: Multivariate analysis showed that the presence of emphysema [ RR , 2.51 ; 95 % CI , 1.01 to 6.23 ] on LDCT but not airway obstruction [ RR , 2.10 ; 95 % CI , 0.79 to 5.58 ] was associated with increased risk of lung cancer after adjusting for potential cofounders .
Translation: 多变量分析显示，在调整潜在混杂因素后，低剂量计算机断层扫描（LDCT）中肺气肿的存在（风险比为2.51，95%置信区间为1.01至6.23）与肺癌风险增加相关，而气道阻塞（风险比为2.10，95%置信区间为0.79至5.58）则未显示相关性。

Query_Text_en: Conclusions : Results suggest that the presence of emphysema on LDCT is an independent risk factor for lung cancer .
Translation: 结论：研究结果表明，低剂量CT检查中发现的肺气肿是肺癌的独立风险因素。

Query_Text_en: Lung cancer is the deadliest malignancy in the world among men and women .
Translation: 肺癌是男性和女性中在世界范围内最致命的恶性肿瘤。

Query_Text_en: Major public health efforts have focused on developing new interventions to decrease smoking rates , the main risk factor for lung cancer , and to test for strategies that could lead to early detection or effective chemoprevention .
Translation: 公共卫生领域的重大努力一直集中在开发新的干预措施以降低吸烟率——这是肺癌的主要致病风险因素——并测试可能带来早期检测或有效化学预防的策略。

Query_Text_en: In particular , lung cancer screening using low-radiation-dose CT [ LDCT ] is a promising strategy currently undergoing intensive research efforts .
Translation: 尤其值得注意的是，采用低辐射剂量计算机断层扫描（LDCT）进行肺癌筛查是一种颇具前景的策略，正成为当前研究的重点。

Query_Text_en: An important aspect of these strategies is the ability to identify patients at high risk for lung cancer who may benefit the most from smoking cessation treatments , early diagnosis , or chemo-prevention .
Translation: 这些策略的重要方面在于能够识别可能从戒烟治疗、早期诊断或化学预防中获益最多的肺癌高风险患者。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , several studies have shown that the cost-effectiveness of these interventions is highly dependent on the prevalence of lung cancer in the target population .
Translation: 此外，多项研究表明，这些干预措施的成本效益高度依赖于目标人群中肺癌的发病率。

Query_Text_en: COPD , also strongly associated with cigarette smoking , is a highly prevalent condition that in industrialized countries is only second to heart disease as a cause of death .
Translation: 慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）作为一种与吸烟密切相关且高发的疾病，在工业化国家的死亡原因中仅次于心脏病。

Query_Text_en: Most patients with COPD have a combination of chronic bronchitis and emphysema , which is anatomically defined as an abnormal permanent enlargement of the airspaces distal to the terminal bronchioles , accompanied by destruction of their walls without obvious fibrosis .
Translation: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者通常同时患有慢性支气管炎和肺气肿。在解剖学上，肺气肿被定义为终末细支气管远端的气腔发生异常永久性扩大，并伴有气腔壁的破坏且无明显纤维化。

Query_Text_en: According to international guidelines , the diagnosis of COPD requires the presence of airway obstruction on spirometry .
Translation: 根据国际指南，慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）的诊断需通过肺功能检查发现气道阻塞。

Query_Text_en: In recent years , CT has been shown to accurately identify areas of the lung parenchyma involved with emphysema .
Translation: 近年来，CT已被证明能够准确识别肺实质中与肺气肿相关的区域。

Query_Text_en: CT may be more sensitive than pulmonary function tests for the detection of emphysema , but the clinical significance of emphysema diagnosed on CT in the absence of airway obstruction is not yet clear .
Translation: CT在检测肺气肿方面可能比肺功能检查更敏感，但通过CT诊断的肺气肿在没有气道阻塞的情况下其临床意义尚不明确。

Query_Text_en: It has been shown that patients with COPD , defined by the presence of airway obstruction , are at increased risk for lung cancer .
Translation: 研究显示，具有气道阻塞特征的慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者罹患肺癌的风险更高。

Query_Text_en: However , there are limited data regarding the potential association between emphysema diagnosed on chest CT and lung cancer , particularly among individuals with normal airway function .
Translation: 关于通过胸部CT诊断的肺气肿与肺癌之间的潜在关联，尤其是气道功能正常人群中，目前尚缺乏相关数据。

Query_Text_en: In this study , we used data from an unselected population of current and former smokers participating in a lung cancer screening study to assess whether emphysema detected on LDCT is an independent risk factor for lung cancer .
Translation: 在本研究中，我们利用参与肺癌筛查研究的未经筛选的当前和既往吸烟者数据，评估通过低剂量计算机断层扫描（LDCT）检出的肺气肿是否为肺癌的独立危险因素。

Query_Text_en: The study was conducted using data from a prospective cohort of individuals enrolled in a lung cancer screening study using LDCT from September 2000 to December 2005 .
Translation: 该研究基于前瞻性队列研究中参与者的数据开展，这些参与者于2000年9月至2005年12月期间参与了一项采用低剂量螺旋CT的肺癌筛查研究。

Query_Text_en: Eligibility criteria included age 40 years , ] 10 pack-year smoking history , and no symptoms of lung cancer .
Translation: 资格标准包括年龄≥40岁、吸烟史超过10包年以及无肺癌症状。

Query_Text_en: The study protocol consisted of a baseline LDCT of the chest followed by annual repeat studies for up to 5 years .
Translation: 研究方案包括胸部基线低剂量螺旋CT检查，随后在长达5年内每年进行复查。

Query_Text_en: All patients underwent spirometry at enrollment and a baseline standardized questionnaire to collect sociodemographic information and smoking history data .
Translation: 所有患者在入组时均接受了肺功能测试，并填写了基线标准化问卷，以收集社会人口统计信息和吸烟史数据。

Query_Text_en: The ethics committee of the University of Navarra approved the study protocol , and all subjects signed an informed consent form prior to participation .
Translation: 纳瓦拉大学伦理委员会批准了该研究方案，所有受试者均在参与前签署了知情同意书。

Query_Text_en: LDCT examinations were performed in a single breath-hold at end-inspiration .
Translation: 低剂量计算机断层扫描检查在吸气末期通过单次屏气完成。

Query_Text_en: The initial 297 subjects were studied with a single-slice helical scanner [ Somatom Plus 4 ; Siemens ; Erlangen , Germany ] at low-dose settings [ 140 kilovolt peak , 43 mA seconds ] and 1.5 pitch with a collimation of 8 mm . We used a four-row multislice helical CT scanner [ Somatom Volume Zoom ; Siemens ; Forchheim , Germany ] also at a low-dose setting [ 120 kilovolt peak , 20 mA seconds , and 1.25-mm slice thickness ] for all subsequent studies .
Translation: 初始297例受试者的研究采用单层螺旋CT扫描仪（西门子Somatom Plus 4型，德国埃尔朗根），设置低剂量参数[140千伏峰值，43毫安秒]，螺距1.5，准直宽度8毫米。后续所有研究均采用四排多层螺旋CT扫描仪（西门子Somatom Volume Zoom型，德国福希海姆），设置低剂量参数[120千伏峰值，20毫安秒，层厚1.25毫米]。

Query_Text_en: All images were reconstructed using a high - spatial-frequency algorithm and displayed at window settings appropriate for viewing the lung parenchyma [ window width of 1,500 Hounsfield units , and window center of 650 Hounsfield units ] .
Translation: 所有图像均采用高空间频率算法重建，并以适合观察肺实质的窗宽（1500 Hounsfield单位）和窗位（650 Hounsfield单位）进行显示。

Query_Text_en: All images were read by two expert chest radiologists for visual assessment of the presence of emphysema , using validated criteria .
Translation: 所有影像均由两位胸科放射科专家通过经过验证的标准进行视觉评估，以判断肺气肿的存在。

Query_Text_en: In brief , the extent of emphysema was graded from 0 to 4 , with a grade of 0 indicating no emphysema , and a grade of 4 indicating the presence of emphysema in ] 75 % of the lung .
Translation: 简而言之，肺气肿程度被分级为0至4级，其中0级表示无肺气肿，4级则表示肺部75%以上区域存在肺气肿。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of this study , patients with a score 1 were classified as having emphysema .
Translation: 在本研究中，评分为1分的患者被归类为患有肺气肿。

Query_Text_en: Airway function was measured at baseline in all study participants using a flow spirometer [ V Bmax 22 ; Sensor Medics ; Yorba Linda , CA ] according to the standards of the American Thoracic Society .
Translation: 所有研究参与者均通过V Bmax 22型流量 spirometer（Sensor Medics公司，美国加利福尼亚州约巴林达市）按照美国胸科学会的标准测量了基线气道功能。

Query_Text_en: FEV1 and FVC measures were expressed as a percentage of the predicted value according to the European Community Lung Health Survey .
Translation: FEV1和FVC的测量值以预测值的百分比表示，该百分比依据欧洲社区肺健康调查的标准确定。

Query_Text_en: Using the criteria established by the Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease , subjects with a FEV1\/FVC ratio [ 70 % were classified as having airway obstruction .
Translation: 根据慢性阻塞性肺疾病全球倡议建立的诊断标准，FEV1/FVC比率＜70%的受试者被分类为存在气道阻塞。

Query_Text_en: Study participants were evaluated for the presence of lung cancer using a standardized diagnostic algorithm .
Translation: 研究参与者通过标准化诊断算法接受了肺癌的诊断评估。

Query_Text_en: Briefly , patients with noncalcified nodules [ 10 mm were followed up with repeat LDCTs and further workup if growth of a nodule was detected .
Translation: 简而言之，对于直径10毫米以下的非钙化结节患者，若发现结节增大，将通过重复低剂量CT进行随访并进一步检查。

Query_Text_en: Subjects with suspicious nodules 10 mm were immediately referred for positron emission tomography , percutaneous needle biopsy , or intraoperative biopsy .
Translation: 具有10毫米可疑结节的受试者将立即转诊进行正电子发射断层扫描、经皮穿刺活检或术中活检。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of the study , all cases of lung cancer diagnosed as a consequence of screening or due to a new onset of symptoms [ interval cases ] were included in the analysis .
Translation: 在本研究中，所有因筛查发现或因新发症状确诊的肺癌病例（间隔病例）均被纳入分析范围。

Query_Text_en: Normal data are presented as mean SD , and nonnormal variables are presented as median [ interquartile range [ IQR ] ] .
Translation: 正态分布数据以均值±标准差形式呈现，而非正态分布变量则以中位数[四分位距（IQR）]形式呈现。

Query_Text_en: The agreement between raters for the visual assessment of emphysema and the coefficient for interrater reliability was calculated .
Translation: 计算了评分者间对肺气肿进行视觉评估的一致性以及评分者间信度系数。

Query_Text_en: The incidence density of lung cancer was calculated with person-years as the denominator under the Poisson assumption .
Translation: 在泊松假设下，肺癌的发病率密度以人年为分母进行计算。

Query_Text_en: We used the risk ratio [ RR ] with 95 % confidence intervals [ CIs ] to compare the risk of lung cancer among study subjects with and without emphysema .
Translation: 我们采用风险比（RR）并采用95%置信区间（CI）对有肺气肿和无肺气肿的研究对象的肺癌风险进行比较。

Query_Text_en: Stratified analyses were also conducted to evaluate the relationship between emphysema and lung cancer risk among patients with normal airway function .
Translation: 还对具有正常气道功能的患者进行了分层分析，以评估肺气肿与肺癌风险之间的关系。

Query_Text_en: We used Poisson regression to assess whether emphysema on LDCT was independently associated with lung cancer incidence density after controlling for other known risk factors such as age , gender , presence of airway obstruction , and smoking history [ number of pack-years ] .
Translation: 我们采用泊松回归模型，在控制了年龄、性别、气道阻塞情况及吸烟史（吸烟包年数）等其他已知风险因素后，评估了低剂量CT（LDCT）显示的肺气肿与肺癌发病率之间的独立相关性。

Query_Text_en: All analyses were performed with statistical software [ version 9.0 ; SAS Institute ; Cary , NC ] and using two-sided p values .
Translation: 所有分析均采用版本9.0的SAS统计软件（SAS研究所，北卡罗来纳州卡里市）并使用双侧p值进行。

Query_Text_en: Baseline characteristics of the study participants are shown in Table 1 .
Translation: 表1列出了研究对象的基线特征。

Query_Text_en: All participants were white western Europeans , mean age was 54 8 years , and 74 % were male .
Translation: 所有参与者均为白种西欧人，平均年龄为54.8岁，其中74%为男性。

Query_Text_en: The median number of pack-years smoked was 33 [ IQR : 22 pack-years ] .
Translation: 吸烟的包年数中位数为33（IQR：22包年）。

Query_Text_en: Overall , 29 % [ 95 % CI , 26 to 31 % ] of the subjects had emphysema on baseline LDCT and 25 % [ 95 % CI , 22 to 27 % ] had airway obstruction on spirometry [ Fig 1 ] .
Translation: 总体而言，29%（95%置信区间，26%至31%）的研究对象基线低剂量CT检查显示存在肺气肿，25%（95%置信区间，22%至27%）在肺量计检查中存在气道阻塞（图1）。

Query_Text_en: Fifty-three percent of the participants with emphysema on CT had no airway obstruction .
Translation: 在CT检查中显示有肺气肿的参与者中，53%未出现气道阻塞。

Query_Text_en: The interrater agreement for the presence or absence of emphysema based on visual assessment was excellent [ coefficient = 0.91 ] .
Translation: 基于视觉评估的肺气肿存在与否的评分者间一致性极佳[系数=0.91]。

Query_Text_en: No interval lung cancers were diagnosed .
Translation: 未诊断出间隔期肺癌。

Query_Text_en: Adenocarcinoma was the most frequent histologic type [ 57 % ] , followed by squamous cell carcinoma [ 22 % ] , small cell carcinoma [ 17 % ] , and large cell carcinoma [ 4 % ] .
Translation: 最常见的组织学类型为腺癌[57%]，其次为鳞状细胞癌[22%]、小细胞癌[17%]和大细胞癌[4%]。

Query_Text_en: Nearly 80 % of the cancers were diagnosed in stage I , 13 % in stage II , and 7 % in stage III .
Translation: 其中近80%的癌症病例在一期被诊断，13%在二期，7%在三期。

Query_Text_en: Of the 17 individuals with lung cancer and emphysema on LDCT , 16 patients [ 94 % ] had heterogenous emphysema with upper-lobe predominance and the cancer was located in the upper lobes .
Translation: 在低剂量计算机断层扫描（LDCT）检查出的17例肺癌合并肺气肿患者中，有16例（占94%）呈现以肺上叶为主的异质性肺气肿，且肿瘤位于肺上叶。

Query_Text_en: One individual had homogenous emphysema and lung cancer in the left lower lobe .
Translation: 一名患者左下叶患有均质型肺气肿和肺癌。

Query_Text_en: The histologic type of cancer in 10 of the 17 individuals with emphysema [ 58 % ] was adenocarcinoma .
Translation: 在17例肺气肿患者中，58%（10例）的癌症组织学类型为腺癌。

Query_Text_en: On univariate analysis , the incidence density of lung cancer among individuals with and without emphysema on LDCT was 25.0 per 1,000 person - years and 7.5 per 1,000 person-years , respectively [ RR , 3.33 ; 95 % CI , 1.41 to 7.85 ; Table 2 ] .
Translation: 在单变量分析中，接受低剂量计算机断层扫描（LDCT）检查的肺气肿患者和非肺气肿患者的肺癌发病率分别为每千人年25.0例和7.5例；相对风险（RR）为3.33，95%置信区间（CI）为1.41至7.85（表2）。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , the incidence density of lung cancer in individuals with and without airway obstruction on spirometry was 32.3 per 1,000 person-years and 6.7 per 1,000 person-years , respectively [ RR , 4.83 ; 95 % CI , 2.05 to 11.41 ] .
Translation: 与肺功能检测显示无气道阻塞的个体相比，有气道阻塞者的肺癌发病率密度分别为每千人年32.3例和6.7例[相对风险（RR）4.83；95%置信区间2.05至11.41]。

Query_Text_en: A potential synergy between emphysema detected on LDCT and airway obstruction detected on spirometry is suggested by the increased incidence density of lung cancer in subjects with both conditions [ 37.5 per 1,000 person-years ] as compared to those with neither one [ 3.4 per 1,000 person-years ; RR , 5.49 ; 95 % CI , 1.51 to 19.98 ] .
Translation: 低剂量螺旋CT检测到的肺气肿与肺功能测定发现的气道阻塞之间可能存在协同作用，这体现在合并两种情况者的肺癌发病率密度显著升高[每千人年37.5例]，而两种情况均无者仅为[每千人年3.4例；相对危险度5.49；95%置信区间1.51至19.98]。

Query_Text_en: The incidence density of lung cancer in subjects with only one of the two abnormalities [ emphysema or airway obstruction ] was 18.8 per 1,000 person-years [ RR , 10.94 ; 95 % CI , 3.01 to 39.74 ; Table 2 ] .
Translation: 仅存在两种异常之一（肺气肿或气道阻塞）的受试者中，肺癌发病密度为每千人年18.8例（RR，10.94；95% CI，3.01至39.74；表2）。

Query_Text_en: In the stratified analysis , the presence of emphysema on LDCT was associated with an increased likelihood of a lung cancer diagnosis among subjects without airway obstruction [ RR , 4.33 ; 95 % CI , 1.04 to 18.16 ] .
Translation: 分层分析显示，在无气道阻塞的受试者中，低剂量CT检测到肺气肿的存在与肺癌诊断风险增加相关（相对风险比为4.33；95%置信区间为1.04至18.16）。

Query_Text_en: When the analysis was limited to participants with airway obstruction on spirometry , no relationship between emphysema on LDCT and lung cancer risk was found [ RR , 1.48 ; 95 % CI , 0.51 to 4.34 ] .
Translation: 当分析仅限于肺功能测试显示气道阻塞的参与者时，未发现低剂量CT扫描显示的肺气肿与肺癌风险之间存在关联（RR=1.48；95%CI为0.51至4.34）。

Query_Text_en: The results of the Poisson regression analyses are shown in Table 3 .
Translation: 表3列出了泊松回归分析的结果。

Query_Text_en: Emphysema detected on LDCT was significantly associated with a higher risk of lung cancer in a model adjusting for age , gender , and number of pack-years of smoking [ RR , 3.13 ; 95 % CI , 1.32 to 7.44 ; model 1 ] .
Translation: 在校正年龄、性别及吸烟包年数的模型中，通过低剂量CT检测到的肺气肿与肺癌风险升高显著相关（相对风险为3.13；95%置信区间为1.32至7.44；模型1）。

Query_Text_en: Lung cancer was also more common among patients with airway obstruction after controlling for the same covariates [ RR , 2.89 ; 95 % CI , 1.14 to 7.27 ; model 2 ] .
Translation: 在控制了相同的协变量后，呼吸道阻塞患者中肺癌的发病率也更高（RR为2.89；95%置信区间为1.14至7.27；模型2）。

Query_Text_en: However , in a final model [ model 3 ] that included terms for presence of emphysema , airway obstruction , age , gender , and smoking history , emphysema [ RR , 2.51 ; 95 % CI , 1.01 to 6.23 ] and the number of pack-years of smoking [ RR , 2.9 ; 95 % CI , 1.1 to 7.2 ] but not airway obstruction [ RR , 2.10 ; 95 % CI , 0.79 to 5.58 ] were independently associated with a higher risk for lung cancer .
Translation: 在最终模型（模型3）中，纳入了肺气肿、气道阻塞、年龄、性别和吸烟史等因素后，肺气肿[相对风险（RR）2.51；95%置信区间（CI）1.01至6.23]和吸烟包年数[RR 2.9；95% CI 1.1至7.2]与肺癌风险升高独立相关，而气道阻塞[RR 2.10；95% CI 0.79至5.58]则未显示相关性。

Query_Text_en: Results of this prospective cohort study of current and former smokers suggest that the presence of emphysema on LDCT is associated with an increased risk for lung cancer .
Translation: 这项针对当前和既往吸烟者的前瞻性队列研究结果表明，低剂量计算机断层扫描（LDCT）显示肺气肿的存在与肺癌风险增加相关。

Query_Text_en: Stratified and multivariate analyses showed that this association was significant even after controlling for the presence of airway obstruction on spirometry , suggesting that emphysema on LDCT is an independent risk factor for lung cancer .
Translation: 分层和多变量分析表明，即使在控制肺功能测定中气道阻塞因素后，这种关联仍具有统计学意义，提示低剂量CT显示的肺气肿是肺癌的独立危险因素。

Query_Text_en: This information can help identify patients at high risk for lung cancer who may benefit from more-aggressive preventive interventions or lung cancer screening programs .
Translation: 该信息有助于识别可能从更积极的预防干预措施或肺癌筛查项目中获益的肺癌高风险患者。

Query_Text_en: The majority of lung cancers occur in current or former smokers , and the risk increases with older age and longer exposure to tobacco .
Translation: 大多数肺癌病例发生在现症吸烟者或既往吸烟者中，且患病风险随年龄增长及烟草接触时间延长而增加。

Query_Text_en: However , lung cancer develops in only a minority of smokers .
Translation: 然而，肺癌仅发生在少数吸烟者身上。

Query_Text_en: Therefore , the identification of additional factors that may help in the selection of individuals with the highest risk may be useful .
Translation: 因此，识别其他有助于筛选最高风险个体的因素可能具有实用性。

Query_Text_en: There is less information regarding the association between emphysema and lung cancer .
Translation: 关于肺气肿与肺癌之间关联的信息较少。

Query_Text_en: Emphysema has traditionally been a pathologic diagnosis , but the development of CT-based image analysis techniques has lead to accurate noninvasive in vivo detection and quantification of emphysema .
Translation: 肺气肿传统上属于病理学诊断范畴，但基于CT的影像分析技术的发展使得能够在活体中准确、非侵入性地检测和量化肺气肿。

Query_Text_en: For example , CT has been shown to be useful in the selection of individuals with severe emphysema who are at a greater risk for a poor outcome after lung volume reduction surgery [ ie , those with a homogenous distribution of emphysema ] .
Translation: 例如，CT已被证明在筛选严重肺气肿患者方面具有重要作用，这些患者在肺减容手术后出现不良预后的风险更高（即肺气肿分布均匀的患者）。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , quantification of emphysema using CT has been used to follow the effects of replacement therapy in patients with1-antitrypsin deficiency .
Translation: 使用CT对肺气肿进行量化评估已被用于监测α1-抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症患者替代疗法的效果。

Query_Text_en: However , the clinical significance of emphysema on CT among individuals without symptoms or with normal pulmonary function tests remains unclear .
Translation: 然而，在无症状或肺功能检查结果正常的个体中，CT显示的肺气肿的临床意义尚不明确。

Query_Text_en: A novelty of this study is the use of LDCT instead of high-resolution CT , as has been used in the aforementioned studies .
Translation: 本研究的创新之处在于采用了低剂量CT（LDCT）而非高分辨率CT，后者在上述研究中已被使用。

Query_Text_en: In this study , a strong association between emphysema detected on LDCT and lung cancer risk was found even among individuals with normal airway function .
Translation: 本研究发现，即使在肺功能正常的人群中，通过低剂量计算机断层扫描（LDCT）检测到的肺气肿与肺癌风险之间仍存在显著关联。

Query_Text_en: These results are consistent with previous retrospective and epidemiologic reports .
Translation: 这些结果与既往的回顾性及流行病学报告一致。

Query_Text_en: Additionally , a recent study has found that emphysema detected on CT , and not airway obstruction , was associated with a worse prognosis in smokers with early stage lung cancer .
Translation: 此外，近期一项研究发现，通过CT检查发现的肺气肿而非气道阻塞，与早期肺癌吸烟者预后较差相关。

Query_Text_en: Conversely , a case-controlled study using data from subjects enrolled in the Mayo Clinic LDCT early lung cancer detection study found that severe airway obstruction , but not emphysema , was associated with a higher risk of lung cancer .
Translation: 另一方面，一项使用梅奥诊所低剂量螺旋CT早期肺癌检测研究受试者数据的病例对照研究发现，严重气道阻塞（而非肺气肿）与肺癌的高风险相关。

Query_Text_en: The discrepancy in the results between this study and ours may be explained by several reasons .
Translation: 本研究与我们的研究结果之间的差异可能由多种因素引起。

Query_Text_en: Firstly , the Mayo Clinic study follows a case-control design in which only a small subgroup of individuals of the entire cohort is used in the analysis .
Translation: 梅奥诊所的研究采用了病例对照设计，其中仅使用整个队列中的一个小群体进行分析。

Query_Text_en: In our study , the entire population entered into the lung cancer screening trial was included in the analysis .
Translation: 在本研究中，被纳入肺癌筛查试验的全部研究人群均被纳入分析。

Query_Text_en: Secondly , the proportion of subjects with airway obstruction that were included in the analysis was 67 % and 79 % in the control and lung cancer groups , respectively , in the Mayo Clinic study , and 25 % in ours .
Translation: 在梅奥诊所的研究中，对照组和肺癌组纳入分析的气道阻塞受试者比例分别为67%和79%，而我们研究中的这一比例为25%。

Query_Text_en: Lastly , the method to determine the presence of emphysema was quantitative in the Mayo Clinic study and by visual assessment in ours .
Translation: 最后，梅奥诊所的研究采用定量方法判断肺气肿的存在，而我们的研究则是通过视觉评估进行判断。

Query_Text_en: In the former , participants were subclassified into groups depending on the amount of emphysema ; whereas in our study , only the presence or absence of emphysema was considered for the analysis .
Translation: 在前者研究中，参与者根据肺气肿程度被分为不同亚组；而在本研究中，仅将肺气肿的存在与否纳入分析考量。

Query_Text_en: The findings presented herein have several potential clinical implications .
Translation: 本研究呈现的发现具有若干潜在的临床意义。

Query_Text_en: Lung cancer is the most lethal cancer in the world mainly due to the fact that ] 80 % of cases are diagnosed in advanced stages of the disease .
Translation: 肺癌是世界上最致命的癌症，主要原因是80%的病例在晚期阶段才被确诊。

Query_Text_en: In the last few years , a great interest in lung cancer screening research has emerged .
Translation: 近年来，肺癌筛查研究领域引发了极大的兴趣。

Query_Text_en: A recent report by the International Early Lung Cancer Action Program consortium , among other studies , has shown promising results using annual LDCT .
Translation: 包括其他研究在内的国际早期肺癌行动计划联盟近期发布的一份报告显示，在使用年度低剂量螺旋CT方面取得了积极成果。

Query_Text_en: Other studies have found different results raising questions about mortality benefit , cost-effectiveness , and safety of lung cancer screening using LDCT .
Translation: 其他研究发现了不同结果，对使用低剂量螺旋CT进行肺癌筛查的死亡率益处、成本效益和安全性提出了质疑。

Query_Text_en: Several randomized control studies in the United States and in Europe are underway , and results should be available in a few years .
Translation: 美国和欧洲正在开展的多项随机对照研究有望在几年内公布结果。

Query_Text_en: If early detection of lung cancer with LDCT is shown to be effective by studies currently underway , the appropriate selection of the target population will be very important .
Translation: 如果目前正在进行的研究表明低剂量螺旋CT用于肺癌早期检测有效，那么合理选择目标人群将非常重要。

Query_Text_en: For a screening program to be beneficial and cost-effective , it is necessary to identify individuals with the highest risk for lung cancer so that there is an adequate ratio of prevalence of the disease to the number of false-positive findings .
Translation: 为了使筛查项目具有成本效益且有益，必须识别出肺癌高风险人群，以便疾病患病率与假阳性结果数量之间的比例合理。

Query_Text_en: The results presented herein suggest that emphysema detected on a baseline LDCT could be used in this context to identify individuals who may need additional follow-up studies .
Translation: 本研究结果表明，通过基线低剂量CT检测到的肺气肿可能在此类情境下用于识别需要进行进一步随访研究的个体。

Query_Text_en: Conversely , individuals with no evidence of emphysema and with no suspicious nodules on a baseline LDCT may not require further screening .
Translation: 另一方面，对于基线低剂量CT检查中未发现肺气肿迹象且无可疑结节的个体，可能无需进一步进行筛查。

Query_Text_en: Additionally , LDCT screening may provide a means for diagnosing emphysema at an earlier stage , even before abnormalities develop that are detectable on pulmonary function testing .
Translation: 此外，低剂量螺旋CT筛查可能提供了一种在更早期阶段诊断肺气肿的方法，甚至在肺功能检测能够发现异常之前即可实现。

Query_Text_en: Whether the detection of emphysema in such early stages will have an impact on outcomes or on the natural history of the disease by earlier interventions is a question that should be explored in future studies .
Translation: 肺气肿在早期阶段的检出是否会对疾病结果或其自然病程产生影响，这一问题有待未来研究通过早期干预措施进一步探讨。

Query_Text_en: As an example , this information could be used to identify individuals who may need more-aggressive smoking cessation interventions .
Translation: 例如，这些信息可用于识别可能需要采取更积极戒烟干预措施的人群。

Query_Text_en: Smoking cessation has been shown to reduce the risk of lung cancer as well as to reduce the rate of progression of COPD .
Translation: 戒烟可降低肺癌风险，并减缓慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）的进展速度。

Query_Text_en: Several mechanisms have been proposed to explain the link between lung cancer and COPD .
