Query_Text_en: In turn , clinical advice is given on the Fio2 needed to attain a target Pao2 for patients with compromised pulmonary function .
Translation: 相应地，针对肺功能受损的患者，临床建议会提供所需的氧浓度（Fio2）以达到目标动脉血氧分压（Pao2）。

Query_Text_en: Rutledge et al described a qualitative and quantitative ventilator management advisor [ VentPlan ] to provide recommendations for setting a ventilator that are based on a mathematical model of cardiopulmonary physiology .
Translation: Rutledge等人提出了一种基于心肺生理学数学模型的定性和定量呼吸机管理顾问系统（VentPlan），旨在为呼吸机设置提供建议。

Query_Text_en: By applying a patient-specific physiologic model , the advice for ventilator settings was in agreement with the physician preferences for setting the ventilator .
Translation: 通过应用患者特异性生理模型，呼吸机设置建议与医生的设置偏好保持一致。

Query_Text_en: When physician intensivists determined it appropriate to maintain a specific level of PSV , the implication was that respiratory muscle loads were optimal at that time .
Translation: 当重症医学专家认为维持特定水平的压力支持通气（PSV）是合适时，这意味着此时呼吸肌的负荷处于最适宜状态。

Query_Text_en: For this clinical condition , the advisory system agreed with the physician intensivists more than 9 times in 10 .
Translation: 对于这种临床状况，建议系统与重症监护医生在超过九成的情况下达成一致。

Query_Text_en: The POBn for all patients at all sites at that time approximated the upper limit of normal for the power of breathing in adults .
Translation: 当时所有研究点的所有患者的POBn值接近成人呼吸力量正常值的上限。

Query_Text_en: The potential clinical utility of this advisory system is that it is automatic and continuously operational .
Translation: 该辅助决策系统的潜在临床应用价值在于其自动化且持续运行的特点。

Query_Text_en: This would be important in clinical situations where expert physician intensivists may not always be available for patient assessment and to make timely decisions for setting PSV .
Translation: 在专家级重症监护医师可能无法随时在场对患者进行评估并及时制定PSV设置决策的临床场景中，这一点尤为重要。

Query_Text_en: Examples of this might include large , multipatient , ventilatory care facilities\/nursing homes , battlefield military hospitals , mass-casualty treatment centers , and large ICUs .
Translation: 这可能会包括以下示例：大型多患者呼吸治疗设施/养老院、战场野战医院、群体伤亡救治中心以及大型重症监护室（ICUs）。

Query_Text_en: In such venues with limited manpower , the advisory system may be able to assist in setting an appropriate level of PSV .
Translation: 在人力资源有限的场所，咨询系统或许能够协助设定适当的PSV水平。

Query_Text_en: Although this study was an initial step in validating the advisory system , a possible limitation of this study may be that to fully validate the advisory system a similar study over a wider range of patient conditions may be needed .
Translation: 尽管这项研究是验证咨询系统的初步尝试，但其潜在局限性在于，要全面验证该系统，可能需要在更广泛的患者条件下开展类似研究。

Query_Text_en: Also , such a study could be performed over the total duration of ventilatory support up to the point of extubation .
Translation: 此类研究可以在整个呼吸机支持持续期间直至拔管时点开展。

Query_Text_en: In summary , this clinical study compared recommendations from a computerized , ventilator advisory system for increasing , maintaining , or decreasing PSV , and demonstrated a significantly high level of agreement with physician intensivists for setting PSV in patients with respiratory failure .
Translation: 本项临床研究比较了计算机化呼吸机决策系统关于压力支持通气（PSV）增减或维持的建议，结果表明该系统在为呼吸衰竭患者设置PSV参数时，与重症监护医师的建议具有显著高度的一致性。

Query_Text_en: Clinical outcome studies evaluating the novel load-and-tolerance strategy of the advisory system as the means of applying PSV are needed .
Translation: 需要开展评估建议系统新型负荷与耐受策略作为应用压力支持通气（PSV）方法的临床结果研究。

Query_Text_en: A hemodialysis patient with hypercholesterolemia was admitted with an ulcer on his left foot .
Translation: 一名患有高胆固醇血症的血液透析患者因左脚溃疡入院。

Query_Text_en: Shortly after admission he complained of generalised aching and difficulty in mobilising .
Translation: 入院后不久，他主诉全身酸痛及活动困难。

Query_Text_en: Osteomyelitis complicating his foot ulcer was suspected and a Tc99-labelled diphosphonate bone scan was done .
Translation: 怀疑其脚部溃疡合并骨髓炎，并进行了锝-99标记的双膦酸盐骨扫描。

Query_Text_en: The scan showed uptake into damaged muscle -- consistent with rhabdomyolysis [ figure ] .
Translation: 扫描显示显像剂被受损肌肉吸收——符合横纹肌溶解症的表现[图]。

Query_Text_en: His serum creatinine kinase was checked and was high ,
Translation: 其血清肌酸激酶水平经检查发现偏高。

Query_Text_en: and his atorvastatin [ which he had been prescribed , but had not been taking at home ] , the suspected cause of his rhabdomyolysis , was discontinued .
Translation: 他所服用的阿托伐他汀（该药物此前虽已开具处方但他未按医嘱在家服用，疑似引发其横纹肌溶解的病因）已被停用。

Query_Text_en: His symptoms and biochemistry resolved rapidly and a repeat scan 1 month later was normal .
Translation: 他的症状和生化指标迅速缓解，一个月后的复查结果显示正常。

Query_Text_en: Tc99-labelled diphosphonate is normally taken up into bone and the distribution of uptake is detected by a - camera .
Translation: 锝-99m标记的双膦酸盐通常会被骨骼摄取，其摄取分布情况通过γ相机进行检测。

Query_Text_en: In this case of rhabdomyolysis , the sarcolemmal disruption in the muscle caused calcium release and , following a reaction with the diphosphonate tracer , the subsequent formation of calcium phosphate salt -- resulting in the radiolabelling of damaged muscle .
Translation: 在该横纹肌溶解症病例中，肌肉的肌膜损伤导致钙离子释放，随后与双膦酸盐示踪剂发生反应并形成磷酸钙盐，从而对受损肌肉进行放射性标记。

Query_Text_en: The images produced by the - camera are at once diagnostic , anatomically specific , and strikingly aesthetic .
Translation: 该相机生成的图像兼具诊断功能，具有高度解剖学精确性，并呈现出极具美学效果的视觉特征。

Query_Text_en: For a man at the top of his chosen discipline , Werner Hacke s early career was strikingly unorthodox .
Translation: 对于一位在其所选领域登峰造极的人来说，沃纳·哈克的早期职业生涯却显得异常非常规。

Query_Text_en: The far from linear path that brought him to the chairmanship of the University of Heidelberg s Department of Neurology in Germany began most unpromisingly .
Translation: 他最终成为德国海德堡大学神经学系主任的漫长道路充满波折，最初毫无征兆。

Query_Text_en: Hacke enjoyed it so much that when he was subsequently granted a place at medical school , he continued his psychology studies , so acquiring two degrees in parallel .
Translation: 哈克对此充满热情，因此在后来被医学院录取后，他继续攻读心理学课程，最终同时获得了两个学位。

Query_Text_en: His career ? appropriately for a Harley-Davidson enthusiast ? had begun to pick up speed .
Translation: 他的事业——对一名哈雷戴维森爱好者而言堪称相配——开始加速发展了。

Query_Text_en: With qualifications in medicine and psychology , a future in psychiatry seemed to be on the cards .
Translation: 拥有医学和心理学资质，从事精神病学领域似乎前途无量。

Query_Text_en: The first ward he worked on was neurology s own intensive care ward .
Translation: 他负责的第一个病区是神经科所属的重症监护病房。

Query_Text_en: Fascinated by this work Hacke continued his neurology training , specialised in neurological intensive care , and developed his interest in stroke .
Translation: 被这项工作深深吸引，哈克继续深造神经学，专攻神经重症监护，并逐渐对中风领域产生兴趣。

Query_Text_en: When he got the Heidelberg chairmanship in 1987 he was the youngest person to hold such a post in German neurology .
We have 20 monitored stroke beds , and that makes us the largest monitored stroke unit in the world .
Translation: 我们拥有20张监护型中风病床，这使我们成为全球规模最大的监护型中风治疗单元。

Query_Text_en: I was the critical care physician involved .
Translation: 我是参与其中的重症监护医师。

Query_Text_en: He also talks of the aggressive approach he has always taken to severe stroke , including hemicraniectomy for large infarcts , and welcomes the development of a more positive attitude among clinicians , believing his work has helped to foster it .
Translation: 他还谈及自己对严重中风一贯采取的积极治疗策略，包括对大面积脑梗死实施去骨瓣减压术，并欢迎临床医生群体逐渐形成更加积极的治疗态度，认为自己的工作为此作出了推动性贡献。

Query_Text_en: It s a view that finds support among other stroke specialists .
Translation: 这种观点在其他中风专家中也得到了支持。

Query_Text_en: and he s pushed the general idea that stroke is an emergency .
Translation: 他一直倡导中风是一种突发疾病的普遍认识。

Query_Text_en: He s shown great leadership in persuading people to take up challenging new treatments .
Translation: 他在推动人们采纳具有挑战性的新疗法方面展现了卓越的领导力。

Query_Text_en: The trial reported in September , 2008 , in The New England Journal of Medicine ? the ECASS 3 trial ? was intended to find out if intravenous thrombolysis for ischaemic stroke using alteplase could reduce mortality when used later than the 3-h window specified in its licence .
Translation: 2008年9月在《新英格兰医学杂志》上报道的一项试验——ECASS 3试验——旨在探究在超过药物批准的3小时时间窗后，使用阿替普酶进行静脉溶栓治疗缺血性中风是否能降低患者死亡率。

Query_Text_en: It comprised a randomised controlled trial of more than 800 patients who received alteplase between 3 and 4.5 h after the onset of symptoms .
Translation: 该试验对象为症状出现后3至4.5小时内接受阿替普酶治疗的800多名患者，采用随机对照试验方法。

Query_Text_en: Significantly more patients had a beneficial outcome with alteplase than without it .
Translation: 使用阿替普酶的患者比未使用者获得有益结果的比例显著更高。

Query_Text_en: As Hacke points out , a minority of clinicians has always been reluctant to accept the data from the first American trial that showed the value of thrombolysis up to 3 h after a stroke .
Translation: 正如哈克指出的那样，一小部分临床医生一直不愿接受美国首次试验中显示的中风后3小时内溶栓治疗有效性的数据。

Query_Text_en: We have now confirmed in a later time window and with a larger study that it works , and it s safe .
Translation: 我们现已通过后续阶段更大规模的研究进一步证实了其有效性和安全性。

Query_Text_en: This will certainly encourage more people to use it within the first 3 hours .
Translation: 这必将鼓励更多用户在最初的3小时内使用。

Query_Text_en: I think it may double the number of patients receiving thrombolysis .
Translation: 我认为这可能会使接受溶栓治疗的患者数量翻倍。

Query_Text_en: Sandercock too welcomes the findings , although in one respect his enthusiasm is slightly muted .
Translation: 桑德科克也对这些研究结果表示欢迎，不过在某一点上，他的热情略有保留。

Query_Text_en: This trial included only patients who met the criteria set by the current European Medicines Agency licence , which meant an extensive list of exclusions .
Translation: 该试验仅纳入符合当前欧洲药品管理局许可规定标准的患者，这意味着存在大量排除条款。

Query_Text_en: We still don t know the true extent of the population that might be treatable , he says .
Translation: 他表示，我们仍不清楚可能可治疗人群的实际规模。

Query_Text_en: While Hacke s work on thrombolysis is bringing incremental improvements to stroke medicine , he has no illusions about the full extent of the greater problems that remain .
Translation: 他的研究工作在中风医学领域带来渐进式改进，但他对仍存的更严重难题的全部程度有着清醒的认识。

Query_Text_en: What he describes as the Holy Grail of his discipline is a solution to the problem of neuroprotection .
Translation: 他所称作该领域"圣杯"的，正是解决神经保护问题的关键所在。

Query_Text_en: But our mistake is to think that influencing one small step in a cascade of events will influence the whole situation .
Translation: 我们的误区在于认为，在一系列事件的连锁反应中影响其中一个微小环节就能改变整个局势。

Query_Text_en: Thrombolysis , if done sufficiently early , will sidestep the need to find ways of interrupting the complex postischaemic cascade .
Translation: 如果在足够早的阶段实施溶栓治疗，将可以避免需要寻找中断复杂缺血后级联反应的方法。

Query_Text_en: A less-than-keen high school student , Hacke had decided to study medicine , envisaging a future in which he might combine doctoring with the only subject at which he d excelled : sport .
Translation: 作为不太热衷学习的高中生，Hacke决定攻读医学，他设想未来或许能将行医与自己唯一擅长的科目——体育——结合起来。

Query_Text_en: But his grades turned out to be inadequate to get him into medical school . So after military service , he embarked on a degree in psychology .
Translation: 但他的成绩未能达到进入医学院的要求，于是服兵役结束后，他选择攻读心理学学位。

Query_Text_en: Of the 60 beds allocated to his department , 30 are intensive or semi-intensive . For inpatients we concentrate on very severe cases , he says . We deal with 1300 new strokes every year in our service , and see 15 000 ambulatory patients .
Translation: 该部门分配到的60张床位中，有30张为重症或半重症监护床位。他表示，对于住院患者，他们主要收治病情极为严重的病例。该科室每年处理1300例新发中风病例，并接诊15000名门诊患者。

Query_Text_en: Asked to identify his contributions to stroke medicine , he picks out his early interest in thrombolytic therapy . In our department in Aachen we did the first intra-arterial thrombolysis cases in the late 1970s .
Translation: 当被要求列举他在中风医学领域的贡献时，他提到了自己早期对溶栓治疗的兴趣。20世纪70年代末，我们在亚琛的我院实施了首批动脉内溶栓病例。

Query_Text_en: He s a big character . He s bluff , funny , a pioneer ,
Translation: 他性格鲜明，为人直率豪爽、幽默风趣，堪称行业先驱。

Query_Text_en: Anthony Rudd , consultant physician in stroke medicine at Kings College , London , agrees . He s been a very important figure in developing stroke as a specialty .
Translation: 伦敦国王学院卒中医学顾问医师安东尼·拉德表示赞同。他一直在推动将卒中发展为独立专科领域方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

Query_Text_en: We ve had a relatively small number of trials available to us until recently , and there s always been a question about whether 3 hours is the maximum time limit . We ve all been hoping for this result .
Translation: 直到最近，我们能够使用的试验数量相对较少，而且一直存在一个疑问，即3小时是否为最大时限。我们一直期待着这一结果。

Query_Text_en: This paper is likely to be very influential . I think it will change practice , not just in Europe but in many parts of the world .
Translation: 这篇论文极有可能产生深远影响。我认为它不仅将改变欧洲的实践，还会对世界其他许多地区的做法产生影响。

Query_Text_en: Like the Holy Grail I sometimes believe this is more legend than reality , he reflects . It s such a complex problem that we are not yet able to translate basic science into treatment .
Translation: 他反思道，就像圣杯一样，我有时认为这更像是传说而非现实。这是一个如此复杂的问题，以至于我们目前还无法将基础科学转化为治疗方法。

Query_Text_en: For one patient it may be that treatment after 30 minutes is too late . For another , treatment after 6 hours can still be effective .
Translation: 对某一患者而言，30分钟后进行治疗可能已经太迟。而对另一位患者而言，6小时后进行治疗仍可能有效。

Query_Text_en: That said , speed is still the critical factor , Hacke says . As he concludes his NEJM paper , Having more time does not mean we should be allowed to take more time .
Translation: 不过，Hacke指出，速度仍然是关键因素。他在《新英格兰医学杂志》的论文结论中写道："时间充裕并不等于可以拖延。"

Query_Text_en: Yesterday was Ash Wednesday , the first day of the Christian season of Lent .
Translation: 昨日是圣灰星期三，标志着基督教大斋期的第一天。

Query_Text_en: Many Christians have a cross marked in ashes on their foreheads .
Translation: 许多基督徒的前额会用灰烬画出十字标记。

Query_Text_en: For Roman Catholics , it comes from the palms used on Palm Sunday .
Translation: 对天主教徒而言，它源自棕榈主日所用的棕榈枝。

Query_Text_en: Lent is a time of fasting and repentance lasting 40 days , until Easter Sunday .
Translation: 四旬斋是为期40天的斋戒和悔罪期，直至复活节主日。

Query_Text_en: It commemorates the 40 days Jesus Christ fasted in the desert .
Translation: 它纪念耶稣基督在沙漠中禁食40天。

Query_Text_en: And today is the Chinese New Year .
Translation: 而今天是中国的新年。

Query_Text_en: It 's also called Lunar New Year because it starts with the new moon and lasts 15 days , until the moon is full .
Translation: 它也被称为农历新年，因为其始于新月，持续15天直至圆月当空。

Query_Text_en: It 's a major holiday for Chinese all over the world .
Translation: 这是全球华人的重要节日。

Query_Text_en: In fact , it 's the world 's annual human migration , with millions of Chinese workers going home for the holidays .
Translation: 事实上，这是全球规模最大的年度人口迁徙，数以百万计的中国务工人员踏上返乡过节的旅程。

Query_Text_en: 2015 is the year of the sheep or goat in the Chinese zodiac .
Translation: 2015年是中国生肖中的羊年。

Query_Text_en: Some who follow Chinese astrology expect it to be a good year , some do n't .
Translation: 一些遵循中国星象的人认为今年将是好年景，另一些则不这样认为。

Query_Text_en: But celebrations are taking place far and wide .
Translation: 庆祝活动正在各地广泛举行。

Query_Text_en: On its way from Kuala Lumpur , Malaysia to Beijing , China , it vanished from radar on March 8th of last year .
Translation: 这架飞机在去年3月8日从马来西亚吉隆坡飞往中国北京途中，从雷达上消失。

Query_Text_en: The search has been anything but smooth .
Translation: 搜索过程远非一帆风顺。

Query_Text_en: Among the massive container ships and live export vessels at Perth 's Freemantle Harbor is a boat that 's just arrived at port .
Translation: 在珀斯弗里曼特尔港的大型集装箱船和活畜出口船中，停泊着一艘刚抵达的船只。

Query_Text_en: This is Discovery , a former Norwegian Coast Guard vessel that 's taking part in one of the most challenging searches in history .
Translation: 这是"发现号"，这艘前挪威海岸警卫队船只正在参与历史上最具挑战性的搜索行动之一。

Query_Text_en: If there is a plane down there , you know , we will see it .
Translation: 如果有飞机在那里，我们当然会发现它。

Query_Text_en: It will show up in our records .
Translation: 这将显示在我们的记录中。

Query_Text_en: But it takes time .
Translation: 但这需要时间。

Query_Text_en: Chris Morris and his survey team have just spent the past 42 days looking for MH370 in the remote Southern Indian Ocean ,1,000 nautical miles offshore .
Translation: 克里斯·莫里斯及其调查团队刚刚在过去42天里，在距离海岸1000海里的偏远南印度洋海域搜寻马航MH370航班。

Query_Text_en: You see it 's trailing here .
Translation: 您可以看到，此处数据呈现持续下滑态势。

Query_Text_en: We 've got the whole survey area where we started with the seventh arc .
Translation: 我们已全面覆盖了最初从第七弧段开始的整个调查区域。

Query_Text_en: We 're looking at this southern section down here .
Translation: 我们正在关注这里的南部区域。

Query_Text_en: The Boeing 777 , with 239 people on board , disappeared almost a year ago .
Translation: 载有239人的波音777客机近一年前失踪。

Query_Text_en: And according to satellite data , experts believe it 's somewhere here on the ocean floor .
Translation: 根据卫星数据，专家认为它位于海底某处。

Query_Text_en: After an initial search zone roughly half the size of the United States , it 's been narrowed down to a priority area of 60,000 square kilometers .
Translation: 最初的搜索区域范围大约相当于美国国土面积的一半，现已缩小至一个6万平方公里的重点区域。

Query_Text_en: But the conditions are horrendous .
Translation: 但条件极为恶劣。

Query_Text_en: Trenches , volcanoes and underwater mountains are part of the terrain .
Translation: 海沟、火山和海底山脉属于地形的一部分。

Query_Text_en: And for the sonar equipment that 's towed 10 kilometers behind the ship and four kilometers below , it 's a logistical nightmare .
Translation: 而对于拖曳在船尾后方10公里、水下4公里处的声呐设备，其后勤保障堪称巨大挑战。

Query_Text_en: As for the conditions above the surface , search crews recently weathered three cyclones and waves up to 16 meters high .
Translation: 对于海面以上的恶劣环境条件，搜救人员近日成功经受住了三次气旋考验，并在高达16米的巨浪中开展工作。

Query_Text_en: If MH370 is in the Southern Indian Ocean , then the discovery is one of four ships that is going to help find it .
Translation: 如果马航MH370位于南印度洋，那么此次发现将由四艘船只中的一艘协助完成。

Query_Text_en: They 've already covered one third of the priority search area and are on schedule to complete the zone by May .
Translation: 他们已完成重点搜索区域的三分之一，并按计划将于5月前完成该区域的搜寻工作。

Query_Text_en: But what they 're looking for , the debris field on the ocean floor , is quite literally a speck on a map .
Translation: 但他们要寻找的海底残骸区域，在地图上实际上只是一个微小的点。

Query_Text_en: The hunt for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 continued at full speed Tuesday , with 10 planes andnine ships joining the multinational search as the time left to find the plane 's ` black-box ' flightrecorder runs critically low .
Translation: 周二，马航370航班的搜寻工作全速推进，10架飞机和9艘船只加入多国搜寻行动，而寻找飞机"黑匣子"飞行记录仪的时间已濒临耗尽。

Query_Text_en: Now in its fourth week , the search has yielded little except satellite images and aerialphotographs of objects that have n't been linked to the missing plane .
Translation: 目前，搜索行动已持续四周，但收效甚微，仅获得一些未被证实与失联客机存在关联的卫星图像和航空照片。

Query_Text_en: Numerous shipsengaged in the hunt for the airliner-which vanished from civilian radar on March 8-have hauledin only unrelated scraps of junk .
Translation: 参与搜寻于3月8日从民用雷达上消失的客机的多艘船只，仅打捞到与失联客机无关的碎片垃圾。

Query_Text_en: A new search and coordination body , led by the former chief of Australia 's defense force , saidTuesday that weather in the search area was expected to be poor , with areas of low visibility .
Translation: 由澳大利亚国防军前总司令领导的新搜索协调机构周二表示，搜救区域天气预计恶劣，部分地区能见度低。

Query_Text_en: Military aircraft from seven nations will scour a remote stretch of the southern Indian Oceancomprising about 46,000 square miles on Tuesday , the Joint Agency Coordination Centre said ina statement .
Translation: 联合机构协调中心发表声明称，七国军用飞机将于周二对南印度洋一片面积约4.6万平方英里的偏远海域展开搜寻。

Query_Text_en: Australian maritime authorities leading the operation abruptly shifted the search zone some700 miles [ 1,100 kilometers ] to the northeast last week , to about 1,150 miles [ 1,850 kilometers ] west of Perth .
Translation: 上周，主导行动的澳大利亚海事当局突然将搜索区域向东偏北方向调整了约700英里（1100公里），现位于珀斯以西约1150英里（1850公里）处。

Query_Text_en: The zone was moved again fractionally to the west on Monday , basedon a reassessment of ocean drift taking into account a more circular counterclockwisecurrent and eddies than in the earlier search zone to the south .
Translation: 周一，搜索区域再次被小幅向西调整，基于对海洋漂流的重新评估，此次评估考虑到该区域逆时针洋流和涡流比南部先前的搜索区更呈圆形。

Query_Text_en: The new zone has more hospitable weather and ocean conditions than the one to the south , but also a lot more unrelated debris for searchers to investigate .
Translation: 新划定区域的天气和海洋条件比南部区域更加适宜，但同时也存在大量需要调查的无关碎片。

Query_Text_en: ` The intensity of our search and magnitude of our operations is increasing , not decreasing , ` Australian Prime Minister Tony Abbott told reporters in Perth on Monday .
Translation: 澳大利亚总理托尼·阿博特周一在珀斯对记者表示，我们搜寻行动的强度和行动规模正在增强，而非减弱。

Query_Text_en: The operation remains ` well short ' of the point at which it could be called off .
Translation: 该行动目前仍远未达到能够取消的程度。

Query_Text_en: ` If this mystery is solvable , we 'll solve it , ' said Mr.
Translation: “如果这个谜团能够破解，我们一定会解决它，”某先生表示。

Query_Text_en: Abbott , praising the search teams , whichcome from the U.S. , China , Japan , South Korea , Malaysia and New Zealand as well as Australia .
Translation: 阿博特对来自美国、中国、日本、韩国、马来西亚、新西兰以及澳大利亚的搜救队伍表示赞扬。

Query_Text_en: Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak plans to visit an air force base in Perth Wednesday in ashow of support .
Translation: 马来西亚总理纳吉布·拉扎克计划于星期三访问珀斯的一处空军基地，以示支持。

Query_Text_en: Authorities calculate they may have as little as five days left before the plane 's black-box flightrecorders stop emitting signals that could help searchers locate them deep underwater .
Translation: 有关部门测算，可能只剩下短短五天时间，在飞机黑匣子停止发射可用于帮助搜救人员在深水下定位它们的信号前。

Query_Text_en: Afterthat point , they say , finding the recorders will become much more difficult and could mark aturning point in the search effort .
Translation: 此后，他们表示，找到飞行记录器将变得困难得多，这可能标志着搜寻行动的一个转折点。

Query_Text_en: Investigators for the Air FranceAirbus A330 that plunged intothe Atlantic Ocean in 2009 took almst two years to retrieve the plane 's data recorder .
Translation: 2009年坠入大西洋的法航空客A330客机调查人员耗时近两年才打捞到该飞机的数据记录器。

Query_Text_en: An Australian vessel carrying a U.S. Navy black-box locator that can detect flight-recordersignals left for the search area on Monday night from Perth after completing trials .
Translation: 一艘澳大利亚船只周一晚间从珀斯出发前往搜索区域，该船只搭载了可探测飞行记录器信号的美国海军黑匣子定位器，此前相关设备已完成试验。

Query_Text_en: Ocean Shield , a vessel built to operate in Antarctic weather , is expected to arrive in the search area by April5-leaving teams as little as two days to locate the recorders in depths of some 6,500 feet to13 ,000 feet [ 2,000 meters to 4,000 meters ] .
Translation: "海洋之盾"号是一艘专为南极气候条件设计的船只，预计将于4月5日抵达搜索区域。届时搜寻团队将仅有两天时间，在约2000米至4000米深（6500英尺至13000英尺）的海域定位黑匣子。

Query_Text_en: Experts say the pinger locator has to be towed at a speed of just three knots-three nauticalmiles an hour-to work effectively . That limits its search area to about 150 square miles [ 400square kilometers ] a day .
Translation: 专家表示，声呐定位仪必须以每小时仅三海里的速度拖曳才能有效运作。这使其每日搜索范围仅限约150平方英里（400平方公里）。

Query_Text_en: Malaysian Defense Minister Defense Minister Hishammuddin Hussein said Monday he would askthe U.S. and other nations about getting more equipment to search deep below the surface .
Translation: 马来西亚国防部长希沙姆丁·侯赛因周一表示，将要求美国及其他国家提供更多设备以用于深海搜索。

Query_Text_en: Heplans to put the request to Association of Southeast Asian Nations defense ministers , whoare meeting in Hawaii starting Tuesday .
Translation: 他计划向将于周二开始在夏威夷举行会议的东盟国防部长提出这一请求。

Query_Text_en: Denise Hardesty , a research scientist at Australia 's national science agency , which is advisingthe search teams , said it is likely the area being searched is one where currents frequentlybring floating garbage together .
Translation: 澳大利亚国家科学机构的研究科学家Denise Hardesty表示，目前正在搜索的区域很可能正是洋流经常聚集漂浮垃圾的地方。

Query_Text_en: ` We estimate there are tens of thousands of objects in any given square kilometer of theocean , ' she said , adding that while most are quite small it is n't uncommon for containers andother large objects to fall into the water from commercial and fishing vessels .
Translation: "据估算，海洋中每平方公里范围内存在数以万计的物体，"她表示，补充道，虽然大多数物体体积较小，但集装箱及其他大型物体从商船和渔船上坠入水中的情况并不罕见。

Query_Text_en: The largenumber of objects already spotted by search teams suggests this is an area of ` convergence , ` Ms. Hardesty said .
Translation: 哈德斯蒂女士表示，搜救队已发现的大量物体表明，这里是"汇聚区"。

Query_Text_en: Chinese , Australian and New Zealand aircraft have each spotted objects in recent days , raisinghopes the authorities had made the right call in shifting the search area-a decision based onnew calculations of radar data provided by Malaysians investigators .
Translation: 中国、澳大利亚和新西兰的飞机近日分别发现了一些物体，提升了人们对当局调整搜索区域这一决定正确性的信心——该决定基于马来西亚调查人员提供的雷达数据新分析结果。

Query_Text_en: But items fished out of thewater so far have turned out to be unrelated to the missing plane .
Translation: 但到目前为止打捞出水的物品均与失踪飞机无关。

Query_Text_en: In a 55-page report , the Australian Transport Safety Board outlined how investigators had arrived at this conclusion after comparing the conditions on the flight with previous disasters , although it contained no new evidence from within the jetliner .
Translation: 澳大利亚运输安全局在一份55页的报告中详细说明了调查人员如何通过比对此次航班情况与以往空难事故，最终得出这一结论，但报告中并未发现来自客机内部的新证据。

Query_Text_en: The report narrowed down the possible final resting place from thousands of possible routes , while noting the absence of communications and the steady flight path and a number of other key abnormalities in the course of the ill-fated flight .
Translation: 报告将可能的最终坠毁地点从数千条可能航线中进一步缩小范围，同时指出该次失事航班在飞行过程中存在与地面失去联系、飞行轨迹平稳以及其他多项关键异常情况。

Query_Text_en: `` Given these observations , the final stages of the unresponsive crew\/hypoxia event type appeared to best fit the available evidence for the final period of MH370 's flight when it was heading in a generally southerly direction , '' the ATSB report said .
Translation: 根据这些观测，澳大利亚运输安全局（ATSB）在报告中指出，马航MH370在最终向南方向飞行的最后阶段，机组失能或缺氧事件的末端阶段似乎最符合现有证据。

Query_Text_en: All of that suggested that the plane most likely crashed farther south into the Indian Ocean than previously thought , Australian officials also said , leading them to announce a shift farther south within the prior search area .
Translation: 澳方官员表示，所有迹象表明，飞机极有可能坠毁在印度洋比此前推测更靠南的区域，这导致他们宣布将在先前划定的搜索区域内进一步向南调整搜寻范围。

Query_Text_en: The new analysis comes more than 100 days after the Boeing 777 , carrying 239 passengers and crew , disappeared on March 8 shortly after taking off from Kuala Lumpur bound for Beijing .
Translation: 这份最新分析报告出炉时，正值马航波音777客机于3月8日从吉隆坡起飞前往北京途中失联后的100多天。该客机当时载有239名乘客和机组人员。

Query_Text_en: Investigators say what little evidence they have to work with suggests the plane was deliberately diverted thousands of kilometers from its scheduled route before eventually plunging into the Indian Ocean .
Translation: 调查人员表示，目前有限的证据表明，该航班是被人蓄意改变航线，偏离预定航向数千公里后，最终坠入印度洋。

Query_Text_en: The search was narrowed in April after a series of acoustic pings thought to be from the plane 's black box recorders were heard along a final arc where analysis of satellite data put its last location .
Translation: 搜索范围在4月进一步缩小，此前在卫星数据分析确定的最后位置所在的弧形搜索区域内，探测到一系列被认为来自飞机黑匣子的声波信号。

Query_Text_en: But a month later , officials conceded the wreckage was not in that concentrated area , some 1,600 km [ 1,000 miles ] off the northwest coast of Australia , and the search area would have to be expanded .
Translation: 但一个月后，官员们承认残骸并不在澳大利亚西北海岸外约1600公里处的那片集中区域，因此必须扩大搜索范围。

Query_Text_en: `` The new priority area is still focused on the seventh arc , where the aircraft last communicated with satellite . We are now shifting our attention to an area further south along the arc , '' Australian Deputy Prime Minister Warren Truss told reporters in Canberra .
Translation: 新的重点搜索区域仍然集中在第七条弧线区域，即飞机最后一次与卫星联系的位置。我们现在将注意力转向该弧线南端的区域，"澳大利亚副首相沃伦·特拉斯在堪培拉对记者说。

Query_Text_en: Truss said the area was determined after a review of satellite data , early radar information and aircraft performance limits after the plane diverted across the Malaysian peninsula and headed south into one of the remotest areas of the planet .
Translation: 特鲁斯表示，这一区域是在对卫星数据、早期雷达信息以及飞机性能限制进行审查后确定的。此前，该客机在偏离原定航线飞越马来半岛后，向南转向了地球上最偏远的地区之一。

Query_Text_en: `` It is highly , highly likely that the aircraft was on autopilot otherwise it could not have followed the orderly path that has been identified through the satellite sightings , '' Truss said .
Translation: 特拉斯表示："极有可能、极有可能处于自动驾驶状态，否则根据卫星监测数据，它无法沿着如此规律的轨迹飞行。"

Query_Text_en: The next phase of the search is expected to start in August and take a year , covering some 60,000 sq km at a cost of A$ 60 million [ $ 56 million ] or more .
Translation: 下一阶段的搜索行动预计将于8月启动，耗时一年，计划覆盖约6万平方公里区域，耗资约6000万澳元（约合5600万美元）或更多。

Query_Text_en: The search is already the most expensive in aviation history .
Translation: 此次搜寻行动已成为航空史上最昂贵的一次。

Query_Text_en: The new priority search area is around 2,000 km west of Perth , a stretch of isolated ocean frequently lashed by storm force winds and massive swells .
Translation: 新的重点搜索区域位于珀斯以西大约2000公里处，这片偏远海域经常遭受风暴级强风和巨大涌浪的侵袭。

Query_Text_en: Two vessels , one Chinese and one from Dutch engineering company Fugro , are currently mapping the sea floor along the arc , where depths exceed 5,000 meters in parts .
Translation: 一艘为中国船只，另一艘属于荷兰工程公司Fugro的两艘船舶目前正在沿该弧形区域测绘海床，部分海域深度超过5000米。

Query_Text_en: A tender to find a commercial operator to conduct the sea floor search closes on Monday .
Translation: 寻找海底搜索商业运营商的招标将于周一截止。

Query_Text_en: The search for Malaysia Airlines ' flight MH370 will be focused on 58 spots in a 60,000 sq km area of the Indian ocean .
Translation: 马航MH370航班的搜寻工作将集中在印度洋一片6万平方公里区域内的58个地点。

Query_Text_en: Transport Minister Datuk Seri Liow Tiong Lai said the locations were identified in a latest survey by the international search team .
Translation: 交通部长丹斯里刘廷莱表示，这些地点是在国际搜索队的最新调查中确定的。

Query_Text_en: He said in the survey conducted at the arc-shaped priority area , about 1,600 km from Perth , the search team found that there were 58 spots where hard objects were lying on the seabed .
Translation: 他在调查中提到，在距离珀斯以西约1600公里处的弧形重点区域，搜寻团队发现海底存在58个硬质物体点位。

Query_Text_en: `` Although the hard objects can be anything , from rocks to ship wreckages or a plane , the finding gives us where to focus in the next stage of search .
Translation: 尽管这些硬物可以是任何物体，从岩石到沉船残骸或飞机，但这一发现为我们指明了下一阶段搜索的重点方向。

Query_Text_en: `` An underwater search using deep sea equipment will be conducted at these spots soon , '' he told reporters at a press conference today .
Translation: 他今日在记者会上对记者说："将很快在这些地点展开使用深海设备的水下搜寻行动。"

Query_Text_en: Liow was in Seremban to launch the Negeri Sembilan state MCA annual general meeting .
Translation: 刘在斯里曼南出席森美兰州马华公会年度大会的开幕仪式。

Query_Text_en: He said the underwater search may take about a year to complete .
Translation: 他表示，水下搜索可能需要大约一年时间才能完成。

Query_Text_en: A Chinese aircraft was forced to delay its landing after two air traffic controllers nodded off , reports said Tuesday , sparking a wave of online anger about airline safety .
Translation: 周二有报道称，因两名空中交通管制员打瞌睡，一架中国客机被迫推迟降落，此事引发网上对航空安全的强烈不满。

Query_Text_en: The Boeing 737 was preparing to land at Wuhan airport in central China but had no response from the air traffic control tower for 12 minutes , reports said .
Translation: 据报道，一架波音737客机准备在中国中部的武汉机场降落时，与塔台失去联系长达12分钟。

Query_Text_en: Contact was eventually made and China Eastern Airlines flight MU2528 from Sanya landed safely , the Sina.com news portal said .
Translation: 新浪网消息：东方航空公司MU2528航班从三亚起飞后最终成功建立联系并安全降落。

Query_Text_en: `` Because air traffic control was asleep on duty , [ the plane ] called many times , '' civil aviation authorities said in a statement , `` but there was no reply , and no contact could be made with the control tower .
Translation: 民航当局在声明中指出，由于空中交通管制员值班期间处于睡眠状态，涉事飞机曾多次尝试联络，但始终未获回应，且无法与塔台建立有效联系。

Query_Text_en: The pilots of Northwest Flight 188 assert they lost track of time and location -- but never went to sleep -- when they failed last week to respond to air-traffic controllers for more than an hour , according to people familiar with what the crew intended to tell federal safety investigators Sunday .
Translation: 据知情人士透露，西北航空188航班飞行员声称，他们在上周未能及时回应空中交通管制人员长达一小时以上期间，始终未入睡，但未能及时掌握飞行时间和位置信息。这一陈述内容来自机组人员周日向联邦安全调查人员的说明。

Query_Text_en: They became distracted in conversation while cruising at 37,000 feet Wednesday night , did n't realize how long the plane had lost radio contract and flew well past their airport destination .
Translation: 周三晚间在3.7万英尺的巡航高度上，机组人员因交谈而分心，未意识到飞机已失去无线电联系的时间长度，导致飞机飞过了目的地机场。

Query_Text_en: Such a scenario is consistent with the brief statements first officer Richard Cole of Salem , Ore. , made to reporters earlier in the weekend .
Translation: 这一情景与俄勒冈州塞勒姆市副警长理查德·科尔本周末早些时候向记者发表的简短声明一致。

Query_Text_en: During the 78-minute radio silence , controllers became so concerned about the fate of the 149 people aboard that they asked pilots of other aircraft in the vicinity to see if they could rouse the Northwest crew , according to industry and government officials .
Translation: 在长达78分钟的无线电静默期间，管制员因担忧机上149人的安危，请求附近其他飞机的飞行员尝试联系西北航空机组。据行业和政府官员透露。

Query_Text_en: When that failed , the Federal Aviation Administration began to consider having military jets scrambled to intercept the twin-jet Airbus A320 , these officials said .
Translation: 相关官员表示，在这一举措未能奏效后，美国联邦航空管理局开始考虑紧急出动军机拦截那架双引擎空客A320客机。

Query_Text_en: A deserted airport customs lounge , luggage weighed by hand on an old fashioned scale and a cockpit with no digital assistance , are just some of the sites a photographer from Singapore has captured on camera after flying with the world s only one-star airline .
Translation: 新加坡一名摄影师在乘坐全球唯一的"一星航空公司"航班后，用镜头记录下了这些场景：废弃的机场海关休息室、用老式秤手工称重的行李，以及未配备数字辅助设备的驾驶舱。

Query_Text_en: Aram Pan gained unprecedented access to the Soviet-era planes still used in North Korea by the nation s civil carrier , Air Koryo , plus cargo transporters and helicopters , after joining a tour for aviation enthusiasts inside the communist enclave .
Translation: 阿兰·潘在参加朝鲜共产主义飞地的航空爱好者旅游团后，得以以前所未有的机会接触朝鲜高丽航空仍在使用的苏联时期飞机，以及货运运输机和直升机。

Query_Text_en: From the photos , the airline , which was founded in 1950 as a joint North Korean-Soviet partnership to connect the capital Pyongyang with Moscow , appears to be stuck in a time warp .
Translation: 从这些照片来看，这家成立于1950年的朝鲜-苏联合资企业朝鲜航空公司，旨在连接首都平壤与莫斯科，如今却仿佛停滞在时光隧道中。

Query_Text_en: Photographer Aram Pan was greeted by smiling Air Koryo flight attendants dressed in smart navy blue outfits before he boarded an Ilyushin Il-18 plane , a large turboprop airliner .
Translation: 摄影师阿拉姆·潘在登机前受到身着整洁深蓝色制服的高丽航空乘务员的迎接，随后将乘坐一架伊尔-18型大型涡轮螺旋桨客机。

Query_Text_en: The Soviet aircraft was first flown in 1957 .
Translation: 这架苏联飞机于1957年首飞。

Query_Text_en: As the search continued late Saturday for a missing Malaysia Airlines jetliner , experts pointed at how many Asian carriers have succeeded in the last decade to overhaul their patchy safety records , helping make flying in the region among the world 's safest .
Translation: 周六深夜，随着对失踪的马来西亚航空公司客机的搜寻仍在继续，专家指出过去十年间许多亚洲航空公司成功整顿了存在缺陷的安全记录，使该地区的航空安全水平跻身全球最安全之列。

Query_Text_en: Authorities across Malaysia , Singapore and Vietnam scrambled to locate the Boeing 777-200 jet with 239 people aboard that had lost contact with air-traffic controllers two hours into a routine flight to Beijing from Kuala Lumpur .
Translation: 马来西亚、新加坡和越南三国相关部门紧急展开行动，搜寻一架在从吉隆坡飞往北京的常规航班飞行约两小时后与空中交通管制部门失去联系的波音777-200客机，该航班机上共有239人。

Query_Text_en: Though the fate of the aircraft remains unclear , aviation experts are pointing to the Malaysian flag carrier 's strong safety record that stands out among some of its rivals in Southeast Asia .
Translation: 尽管飞机的命运仍然不明朗，但航空专家指出，马来西亚国家航空公司的安全记录在东南亚部分竞争对手中表现尤为突出。

Query_Text_en: The airline , which is 69.4 % owned by Khazanah Nasional Bhd , the Malaysian sovereign-wealth fund , had n't suffered a fatal aircraft accident since 1995 , when one of its small turboprop planes crashed after an aborted landing attempt , killing 34 people , according to data from the Aviation Safety Network , an industry database .
Translation: 该航空公司由马来西亚主权财富基金国库控股公司（Khazanah Nasional Bhd）持股69.4%，据行业数据库航空安全网络（Aviation Safety Network）数据显示，自1995年以来该公司未发生过致命空难——此前其一架小型涡轮螺旋桨飞机曾在一次中断降落尝试后坠毁，造成34人遇难。

Query_Text_en: Meanwhile , serious accidents were more frequent involving other airlines from many of the region 's developing countries between the 1980s to early 2000s . This came as Asia 's fledgling commercial aviation industry began to take off , significantly hurting the reputation of operators in nations such as China , South Korea , Taiwan and Indonesia .
Translation: 与此同时，在20世纪80年代至21世纪初，该地区许多发展中国家的其他航空公司发生严重事故的频率显著增加。恰逢亚洲尚处起步阶段的民航业开始快速发展，这严重损害了中国、韩国、台湾和印度尼西亚等国航空运营商的声誉。

Query_Text_en: Among the deadliest air crashes in Asia , an Airbus A300 plane of Garuda Indonesia crashed in September 1997 , killing 234 people .
Translation: 在亚洲最严重的空难之一中，加鲁达印尼航空的一架空客A300客机于1997年9月坠毁，造成234人遇难。

Query_Text_en: Two months later , a 10-month old Boeing 737-300 operated by SilkAir , the regional unit of Singapore Airlines , crashed near Palembang , also in Indonesia , killing all 104 onboard .
Translation: 两个月后，新加坡航空的区域子公司胜安航空运营的一架服役仅10个月的波音737-300客机在印度尼西亚棉兰附近坠毁，机上104人全部遇难。

Query_Text_en: But safety has improved considerably in Asia over the last decade , experts say , with airlines and national governments investing billions of dollars to boost crew training and flight infrastructure .
Translation: 专家表示，过去十年间，亚洲航空安全状况显著提升，这得益于航空公司和各国政府投入数百亿美元加强机组人员培训及飞行基础设施建设。

Query_Text_en: China has completely turned itself around since the 1990s to be among the safest aviation regions in the world , they say .
Translation: 他们表示，自20世纪90年代以来，中国航空安全领域实现了全面转型，现已跻身全球最安全航空区域之列。

Query_Text_en: The safety performance of Asian airlines is in line with the overall industry performance , ' said Andrew Herdman , the director general of the Association of Asia Pacific Airlines , a Kuala Lumpur-based industry organization .
Translation: “亚洲航空公司的安全表现与整个行业的整体表现保持一致，”总部位于吉隆坡的行业组织亚太航空协会总干事安德鲁·赫德曼表示。

Query_Text_en: Over last decade , the industry hull loss rate , or planes getting completely damaged , has improved to one loss in three million flights from one in a million , Mr. Herdman said .
Translation: 赫德曼表示，过去十年间，航空业飞机全损率，即飞机完全损毁的比例，已从百万分之一提升至三百万分之一。

Query_Text_en: Still , safety remains a concern among some smaller Asian markets , particularly in some developing Southeast Asian nations that involve smaller commuter aircraft .
Translation: 不过，安全问题在部分较小的亚洲市场仍受关注，尤其是东南亚部分发展中使用小型通勤飞机的国家。

Query_Text_en: In February , a Nepal Airlines Canadian-made Twin Otter turboprop crashed , killing all 18 onboard , in Nepal 's seventh fatal commercial aircraft crash since 2008 , killing a total of 125 people .
Translation: 2月，尼泊尔航空公司一架加拿大制造的双水獭涡轮螺旋桨飞机在尼泊尔境内坠毁，机上18人全部遇难。这是该国自2008年以来发生的第七起致命商业航班空难，累计造成125人遇难。

Query_Text_en: Elsewhere in Asia , India 's airline safety ranking was downgraded by the U.S. Federal Aviation Authority earlier this year following a review of the South Asian nation 's regulatory oversight .
Translation: 今年早些时候，美国联邦航空管理局在对印度民航监管体系进行审查后，将其航空安全评级下调。

Query_Text_en: As well , many Indonesia airlines continue to be on the European Union watch list for safety .
Translation: 此外，许多印度尼西亚航空公司仍被列入欧盟安全观察名单。

Query_Text_en: In a sign of the improved safety standards , however , flag carrier Garuda Indonesia was among the few of the nation 's airlines removed from the list in 2009 .
Translation: 然而，作为安全标准提升的一个标志，该国的国营航空公司——印尼航空——是2009年被移出名单的少数几家航空公司之一。

Query_Text_en: Every day approximately six million people board airplanes and arrive safely at their destinations ... The overall safety record of commercial airplanes is excellent and has been steadily improving over time , ' according to Boeing Co. , the Chicago-based manufacturer of the missing 777-200 .
Translation: 根据位于芝加哥的失联777-200制造商波音公司（Boeing Co.）介绍，每天约有六百万人乘坐飞机并安全抵达目的地……商用飞机的整体安全记录非常出色，并且一直在稳步提升。

Query_Text_en: The aircraft was delivered to Malaysia Airlines in May 2002 .
Translation: 这架飞机于2002年5月交付给马来西亚航空公司。

Query_Text_en: Since its introduction in 1995 , the Boeing 777 has quickly become the workhorse of Asia 's full-service carriers , shuttling thousands of passengers a day on regional and long-haul flights to Europe and North America .
Translation: 自1995年投入运营以来，波音777迅速成为亚洲全服务航空公司的主力机型，每天通过区域及远程航线为欧洲和北美运送数千名乘客。

Query_Text_en: Asian airlines credit the twin-engine jet as a more fuel-efficient and reliable aircraft to operate than the bigger aircraft it is replacing , the Boeing 747 .
Translation: 亚洲航空公司认为这款双引擎客机相较于其取代的更大机型（即波音747）而言，是运营成本更低且更为可靠的节油机型。

Query_Text_en: Boeing data show fatal accidents now occur less than once every two million flights , a huge improvement over once in 200,000 flights in the 1950s and 1960s .
Translation: 波音公司的数据显示，目前致命事故的发生频率已降至每两百万次航班不足一次，与20世纪50年代和60年代每20万次航班发生一次致命事故相比，这是一个巨大的进步。

Query_Text_en: As for the missing Malaysian jet , Vietnam 's navy said it possibly crashed 153 nautical miles off the Vietnam coast .
Translation: 关于失踪的马航客机，越南海军表示，该客机可能在距离越南海岸153海里处坠毁。

Query_Text_en: The Vietnam navy could n't confirm the possible crash site , while Malaysia Airlines and the nation 's government said the plane had n't yet been found .
Translation: 越南海军无法确认可能的坠机地点，而马来西亚航空公司和该国政府称该飞机尚未被找到。

Query_Text_en: ` There are only two possibilities in my mind -- some undefined mechanical problem or terrorism -- that would explain how the pilot would be caught unaware and ca n't react , that controllers heard nothing , ' said Harshvardhan , an aviation analyst in New Delhi .
Translation: "在笔者看来，只有两种可能性——或是不明机械故障，或是恐怖主义——可以解释为何飞行员会措手不及、无法反应，以及控制员未听到任何异常，"新德里航空分析师哈什瓦尔丹表示。

Query_Text_en: If there was some trouble , the plane would have sent a warning or tried to make an emergency landing , said Mr. Harshvardhan .
Translation: 哈什瓦尔丹表示，如果有某种故障，飞机本会发出警报或尝试紧急着陆。

Query_Text_en: The aircraft was carrying enough fuel to keep it in the air for two extra hours and analysts said every passing minute pointed to a mishap .
Translation: 该飞机携带的燃料足以支持其在空中多飞行两小时，分析人士指出，每一分钟的流逝都在暗示一起事故的发生。

Query_Text_en: ` Every hour that goes by without a sign of life from the aircraft will further point to a catastrophic event , ' said Jonathan Galaviz , a partner with Global Market Advisors , an aviation and leisure consulting firm .
Translation: 航空与休闲咨询公司Global Market Advisors的合伙人乔纳森·加拉维兹表示："随着时间每过去一个小时，若仍未收到飞机任何信号，都将进一步表明此次事件可能是灾难性的。"

Query_Text_en: ` The route that flight takes has difficult terrain and the weather conditions could be harsh .
Translation: 该航班的航线地形复杂，天气条件可能较为恶劣。

Query_Text_en: In the next two decades , the Asia Pacific region will account for almost half of the growth in air traffic , according Boeing 's estimates .
Translation: 据波音公司预测，未来二十年间，亚太地区将占全球航空交通量增长的近一半。

Query_Text_en: To accommodate this growth , the region will need 12,820 new aircraft , worth around $ 1.9 trillion , Boeing said last month .
Translation: 波音公司上月表示，为满足这一增长需求，该地区未来将需要12820架新飞机，价值约1.9万亿美元。

Query_Text_en: Eighteen current or former Los Angeles country sheriff 's deputies are facing federal corruption charges .
Translation: 洛杉矶县现职或前任治安官副手中有18人面临联邦腐败指控。

Query_Text_en: NPR 's Ina Jaffe reports the charges unveiled today as a result of an FBI investigation into civil rights violations in nation 's largest jail system .
Translation: 美国国家公共电台记者伊娜·杰斐报道了联邦调查局对美国最大监狱系统侵犯民权行为展开调查后今日披露的指控。

Query_Text_en: The charges alleged unjustified beatings of both jail inmates and visitors at the downtown Men 's Central Jail .
Translation: 指控称，市中心男子中央拘留所内的在押人员及访客遭到不正当殴打。

Query_Text_en: The sheriff 's deputies are also accused of unjustified detentions and conspiracy to abstract the federal investigation .
Translation: 治安官的副手们也被指控存在无正当理由的拘留行为，并合谋妨碍联邦调查。

Query_Text_en: Specifically sergeants are accused of trying to intimidate one of the FBI agents involved in the probe , while two lieutenants are accused of hiding the whereabouts of an inmate who was cooperating with the investigation .
Translation: 具体而言，几名警员被指控试图恐吓调查组中的一名联邦调查局探员，另有两名下士则被指控隐瞒了一名配合调查的囚犯的行踪。

Query_Text_en: No under sheriffs or other top brass were charged .
Translation: 没有副职官员或其他高层官员被起诉。

Query_Text_en: The spokesman for Sheriff Lee Baca said that the department had cooperated with the investigation which is ongoing .
Translation: 李·巴卡治安官的发言人表示，该部门已配合目前仍在进行中的调查。

Query_Text_en: Ina Jaffe , NPR News .
Translation: 美国国家公共电台记者伊娜·杰斐。

Query_Text_en: For NPR News , I 'm Peter O'Dowd , in Phoenix .
Translation: 我是彼得·奥道，目前在菲尼克斯，为您报道美国国家公共电台新闻。

Query_Text_en: Former San Diego Mayor Bob Filner has been sentenced to three months of home confinement and three years probation for charges he harassed a number of women while mayor of the California city .
Translation: 前圣地亚哥市长鲍勃·菲尔纳因在任期间骚扰多名女性的指控，被判处三个月居家监禁及三年缓刑。

Query_Text_en: Former ten-term congressman apologized to the women he 's admitted to victimizing .
Translation: 前众议员向其承认曾侵害的女性致歉。

Query_Text_en: `` I want to apologize to my family who have stood by me through this ordeal , to my royal staff and supporters , to the citizens of San Diego , and most sincerely to the women who I 've hurt and offended .
Translation: 我要向在我经历这段艰难时期始终支持我的家人、皇室工作人员及支持者，向圣地亚哥市民，以及最诚挚地向我伤害并冒犯过的女性致以歉意。

Query_Text_en: Seventy-one-year-old Filner pleaded guilty to one felony and one misdemeanor charge connection with arrogations of inappropriate touching or kissing a female member of his staff .
Translation: 71岁的菲尔纳就一项与不当触摸或亲吻其女下属有关的重罪和一项轻罪指控认罪。

Query_Text_en: Filner was the first Democrat to run the city in 20 years .
Translation: 菲尔纳是20年来首位担任市长的民主党人。

Query_Text_en: Hours before it was slated to expire , Congress has renewed a ban on plastic firearms that can , in some incidents , evade detection at airports .
Translation: 在美国国会即将到期前数小时，该机构延长了禁止可逃避机场安检的塑料枪支的禁令。

Query_Text_en: While it was said to expire at midnight extended for 10 years by Senate lawmakers , the voice vote .
Translation: 虽然人们认为某项措施将于午夜到期，但参议院议员通过口头表决将其延长了十年。

Query_Text_en: Some Democrats wanted to require such weapons contained undetachable metal parts , but that was blocked by Republicans .
Translation: 一些民主党人曾试图要求这类武器必须配备不可拆卸的金属部件，但该提议遭到共和党人的反对。

Query_Text_en: Families of some the victims of last year 's elementary school shooting in Newtown Connecticut , are asking the people perform an act of kindness to mark the one-year anniversary of the incident .
Translation: 去年康涅狄格州纽敦小学枪击案的部分受害者家属，呼吁人们以善举纪念这一事件的一周年。

Query_Text_en: Some is also setting up a website under the 26 victims of the shootings , which took place December 14th of last year .
Translation: 一些人还以去年12月14日发生的枪击案中26名受害者的名义设立了网站。

Query_Text_en: Though it was one of the worst mass school shootings in U.S. history , 20-year-old Adam Lanza opened fire inside the school , killing 20 children and six adults before killing himself .
Translation: 尽管这是美国历史上最严重的校园枪击案之一，20岁的亚当·兰扎仍在学校内开枪，造成20名儿童和6名成年人死亡，随后其本人自杀身亡。

Query_Text_en: The director of the 1978 film , La Cage aux Folles , has died .
Translation: 1978年电影《戏院魅影》的导演去世了。

Query_Text_en: NPR 's Neda Ulaby reports , Edouard Molinaro died on Saturday in Paris . He was 85 .
Translation: 美国国家公共电台（NPR）记者内达·乌拉比报道，埃德瓦尔·莫利纳罗于周六在巴黎去世，享年85岁。

Query_Text_en: La Cage aux Folles was a pioneering film at the time , a sympathetic look at gay male couple .
Translation: 《鸟笼》在当时是一部先驱之作，以同情的视角展现了同性伴侣的生活。

Query_Text_en: The story has then posed as a straight male female couple with one in drag to help their son marry a girl from a conservative family .
Translation: 这个故事中，一对男女假扮成异性恋夫妻（其中一人易装）以帮助他们的儿子迎娶一个来自保守家庭的女孩。

Query_Text_en: Director Edouard Molinaro had made dozens of serious movies and documentaries before La Cage aux Folles .
Translation: 埃德瓦尔·莫利纳罗导演在拍摄《法庭争风》之前已执导过数十部严肃电影和纪录片。

Query_Text_en: When he saw the final cut for the first time , he thought it was so terrible that would finish his career .
Translation: 当他第一次看到最终剪辑版本时，他认为这部作品糟糕透顶，足以终结他的职业生涯。

Query_Text_en: Instead , La Cage aux Folles would become highest grossing foreign film at the time in the United States .
Translation: 相反，《鸟 Cage aux Folles》成为当时美国票房最高的外国电影。

Query_Text_en: Some critics complained the drag queen character was too stereotypical .
Translation: 一些批评者指出该变装皇后角色过于刻板。

Query_Text_en: But the movie inspired an American remix starring Robin Williams and a Tony Award winning Broadway musical .
Translation: 但这部电影催生了一部由罗宾·威廉姆斯主演的美国翻拍电影和一部托尼奖获奖的百老汇音乐剧。

Query_Text_en: Edouard Molinaro 's death was announced by the president of France .
Translation: 法国总统宣布了埃德华·莫利纳罗的死讯。

Query_Text_en: Neda Ulaby , NPR News .
Translation: 内达·乌拉比，美国国家公共电台。

Query_Text_en: That degree was taken in east antarctica not by human but by a NASA weather satellite .
Translation: 该温度记录是在东南极地区由美国国家航空航天局的一颗气象卫星而非人类测得。

Query_Text_en: The low temperature previously recorded in the August of 2010 beats the old record .
Translation: 2010年8月此前记录到的低温打破了旧纪录。

Query_Text_en: THE world 's busiest train route , and one of the busiest air routes , is between Tokyo and Osaka , Japan 's two biggest metropolitan areas .
Translation: 世界上最繁忙的铁路线路，同时也是最繁忙的航空路线之一，连接日本两大都市圈东京和大阪。

Query_Text_en: On that corridor , the shinkansen , as Japan 's bullet trains are known , were born in 1964 .
Translation: 正是在这条线路上，日本的新干线（即子弹头列车）于1964年诞生。

Query_Text_en: They whizz 120,000 passengers a day smoothly from one place to another , on trains that leave every ten minutes .
Translation: 这些列车每天高效运送12万名乘客往来于各站点之间，发车间隔仅为十分钟。

Query_Text_en: Although humans , not robots , are at the controls , the average delay is a miraculous 36 seconds .
Translation: 尽管由人类而非机器人操控，平均延误时间仅有令人惊叹的36秒。

Query_Text_en: To take all those passengers by air would require 667 aircraft , each with 180 seats , or five times Japan 's fleet of Boeing 737s , estimates Macquarie , an investment bank .
Translation: Macquarie投资银行估算认为，若要通过航空运输所有这些乘客，需要配备180个座位的飞机667架，相当于日本波音737机队规模的五倍。

Query_Text_en: Undeterred , between March and August three low-cost airlines will have started operations in Japan .
Translation: 尽管如此，在三月至八月期间，日本将有三家低成本航空公司投入运营。

Query_Text_en: It would be a miracle if they could help hammer down train and plane fares in Japan , which are excruciating .
Translation: 如果他们真能压低日本目前高昂得令人痛苦的铁路和航空票价，那可真是奇迹了。

Query_Text_en: For example , a one-way shinkansen ticket from Tokyo to Osaka costs 14,000 [ $ 170 ] , and there are no discounts for return fares or for booking early .
Translation: 例如，从东京到大阪的单程新干线车票票价为14,000日元（约合170美元），且不提供往返票价优惠或提前预订优惠。

Query_Text_en: But compared with Europe and other parts of Asia , where budget airlines have quickly gained market share , in Japan the low-cost model is expected to take time to take off .
Translation: 但与欧洲和其他亚洲地区不同，廉价航空公司在当地迅速抢占市场份额，而在日本，低成本模式预计需要较长时间才能发展起来。

Query_Text_en: First , all three newcomers have established parents .
Translation: 首先，这三个新成员均有已确立的母公司。

Query_Text_en: Peach , which started flying in March , and Air Asia Japan , which starts in August , are part-owned by ANA , one of Japan 's two main carriers .
Translation: 3月开始运营的Peach航空公司和将于8月开航的亚洲航空日本均为日本两大航空公司之一的全日空的部分持股企业。

Query_Text_en: Such ties have usually hobbled low-cost airlines elsewhere : incumbents hate to cannibalise their own business .
Translation: 这种联系通常会阻碍其他国家低成本航空公司的成长：老牌企业不愿因内部竞争蚕食自身业务。

Query_Text_en: Analysts say the upstarts will thrive only if ANA and JAL step out of their way , letting them shake up the domestic tourist market .
Translation: 分析人士指出，只有当全日空和日航不再阻碍其发展，允许新兴企业彻底改变国内旅游市场时，这些新兴企业才能蓬勃发展。

Query_Text_en: The big boys could then concentrate on long-haul and business travel .
Translation: 这样一来，大型企业便可专注于长途航线和商务旅行。

Query_Text_en: Second , the budget airlines may struggle to make similar profits to their lucrative low-cost counterparts in other countries because , despite deregulation , airport costs and fuel taxes in Japan remain among the highest in the world .
Translation: 其次，由于日本的机场成本和燃油税在全球范围内仍属最高之列，尽管存在放松管制，廉航企业可能难以实现与其它国家高利润低成本同行相似的盈利水平。

Query_Text_en: That could limit expansion , though Jetstar Japan is boldly aiming for 100 aircraft by the end of the decade , up from three at its launch .
Translation: 尽管捷星日本大胆计划到本十年末将飞机数量从成立时的3架增至100架，但仍可能限制其扩张。

Query_Text_en: Third , it will be hard to convince finicky Japanese passengers that low fares make up for the lack of comfort and convenience they are used to .
Translation: 第三，很难说服挑剔的日本乘客，低价可以弥补他们习惯的舒适性和便利性的不足。

Query_Text_en: Jetstar and Air Asia are using Narita airport as their hub , which is expensive and time-consuming to get to from Tokyo .
Translation: 捷星和亚航将成田机场作为枢纽，而从东京前往该机场的交通费用高昂且耗时较长。

Query_Text_en: The main carriers use Haneda , which is closer to the capital and cheaper . The shinkansen zoom out of the city center , with no reservations needed .
Translation: 主要航空公司使用羽田机场，因为该机场距离首都更近且费用更低。新干线从市中心快速驶出，无需提前预约。

Query_Text_en: Miyuki Suzuki , the boss of Jetstar Japan , says her company 's strategy is to use low fares to persuade people to make trips they would otherwise not have made at all .
Translation: Jetstar Japan掌门人铃木美优表示，公司战略是通过提供低价机票来吸引那些原本根本不会出行的消费者进行旅行。

Query_Text_en: More tourists , she hopes , will start visiting Japan 's most far-flung islands . She says she will not go head-to-head with the shinkansen [ though her airline will fly between Tokyo and Osaka ] .
Translation: 她希望，将有更多游客开始访问日本最偏远的岛屿。她表示不会与新干线展开正面竞争（尽管她的航空公司将在东京和大阪之间执飞）。

Query_Text_en: Peach and Air Asia Japan have their sights not only on domestic flights but also on the route between Tokyo and Seoul , the nearest foreign capital .
Translation: 桃航空和亚洲航空日本不仅瞄准国内航线，还将目标锁定在东京至首尔这条最近的外国首都航线上。

Query_Text_en: They may be eyeing the East Asian market , where low-cost penetration lags behind the rest of Asia .
Translation: 他们可能正在瞄准东亚市场，其低成本渗透进程落后于亚洲其他地区。

Query_Text_en: Alas , none of Japan 's new budget carriers is expected to be as cut-throat as low-cost carriers elsewhere .
Translation: 不过，预计日本的新低成本航空公司不会像其他国家的廉航那样采取激进的竞争策略。

Query_Text_en: Ms Suzuki says Jetstar Japan will allow its passengers to book through travel agents , which are still ubiquitous , as well as online .
Translation: 铃木女士表示，捷星日本航空将允许乘客通过旅行社（目前仍普遍存在）以及在线方式预订。

Query_Text_en: `` This is Japan , '' she says , with a sympathetic air unusual for a budget-airline boss . `` It 's not all going to be self-service .
Translation: “这里是日本，”她带着一种对低成本航空公司主管而言罕见的体恤神情说道，“并不是所有服务都会是自助式的。”

Query_Text_en: On March 8 , 2014 a Malaysia Airlines flight took off from Kuala Lumpur enroute to Beijing . All transmission from the plane ended 40 minutes after take-off .
Translation: 2014年3月8日，一架马来西亚航空公司航班从吉隆坡起飞前往北京。该飞机所有通讯在起飞40分钟后中断。

Query_Text_en: The plane has not been found and is presumed to have crashed into the ocean .
Translation: 飞机尚未找到，被认为已坠入海洋。

Query_Text_en: Exactly what happened and whether this type of incident could occur again remain unresolved issues .
Translation: 究竟发生了什么以及此类事件是否会再次发生，仍然是未解决的问题。

Query_Text_en: Good night -- Malaysian 370 . Those were the last words heard from a Malaysia Airlines plane before it vanished from radar .
Translation: 晚安——马航370。这是从该马航客机在从雷达上消失前传出的最后话语。

Query_Text_en: A year later , the plane and the 239 people on board have not been found .
Translation: 一年后，飞机及机上的239人仍未被找到。

Query_Text_en: `` What we really need is real-time data tracking for when an act occurs , '' he said .
Translation: “我们真正需要的是实时追踪行为发生时的数据，”他说。

Query_Text_en: The International Civil Aviation Organization [ ICAO ] , which sets global standards for the airline industry , is recommending that planes report their positions every 15 minutes and every minute during distress .
Translation: 负责制定全球航空业标准的国际民航组织（ICAO）建议飞机每15分钟报告一次位置，遇险时则每分钟报告一次。

Query_Text_en: Less than an hour after MH 370 departed Kuala Lumpur to Beijing , all communication from the plane ceased , and it dropped off radar .
Translation: 马航MH370航班从吉隆坡飞往北京的途中，起飞后不到一小时便与地面失去联系，并随后从雷达屏幕上消失。

Query_Text_en: The first search area was along the original flight path . But the search areas kept shifting , especially after Malaysian military radar found a final transmission further north -- and that the plane could have flown another seven hours .
Translation: 最初的搜索区域位于原始飞行路线附近。但搜索区域不断调整，尤其是在马来西亚军用雷达发现最后一次信号传输的位置更靠北——并表明该飞机可能还能继续飞行七个小时之后。

Query_Text_en: The discrepancy exists because traditional radar does not track over oceans , and the plane was only equipped to report its location every 60 minutes .
Translation: 这种差异的存在是由于传统雷达无法覆盖海洋区域，且该飞机仅配备每60分钟报告一次位置的功能。

Query_Text_en: `` Once we implement this system and we 're able to track flights every one minute , which will increase our ability to locate flights .
Translation: 实施这一系统后，我们能够每分钟追踪航班，这将提升我们定位航班的能力。

Query_Text_en: Underwater devices searched the ocean floor for MH370 , hoping to hear a signal from the flight data recorders .
Translation: 水下探测设备在海底搜寻马航MH370客机，希望能接收到飞行数据记录仪发出的信号。

Query_Text_en: But the recorder batteries only last 30 days .
Translation: 但录音设备的电池仅能维持30天。

Query_Text_en: The US Federal Aviation Administration and other global organizations are extending the battery requirements to 90 days , effective in five years .
Translation: 美国联邦航空管理局及其他国际组织将电池相关要求延长至90天，该规定将于五年后生效。

Query_Text_en: This also is a problem . Search vehicles heard pinging sounds they thought were coming from the plane , but were actually from marine life .
Translation: 这也是一个问题。搜索设备探测到的声呐信号，他们原以为来自飞机，但实际上却是海洋生物发出的。

Query_Text_en: Former FAA Accident Investigator David Soucie has written a book on MH370 .
Translation: 前美国联邦航空局事故调查员大卫·索西撰写了一本关于马航MH370航班的书籍。

Query_Text_en: He suggests the frequency be changed .
Translation: 他建议调整频率。

Query_Text_en: ... So that it s a distinguishable pattern . It s a pattern that may be able to have a Morse Code situation that tells us what aircraft it actually came from or at least that was from an aircraft , he said .
Translation: 残骸可能形成一种可识别的模式，这种模式或许能够形成类似摩斯密码的编码方式，从而告知我们残骸实际来自哪架飞机，或至少表明残骸来自飞机，他表示。

Query_Text_en: Experts also suggest unsinkable flight recorders .
Translation: 专家还建议采用不可沉没的飞行记录器。

Query_Text_en: If you get it floating on the surface , with some sort of locator , both visually and by electronic means , I think that will both expedite the recovery process and also save millions upon millions of dollars in the search , said Captain Gebow .
Translation: 格伯上尉表示，如果能让目标物体漂浮在水面上，并配备某种定位装置，既通过视觉观察又借助电子设备，这不仅能加快回收进程，还能在搜寻过程中节省数以千万计的美元。

Query_Text_en: Already the MH370 search is the most expensive in aviation history -- estimated at more than $ 90 million .
Translation: 马航MH370的搜救行动已成为空难史上耗资最大的一次，估计费用超过9000万美元。

Query_Text_en: Experts agree missing aircraft are rare , but could happen again .
Translation: 专家一致认为，失联客机虽然极为罕见，但仍有可能再次发生。

Query_Text_en: They say the probability drops once all this new technology is installed on new planes .
Translation: 他们表示，一旦所有这些新技术安装到新飞机上，相关概率将降低。

Query_Text_en: That will happen several years from now .
Translation: 这将在数年后发生。

Query_Text_en: Scientists say achieving those goals calls for lightweight materials , better aerodynamics , new kinds of fuels and alternative aircraft configurations .
Translation: 科学家表示，实现这些目标离不开轻量化材料、更好的空气动力学设计、新型燃料以及替代型飞机构型。

Query_Text_en: In NASA 's huge Transonic Dynamics Wind Tunnel , engineers are testing a new design of airplane wing made of a composite material that is considerably lighter than the industry standard , aluminum alloy .
Translation: 在美国国家航空航天局的巨型跨音速动力学风洞中，工程师正在测试一种新型飞机机翼设计，该机翼采用的复合材料比行业标准材料铝合金轻许多。

Query_Text_en: Senior aerospace engineer Robert C. Scott says in the future , wings will likely be made out of materials like this .
Translation: 高级航空航天工程师罗伯特·C·斯科特表示，未来机翼可能将采用此类材料。

Query_Text_en: With advances in material , advances in design and analysis capability and the need for higher efficiency , you re driving yourself toward very lightweight designs , '' said Scott .
Translation: 随着材料的进步、设计与分析能力的提升以及对更高效率的需求，你们正朝着极轻量化的设计方向发展，" Scott表示。

Query_Text_en: One of those designs is the long , truss-supported wing , says project scientist Richard Wahls .
Translation: 项目科学家理查德·沃尔斯表示，其中一种设计是桁架支撑式长翼。

Query_Text_en: That allows you to stiffen the wing , keep the wing thin , grow the span to reduce drag , '' said Wahls .
Translation: "这使得增强机翼刚性、保持机翼纤薄、增大翼展以降低阻力成为可能，"瓦尔斯说道。

Query_Text_en: If someone decides to build one of these advanced configurations , they will be able to use the results of tests done by NASA .
Translation: 如果有人决定建造其中一种先进配置，他们将能够使用NASA所进行的测试结果。

Query_Text_en: In another part of the center , researchers are testing a new way of manufacturing composite materials .
Translation: 在中心的另一区域，研究人员正在测试一种新型复合材料生产方法。

Query_Text_en: Instead of aligning the fibers in straight , parallel lines , these fibers are molded around the points of heavy load , explains materials research engineer Karen Taminger .
Translation: 材料研究工程师凯伦·坦明格解释道，这些纤维并非排列成笔直的平行线，而是根据高负荷区域塑造成型。

Query_Text_en: That allows the fibers to continue to carry the load all the way around the corners instead of being interrupted if we cut that out from a straight aligned composite , '' said Taminger .
Translation: 这使得纤维能够在整个拐角区域持续传递载荷，而非像从直线排列的复合材料中切割出该部分那样造成中断，"塔明格说道。

Query_Text_en: Taminger says new structural designs will allow manufacturers to reduce the weight of airplanes and make them more energy efficient .
Translation: 塔明格表示，新型结构设计将使制造商能够减轻飞机重量并提升其能源效率。

Query_Text_en: NASA researchers also want to reduce the pollution that comes out of airplane engines , says Fay Collier , who manages the Environmentally Responsible Aviation project .
Translation: 负责管理环保航空项目的法伊·科尔表示，美国宇航局的研究人员还希望减少飞机引擎排放的污染物。

Query_Text_en: We want to take advantage of alternative fuels and the emergence of alternative fuels , and we want to design advanced combustors to minimize the output , '' said Collier .
Translation: 科尔利表示："我们希望利用替代燃料及其出现，并设计先进燃烧室以减少其输出。"

Query_Text_en: To learn what 's in the exhaust of an airplane burning a mixture of petroleum and alternative-based fuel , NASA scientists fly a second plane right behind the first one .
Translation: 为了了解燃烧石油和替代性燃料混合物的飞机尾气成分，美国国家航空航天局科学家驾驶第二架飞机紧跟其后。

Query_Text_en: On-board sensors measure the percentage of pollutants contained in different fuel mixtures .
Translation: 车载传感器测量不同燃料混合物中所含污染物的百分比。

Query_Text_en: Project scientist Richard Wahls says NASA is constantly looking for ways to revolutionize aviation .
Translation: 项目科学家理查德·沃尔斯表示，美国国家航空航天局（NASA）一直在持续寻求推动航空业革命性变革的方法。

Query_Text_en: We hope to find technologies that we can accelerate forward through the research , but other technologies - they may not be possible for 20 or 30 years , '' he said .
Translation: “我们希望能找到可以通过研究加速发展的技术，但其他技术可能需要20到30年才能实现，”他表示。

Query_Text_en: In the meantime , he says , there are incremental improvements moving the aviation industry towards better , safer and more efficient aircraft .
Translation: 与此同时，他表示，航空业正通过逐步改进朝着更优质、更安全和更高效的飞机发展。

Query_Text_en: Royal Dutch Shell PLC s $ 70 billion deal to buy BG Group PLC marks the most aggressivestep yet in the competition to be the world s dominant supplier of liquefied natural gas a fuel with a fast-growing and increasingly global market .
Translation: 荷兰皇家壳牌集团以700亿美元收购BG集团的交易，标志着其在全球争夺液化天然气市场主导地位的竞争中迈出了迄今为止最为激进的一步。这种燃料的市场需求增长迅速且日趋全球化。

Query_Text_en: The deal , announced Wednesday , would vault Shell far ahead of rivals like Exxon Mobil Corp and Chevron Corp. in the race to build market share for LNG , a chilled form of natural gas used for electricity generation and home heating .
Translation: 壳牌公司周三宣布的这笔交易，将使其在争夺液化天然气市场份额的竞争中远超埃克森美孚公司和雪佛龙公司等竞争对手。液化天然气是一种经过冷冻处理的天然气，主要用于发电和家庭取暖。

Query_Text_en: The tie-up is a bet that countries like China , India and others in the developing world will move toward cleaner burning fuels like natural gas instead of coal amid growing pressure to curb emissions .
Translation: 此次合作押注于在控制排放压力日益增大的背景下，中国、印度及其他发展中国家将转向使用天然气等更清洁的燃料而非煤炭。

Query_Text_en: And it is a gamble that Asian markets will come to rely on U.S. exports of the product , when the first shipments leave the country expected sometime in late 2015 or early next year .
Translation: 这是一场赌注，即亚洲市场将逐渐依赖美国该产品的出口，而首批货物预计将于2015年底或2016年初离境。

Query_Text_en: Exxon Mobil estimates that the global trade in liquefied natural gas will more than triple through 2040 , to nearly 100 billion cubic feet a day roughly 40 % higher than current U.S. gas output .
Translation: 埃克森美孚预计，到2040年全球液化天然气贸易量将增长超过三倍，达到日均近1000亿立方英尺，这一规模比当前美国天然气日产量高出约40%。

Query_Text_en: The company projects that countries throughout Asia and the Pacific will import half of the gas they consume by 2040 , with LNG making up 80 % of imports .
Translation: 该公司预计，到2040年，亚太地区各国进口的天然气将占其消费总量的一半，其中液化天然气占进口总量的80%。

Query_Text_en: Building up its LNG business would also give Shell some insulation from volatile oil prices , which have plummeted since last summer .
Translation: 发展液化天然气业务也将为壳牌提供一定的缓冲，使其免受油价波动的影响，自去年夏季以来油价已暴跌。

Query_Text_en: Eleven years ago , a shiny silver Boeing 727 airliner took off from Luanda , Angola , and became one of the few commercial jetliners to vanish and never be found .
Translation: 11年前，一架银光闪闪的波音727客机从安哥拉罗安达起飞，成为少数从未被找到的失踪商业客机之一。

Query_Text_en: Massive jet airplanes disappear more often in fiction than in real life , but it does happen .
Translation: 大型喷气式客机在虚构作品中消失的频率高于现实生活中，但这种情况确实会发生。

Query_Text_en: In 1979 , a Boeing 707 with six people aboard was lost in the Pacific Ocean after leaving Tokyo .
Translation: 1979年，一架载有6人的波音707客机在从东京起飞后于太平洋上空失踪。

Query_Text_en: And dozens of smaller planes have gone missing and never been located .
Translation: 数十架小型飞机失踪且一直下落不明。

Query_Text_en: ` The fact that it 's so rare is the reason everyone is paying attention to it , ' said Bob van der Linden , chairman of the aeronautics department at the Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum .
Translation: 史密森尼国家航空航天博物馆航空部主席鲍勃·范德林登表示："它之所以如此罕见，正是人们关注它的原因。"

Query_Text_en: Disappearances used to be more common .
Translation: 失踪案件过去更为常见。

Query_Text_en: Amelia Earhart was notable as one of the first female aviators to set distance records in the 1930s .
Translation: 阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特是20世纪30年代首批创下飞行距离纪录的女飞行员之一。

Query_Text_en: But she remains in the public conscience today more because she disappeared in her Lockheed Electra near New Guinea while attempting to circumnavigate the globe .
Translation: 但今天她仍被公众铭记更多是因为，她在试图环球飞行时，在新几内亚附近驾驶的洛克希德"埃莱克特拉"飞机失踪。

Query_Text_en: Today , radar can generally track aircraft large and small .
Translation: 如今，雷达能够有效追踪大小不等的飞机。

Query_Text_en: But even in an age of global satellite navigation and the perception of world-wide surveillance , significant areas of Earth are untouched by radar or regular observation .
Translation: 即使在全球卫星导航系统和全球监控覆盖看似无处不在的时代，地球的广大区域仍未被雷达扫描或定期观测覆盖。

Query_Text_en: Empty spots are shrinking .
Translation: 空缺持续缩减。

Query_Text_en: In the 1970s , the ` Bermuda Triangle ' loomed in the American imagination after several military planes disappeared in the Atlantic Ocean region between Florida , Puerto Rico and Bermuda , and other planes and ships were said to have vanished there .
Translation: 20世纪70年代，随着多架美军飞机在佛罗里达、波多黎各和百慕大之间的大西洋海域区域失踪，加之据称其他飞机和船只也在此神秘消失，"百慕大三角"逐渐在美国公众意识中浮出水面。

Query_Text_en: Supernatural explanations were eventually debunked .
Translation: 超自然解释最终被证伪。

Query_Text_en: ` The accident rate in the Bermuda Triangle is no better or worse than anywhere else , but it sounds really intriguing , ' said the Smithsonian 's Mr. van der Linden .
Translation: "百慕大三角的事故率与世界其他海域并无二致，但这一说法听起来格外引人入胜，"史密森学会的范德林登先生表示。

Query_Text_en: Rational explanations have n't limited people 's imaginations .
Translation: 理性解释并未限制人们的想象力。

Query_Text_en: The hugely successful TV series ` Lost ' focused on passengers of a jetliner that crashed on a mysterious island not found on maps .
Translation: 大获成功的电视剧《迷失》讲述了某架坠毁在地图上并不存在的神秘岛屿上的客机乘客的故事。

Query_Text_en: Disappearances are often simply accidents in remote locations , based on an analysis of planes that eventually showed up .
Translation: 根据对最终现身的飞机的分析，失踪事件很多时候只是偏远地区的事故。

Query_Text_en: Air France Flight 447 vanished for more than a day before searchers found floating pieces of the Airbus A330 .
Translation: 法航AF447航班失踪超过一天后，搜救人员才发现了空客A330客机的漂浮残骸。

Query_Text_en: Millionaire adventurer Steve Fossett disappeared in September 2007 while flying a single-engine propeller plane near Yosemite National Park in California . It took more than a year to find the wreckage .
Translation: 2007年9月，百万富翁冒险家史蒂夫·福塞特在加利福尼亚优胜美地国家公园附近驾驶单引擎螺旋桨飞机飞行时失踪。直到一年多后才找到飞机残骸。

Query_Text_en: Other accidents are often too difficult to investigate , or the small number of people killed is deemed too low to merit a costly search .
Translation: 其他事故往往难以调查，或因遇难人数较少被认为不足以启动代价高昂的搜救行动。

Query_Text_en: ` It is very expensive to do , ' said Mr. Stone , the accident investigator .
Translation: “这样做非常昂贵，”事故调查员斯通先生说道。

Query_Text_en: The Boeing 707 that crashed off Japan in 1979 had six people aboard .
Translation: 1979年在日本附近海域坠毁的波音707客机上共有6人。

Query_Text_en: A Boeing 727 that sent distress messages and vanished after taking off from Reykjavik , Iceland , in 1990 had 18 people aboard .
Translation: 1990年，一架从冰岛雷克雅未克起飞的波音727客机在发送遇险信号后失踪，机上共有18人。

Query_Text_en: Neither was ever found .
Translation: 两者均未被发现。

Query_Text_en: On rare occasions , disappearances are solved by passengers .
Translation: 在极少数情况下，失踪事件由乘客协助解决。

Query_Text_en: On Oct. 13 , 1972 , a Fairchild FH-227D with 45 people aboard , including a Uruguayan rugby team , crashed in the Andes while flying from Argentina to Chile -- an incident later dramatized in the 1993 film ` Alive .
Translation: 1972年10月13日，一架载有45人的福尔蒂斯FH-227D客机在从阿根廷飞往智利途中坠毁于安第斯山脉，机上人员包括一支乌拉圭橄榄球队。这一事件后来被改编成1993年电影《活著》。

Query_Text_en: Twelve passengers died immediately or were missing and the others waited in the freezing heights for rescue , some eventually resorting to cannibalism to survive .
Translation: 12名乘客当场死亡或失踪，其余人在严寒的高海拔地区等待救援，其中部分人最终不得不 resort to 吃人肉来求生。

Query_Text_en: When no help arrived , three of the 16 survivors in December set off for help .
Translation: 当救援未至时，12月幸存的16人中有3人启程求救。

Query_Text_en: JOHN GRISHAM , a prolific author of legal thrillers , long refused to allow his books to be sold in electronic form .
Translation: 约翰·格里沙姆，这位法律惊悚小说的高产作家，长期以来拒绝允许自己的作品以电子形式销售。

Query_Text_en: In a television interview last year , he lamented that e-books and heavy discounting of printed books by big retailers were a disaster in the long term for the publishing industry .
Translation: 去年在一次电视采访中，他指出，电子书以及大型零售商对纸质图书的大折扣销售，长远来看将对出版业造成灾难性影响。

Query_Text_en: But last month Mr Grisham s publisher announced that the author had had a change of heart : henceforth all of his books will be available in virtual form .
Translation: 但上月格里沙姆先生的出版商宣布该作者已改变心意：今后其所有著作均可提供电子版本。

Query_Text_en: His timing was impeccable . On April 3rd Apple is due to start shipping the first of its iPad tablet computers , which are expected to give a big boost to e-book sales .
Translation: 他的时机把握堪称无懈可击。苹果公司将于4月3日开始发货首批iPad平板电脑，预计将对电子书销售带来显著推动。

Query_Text_en: The iPad s impending arrival has created commercial intrigue worthy of a Grisham yarn .
Translation: iPad即将上市引发的商业圈勾心斗角堪比格里沙姆小说情节。

Query_Text_en: A group of big publishers , including Macmillan and HarperCollins , have been using Apple s interest in e-books to persuade Amazon , which currently dominates sales of digital books , to renegotiate its pricing model .
Translation: 包括麦克米伦和哈珀柯林斯在内的多家大型出版商，正借助苹果公司对电子书的兴趣，促使目前主导数字图书销售的亚马逊重新谈判其定价模式。

Query_Text_en: At one point in January an angry Amazon briefly removed many of Macmillan s books from its own virtual shelves before reinstating them after some authors kicked up a fuss .
Translation: 今年1月期间，因不满某项安排，亚马逊一度暂时下架了麦克米伦出版社的多本图书，后在部分作者提出抗议后恢复了这些书籍。

Query_Text_en: Like many other parts of the media industry , publishing is being radically reshaped by the growth of the internet .
Translation: 与媒体行业的其他许多领域一样，出版业正因互联网的发展而经历着深刻的变革。

Query_Text_en: Online retailers are already among the biggest distributors of books .
Translation: 在线零售商已经是图书领域最大的分销商之一。

Query_Text_en: Now e-books threaten to undermine sales of the old-fashioned kind . In response , publishers are trying to shore up their conventional business while preparing for a future in which e-books will represent a much bigger chunk of sales .
Translation: 如今，电子书正冲击传统纸质书的销量。作为回应，出版商一方面努力巩固传统业务，另一方面为电子书销售占比将大幅提高的未来做准备。

Query_Text_en: Quite how big is the subject of much debate .
Translation: 这一问题的规模究竟有多大，一直存在很大争议。

Query_Text_en: PricewaterhouseCoopers , a consultancy , reckons e-books will represent about 6 % of consumer book sales in North America by 2013 , up from 1.5 % last year ( see chart ) .
Translation: 普华永道咨询公司预计，到2013年，电子书将占北美地区图书消费销量的约6%，较去年的1.5%有所上升（见图表）。

Query_Text_en: Carolyn Reidy , the boss of Simon and Schuster , another big publisher , thinks they could account for 25 % of the industry s sales in America within three to five years .
Translation: 另一家大型出版商西蒙与舒斯特的掌门人卡罗琳·里迪认为，该公司有可能在未来三到五年内占据美国图书行业25%的销售额。

Query_Text_en: She may well be right if the iPad and other tablet computers take off , the prices of dedicated e-readers such as Amazon s Kindle keep falling and more consumers start reading books on smart-phones .
Translation: 如果iPad等平板电脑持续流行、以亚马逊Kindle为代表的专用电子阅读器价格持续下降，且越来越多消费者开始使用智能手机阅读书籍，那么她或许确实有道理。

Query_Text_en: Mobclix , an advertising outfit , reckons the number of programs , or apps , for books on Apple s iPhone recently surpassed that for games , previously the largest category .
Translation: 广告公司Mobclix认为，苹果iPhone平台上的书籍类应用程序数量近日已超过此前最大的应用类别游戏。

Query_Text_en: Alert to such shifts , publishers are trying to undo a mess that is largely of their own making .
Translation: 警觉到这些转变，出版商正试图解决主要由自身行为导致的混乱局面。

Query_Text_en: For some time they have operated a wholesale pricing model with Amazon under which the online retailer pays publishers for books and then decides what it charges the public for them .
Translation: 一段时间以来，他们与亚马逊采用了一种批发定价模式，即在线零售商向出版商支付书款后，自行决定向公众收取的价格。

Query_Text_en: This has enabled it to set the price of many new e-book titles and bestsellers at $ 9.99 , which is often less than it has paid for them .
Translation: 这使它能够将大量电子书新书和畅销书的定价定为9.99美元，这一价格通常低于其为此类书籍所支付的成本。

Query_Text_en: Amazon has kept prices low in order to boost demand for its Kindle , which dominates the e-reader market but faces stiff competition from Sony and others .
Translation: 亚马逊通过保持低价来刺激其Kindle电子阅读器的需求，这款产品虽在电子阅读器市场占据主导地位，但面临来自索尼等公司的激烈竞争。

Query_Text_en: Publishers fret that this has conditioned consumers to expect lower prices for all kinds of books .
Translation: 出版商担忧，这种情况已使消费者形成了对各类书籍更低价格的预期。

Query_Text_en: And they worry that the downward spiral will further erode their already thin margins some have had to close imprints and lay off staff in recent years as well as bring further dismay to struggling bricks-and-mortar booksellers ( see article ) .
Translation: 他们担心这种下行趋势将进一步侵蚀本已微薄的利润——近年来部分企业不得不关闭出版品牌并裁员——并给处境艰难的实体书店带来进一步打击（详见本文相关报道）。

Query_Text_en: Unless things change , some in the industry predict that publishers will suffer a similar fate to that of music companies , whose fortunes faded when Apple turned the industry upside down by selling individual songs cheaply online .
Translation: 除非形势发生变化，业内一些人士预测出版商或将遭遇与音乐公司类似的命运——当苹果公司通过在线销售单曲并采取低价策略颠覆行业格局时，音乐公司的辉煌便逐渐褪色。

Query_Text_en: Ironically , publishers have turned to Apple to help them twist Amazon s arm .
Translation: 颇具讽刺意味的是，出版商转而求助苹果公司以迫使亚马逊就范。

Query_Text_en: Keen to line up lots of titles for new iPad owners , the company has agreed to an agency model under which publishers get to set the price at which their e-books are sold , with Apple taking 30 % of the revenue generated .
Translation: 为了吸引新iPad用户购买大量电子书，该公司已同意采用代理模式，允许出版商自行设定电子书售价，苹果公司从中获取销售收入的30%。

Query_Text_en: Faced with these deals , Amazon has reportedly agreed similar terms with several big publishers . As a result , the price of some popular e-books is expected to rise to $ 12.99 or $ 14.99 .
Translation: 据报道，面对这些协议，亚马逊已与多家大型出版商达成类似条款。因此，部分热门电子书的价格预计上涨至12.99美元或14.99美元。

Query_Text_en: Once Apple and Amazon have taken their cut , publishers are likely to make less money on e-books under this new arrangement than under the wholesale one a price they seem willing to pay in order to limit Amazon s influence and bolster print sales .
Translation: 在苹果和亚马逊各自抽成后，出版商在新安排下的电子书收入可能低于批发模式下的收入——这一代价他们似乎愿意付出，以限制亚马逊的影响并提振纸质书销量。

Query_Text_en: Yet there are good reasons to doubt whether this and other strategies , such as delaying the release of electronic versions of new books for several months after the print launch , will halt the creeping commoditisation of books .
Translation: 然而，有充分理由质疑，包括在纸质书上市数月后再发布电子版等此类策略，能否真正遏制图书逐渐商品化的趋势。

Query_Text_en: Apple , for instance , is rumored to have kept the option of charging much less for popular e-books if they are being heavily discounted elsewhere .
Translation: 例如，苹果公司据传可能采取这样的策略：如果热门电子书在其他平台大幅降价，它们也会相应降低售价。

Query_Text_en: Other firms , including the mighty Google , are likely to enter the fray soon , which will only increase the competitive pressure .
Translation: 其他企业，包括行业巨头谷歌，很可能很快加入竞争，这只会加剧竞争压力。

Query_Text_en: This is particularly alarming for publishers because digital margins are almost as slender as print ones . True , e-books do not need to be printed and shipped to retailers . But these costs typically represent only a tenth of a printed book s retail price , estimates Credit Suisse , an investment bank .
Translation: 这对出版商尤其令人担忧，因为数字产品的利润率几乎与印刷品同样微薄。诚然，电子书无需印刷和运输至零售商，但瑞士信贷银行估计，这些成本通常仅占印刷书籍定价的十分之一。

Query_Text_en: Meanwhile , as David Young , the boss of Hachette Book Group , points out , publishers are incurring new costs in the form of investment in systems to store and distribute digital texts , as well as to protect them from piracy .
Translation: 与此同时，正如哈奇出版社集团总裁大卫·扬指出的，出版商正以投资的形式承担新的成本，用于建立存储和分发数字文本的系统，以及保护其免受盗版侵害。

Query_Text_en: Publishers are investing in the internet in other ways too . A few are starting to build their own online groups of readers . For instance Tor.com , a publisher-run website for science-fiction and fantasy enthusiasts , highlights content relevant to its members , even if some of it comes from rival publishers .
Translation: 出版商也在以其他方式投资互联网。一些出版商开始建立自己的在线读者社群。例如，由出版商运营的科幻与奇幻爱好者网站Tor.com会突出展示与会员相关的内容，即使部分内容来自竞争对手出版社。

Query_Text_en: ' This is a rare sign that the light 's finally gone on in publishing , ' says Mike Shatzkin of Idea Logical , a consultancy .
Translation: 咨询公司Idea Logical的迈克·沙茨金表示："这表明出版业终于迎来转机，堪称一个罕见的积极信号。"

Query_Text_en: Sourcebooks , a medium-sized publisher that has developed an online group focused on poetry , found that sales of its books rose by more than 50 % in the six weeks after poems from them had featured on the site .
Translation: Sourcebooks出版社是一家专注于诗歌领域的中型出版机构，其建立的在线诗歌社群在推出相关作品后，六周内图书销售额增长超过50%。

Query_Text_en: Publishers are also pumping plenty of money into what Hachette s Mr Young calls enriched e-books , which combine the printed word with audio , video and other media to create content that can command a premium price .
Translation: 出版商也在向哈珀·柯林斯的杨先生所称的"增强型电子书"投入大量资金。这类电子书将文字内容与音频、视频等多媒体形式相结合，从而能够以更高价格出售。

Query_Text_en: The launch of the iPad will speed up this experimentation , but it is not the only device to catch publishers attention . HarperCollins , for instance , has sold hundreds of thousands of cartridges in Britain that let users read electronic versions of classic texts on Nintendo DS portable game consoles .
Translation: iPad的发布将加速这一试验进程，但它并非唯一引起出版商关注的设备。以哈珀柯林斯出版社为例，该公司已在英国售出数十万张卡带，使用户能够在任天堂DS便携式游戏机上阅读经典文本的电子版。

Query_Text_en: Charlie Redmayne , the chief digital officer of one of its units , reckons many of the buyers would not have splashed out on print editions , so the move to a new platform has created fresh demand for books .
Translation: 该公司的某部门首席数字官查理·雷德梅因认为，许多买家原本不会在纸质版上大手笔消费，因此转向新平台的做法为书籍创造了新的市场需求。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , many publishing executives like to argue that the digital revolution could usher in a golden age of reading in which many more people will be exposed to digital texts .
Translation: 事实上，许多出版业高管认为数字革命或将开启阅读的黄金时代，让更多人接触数字文本。

Query_Text_en: They also point out that new technologies such as print on demand , which makes printing short runs of physical books more economical , should help them squeeze more money out of the old-fashioned format . And they insist that the shift away from printed books will be slow , giving them more time to adapt to the brave new digital world .
Translation: 他们还指出，按需印刷等新技术使小批量印刷实体书籍更具经济性，有望帮助出版商进一步挖掘传统格式的剩余价值。他们坚持认为向电子书的转型将是一个缓慢的过程，从而为他们争取到更多时间来适应这个崭新的数字世界。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps . But there are still plenty of inefficiencies in the supply chain for conventional books that firms such as Amazon and Apple can exploit . Many publishers , for example , still take far too long to get books to market in print or electronic form , missing valuable opportunities .
