Translation: 我们站在俯瞰湖面的高地上。我的女儿正和那个无精打采的新兵一起坐在湖中的小船上。她很快发现可以指使他，并且他会服从，于是她便让他像小学生般替她跑腿。

Query_Text_en: He did n't seem to mind very much .
Translation: 他似乎并不十分介意。

Query_Text_en: `` I 've lost her too , '' I said .
Translation: “我也失去了她，”我说。

Query_Text_en: `` That 's really the only thing that hurts .
Translation: 这确实是唯一真正造成损害的因素。

Query_Text_en: She did n't understand . `` Yes , '' she said and smiled .
Translation: 她没明白。“是的，”她微笑着说。

Query_Text_en: `` You do n't like yourself , '' she said with a voice that suggested she understood and shared my opinion .
Translation: “你不喜欢自己，”她语气中带着理解与认同地说。

Query_Text_en: `` I do , but I do n't think I understand myself . ''
Translation: 我确实如此，但我并不认为自己真正理解自己。

Query_Text_en: `` It is n't true at all , '' I said . `` You humor me , that 's something entirely different . ''
Translation: “这完全不对，”我说道，“你不过是敷衍我，那完全是另一回事。”

Query_Text_en: I tried to explain it to the psychiatrist , but without much success .
Translation: 我试图向心理医生解释，但收效甚微。

Query_Text_en: I had no words to explain with , not even images to explain .
Translation: 我无法用语言解释，甚至连图像也无法表达。

Query_Text_en: I had been brought to the air force base outside Stockholm , together with the two other Swedish Contacts ;
Translation: 我和另外两位瑞典联络员被带到斯德哥尔摩郊外的一座空军基地。

Query_Text_en: contact was established , and I was rejected .
Translation: 联系得以建立，然而遭到拒绝。

Query_Text_en: That would have been the end of it , only it became known I had taken control over the contacting alien , which made me very interesting .
Translation: 事情本该到此为止，但人们得知我已经控制了那个接触外星人的存在，这让我极具吸引力。

Query_Text_en: I had also killed her , but that was not known then .
Translation: 我也杀死了她，但这件事当时还不为人所知。

Query_Text_en: I said , `` Nothing that would make any sense to you .
Translation: 我说：“这些对你来说毫无意义。”

Query_Text_en: It does n't even make sense to me . It was something that is n't done there , something so vile they could n't even think about it , so shameful they do n't have a name for it , or even a punishment .
Translation: 这在我看来简直荒谬至极。这种事情在当地是绝不允许的，既卑劣到令人无法直视，又可耻到无法命名，甚至没有相应的惩罚。

Query_Text_en: I had her there , she was interested , it could be a break , a means of getting to the aliens , maybe a weapon of sorts .
Translation: 我已将其置于掌控之中，她对此表现出兴趣，这或许是个转机，或是接近外星人的途径，说不定还能成为某种形式的武器。

Query_Text_en: She watched me .
Translation: 她监视了我。

Query_Text_en: My daughter was out on the lake again , at two o'clock in the morning -- catching fish , watching them die , and throwing them back .
Translation: 我的女儿又在凌晨两点来到湖上——钓鱼，看着它们死去，然后将它们扔回。

Query_Text_en: `` I do n't have time anymore , '' I said , `` that 's why I must get back to them if they do n't come for me . ''
Translation: “我没时间了，”我说，“这就是为什么如果他们不来找我，我必须回去找他们的原因。”

Query_Text_en: These weeks and months could be a moment for her , or an eternity .
Translation: 接下来的数周乃至数月，对她而言，可能是转瞬即逝的关键时刻，也可能是绵延不绝的漫长岁月。

Query_Text_en: She could return any time , and she would not have changed at all .
Translation: 她随时可能回来，而她依然毫无变化。

Query_Text_en: I had killed her ; but for a species that does n't know time , death is just another experience among others , she 'd be back .
Translation: 我曾了结了她性命；但对一个不知时间为何物的物种而言，死亡不过是众多体验中的一种，她终将归来。

Query_Text_en: In the eternal night at the bottom of the great oceans , innumerable metal nodules are spread over the never-ending deep-sea plains .
Translation: 在各大洋的深处，永恒的黑暗之中，无数金属结核分布于无垠的深海平原之上。

Query_Text_en: At one time the continent will sink , and the nodule resume its journey over the deep-sea plains , toward its starting point .
Translation: 在某一时刻，大陆将下沉，结核将重新开始其在深海平原上的旅程，朝向其起点。

Query_Text_en: I watched my daughter playing on the beach , and I thought of the stones that started wandering long before life emerged on Earth and that will continue wandering long after it has disappeared .
Translation: 我看着女儿在沙滩上玩耍，不禁想到那些早在地球生命出现之前就开始漂泊的石头，它们将在生命消失之后仍将继续漂泊。

Query_Text_en: During the days and months that followed , I walked in the woods , pursued by shadows without names .
Translation: 在接下来的日子里和数月间，我在林间穿行，始终被无形的阴影所追逐。

Query_Text_en: I defended myself like when I was a kid , by walking certain trails without ever touching tree roots , or stepping over every second stone .
Translation: 我像小时候那样保护自己，走路时避开所有树根，或是每隔一块石头就跨过去。

Query_Text_en: Two inventions sparked the computer revolution .
Translation: 两项发明引发了计算机革命。

Query_Text_en: The first was the so-called stored program concept .
Translation: 第一个便是所谓的“存储程序”概念。

Query_Text_en: Every computer system since the late 1940s has adhered to this model , which prescribes a processor for crunching numbers and a memory for storing both data and programs .
Translation: 自20世纪40年代末以来，每一台计算机系统都沿用了这一模型，该模型规定处理器负责数值运算，而内存则用于存储数据和程序。

Query_Text_en: The advantage in such a system is that , because stored programs can be easily interchanged , the same hardware can perform a variety of tasks .
Translation: 这种系统的优点在于，由于存储程序可以灵活替换，因此同一硬件能够执行多种任务。

Query_Text_en: Had computers not been given this flexibility , it is probable that they would not have met with such widespread use .
Translation: 如果没有赋予计算机这种灵活性，可能就不会得到如此广泛的应用。

Query_Text_en: During the late I940s , researchers invented the transistor .
Translation: 20世纪40年代末，研究人员发明了晶体管。

Query_Text_en: These silicon switches were much smaller than the vacuum tubes used in early circuitry .
Translation: 这些硅开关的体积要比早期电路中使用的电子管小得多。

Query_Text_en: As such , they enabled workers to create smaller and faster electronics .
Translation: 因此，这使得工人得以制造出体积更小、运行更快的电子产品。

Query_Text_en: More than a decade passed before the stored program design and transistors were brought together in the same machine , and it was not until 1971 that the most significant pairing -- the Intel 4004-came about .
Translation: 直到1971年，最重要的组合——英特尔4004芯片才最终问世，而存储程序设计与晶体管在同台设备中实现整合，相隔了十余年。

Query_Text_en: This processor was the first to be built on a single silicon chip , which was no larger than a child 's fingernail .
Translation: 该处理器是首款被集成于单一硅芯片的产品，其尺寸仅有儿童指甲盖大小。

Query_Text_en: Because of its tiny size , it was dubbed a microprocessor .
Translation: 由于其体积微小，因此被命名为微处理器。

Query_Text_en: Although this basic recipe is still followed , the production line has made ever cheaper , faster chips over time by churning out larger wafers and smaller transistors .
Translation: 虽然这一基本工艺流程仍在沿用，但生产线通过不断生产更大尺寸的晶圆和更小的晶体管，逐渐制造出越来越便宜、性能更快的芯片。

Query_Text_en: This trend reveals an important principle of microprocessor economics : the more chips made per wafer , the less expensive they are .
Translation: 这一趋势揭示了微处理器经济学中的一个重要原则：每晶圆生产的芯片数量越多，其成本就越低。

Query_Text_en: Larger chips are faster than smaller ones because they can hold more transistors .
Translation: 更大的芯片比小芯片速度更快，因为它们能容纳更多晶体管。

Query_Text_en: But larger chips are also more likely to contain flaws .
Translation: 但芯片尺寸越大，其存在缺陷的可能性也越高。

Query_Text_en: Computer companies acted in concert to adopt this design strategy during the I980s , and as a result , the rate of improvement in microprocessor technology has risen from 35 percent a year only a decade ago to its current high of approximately 55 percent a year , or almost 4 percent each month .
Translation: 20世纪80年代，计算机企业协同采用这一设计策略，因此微处理器技术改进率由此从十年前的每年35%提升至目前的约每年55%，即每月近4%。

Query_Text_en: These breakthroughs will undoubtedly lead to further advancements in the near future .
Translation: 这些突破性进展必将推动未来不久的进一步发展。

Query_Text_en: One key technique is called pipelining .
Translation: 一个关键技术被称为流水线技术。

Query_Text_en: The pipelined approach is much quicker .
Translation: 流水线式方法要快得多。

Query_Text_en: As soon as the first load is in the dryer , the second dirty load goes into the washer , and so on .
Translation: 第一桶衣物放入烘干机后，第二桶脏衣物立即投入洗衣机，依此类推。

Query_Text_en: All the stages operate concurrently .
Translation: 所有阶段同步推进。

Query_Text_en: The pipelining paradox is that it takes the same amount of time to clean a single dirty sock by either method .
Translation: 流水线悖论在于，无论是采用哪种方法，清洗一只脏袜子所需的时间都相同。

Query_Text_en: Yet pipelining is faster in that more loads are finished per hour .
Translation: 然而，流水线作业更快，因为每小时完成的任务更多。

Query_Text_en: In fact , assuming that each stage takes the same amount of time , the time saved by pipelining is proportional to the number of stages involved .
Translation: 事实上，假设每个阶段耗时相同，流水线技术节省的时间与其涉及的阶段数量成正比。

Query_Text_en: In our example , pipelined laundry has four stages , so it would be nearly four times faster than nonpipelined laundry .
Translation: 在本例中，流水线洗衣包含四个阶段，因此其速度几乎达到非流水线洗衣的四倍。

Query_Text_en: Twenty loads would take roughly five hours .
Translation: 处理二十批大约需要五个小时。

Query_Text_en: Also in the interest of making faster chips , designers have begun to include more hardware to process more tasks at each stage of a pipeline .
Translation: 为了制造更快的芯片，设计人员开始在流水线的每个阶段增加更多硬件以处理更多任务。

Query_Text_en: The buzzword `` superscalar '' is commonly used to describe this approach .
Translation: “超标量”这一术语常被用来描述这一方法。

Query_Text_en: A superscalar laundromat , for example , would use a professional machine that could say and wash three loads at once .
Translation: 例如，一家超标量洗衣店会使用专业设备，能够一次同时洗涤三批衣物。

Query_Text_en: Modem superscalar microprocessors try to perform anywhere from three to six instructions in each stage .
Translation: 现代超标量微处理器力求在每个阶段执行三条至六条指令。

Query_Text_en: Hence , a 250 - megahertz , four-way superscalar microprocessor can execute a billion instructions per second .
Translation: 因此，一款250兆赫兹的四发射超标量微处理器每秒可以执行十亿条指令。

Query_Text_en: A 21st-century microprocessor may well launch up to dozens of instructions in each stage .
Translation: 21世纪的微处理器每个阶段可能最多执行几十条指令。

Query_Text_en: Since random-access memory -LRB- RAM -RRB- on a chip became widely available in the mid-I970s , its capacity has grown fourfold every three years .
Translation: 自20世纪70年代中期随机存取存储器（RAM）芯片普及应用以来，其容量每三年增长四倍。

Query_Text_en: But memory speed has not increased at anywhere near this rate .
Translation: 但存储速度的增长远未达到这一水平。

Query_Text_en: The gap between the top speed of processors and the top speed of memories is widening .
Translation: 处理器的最高速度与内存的最高速度之间的差距正在扩大。

Query_Text_en: The Holy Grail of computer design is an approach called parallel processing , which delivers all the benefits of a single fast processor by engaging many inexpensive ones at the same time .
Translation: 计算机设计领域的圣杯是一种名为并行处理的方法，它通过同时利用许多廉价处理器，能够带来单一快速处理器的所有优势。

Query_Text_en: In our analogy , we would go to a laundromat and use 20 washers and 20 dryers to do 20 loads simultaneously .
Translation: 在我们的类比中，我们会去洗衣店并使用20台洗衣机和20台干衣机同时进行20件洗衣任务。

Query_Text_en: Clearly , parallel processing is an expensive solution for a small workload .
Translation: 显然，并行处理对于小规模任务而言是一种昂贵的解决方案。

Query_Text_en: And writing a program that can use 20 processors at once is much harder than distributing laundry to 20 washers .
Translation: 编写一个能够同时调用20个处理器的程序，远比将衣物分配到20台洗衣机中困难得多。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , the program must specify which instructions can be launched by which processor at what time .
Translation: 事实上，该程序必须明确哪些指令可以在何时由哪个处理器启动。

Query_Text_en: What will be startling is that microprocessors will probably exist in everything from light switches to pieces of paper .
Translation: 令人惊讶的是，微处理器可能存在于从电灯开关到纸张等各类物品中。

Query_Text_en: And the range of applications these extraordinary devices will support , from voice recognition to virtual reality , will very likely be astounding
Translation: 这些非凡设备支持的应用范围，从语音识别到虚拟现实，很可能令人惊叹。

Query_Text_en: Today microprocessors and memories are made on distinct manufacturing lines , but it need not be so .
Translation: 如今，微处理器和内存是在独立的生产线上制造的，但情况并非必须如此。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps in the near future , processors and memory will be merged onto a single chip , just as the microprocessor first merged the separate components of a processor onto a single chip .
Translation: 或许在不久的将来，处理器和内存将被整合到单一芯片上，正如微处理器最初将处理器的各个独立部件整合到单一芯片上一样。

Query_Text_en: An earthquake is a shaking of the ground caused by the sudden breaking and shifting of large sections of the earth 's rocky outer shell .
Translation: 地震是由地球岩石圈大块板块突然断裂和错动引发的地面震动。

Query_Text_en: Earthquakes are among the most powerful events on earth , and their results can be terrifying .
Translation: 地震是地球上最具破坏力的自然现象之一，其后果往往令人不寒而栗。

Query_Text_en: A severe earthquake may release energy 10,000 times as great as that of the first atomic bomb .
Translation: 一次强烈地震所释放的能量可能达到第一颗原子弹的1万倍。

Query_Text_en: Rock movements during an earthquake can make rivers change their course .
Translation: 地震期间的岩层移动可能导致河流改道。

Query_Text_en: Earthquakes can trigger landslides that cause great damage and loss of life .
Translation: 地震可能引发山体滑坡灾害，造成重大损失和人员伤亡。

Query_Text_en: Large earthquakes beneath the ocean can create a series of huge , destructive waves called tsunamis that flood coasts for many miles .
Translation: 海底发生的大地震可能会引发一系列巨大而具有破坏性的海浪，即海啸，这些海浪会淹没数英里之遥的沿海地区。

Query_Text_en: On average , a powerful earthquake occurs less than once every two years .
Translation: 平均来看，强烈地震平均每两年不足一次。

Query_Text_en: At least 40 moderate earthquakes cause damage somewhere in the world each year .
Translation: 每年全球至少有40次中等地震造成损失，分布于世界各地。

Query_Text_en: About 40,000 to 50,000 small earthquakes large enough to be felt but not damaging occur annually .
Translation: 每年发生约4万至5万次强度足以被感知但不会造成破坏的小型地震。

Query_Text_en: To determine the strength and location of earthquakes , scientists use a recording instrument known as a seismograph is equipped with sensors called seismometers that can detect ground motions caused by seismic waves from both near and distant earthquakes .
Translation: 科学家通过一种名为地震仪的记录仪器来确定地震的强度和位置，该仪器配备有名为地震计的传感器，能够探测由近处和远处地震引发的地震波所导致的地面运动。

Query_Text_en: Some seismometers are capable of detecting ground motion as small as 1 billionth of a meter , or about 40 billionth of an inch .
Translation: 某些地震仪能够探测到小至十亿分之一米的地壳运动，约合四十亿分之一英寸。

Query_Text_en: Probably the best-known gauge of earthquake intensity is the local Richter magnitude scale , developed in 1935 by United States seismologist Charles F.Richter .
Translation: 衡量地震强度最著名的指标或许是地方性里氏震级，该指标由美国地震学家查尔斯·F·里克特于1935年创立。

Query_Text_en: This scale , commonly known as the Richter scale , measures the ground motion caused by an earthquake .
Translation: 该震级测定仪通常被称为里氏震级，用于测定地震引发的地面运动。

Query_Text_en: Although large earthquakes are customarily reported on the Richter scale , scientists prefer to describe earthquakes greater than 7.0 on the moment magnitude scale .
Translation: 虽然通常用里氏规模报道大地震，但科学家更倾向于用矩震级来描述震级超过7.0的地震。

Query_Text_en: The largest earthquake ever recorded on the moment magnitude scalemeasured 9.5 .
Translation: 有记录以来最大的矩震级地震达到了9.5级。

Query_Text_en: The largest interpolate earthquakes in the history of the United States were three quakes that occurred in New Madrid in 1811 and 1812 .
Translation: 美国历史上最大的板块内部地震是发生在1811年和1812年新马德里地区的三次地震。

Query_Text_en: The earthquakes were so powerful that they changed the course of the Mississippi River .
Translation: 地震威力如此强大，以至于改变了密西西比河的流向。

Query_Text_en: During the largest of them , the ground shook from southern Canada to the Gulf of Mexico and from the Atlantic Coast to the Rocky Mountains .
Translation: 在其中规模最大的一次中，地面剧烈震动，范围从加拿大南部一直延伸到墨西哥湾，从大西洋沿岸直达落基山脉。

Query_Text_en: Scientists estimate the earthquakes had moment magnitudes of about 7.5 .
Translation: 科学家估计，此次地震的矩震级约为7.5级。

Query_Text_en: Scientists locate earthquakes by measuring the time it takes body waves to arrive at seismographs in a minimum of three locations .
Translation: 科学家通过测量体波到达至少三个不同地点的地震仪所需的时间来确定地震的位置。

Query_Text_en: From these wave arrival times , seismologists can calculate the distance of an earthquake from each seismograph .
Translation: 通过分析这些波的到达时间，地震学家可以计算出地震发生地与每个地震仪之间的距离。

Query_Text_en: Scientists have developed a theory , called plate tectonics , that explains why most earthquakes occur .
Translation: 科学家提出了一种名为板块构造学说的理论，解释了大多数地震发生的原因。

Query_Text_en: As the plates move , they collide , move apart , or slide past one another .
Translation: 当板块移动时，它们可能发生碰撞、分离或相互擦过。

Query_Text_en: The movement of the plates strains the rock at and near plate boundaries and produces zones of faults around these boundaries .
Translation: 板块的运动使岩石在板块边界及其附近产生应力，并在这些边界周围形成断层带。

Query_Text_en: Along segments of some faults , the rock becomes locked in place and can not slide as the plates move .
Translation: 在某些断层的某些段落中，当板块移动时，岩石会被锁定无法滑动。

Query_Text_en: Stress builds up in the rock on both sides of the fault and causes the rock to break and shift in an earthquake .
Translation: 断层两侧的岩石中积累起应力，导致在地震中岩石破裂并发生位移。

Query_Text_en: When an earthquake occurs , the violent breaking of rock releases energy that travels through the earth in the form of vibrations called seismic waves .
Translation: 当地震发生时，岩石的剧烈断裂会释放出以地震波形式在地球中传播的能量。

Query_Text_en: Seismic waves move out from the focus of an earthquake in all directions .
Translation: 地震波从震源向各个方向传播。

Query_Text_en: Black holes are objects so dense that not even light can escape their gravity , and since nothing can travel faster than light , nothing can escape from inside a black hole .
Translation: 黑洞是密度极大的天体，其引力之强连光线也无法逃脱，由于没有任何物体的运动速度能够超过光速，因此黑洞内部的任何物质都无法逃脱。

Query_Text_en: Properties of black holes are indeed be defined by its mass , charge , and spin .
Translation: 黑洞的性质确实由其质量、电荷和自旋所决定。

Query_Text_en: The simplest type of black holes is the known as Schwarz child black holes , named after the scientist who discovered this solution of General Relativity .
Translation: 最简单的黑洞类型被称为史瓦西黑洞，以发现广义相对论这一解的科学家命名。

Query_Text_en: Contrary to popular belief , there is a great deal of observational evidence for the existence of two types of black holes , those with masses of a typical star , and those with masses of a typical galaxy .
Translation: 与普遍看法相反，存在两种黑洞的观测证据：一种质量与典型恒星相当，另一种质量与典型星系相当。

Query_Text_en: Black holes are the evolutionary endpoints of stars at least 10 to 15 times as massive as the Sun .
Translation: 黑洞是质量至少是太阳的10到15倍的恒星的演化终点。

Query_Text_en: If a star that massive or larger undergoes a supernova explosion , it may leave behind a fairly massive bummed out stellar remnant .
Translation: 如果某颗质量如此之大或更大的恒星发生超新星爆炸，它可能会留下一个质量较大的燃烧殆尽的恒星残骸。

Query_Text_en: But contrary to popular myth , a black hole is not a cosmic vacuum cleaner .
Translation: 但与普遍存在的误解相反，黑洞并非宇宙吸尘器。

Query_Text_en: If our Sun were suddenly replaced by a black hole of the same mass , the only thing that would change would be the Earth 's temperature .
Translation: 如果太阳突然被一个同等质量的黑洞取代，唯一会发生变化的是地球的温度。

Query_Text_en: To be `` sucked '' into a black hole , one has to cross inside the Schwarz child radius .
Translation: 要被黑洞吞噬，就必须穿过施瓦西半径。

Query_Text_en: At this radius , the escape speed is equal to the speed of light , and once light passes through , even it can not escape .
Translation: 在这个半径范围内，逃逸速度等于光速，一旦光线穿过这一区域，连它本身也无法逃脱。

Query_Text_en: A companion star is a perfect source of in falling material for a black hole .
Translation: 伴星是黑洞下落物质的理想来源。

Query_Text_en: A binary system also allows the calculation of the black hole candidate 's mass . Once the mass is found , it can be determined if the candidate is a neutron star or a black hole .
Translation: 双星系统也能够计算黑洞候选体的质量。一旦确定质量，就能判断该候选体是中子星还是黑洞。

Query_Text_en: Another sign of the presence of a black hole is random variation of emitted X-rays .
Translation: 黑洞存在的另一个迹象是其发出的X射线呈现随机波动。

Query_Text_en: The in falling matter that emits X-rays does not fall into the black hole at a steady rate , but rather more sporadically , which causes an observable variation in X-ray intensity .
Translation: 发出X射线的下落物质并非以稳定速率坠入黑洞，而是呈现间歇性，这导致X射线强度出现可观测的变化。

Query_Text_en: Additionally , if the X-ray source is in a binary system , the X-rays will be periodically cut off as the source eclipsed by the companion star .
Translation: 此外，如果X射线源位于双星系统中，由于该光源会被伴星遮挡，X射线会周期性地被切断。

Query_Text_en: When looking for black hole candidates , all these things are taken into account .
Translation: 在寻找黑洞候选体时，所有这些因素都会被考虑进去。

Query_Text_en: Many X-ray satellites have scanned the skies for X-ray sources that might be possible black hole candidates .
Translation: 许多X射线卫星已对天空进行扫描，以寻找可能成为黑洞候选体的X射线源。

Query_Text_en: There are no `` real '' pictures of a black hole .
Translation: 没有“真实”的黑洞图片。

Query_Text_en: As the human population grows , pollution from human activity also increases .
Translation: 随着人口增长，人类活动产生的污染也随之增加。

Query_Text_en: Currents in rivers , lakes , and oceans spread pollutants that are dumped into water . Pollution in soil can seep into ground water and appear later in wells .
Translation: 河流、湖泊和海洋中的水流会传播被排入水体的污染物。土壤中的污染物质会渗入地下水，并最终出现在井水中。

Query_Text_en: Scientists have found evidence of pollution everywhere on Earth , from the largest cities to the remote and isolated South Pole .
Translation: 科学家发现，地球各处都存在污染痕迹，从最大的城市到偏远与人迹罕至的南极洲。

Query_Text_en: Plant and animal life is sensitive to changes in the chemistry of the environment .
Translation: 动植物生命对环境化学成分的变化极为敏感。

Query_Text_en: There are many toxic -LRB- poisonous -RRB- pollutants , but the best studied are radioactive elements and certain chemical compounds used to kill insects .
Translation: 许多污染物具有毒性（即有毒物质），但研究最为深入的是放射性元素和某些用于杀虫的化学物质。

Query_Text_en: Radioactive elements give off radiation that is harmful to plants and animals . They have been well studied because scientists can measure and track them easily with instruments that detect the radiation they give off .
Translation: 放射性元素会释放对动植物有害的辐射。由于科学家能够借助探测其释放辐射的仪器轻松进行测量和追踪，这类元素的研究较为充分。

Query_Text_en: Such radioactive elements as strontium 90 were distributed worldwide in nuclear-bomb testing in the 1950 's and early 1960 's .
Translation: 如锶-90等放射性元素在20世纪50年代至60年代初的核试验中被散布到世界各地。

Query_Text_en: Studies of radioactive and chemical contaminants have taught scientists a great deal about the hazards of toxins and their threat to people and nature .
Translation: 对放射性和化学污染物的研究使科学家对毒素的危害及其对人类和自然的威胁有了深入了解。

Query_Text_en: One of scientists ' most important discoveries was that toxins released into the environment not only circulate widely in air and water , but also may appear in living creatures where concentrations are tens , hundreds , thousands , or hundreds of thousands of times higher than those measured in the air , water , or soil .
Translation: 科学家最重要的发现之一是，释放到环境中的毒素不仅在空气和水中广泛循环，还可能富集于生物体内，其浓度比在空气、水体或土壤中测得的数值高出数十、数百、数千乃至数万倍。

Query_Text_en: Scientists have found , however , that some of the compound remained in the air and was carried far away and sometimes fell with precipitation into bodies of water .
Translation: 然而，科学家发现，部分化合物残留在空气中，被带到遥远的地方，有时随降水落入水体。

Query_Text_en: DDT dissolves in fat but not water , so if the toxin contaminated a lake , river , or stream , it would bond to the fatty tissue in fish .
Translation: DDT易溶于脂肪但难溶于水，因此若该毒素污染了湖泊、河流或溪流，便会附着在鱼类的脂肪组织中。

Query_Text_en: Many countries , especially in the tropics , still permit the use of DDT .
Translation: 许多国家，尤其是热带国家，仍然允许使用DDT。

Query_Text_en: The compound continues to cause worldwide problems , because winds deposit it far from the place of use .
Translation: 该化合物仍在全球范围内引发问题，因为风会将其携带到远离使用地的地方。

Query_Text_en: As greenfly as 1991 , researchers reported finding DDT and other US-banned pesticides in US lakes .
Translation: 早在1991年，研究人员就报告在美国湖泊中发现了DDT和其他被美国禁用的农药。

Query_Text_en: Ecologists consider DDT and radioactive substances such as strontium 90 to be representative of contaminants as a whole .
Translation: 生态学家认为DDT和锶-90等放射性物质是整体污染物的典型代表。

Query_Text_en: Scientists are continuing to amass data concerning the effects of many other types of toxic pollutants .
Translation: 科学家们正在继续收集有关多种其他类型有毒污染物影响的数据。

Query_Text_en: Two of the most serious air pollutants are oxides of sulfur and of nitrogen .
Translation: 最主要的两种空气污染物是硫氧化物和氮氧化物。

Query_Text_en: A major source of these compounds is the burning of fossil fuels -LRB- coal , oil , and natural gas -RRB- in industry and in transportation .
Translation: 这些化合物的主要来源是工业和交通领域中化石燃料（煤、石油和天然气）的燃烧。

Query_Text_en: Sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides also cause acidic precipitation , commonly called acid rain .
Translation: 二氧化硫和氮氧化物也会导致酸性降水，即酸雨。

Query_Text_en: Acid rain results when the airborne pollutants combine with moisture in the air to form sulfuric and nitric acids that fall back to Earth , usually in rain or snow .
Translation: 酸雨是由空气中的污染物与大气中的水分结合形成硫酸和硝酸，并通常以雨水或降雪形式重返地表的现象。

Query_Text_en: Since the late I960 's , numerous scientific studies have demonstrated acid rain 's effects on the environment .
Translation: 自20世纪60年代末以来，大量科学研究表明了酸雨对环境的影响。

Query_Text_en: These studies have shown that acid rain hinders plant photosynthesis -LRB- the process by which plants make food from water , sunlight , and carbon dioxide -RRB- .
Translation: 这些研究表明，酸雨会抑制植物的光合作用（即植物通过水、阳光和二氧化碳制造养分的过程）。

Query_Text_en: Acid rain also contributes to the death of trees , destroys life in lakes and rivers , and damages statues and other structures .
Translation: 酸雨还导致树木死亡，破坏湖泊和河流中的生物，并侵蚀雕像及其他建筑物。

Query_Text_en: Scientists are accumulating evidence of the effects of heavy metals in the environment .
Translation: 科学家们正不断积累关于环境中重金属影响的证据。

Query_Text_en: Studies show that exposure to lead in soil or water can cause nervous system damage in children , and if human beings eat mercury-poisoned fish , the effects can be deadly .
Translation: 研究表明，接触受铅污染的土壤或水可能导致儿童神经系统损伤，若人类食用受汞污染的鱼类，后果可能致命。

Query_Text_en: Acid rain and heavy metals are only a few of the many pollutants that contaminate rivers , lakes , streams , seas , and oceans .
Translation: 酸雨和重金属只是众多污染河流、湖泊、溪流、海洋和大洋的污染物中的一部分。

Query_Text_en: Waste from industries is a Particularly important cause of water pollution . Factories may dump waste containing toxic chemicals directly into bodies of water or into sewerage systems .
Translation: 工业废水是水体污染尤为突出的原因。工厂可能将含有有毒化学物质的废弃物直接排入自然水体或污水系统。

Query_Text_en: Sewage itself is another major contaminant of water that can cause ecological problems and such human diseases as cholera and dysentery .
Translation: 污水是水体的另一种主要污染物，可能导致生态问题，并引发霍乱和痢疾等人畜共患疾病。

Query_Text_en: Marine life is also harmed by agricultural waste , chiefly runoff containing chemical fertilizers and pesticides .
Translation: 农业废弃物，尤其是含有化学肥料和农药的径流，也对海洋生物造成了危害。

Query_Text_en: Chemical pollutants released into water or spread through the air are often invisible to the human eye .
Translation: 排入水体或通过空气扩散的化学污染物通常肉眼不可见。

Query_Text_en: But the growing masses of solid waste that people produce are an all-too-visible pollutant in the form of trash .
Translation: 但人们产生的日益增多的固体废物已成为以垃圾形式存在的显而易见的污染物。

Query_Text_en: The EPA estimates that by 2000 , the United States will generate about 175 million metric tons of solid waste per year .
Translation: 美国环保署预计，到2000年时，美国每年将产生约1.75亿吨固体废物。

Query_Text_en: In most landfills , operators spread earth over the most recent garbage to keep rats , flies , and other vermin away .
Translation: 在大多数垃圾填埋场，作业人员会在最新填埋的垃圾上覆盖泥土，以防止老鼠、苍蝇等害虫侵扰。

Query_Text_en: Apart from the land that landfills pollute , they can also poison underground reservoirs of water with metals and dangerous chemicals from packaging materials and other debris .
Translation: 除了垃圾填埋场污染的土地外，这些设施还会通过包装材料及其他垃圾中的金属和有害化学物质污染地下水源。

Query_Text_en: This happens when rain seeps through garbage , dissolves the metals and chemicals , and carries them into the soil .
Translation: 当雨水渗透垃圾，溶解其中的金属和化学物质，并将其带入土壤时，这种情况就会发生。

Query_Text_en: Once in the ground , the compounds slowly filter down to enter water supplies -- which are often used for drinking water .
Translation: 一旦进入土壤，这些化合物会逐渐渗透并进入水源——其中许多被用于饮用水供应。

Query_Text_en: Blood does many things , of course , and artificial blood is designed to do only one of them : carry oxygen and carbon dioxide .
Translation: 当然，血液具有多种功能，而人造血液的设计目的仅在于实现其中一项功能：输送氧气和二氧化碳。

Query_Text_en: No substitutes have yet been invented that can replace the other vital functions of blood : coagulation and immune defense .
Translation: 目前尚未发明出能够替代血液其他关键功能（如凝血和免疫防御）的替代品。

Query_Text_en: Therefore , the replacement solutions being developed today are more accurately described as oxygen carriers .
Translation: 因此，目前正在开发的替代方案更准确地被描述为氧气载体。

Query_Text_en: There are basically two types of oxygen carriers , which differ in the way they transport oxygen .
Translation: 氧气载体主要有两种类型，其差异在于氧气的运输方式。

Query_Text_en: One is based on perfluorochemicals , the other on hemoglobin .
Translation: 一种基于全氟化合物，另一种基于血红蛋白。

Query_Text_en: Hemoglobin-based oxygen carriers -LRB- HBOCs -RRB- utilize the same oxygen-carrying protein molecule found in blood .
Translation: 血红蛋白基氧载体（HBOCs）采用与血液中相同的携氧蛋白质分子。

Query_Text_en: Oxygen bonds chemically to the hemoglobin , whereas it dissolves only into the perfluorocarbon emulsions .
Translation: 氧气与血红蛋白发生化学结合，而它仅溶解于全氟碳乳液中。

Query_Text_en: HBOCs differ from red blood cells in that the hemoglobin is not contained within a membrane .
Translation: 血红蛋白基氧载体与红细胞的不同之处在于，其血红蛋白并未包裹在膜结构中。

Query_Text_en: Two main problems arise when hemoglobin is removed from the red blood cells .
Translation: 当从红细胞中去除血红蛋白时，将出现两大主要问题。

Query_Text_en: Hemoglobin is the protein in red blood cells that is responsible for carrying oxygen from the lung to the other tissues .
Translation: 血红蛋白是红细胞中的一种蛋白质，负责将氧气从肺部运输到其他组织。

Query_Text_en: Therefore , the present approach for making blood substitutes is to use hemoglobin extracted from red blood cells .
Translation: 因此，目前制备血液代用品的方法是使用从红细胞中提取的血红蛋白。

Query_Text_en: Raw hemoglobin extracted from red blood cells can not be used as a blood substitute , however .
Translation: 然而，从红细胞中提取的未纯化血红蛋白不能用作血液替代品。

Query_Text_en: The first-generation hemoglobin blood substitutes rely on molecular modifications of hemoglobin , either by chemically cross-linking the molecules or by modifying them using recombinant DNA technology .
Translation: 第一代血红蛋白基血液替代物基于对血红蛋白的分子修饰，或是通过化学交联分子，或是利用重组DNA技术对其进行修饰。

Query_Text_en: So-called bifunctional agents can cross-link the hemoglobin molecules to one another to form polyhemoglobin .
Translation: 所谓的双功能试剂能够将血红蛋白分子相互交联，形成聚血红蛋白。

Query_Text_en: The cross-linked hemoglobin molecules are stable and do not break down .
Translation: 交联血红蛋白分子具有稳定性且不会分解。

Query_Text_en: Some bifunctional agents can also cross-link each hemoglobin molecule internally to prevent its breakdown into dimers .
Translation: 某些双功能试剂还可通过内部交联每个血红蛋白分子来防止其分解为二聚体。

Query_Text_en: Recombinant technology applied to the bacterium can produce altered hemoglobin molecules that do not break down into half molecules .
Translation: 将重组技术应用于该细菌可产生不会分解为半分子的修饰血红蛋白分子。

Query_Text_en: Hemoglobin can also be cross-linked to soluble polymers to form so-called conjugated hemoglobin .
Translation: 血红蛋白也可与可溶性聚合物交联以形成所谓的交联血红蛋白。

Query_Text_en: All the above modifications also result in blood substitutes that have a greater ability to release oxygen to the tissues than do red blood cells .
Translation: 上述所有改进使得产生的血液替代品比红细胞具有更强的向组织释放氧气的能力。

Query_Text_en: Unlike red blood cells , blood substitutes can be pasteurized , filtered and chemical-cleansed to make them sterile .
Translation: 与红细胞不同，血液替代品可以经过巴氏杀菌、过滤和化学净化处理以达到无菌状态。

Query_Text_en: These procedures remove microorganisms responsible for diseases such as AIDS and hepatitis .
Translation: 这些程序可去除导致艾滋病和肝炎等疾病的微生物。

Query_Text_en: The basic ideas of cross-linked hemoglobin and encapsulated hemoglobin date back to the 1960s .
Translation: 交联血红蛋白和包被血红蛋白的基本思想可追溯至20世纪60年代。

Query_Text_en: Concentrated efforts to develop blood substitutes for public use only seriously started after 1986 because of public concerns regarding HIV in donor blood .
Translation: 由于公众对献血中HIV的担忧，集中开展血液替代品研发工作以供公共使用，直到1986年后才真正开始。

Query_Text_en: Had there been a serious development effort in the 1960s , blood substitutes would have already been available in 1986 .
Translation: 如果20世纪60年代开展了系统性研发工作，血液替代品本可在1986年就已问世。

Query_Text_en: As it is , the public has continued to be exposed to the potential , though extremely rare , hazard of HIV in donor blood .
Translation: 目前，公众仍面临献血中潜在的、尽管极为罕见的HIV危害。

Query_Text_en: Unchecked , oxygen radicals may cause reperfusion injuries and other problems .
Translation: 若不加以控制，氧自由基可能导致再灌注损伤及其他问题。

Query_Text_en: Enzymes are also important in preventing hemoglobin from being oxidized to met hemoglobin , which can not carry oxygen .
Translation: 酶在防止血红蛋白氧化为无法携带氧气的高铁血红蛋白方面也具有重要作用。

Query_Text_en: Researchers are studying ways to solve this problem , including cross-linking the required enzymes to hemoglobin or further modifying the molecular structure of hemoglobin .
Translation: 研究人员正在研究解决这一问题的方法，包括将所需酶与血红蛋白交联，或进一步修改血红蛋白的分子结构。

Query_Text_en: These advances will appear in second-generation blood substitutes .
Translation: 这些进展将体现在第二代血液替代品中。

Query_Text_en: In addition to the hemoglobin substitutes discussed so far , there is another type of blood substitutes based on perfluorochemicals , synthetic fluids in which oxygen can dissolve .
Translation: 除了迄今为止讨论的血红蛋白替代品外，还有一种基于全氟化合物的血液替代品，其合成液体可溶解氧气。

Query_Text_en: Perfluorochemicals are made into fine emulsions for use as oxygen carriers .
Translation: 全氟化合物被制成微乳液，用作氧气载体。

Query_Text_en: Their biggest advantage is that they are synthetic materials and so can be produced in large amounts ; also , their purity can be more easily controlled .
Translation: 它们最大的优势在于属于合成材料，因此能够实现大规模生产；此外，其纯度也更易于控制。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , perfluorochemicals have a much lower capacity for carrying oxygen than does hemoglobin , so the patient must breathe an oxygen-rich air mixture .
Translation: 另一方面，全氟化合物的携氧能力远低于血红蛋白，因此患者必须吸入富含氧气的空气混合物。

Query_Text_en: Improved fluorochemicals have recently made it possible to use a higher concentration of perfluorochemicals without causing medical complications . .
Translation: 改进的氟化物技术使应用更高浓度的全氟化合物成为可能，同时不会引发医疗并发症。

Query_Text_en: The extinctions or threatened extinctions of many species are but the most visible and well-known manifestation of a deeper and more far-reaching trend .
Translation: 许多物种的灭绝或濒危灭绝不过是更深层和影响更为深远的趋势最显而易见且广为人知的表现。

Query_Text_en: The recent Global Biodiversity Assessment of the United Nations Environment Program -LRB- UNEP -RRB- has identified four major causes of the present decrease in biodiversity , and a fifth , which may yet prove to be important .
Translation: 联合国环境规划署（UNEP）近期发布的《全球生物多样性评估》指出，当前生物多样性下降的主要原因共有四项，第五个原因可能同样重要。

Query_Text_en: Changes in how the land is used are probably the principal contributor to the current decline in biodiversity .
Translation: 土地使用方式的变化可能是导致当前生物多样性减少的主要因素。

Query_Text_en: The pressures on terrestrial resources and land depend very much on population growth and the demands of early stages of economic development .
Translation: 对陆地资源和土地的压力在很大程度上取决于人口增长以及经济发展初期阶段的需求。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , land acquisition , especially for agriculture and forestry , focuses initially on those areas with the most fertile soils and equable climates , which are often the areas of greatest biological diversity .
Translation: 此外，土地获取，尤其是农业和林业领域，最初主要集中在土壤最为肥沃且气候温和的地区，而这些地区往往也是生物多样性最为丰富的区域。

Query_Text_en: Deforestation in the humid tropics is probably the best-known current example of rapid land-use change .
Translation: 热带湿润地区的森林砍伐很可能是目前快速土地利用变化最著名的例子。

Query_Text_en: The rates of extinction of local species that accompany these rapid changes in land cover may soon be far in excess of what is found today , reaching as high as 10,000 times the natural background rate .
Translation: 伴随土地覆盖快速变化而出现的本地物种灭绝速度可能很快会远超当前水平，达到自然背景灭绝率的1万倍。

Query_Text_en: Analyses of potential impacts on biodiversity that are based on simple measures of deforested area can provide little more than very general conclusions .
Translation: 基于森林砍伐面积的简单衡量指标开展的对生物多样性潜在影响的分析，只能得出非常笼统的结论。

Query_Text_en: Heavy applications of fertilizers and pesticides have the potential of creating additional environmental problems as well as affecting the abundance and viability of the other plants and animals and micro-organisms in the same or adjoining areas .
Translation: 化肥和农药的大量使用可能引发新的环境问题，同时影响同一或相邻区域内其他动植物及微生物的数量和存活能力。

Query_Text_en: In addition , because of the understandable tendency to put the best land into production first , the expansion of agriculture into less fertile areas typically requires heavier applications of chemicals , more extensive site preparation , and other forms of more intensive management .
Translation: 此外，由于人们自然倾向于优先开发优质土地，农业向地力较差的地区扩张通常需要增加化肥使用量、加强土地整治以及采取其他更加集约化的管理措施。

Query_Text_en: The typical result is increased chemical run-off to the landscape , and with ensuing degradation , additional pressure for expansion , and so on .
Translation: 典型结果是化学物质径流增加进入周边环境，进而导致环境退化，进一步加剧扩张压力，如此循环往复。

Query_Text_en: It is such a cycle that has led to widespread desertification in some parts of the world , primarily through overgrazing that can be compounded by naturally occurring droughts .
Translation: 正是这种循环导致世界某些地区出现大面积荒漠化，主要原因在于过度放牧，并可能因自然发生的干旱而加剧。

Query_Text_en: The widespread increase of various pollutants and poisonous or toxic substances in the environment has had obvious local impacts on biodiversity in acutely affected areas .
Translation: 环境中各类污染物和有毒有害物质的普遍增加，对受严重影响地区的生物多样性造成了显著的局部影响。

Query_Text_en: Another concern is that long-term pollution , at even low levels , can affect whole ecosystems , with resultant impacts on biodiversity that bring about additional changes in how ecosystems operate .
Translation: 另一个担忧是，长期污染即使在低浓度水平下，也可能影响整个生态系统，进而对生物多样性产生影响，从而进一步改变生态系统的运作方式。

Query_Text_en: The chain of events through which central European forests have responded to acid deposition is a ready example .
Translation: 中欧森林应对酸沉降的事件链是一个典型例证。

Query_Text_en: There , the chronic deposition of airborne acidic substances from industrial effluents affects both chemical processes and essential microorganisms in the soil , lowering the vitality of trees and ground-cover and making groundwater , streams , and lakes more acidic .
Translation: 工业排放产生的空气中的酸性物质长期沉积，既影响土壤中的化学过程和关键微生物，又降低树木及地表植被的生命力，同时加剧了地下水、溪流和湖泊的酸化程度。

Query_Text_en: But the same insecticides can also mimic hormones that regulate the physiological functions of non-target species , especially the reproductive functions .
Translation: 但同样的杀虫剂也可能模拟调控非靶标物种生理机能的激素，尤其是生殖机能的激素。

Query_Text_en: This raises the concern that the ever-increasing load of these compounds in natural systems may impact wildlife in general , and even humans .
Translation: 这引发了人们对于这些化合物在自然系统中的日益增加可能对野生动物总体产生影响，甚至可能波及人类的担忧。

Query_Text_en: Natural variations in climate are among the more important causes of past changes in biodiversity , both locally and for the Earth as a whole .
Translation: 气候自然变化是过去生物多样性变迁的重要原因之一，无论是局部地区还是对整个地球而言均是如此。

Query_Text_en: The prospect of human-induced changes in the climate adds new concerns , however , particularly if the rate of change should prove as rapid as many now foresee .
Translation: 然而，气候变化的人为改变前景增添了新的担忧，尤其是如果变化速度真如许多预测所言之快的话。

Query_Text_en: Current projections of general circulation models imply rates of change of the global climate system that exceed those of almost any natural variation in the geologic past .
Translation: 当前全球气候模型的预测显示，全球气候系统的变率已超过地质历史上几乎所有自然变化的速率。

Query_Text_en: These rapid changes in surface temperature and other weather parameters could lead to severe mismatches between regional conditions and the physiological requirements of many plant species .
Translation: 地表温度和其他气象参数的快速变化可能导致区域环境条件与众多植物物种的生理需求之间出现严重不匹配。

Query_Text_en: Were the average surface temperature to rise by several degrees C , that warming would probably be followed by potentially large re-organizations of some ecological communities .
Translation: 如果地表平均温度上升几摄氏度，这种变暖可能会导致某些生态群落发生潜在的大规模重组。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , some forest ecosystem models have suggested that rapid and extensive diebacks of certain trees could occur over much of their current range .
Translation: 同样地，一些森林生态系统模型表明，某些树种可能在其现有分布区域的大部分地区发生快速且广泛的大面积枯死。

Query_Text_en: Were this to happen , there would undoubtedly be an associated wave of changes in the fauna as well .
Translation: 如果这种情况发生，无疑也会引发动物群的一系列相关变化。

Query_Text_en: From an economic perspective , much more work needs to be done to put a fair and meaningful valuation on biodiversity .
Translation: 从经济角度看，仍需开展大量工作以建立公平且具有实际意义的生物多样性评估体系。

Query_Text_en: The service aspects of biodiversity must be understood , and market mechanisms put in place to include these very real factors in both policy and business decisions .
Translation: 生物多样性的服务功能必须得到充分认识，并建立市场机制，将这些现实因素纳入政策制定和商业决策之中。

Query_Text_en: It is no exaggeration that Earth has been called the `` water planet '' .
Translation: 毫不夸张地说，地球被称为"水行星"。

Query_Text_en: This simple molecule consists of one oxygen atom and two hydrogen atoms .
Translation: 这种简单的分子由一个氧原子和两个氢原子组成。

Query_Text_en: On freezing the general tendency of matter is to contract .
Translation: 在冻结过程中，物质通常的特性是收缩。

Query_Text_en: On the contrary , water anomalously expands on freezing especially below 4 Â° C , and the ice thus formed floats in water .
Translation: 相反，水在结冰时会异常膨胀，尤其是在低于4摄氏度时，因此形成的冰会浮在水面上。

Query_Text_en: This phenomenon has important ecological implications in that if ice were to be denser than water , then the lakes , exposed to low temperatures would start freezing from the bottom up .
Translation: 这一现象具有重要的生态意义，因为如果冰的密度大于水，那么在低温环境下，湖泊会从底部开始结冰。

Query_Text_en: This type of ice formation would then have prevented ice water fishes and other living organisms inclusive of vegetation from surviving due to extreme cold conditions .
Translation: 这种类型的冰层形成会因极端寒冷的条件，导致冰水中的鱼类以及包括植物在内的其他生物无法生存。

Query_Text_en: Its polarity and electrical conductivity make it an ideal solvent for conducting the chemical reactions that are the basis of metabolism the heat capacity of water is also very high or in other words , a large amount of heat is needed to raise its temperature by a degree .
Translation: 水的极性和导电性使其成为进行作为新陈代谢基础的化学反应的理想溶剂。水的比热容也非常高，或者说，要使其温度升高一度需要吸收大量热量。

Query_Text_en: Despite the fact that large amount of heat is generated by these metabolic activities , the temperature of the cell-water system does not rise beyond reasonable limits .
Translation: 尽管这些代谢活动会产生大量热量，但细胞-水系统的温度不会超出合理限度。

Query_Text_en: Water has a high heat of vaporization resulting in perspiration being an effective method of cooling the body .
Translation: 由于水的汽化热较高，因此排汗成为有效的身体降温方式。

Query_Text_en: Hydrogen bond that are the glue holding groups of water molecules together are so plentiful in water that they play a large role in determining its properties .
Translation: 氢键作为将水分子集团粘合在一起的粘合剂，在水中数量如此之多，因此在决定其性质方面起着重要作用。

Query_Text_en: Hydrogen bonding between water molecules occurs not only in liquid water but also in ice and in water vapor .
Translation: 水分子之间的氢键作用不仅存在于液态水中，还存在于冰和水蒸气中。

Query_Text_en: It has been estimated from the heat of fusion of ice that only a small fraction , say about 10 per cent of hydrogen bonds in ice are broken when it melts at 2 Â° C.
Translation: 根据冰的熔化热估计，当冰在2°C熔化时，仅断裂了大约10%的氢键。

Query_Text_en: Liquid water is still hydrogen bonded at 100 Â° C as indicated by its high heat of vaporization and dielectric constant .
Translation: 液态水在100摄氏度时仍存在氢键结合，如其较高的汽化热和介电常数所示。

Query_Text_en: The importance of water is further enhanced as it is expected to be the source of energy in the future .
Translation: 鉴于其有望成为未来能源的重要来源，水的重要性将进一步提升。

Query_Text_en: Hydrogen , which is expected to be an energy carrier , can be obtained from water using any primary energy source like solar energy , electricity or thermal energy or a hybrid system consisting of more than one of these primary energy sources .
Translation: 氢作为预期的能源载体，可从水中制取，所用能源可以是太阳能、电能、热能等任何一次能源，或是由多种此类一次能源组成的混合系统。

Query_Text_en: Hydrogen , a secondary energy carrier , can be converted to produce water and this water appears to be an endless source of energy .
Translation: 氢作为一种二次能源载体，通过转化可生成水，而水可作为取之不尽的能源。

Query_Text_en: Water is extremely important for structural stabilisation of proteins , lipids , membranes and cells .
Translation: 水对于蛋白质、脂质、膜和细胞的结构稳定至关重要。

Query_Text_en: Any attempt to remove water from these structures will lead to many changes in their physical properties and structural stability .
Translation: 任何试图从这些结构中去除水分的行为，都将导致其物理性质和结构稳定性的诸多变化。

Query_Text_en: Researchers argue that a living thing has organised structure and as long as the structural integrity is not violated , the organism is alive .
Translation: 研究人员指出，生命体具有组织结构，只要结构完整性未遭到破坏，该生物体便处于存活状态。

Query_Text_en: Trehalose and sucrose maintain the structural organization in anhydrobiotic organisms on dehydration .
Translation: 在脱水状态下，海藻糖和蔗糖能够维持隐生生物的结构组织。

Query_Text_en: Now the most important question before the scientific community is whether the findings on life without water can be extended to enhance the longevity of the human race .
Translation: 目前科学界面临的最重要问题是，关于无水生命的发现能否被进一步应用以延长人类寿命。

Query_Text_en: It is understood that the Government has already agreed to the use of the so-called Frankenstein technology , believing the benefits outweigh ethical concerns .
Translation: 据悉，政府已同意使用所谓的"弗兰肯斯坦技术"，认为其益处大于伦理顾虑。

Query_Text_en: Researchers think it will be possible to grow brain tissue to combat degenerative diseases like Alzheimer 's , and `` spare part '' organs like hearts and kidneys for transplant .
Translation: 研究人员认为，未来有望培育脑组织以对抗阿尔茨海默病等退行性疾病，并培育心脏、肾脏等可用于移植的备用器官。

Query_Text_en: Ministers are aware that the change in the law which will be required will be equally as explosive and contentious as that which legalised abortion more than 30 years ago .
Translation: 部长们清楚，所需进行的法律变更将同样具有爆炸性和争议性，就像30多年前合法化流产的那项立法一样。

Query_Text_en: Church leaders and anti abortion campaigners have long expressed their horror at the plans , arguing that even the earliest embryos are forms of human life .
Translation: 宗教领袖和反堕胎活动人士长期以来一直对该计划表示强烈反对，认为即使是最早期的胚胎也属于人类生命形式。

Query_Text_en: The cloning of human embryos to provide spare parts and tissues is seen by most experts as a vital step forward in 21st century medicine .
Translation: 大多数专家认为，克隆人类胚胎以提供器官和组织是21世纪医学发展的重要一步。

Query_Text_en: Scientists say treatment of diseases such as Alzheimer 's and Parkinson 's will be the first application of therapeutic cloning .
Translation: 科学家表示，治疗阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等疾病的方法将成为治疗性克隆技术的首个应用领域。

Query_Text_en: The ability to clone embryos was perfected by scientists in Scotland in the late 1990s and the ability to grow stem cells into tissues and organs is being developed by American researchers .
Translation: 20世纪90年代末，苏格兰科学家完善了克隆胚胎的技术，而美国研究人员目前正在开发将干细胞培育成组织和器官的能力。

Query_Text_en: Combining the two technologies , it is hoped , will mean an end to long waits for organs from donors and problems caused by rejection of transplanted tissues by the body .
Translation: 结合两种技术有望结束患者等待捐献器官的漫长周期以及移植组织排异反应引发的问题。

Query_Text_en: Scientists like Lan Wilmut at the Roslin Research Institute near Edinburgh , the man who cloned Dolly the sheep , has warned that British expertise will go to America , where such work is legal , if the Government does not give the go-ahead .
Translation: 爱丁堡附近的罗斯林研究所科学家、克隆多利羊的科学家兰·威尔穆特警告称，如果政府不批准相关研究，英国的专业知识将流向美国——因为该国允许此类研究。

Query_Text_en: As the epidemic rages , scientists patiently invent the ultimate vaccine .
Translation: 疫情肆虐之际，科学家们孜孜不倦地研发最有效疫苗。

Query_Text_en: That goes without saying . It must be terrible over there . ''
Translation: 这是不言而喻的。那边的情况一定很糟糕。

Query_Text_en: Meanwhile English authorities have stepped up their efforts to contain it , putting up a `` firewall '' killing zone around infected farms .
Translation: 与此同时，英国当局已加强防控措施，并在受感染的农场周围设立"防火墙"式扑杀区。

Query_Text_en: They have already slaughtered or marked for slaughter more than 834,000 pigs , sheep and cattle .
Translation: 他们已屠宰或标记为待屠宰的猪、牛、羊超过83.4万头。

Query_Text_en: Britain 's chief scientific adviser warned that the epidemic could grow tenfold in the coming months and wipe out one ha of the country 's livestock .
Translation: 英国首席科学顾问警告称，疫情可能在未来几个月内增长十倍，并摧毁该国一半的牲畜。

Query_Text_en: U. S. Customs officials are on the alert , but there 's only so much they can do .
Translation: 美国海关官员已保持警惕，但他们的能力毕竟有限。

Query_Text_en: Random spot checks at Miami International Airport yield about 2,000 pounds of illegal meat products a day .
Translation: 迈阿密国际机场的随机抽查行动每天查获约2000磅非法肉类制品。

Query_Text_en: Opened in 1954 by the U. S. Agriculture Department , the research facility is the only laboratory in the country , and one of only a handful worldwide , currently developing and testing a vaccine for foot-and-mouth disease .
Translation: 该研究设施由美国农业部于1954年建立，是目前全国唯一、全球范围内仅有的少数几家致力于口蹄疫疫苗研发与测试的实验室之一。

Query_Text_en: New workers often report fatigue because the air inside the lab has been thinned to create a suction that keeps it from migrating out .
Translation: 新员工经常报告感到疲劳，因为实验室内的空气被减压以形成吸力，防止其向外泄漏。

Query_Text_en: Overall , the security precautions add $ 11 million a year to the budget -- about 10 times the lab 's budget for vaccine development .
Translation: 总体而言，安全防范措施每年为预算增加1100万美元开支——大约是该实验室疫苗研发预算的十倍。

Query_Text_en: For more than 40 years , few people outside the government were allowed on the island .
Translation: 四十多年来，岛上只允许极少数非政府人员登岛。

Query_Text_en: The virologist on Mason 's team , has developed a `` recombinant DNA '' vaccine that uses bits of DNA to trigger an immune response in animals .
Translation: 梅森团队的病毒学家研发出一种"重组DNA疫苗"，该疫苗利用DNA片段来激发动物体内的免疫反应。

Query_Text_en: So researchers are using molecular anthropology to seek the origins of disease and then using that knowledge to create customized treatments .
Translation: 因此，研究人员正借助分子人类学探寻疾病起源，并利用这些知识研发定制化治疗方案。

Query_Text_en: At each nuclear locus you may have a gene from a different set of two of those ancestors . ''
Translation: 在每个核位点上，你携带的基因可能来自这些祖先中的不同两个来源。

Query_Text_en: Thus nuclear DNA paints a much fuller picture of the past than mitochondrial and Y , which represent only two ancestors in any generation .
Translation: 因此，核DNA比线粒体DNA和Y染色体能更全面地描绘过去，因为后者在任何一代中只能追溯到两位祖先。

Query_Text_en: Kidd is now studying nuclear DNA in 33 populations around the world , seeking a better understanding of schizophrenia , Tourette 's syndrome , and alcoholism .
Translation: 基德目前正在对全球33个族群的核DNA进行研究，以期更深入理解精神分裂症、妥瑞氏症和酗酒症。

Query_Text_en: Science is far from being able to simply scan the human genome to find the causes of complex diseases like these .
Translation: 科学还远未达到仅凭扫描人类基因组就能找到此类复杂疾病病因的程度。

Query_Text_en: But the day will come , and soon , when it will be possible to pinpoint the genetic roots of disease without the geographic history .
Translation: 但很快就会有这样一天，人们能够无需考虑地理分布背景，就能精确确定疾病的基因根源。

Query_Text_en: Last fall , McNeil Consumer Healthcare , introduced a margarine called Benecol that promises to lower cholesterol by about 10 percent .
Translation: 去年秋季，美华消费者健康公司推出了一款名为Benecol的人造黄油，声称可降低胆固醇约10%。

Query_Text_en: In the future , expect lower-calorie cooking oils , oil with vitamin A , and potatoes with added genes that make them .
Translation: 未来，人们可以期待低热量食用油、添加维生素A的食用油以及通过基因改良增强特性的马铃薯。

Query_Text_en: Despite their pledges of better health , not all of these products will actually become widespread .
Translation: 尽管这些产品承诺提升健康效益，但并非所有产品都将真正普及。

Query_Text_en: In 1994 , for example , a company called Calgene now owned by Monsanto marketed a tomato that had been genetically modified to ripen more slowly than traditional tomatoes .
Translation: 例如，1994年，当时由孟山都公司旗下的卡利基恩公司推出了一种经过基因改造可比传统番茄更缓慢成熟的番茄。

Query_Text_en: Called the Flavr Savr , the tomato reached the supermarket at peak ripeness .
Translation: 被称为“Flavr Savr”的番茄在最佳成熟度时进入超市货架。

Query_Text_en: In test markets , consumers chose price over taste and the company pulled the product .
Translation: 在测试市场，消费者更倾向于价格而非口味，该公司随后撤回了该产品。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , Benecol can cost twice as much as regular margarine , and sales so far have been flat .
Translation: 同样，贝内科的价格是普通人造黄油的两倍，而迄今为止其销售情况一直未见起色。

Query_Text_en: ' Quit while you 're ahead . ' That 's tried-and-true advice . But did you know it goes all the way back to Baltasar Gracidn , a Jesuit scholar who lived in 17th-century Spain ?
Translation: “见好就收。”这是句经得住考验的忠告。但你知道吗？它的源头可以追溯到17世纪西班牙的耶稣会学者巴尔塔萨·格拉西登？

Query_Text_en: As military chaplain and confessor to the mighty , Gracidn observed men in positions of power and concluded that , with intelligence and a rein on one 's emotions , almost anyone could master a situation and be successful .
Translation: 作为军队牧师和权贵的告解神父，格拉西丁观察了身处高位者的行为，得出结论：只要兼具智慧且能克制情绪，几乎任何人都能掌控局势并取得成功。

Query_Text_en: So he set down 300 maxims to instruct his contemporaries in the art of achieving .
Translation: 于是他编纂了300条箴言，旨在教导同时代之人掌握成就之道。

Query_Text_en: Recently retranslated and a best-seller y they are as appropriate today as they were three centuries ago .
Translation: 最近重新翻译出版并成为畅销书，如今它们依然如三个世纪前般适用。

Query_Text_en: Keep matters in suspense .
Translation: 保持悬而未决。

Query_Text_en: Being too obvious is neither useful nor tasteful .
Translation: 过于直白既无实用价值，亦不雅观。

Query_Text_en: By not declaring yourself immediately , you keep people guessing .
Translation: 若不立即表明立场，便能让他人难以揣测。

Query_Text_en: Cautious silence is where prudence takes refuge .
Translation: 审慎的沉默是明智的藏身之所。

Query_Text_en: Once declared , resolutions lie open to criticism .
Translation: 一旦宣布，决议便随时接受批评。

Query_Text_en: If they turn out badly , you will be twice unfortunate .
Translation: 如果事情结果不理想，你就会不幸中的不幸。

Query_Text_en: Know your best quality .
Translation: 认清自身优势。

Query_Text_en: Foster your most outstanding gift and nurture the rest .
Translation: 重点培育你最杰出的才能，同时发展其他方面。

Query_Text_en: All people could achieve eminence in something if only they knew what they excelled at .
Translation: 只要每个人知道自己擅长什么，就能在某个领域取得卓越成就。

Query_Text_en: Never exaggerate .
Translation: 切勿夸大。

Query_Text_en: Superlatives offend the truth and cast doubt on your judgment .
Translation: 使用最高级的形容词会损害真相并引发对判断的质疑。

Query_Text_en: The prudent show restraint , and would rather fall short than long .
Translation: 审慎者有所节制，宁缺毋滥。

Query_Text_en: To overvalue something is a form of lying . It can ruin your reputation for good taste and wisdom .
Translation: 过分评价事物属于说谎的一种形式。这会损害你优雅与睿智的形象。

Query_Text_en: Adapt to those around you .
Translation: 与周围的人群保持适应。

Query_Text_en: Do n't put more effort into things than they require , Don , t show off every day , or you , ll stop surprising people .
Translation: 不要在事情上投入超过其所需的努力，也不要每日炫耀，否则你将失去让人惊喜的能力。

Query_Text_en: There must always be some novelty left over .
Translation: 必须始终留存一些新意。

Query_Text_en: The person who displays a little more of it each day keeps up expectations , and no one ever discovers the limits of his talent .
Translation: 每日多展几分之人可保持期望不减，无人得窥其才之极限。

Query_Text_en: Associate with those you can learn from .
Translation: 与能够从中学习的人结交。

Query_Text_en: Make your friends your teachers , and blend the usefulness of learning with the pleasure of conversation .
Translation: 以友为师，将学习的实用价值与交谈之乐融为一体。

Query_Text_en: Enjoy the company of people of understanding .
Translation: 与通情达理者共处。

Query_Text_en: What you say will be rewarded with applause , what you hear , with learning .
Translation: 你所说的话语将赢得掌声，你所听闻的将收获学识。

Query_Text_en: Do n't be tiresome .
Translation: 别烦人。

Query_Text_en: Brevity is pleasant and flattering , and it gets more done .
Translation: 简洁令人愉悦且广受欢迎，更能取得实效。

Query_Text_en: Good things , if brief : twice good .
Translation: 美好的事物，若简短则加倍美好。

Query_Text_en: Badness , if short , is n't so bad .
Translation: 若负面影响的持续时间较短，则其影响相对有限。

Query_Text_en: Well said is quickly said .
Translation: 说起来容易，做起来难。

Query_Text_en: Plan for bad fortune while your fortune is good .
Translation: 居安思危，未雨绸缪。

Query_Text_en: In the summer it is wise to provide for winter , and it is easier to do so .
Translation: 夏季未雨绸缪是明智之举，且更为可行。

Query_Text_en: Favors are less expensive , and friendships abound .
Translation: 人情往来成本更低，关系网络更为紧密。

Query_Text_en: Keep a following of friends and grateful people , someday you will value what now seems unimportant
Translation: 与朋友及感恩之人保持联系，终将珍视当下看似微不足道的事物。

Query_Text_en: Do n't talk about yourself .
Translation: 不要谈论自己。

Query_Text_en: You must either praise yourself , which is vanity , or criticize yourself9 which is meekness .
Translation: 您必须要么自夸，这是虚荣；要么自责，这是谦逊。

Query_Text_en: You show a lack of good judgment and become a nuisance to others .
Translation: 你缺乏良好的判断力，成为他人的负担。

Query_Text_en: The wise do sooner what fools do later .
Translation: 智者未雨绸缪，愚者亡羊补牢。

Query_Text_en: There is only one good way to see the light : as soon as possible .
Translation: 要看到光明，唯一的良策就是尽快行动。

Query_Text_en: Otherwise , you do out of necessity what you might have done with pleasure .
Translation: 否则，你将不得不去做那些本可以心甘情愿去做的事情。

Query_Text_en: The wise size up immediately what has to be done , sooner or later , and do it with pleasure , enhancing their reputation .
Translation: 明智者能迅速判断出必须做的事，无论早晚，乐此不疲地付诸行动，从而提升自身声望。

Query_Text_en: Never complain .
Translation: 永不抱怨。

Query_Text_en: Complaints will always discredit you .
Translation: 投诉必将损害您的信誉。

Query_Text_en: Rather than compassion , they provoke insolence and encourage others to behave like those we complain about .
Translation: 他们煽动傲慢而非怜悯，纵容他人效仿我们所指责的对象。

Query_Text_en: It is better to praise others , so as to win still more favors of them .
Translation: 称赞他人更为妥当，以便赢得他们的更多支持。

Query_Text_en: Do n't be made of glass .
Translation: 别太玻璃心。

Query_Text_en: Some people break very easily , revealing how fragile they are .
Translation: 有些人很容易崩溃，从而暴露了他们的脆弱性。

Query_Text_en: They fill up with resentment and fill others with annoyance .
Translation: 他们滋生怨恨，招致他人不满。

Query_Text_en: More sensitive than the pupils of the eyes , they are full of themselves , and slaves to their own taste .
Translation: 他们比眼睛的瞳孔还要敏感，自负自满，沦为自身偏好的奴隶。

Query_Text_en: Do n't live in a hurry .
Translation: 切莫匆忙度日。

Query_Text_en: If you know how to organize things , you will know how to enjoy them .
Translation: 若能统筹事务，便知善用之道。

Query_Text_en: Many want to devour in a day what they could hardly digest in a lifetime .
Translation: 许多人贪图在一日之内完成毕生难以为继的任务。

Query_Text_en: Show moderation , so that things known wo n't be badly known .
Translation: 保持克制，以免已知之事沦为谬误。

Query_Text_en: Be quick to act , slow to enjoy .
Translation: 行动雷厉风行，享受慎之又慎。

Query_Text_en: Follow through on your victories .
Translation: 巩固胜利成果，持续推进。

Query_Text_en: Some people do everything to begin and nothing to end .
Translation: 有些人凡事开头热情高涨，收尾时却毫无作为。

Query_Text_en: Fickle characters , they start but don , t persist .
Translation: 这些善变的参与者，往往虎头蛇尾，难以持之以恒。

Query_Text_en: This shows either inconstancy or having rashly attempted the impossible .
Translation: 这表明要么缺乏恒心，要么是贸然尝试了不可能之事。

Query_Text_en: What is worth doing is worth finishing .
Translation: 值得做的事情就值得完成到底。

Query_Text_en: The wise do n't merely stalk their prey t they make the kill .
Translation: 智者不仅追踪目标，更果断行动。

Query_Text_en: Quit while you are ahead .
Translation: 见好就收。

Query_Text_en: All the best gamblers do .
Translation: 最优秀的赌徒皆如此。

Query_Text_en: A fine retreat matters as much as a stylish attack .
Translation: 良好的撤退与精妙的进攻同样重要。

Query_Text_en: Lady Luck grows tired when she has to carry someone on her back for a long time .
Translation: 幸运女神若长期扶持某人，终将力竭。

Query_Text_en: Be careful the way you end things , and devote more attention to a successful exit than a favorable entrance .
Translation: 在处理收尾事宜时务必谨慎，比起注重顺利开局，更应重视圆满收官。

Query_Text_en: What matters is n't being applauded when you arrive , but being missed when you leave .
Translation: 重要的不是初来乍到时受到喝彩，而在于离任时被人铭记。

Query_Text_en: Stephen King , author of nightmare-inducing horror novels , has a recurring nightmare of his own :
Translation: 以擅长创作令人做噩梦的恐怖小说闻名的斯蒂芬·金，自己也经历着反复出现的噩梦：

Query_Text_en: He , s working in a hot , cramped room and a madwoman is hiding behind the attic door , brandishing a scalpel .
Translation: 他正在一个闷热狭小的房间里工作，而一个疯女人正躲在阁楼门后，挥舞着手术刀。

Query_Text_en: If he does n't finish his work , she 'll burst through the door .
Translation: 如果他不完成工作，她就会破门而入。

Query_Text_en: And she does .
Translation: 她确实如此。

Query_Text_en: King always wakes just before she slashes him .
Translation: 国王总是在她砍杀他之前醒来。

Query_Text_en: He says he dreams of her when he , s scrambling to catch up on his work .
Translation: 他说，每当他在拼命赶工作时，都会梦见她。

Query_Text_en: Consciousness is like an ocean , with different issues living at different levels , he says .
Translation: 他说，意识如同海洋，不同层面的问题各居其位。

Query_Text_en: ' Whatever 's going on in our daily lives trickles down and has some sort of influence down there .
Translation: 日常生活中发生的一切都会渗透并最终对基层产生某种程度的影响。

Query_Text_en: King is right .
Translation: 金是正确的。

Query_Text_en: Dreams , new research is showing , are often distorted reflections of our daily lives not necessarily symbolic pictures of unconscious wishest as Freud believed , or random , nonsense images caused by brain signals .
Translation: 最新研究显示，梦境往往是对我们日常生活的扭曲映射，而非弗洛伊德所认为的象征潜意识愿望的画面，也不是由大脑信号引发的随机无意义图像。

Query_Text_en: Many experts now believe our dreams are so closely related to our waking lives that we can use them to help us recognize and work out inner conflicts .
Translation: 许多专家目前认为，我们的梦境与日常生活有着如此紧密的联系，以至于我们可以借助它们来识别并解决内心冲突。

Query_Text_en: Men and women dream differently .
Translation: 男性与女性的梦境存在差异。

Query_Text_en: ' It 's biology and social conditioning , ' explains an expert .
Translation: "这是生物学因素和社会环境的影响，"一位专家解释道。

Query_Text_en: In a study of 1000 dreams , half from each sex , people found that men more often have action-oriented dreams involving strangers , identified mostly by their occupation .
Translation: 一项对1000个梦境的研究显示，男女各占一半，人们发现男性更容易梦见充满行动的场景，其中涉及的陌生人主要通过其职业特征被辨识。

Query_Text_en: Usually these dreams are set outdoors or in unfamiliar surroundings .
Translation: 这类梦境通常发生在户外或陌生环境中。

Query_Text_en: Women dream more of emotional one-on-one struggles with loved ones , usually in indoor settings .
Translation: 女性更容易梦见与至亲之人的一对一情感冲突，这类梦境通常发生在室内场景中。

Query_Text_en: Men and women both dream of sex , but men have more unconflicted fun in these dreams .
Translation: 男性和女性都会梦见性，但男性在这些梦中感受到的乐趣更为单纯。

Query_Text_en: Men typically dream of uninhibited pleasure with beautiful , anonymous women .
Translation: 男性通常渴望与美丽且身份隐秘的女性享受无拘无束的欢愉。

Query_Text_en: But women dream of someone they know , and they have more problems and distractions in the dreams .
Translation: 但女性梦见的是她们认识的人，且她们在梦境中会遇到更多困扰和干扰。

Query_Text_en: In a study , 65 to 75 percent of the women 's sexual dreams contained nervousness , anxiety , sadness or distress . Something usually happens that 's beyond the dreamer 's control .
Translation: 一项研究显示，65%至75%的女性性梦中包含紧张、焦虑、悲伤或痛苦情绪。通常梦中会发生一些超出做梦者控制范围的事情。

Query_Text_en: As more women have careers , their dreams might become more like men , s , according to studies while stay-at-home mothers dream more about children y women in the workplace dream about bosses and colleagues .
Translation: 研究表明，随着越来越多的女性投身职业发展，她们的梦想可能逐渐与男性趋同。全职母亲更多梦见孩子，而职场女性则更多梦见上司和同事。

Query_Text_en: Five months pregnant , California psychologist Patricia Garfield worried about whether sheM be able to nurse her baby .
Translation: 怀孕五个月时，加州心理学家帕特里夏·加菲尔德担心自己是否能够母乳喂养婴儿。

Query_Text_en: She dreamed repeatedly of a litter of starving Kittens meowing for food .
Translation: 她反复梦见一窝饥饿的小猫为食物哀叫。

Query_Text_en: The kittens , she knew , were a symbol of her baby .
Translation: 她知道，这些小猫是她孩子的象征。

Query_Text_en: According to a research , Garfield 's dream was not unusual :
Translation: 根据一项研究，加菲猫的梦境并不罕见：

Query_Text_en: pregnant women dream more than other women about animals .
Translation: 孕妇比其他女性更容易梦见动物。

Query_Text_en: Experts also found that the evolution of the dream animals corresponds to the growth of the baby , ranging from aquatic creatures like tadpoles during the first trimester , to cuddly puppies and bunnies in the second , and to monkeys and gorillas in the final phase .
Translation: 专家们还发现，梦境中的动物演变与胎儿的成长阶段相对应，从孕早期的蝌蚪等水生生物，到中期的毛茸茸小狗和兔子，再到孕晚期的猴子和大猩猩。

Query_Text_en: Expectant fathers experience common themes in their dreams as well .
Translation: 准父亲们的梦境中也常会出现一些共同的主题。

Query_Text_en: ' Most often the dreams are about being left out because during their wives ' pregnancies , men have to navigate between feeling alienated and feeling included .
Translation: 最常见的梦境是关于被排除在外，因为在妻子怀孕期间，男性不得不在疏离感和被接纳感之间周旋。

Query_Text_en: A 30-year-old California counselor , was about to become a father . He felt alienated by his wife 's pregnancy but would n't admit it .
Translation: 一位30岁的加州咨询师即将成为父亲。他对妻子怀孕感到疏离，却不愿承认。

Query_Text_en: One night he had an illuminating dream : ' I was at a baseball game and went to get some beer .
Translation: 一天晚上他做了一个清晰的梦境："我当时正在看棒球比赛，然后起身去取些啤酒。"

Query_Text_en: When I returned , I could n't find my seat , I looked for a new one , but while the stadium was not full , many of the spectators were pregnant women who took up two seats .
Translation: 当我返回时，发现找不到自己的座位，于是寻找新的座位，但虽然体育场并未坐满，但许多观众都是孕妇，每人占用了两个座位。

Query_Text_en: Annoyed , I decided to stand .
Translation: 恼火之下，我决定起身。

Query_Text_en: Later , he says , he realized that there was no emotional ' room , , for him in his wife 's pregnancy , ' just as there was no room for me in the stadium .
Translation: 后来，他说，他意识到在妻子怀孕期间，自己在情感上没有容身之地，就像体育场里没有我的位置一样。

Query_Text_en: ' Once he understood this , he began trying to get more involved in preparing for the baby 's birth .
Translation: 当他意识到这一点后，便开始更加积极参与到迎接新生命的准备工作中。

Query_Text_en: When Amy Tan was in her mid-20s , she dreamed she rented a pair of wings for a quarter and took off , flying with other people and having a splendid time .
Translation: 当谭恩美20多岁的时候，她曾梦见自己花25美分租了一对翅膀，与其他人在空中一同飞翔，玩得不亦乐乎。

Query_Text_en: Immediately she started to fall .
Translation: 她立刻开始坠落。

Query_Text_en: She was afraid she was about to die until she realized that if she 'd been flying before the frightening thought came to her , she ought to be able to fly again .
Translation: 她原以为自己即将死去，直到她意识到，既然在那个可怕的念头浮现之前她能够飞翔，那么现在理应还能再次飞翔。

Query_Text_en: Finally it occurred to her that the wings were not what enabled her to fly ; it was her own confidence .
Translation: 最终她意识到，让她飞翔的并非翅膀，而是她自己的信心。

Query_Text_en: Awake , she also saw she was n't allowing herself to do many things in her life because she lacked the confidence to do them .
Translation: 清醒后，她也意识到自己之所以在生活中无法去做许多事情，是因为缺乏信心。

Query_Text_en: Tan 's dream was typical of early adulthood , a time when people question confidence and self-esteem .
Translation: 谭的梦想是成年早期的典型代表，这一阶段人们开始质疑自信与自尊。

Query_Text_en: ' Life has stages in which things must be accomplished , ' says one expert , ' The issues we grapple with during those stages show up in dreams , and while asleep we often update how we 're doing in a particular stage . '
Translation: "人生有必须完成任务的阶段，"一位专家指出，"在这些阶段中我们所应对的问题会在梦境中呈现，而在睡眠时，我们常常会评估自己在某个阶段的进展状况。"

Query_Text_en: Small children , who are vulnerable and easily scaredf dream of frightening animals and monsters that chase and attack them .
Translation: 脆弱且容易受惊的幼儿常梦见追逐并攻击他们的可怕动物和怪物。

Query_Text_en: Teenagers dream of romance and sex .
Translation: 青少年憧憬浪漫与性。

Query_Text_en: Experts found in a study that people between 21 and 34 have more anxiety over issues of right and wrong in their dreamsһpossibly because they are looking inward and making crucial decisions about career , marriage and life direction .
Translation: 一项研究表明，21至34岁人群在梦境中对是非问题表现出更多焦虑，可能因为他们正在审视内心并就职业、婚姻和人生方向做出重要决定。

Query_Text_en: People of ages 35 to 49 have significantly less hostility toward others in their dreams , perhaps because they 've resolved those earlier issues , they ' re reaching their maximum achievement , and they have less need for aggression while awake .
Translation: 35至49岁人群在梦境中对他人的敌意显著减少，可能是因为他们已解决此前的心理问题，事业达到巅峰期，且清醒时的攻击性需求降低。

Query_Text_en: After age 65 , preoccupation with loss of resources and anxiety about aging appear significantly more often in people 's dreams .
Translation: 65岁以后，人们对资源流失的担忧和对衰老的焦虑在梦境中显著更频繁地出现。

Query_Text_en: If life stages affect our dreams ? so do our attitudes . Studies show that angry people act out their anger in their dreams Other research shows that depressed people sometimes dream they 're victims of rejection , humiliation or abandonment .
Translation: 如果人生阶段会影响我们的梦境，那么我们的态度同样会产生影响。研究表明，愤怒的人会在梦中发泄他们的愤怒，其他研究则表明，抑郁的人有时会梦见自己成为被排斥、羞辱或遗弃的对象。

Query_Text_en: People with ' thin boundaries ' һunusual openness , vulnerability , difficulty standing up for themselves are likely to suffer from nightmares .
Translation: “薄边界”人格者若表现出异常开放、脆弱以及难以维护自身权益的特点，容易遭受噩梦困扰。

Query_Text_en: Creative people often harness their dreams to solve problems .
Translation: 有创造力的人常借助灵感来解决问题。

Query_Text_en: When some writers , artists or scientists go to sleep , they ask their subconscious for a dream that will help them with unresolved issues .
Translation: 当一些作家、艺术家或科学家入睡时，他们会向潜意识寻求能够帮助解决未决问题的梦境。

Query_Text_en: Your unconscious knows things your conscious does n't , ' an expert says . ' It can be an ally with new insights .
Translation: "潜意识知晓意识层面所不了解的事物，专家指出，它能够成为提供全新视角的盟友。"

Query_Text_en: Screenwriter James Cameron dreamed of a robot with a red eye , then woke up and started his script for The Terminator .
Translation: 编剧詹姆斯·卡梅隆梦见一个长着红眼睛的机器人，随后醒来并开始撰写《终结者》的剧本。

Query_Text_en: Steve Allen 's song ' This Could Be the Start of Something Big ' came from a dream .
Translation: 史蒂夫·艾伦的歌曲《这可能是一个重大开端》源自一个梦境。

Query_Text_en: For seven years a Seattle man whose pregnant wife was killed by her former husband kept having nightmares about the murder . What especially haunted him were images of her calling out to him for help .
Translation: 七年来，一名西雅图男子一直被噩梦困扰，他的怀孕妻子被其前夫杀害。尤其令他难以释怀的是，梦中妻子向他呼救的画面始终萦绕心头。

Query_Text_en: Finally , he went to a psychiatrist , and the dreams slowly began to change : he dreamed of confronting the killer and of rescuing his wife .
Translation: 最后，他去看了一位心理医生，梦境逐渐开始发生变化：他梦见自己对抗凶手并救出了妻子。

Query_Text_en: The new dreams enabled him to talk about his rage toward the killer and his irrational feeling of being somehow responsible for his wife 's death .
Translation: 这些新梦境使他得以倾诉对凶手的愤怒，以及自己对妻子之死负有某种责任的非理性感受。

Query_Text_en: With the help of his dreams , he started to heal .
Translation: 借助他的梦想，他开始恢复。

Query_Text_en: This process is common for people who have been traumatized .
Translation: 这一过程在受过创伤的人群中较为常见。

Query_Text_en: Survivors of natural disasters , victims of accidents and crimes and their loved ones and combat veterans relive those terrifying events again and again in their dreams .
Translation: 自然灾害的幸存者、事故和犯罪的受害者及其亲友以及战斗老兵，会在梦中反复经历那些令人恐惧的事件。

Query_Text_en: When the image of a crisis is especially intense , it takes a while to absorb it . Your mind has to work on it before it can be filed away .
Translation: 当危机的图景尤为剧烈时，需要一段时间才能消化吸收。大脑必须先对其进行处理，才能将其整理归档。

Query_Text_en: That our dreams can heal psychic pain is reassuring .
Translation: 我们的梦境能够治愈心理创伤，这一点令人欣慰。

Query_Text_en: Rarely , but some experts say it can happen .
Translation: 虽然罕见，但部分专家指出其仍有可能发生。

Query_Text_en: Out of a sampling of millions of people , you can always find dreams that , in hindsight , seem prescient .
Translation: 在对数百万人进行抽样调查后，你总能找到一些梦境，这些梦境在事后看来似乎具有先见之明。

Query_Text_en: In the weeks prior to his assassination , as one account goes , Abraham Lincoln dreamed he heard people sobbing , and wandered downstairs to find out what was going on .
Translation: 在遇刺前夕的几周里，据某一记载所述，亚伯拉罕·林肯梦见自己听到有人啜泣，随后下楼查看究竟。

Query_Text_en: In the East Room , he saw a coffin and a corpse whose face was covered .
Translation: 在东厅，他看到一口棺材和一具蒙面的尸体。

Query_Text_en: he asked a soldier standing nearby .
Translation: 他向身旁的一名士兵询问道。

Query_Text_en: ' The President , ' the soldier answered . ' He was killed by an assassin .
Translation: “总统，”士兵回答道，“他被一名刺客杀害。”

Query_Text_en: A song in the famous North American musical Guys And Dolls , which is set in the 1940s , suggests that the most important thing in life , at least for a woman , is to marry .
Translation: 北美音乐剧《花柳巷》（背景设定在20世纪40年代）中的一首歌曲暗示，至少对女性而言，人生最重要的事情就是结婚。

Query_Text_en: If her husband doesn , t suit her , she can reform his habits later , says the song .
Translation: 歌曲中唱道：若丈夫不合心意，她日后自能改变他的习惯。

Query_Text_en: This is a dated view , according to the compiler of The Oxford Book of Marriage y Helge Rubinstein .
Translation: 根据《牛津婚姻书》编者海尔格·鲁宾斯坦的说法，这是一种过时的观点。

Query_Text_en: She says in her introduction to this book , that the institution of marriage is being questioned by many people today .
Translation: 她在本书的序言中指出，当今婚姻制度正受到许多人的质疑。

Query_Text_en: In the West , changes of atttitude towards sex and religion mean that unwed couples often live in sin , as it used to be called .
Translation: 在西方，对性和宗教态度的转变意味着未婚夫妇常常过着被视为有罪的生活，正如过去所称。

Query_Text_en: Through the writings of more than 200 writers , including playwrights , novelists and poets , the book charts the extraordinary uncertainties and upheavals of courtship and marriage .
Translation: 通过200多位作家的著作，涵盖剧作家、小说家及诗人，本书生动展现了恋爱与婚姻中的种种变数与动荡。

Query_Text_en: Children ( if it pleases God ) , constant companion ( friend in old age ) who will feel an interest in one , object to be beloved and played with better than a dog anyhow .
Translation: 孩子（若蒙上帝恩准）、忠实伴侣（暮年挚友），能对你怀有兴趣，作为被疼爱和玩耍的对象，总比狗强吧。

Query_Text_en: Charms of music and chitchat .
Translation: 音乐与闲聊的魅力。

Query_Text_en: Charles Darwin eventually married and had ten children .
Translation: 查尔斯·达尔文最终结婚并育有十个子女。

Query_Text_en: Novelist Franz Kafka , some 80 years later , also considered the pros and cons of getting wed. .
Translation: 大约80年后的某时，小说家弗兰茨·卡夫卡也考虑了结婚的利弊。

Query_Text_en: To judge from many of the quotations in this anthology ? he was right .
Translation: 根据这本文集中的许多引言──他是对的。

Query_Text_en: The beginning and the decline of love are evidenced by the embarrassment felt by the couple when they are alone .
Translation: 爱情的萌芽与衰退以夫妻独处时的尴尬为标志。

Query_Text_en: Radical feminism regards marriage as an institution created by men to oppress women .
Translation: 激进女性主义认为婚姻是男性为压迫女性而建立的一种制度。

Query_Text_en: If women are to affect a significant amelioration in their condition , it seems obvious they must refuse to marry .
Translation: 如果女性要显著改善自身境遇，显然她们就必须拒绝结婚。

Query_Text_en: The compiler of The Ox ford Book of Marriage would seem to disagree .
Translation: 《牛津婚姻书》的编者似乎不以为然。

Query_Text_en: Helge Rubinstein suggests that feminism may have strengthened the institution of marriage by giving greater freedom to both partners , and by allowing men to value personal relationships as highly as worldly success .
Translation: Helge Rubinstein指出，女性主义可能通过赋予婚姻双方更大自主权，并使男性能够像重视世俗成就一样重视个人关系，从而巩固了婚姻制度。

Query_Text_en: Her anthology contains plenty of quotations testifying to the fact that marriages can be successful , romantic and enduring .
Translation: 她的文集中收录了大量引文，证明婚姻可以美满、浪漫且持久。

Query_Text_en: Queen Victoria 's relationship with Prince Albert is perhaps the most blissful on record .
Translation: 维多利亚女王与阿尔伯特亲王的关系或许是历史上最为美满的。

Query_Text_en: In her journal , she wrote that her wedding day , 10 February 1840 , was the happiest day of her life , and the following morning :
Translation: 在她的日记中，她写道，她的结婚日——1840年2月10日——是她一生中最幸福的日子，次日清晨：

Query_Text_en: ' There is no universal recipe for success , ' says Helge Rubinstein .
Translation: 赫尔格·鲁宾斯坦表示："没有放之四海而皆准的成功秘诀。"

Query_Text_en: There is , however , plenty of advice .
Translation: 然而，相关建议却比比皆是。

Query_Text_en: Love one another , but make not a bond of love .
Translation: 彼此相爱，但不要让爱成为束缚。

Query_Text_en: Let it rather be a moving sea between the shores of your souls .
Translation: 让其成为你们灵魂海岸间的一片涌动之海。

Query_Text_en: Fill each other 's cup but drink not from one cup .
Translation: 彼此斟满杯盏，但莫共饮一盏。

Query_Text_en: Give one another of your bread but eat not from the same loaf .
Translation: 相互分享面包，但不可共食同一块面饼。

Query_Text_en: More practically the British writer William Cobbett in the 1830s , recommended male suitors to watch a woman eating a mutton chop in order to decide whether she would make a good wife .
Translation: 更实际的是，19世纪30年代英国作家威廉·科贝特曾建议男性追求者观察女性吃羊排时的表现，以此判断她是否适合作为妻子。

Query_Text_en: P G Wodehouse , a century later , advised a girl thinking of marriage to : Tap his forehead first , and if it rings solid , do n't hesitate .
Translation: 一个世纪后，P.G. 伍德豪斯建议一位考虑结婚的女孩：先敲敲他的脑门，若声音清脆，就别犹豫。

Query_Text_en: Unhappy marriages come from the husband having brains .
Translation: 不幸的婚姻源于丈夫的头脑。

Query_Text_en: They only unsettle him .
Translation: 这只会让他不安。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps the most astonishing piece in this anthology is a letter from a farmer called Simon Fallowfield to a local beauty .
Translation: 这部文集中最引人注目的作品或许是一封农夫西蒙·法洛菲尔写给当地一位美女的信件。

Query_Text_en: It was written in 1866 , in northern England .
Translation: 它写于1866年，英格兰北部。

Query_Text_en: If you will not accept me I have another very nice woman in my eye ( and I think I shall marry her if you do not accept me ) , but I thought you would suit my mother better , she being very irritable at times .
Translation: 倘若你不肯接受我，我另有一位非常不错的女子心仪（我想如果你不接受我，我就娶她为妻），不过我认为你更合我母亲的意，因为她时不时会发脾气。

Query_Text_en: His proposal was rejected .
Translation: 他的提案未获通过。

Query_Text_en: When a knock sounded on her office door , Alma Triner looked up , startled and noticed that it was dark outside .
Translation: 当办公室门传来敲门声时，阿尔玛·特林纳抬头望去，一脸惊愕，注意到外面已经天黑了。

Query_Text_en: For a moment , Triner was surprised .
Translation: 片刻间，特林纳感到惊讶。

Query_Text_en: Then her mind shifted gears .
Translation: 她的思维转向了另一个方向。

Query_Text_en: A vice president of an international consulting firm , she was expected at a dinner party for the firm 's top executives .
Translation: 作为某国际咨询公司的副总裁，她本应出席公司高层管理人员的晚宴。

Query_Text_en: But she had n't thought about it for hours .
Translation: 但她好几个小时都没有考虑过这件事。

Query_Text_en: Since morning , she 'd been working on a presentation for a client .
Translation: 从早上起，她一直在为客户准备一份演示文稿。

Query_Text_en: As the ideas and words came smoothly , everything else had escaped her .
Translation: 当她的思路顺畅、文思泉涌时，其他一切事物都从她脑海中溜走了。

Query_Text_en: ' I was getting so much accomplished , ' she recalled later .
Translation: “我那时效率奇高，”她后来回忆道。

Query_Text_en: ' Every sentence , every concept felt just right .
Translation: 每一处措辞、每一个理念都恰如其分。

Query_Text_en: I was hardly aware of what I was doing .
Translation: 我几乎没意识到自己在做什么。

Query_Text_en: Alma Triner had been in her ' zone ' һa term often used by athletes to describe being so zeroed in on a task that they are oblivious to distractions .
Translation: 阿尔玛·特林曾处于她的"最佳状态"——这一术语常被运动员用来形容全神贯注于某项任务而对外界干扰毫无察觉的状态。

Query_Text_en: Absorbed by her project , Triner was able to ignore jangling telephones , hunger pangs , even the march of time .
Translation: 特林纳全神贯注于项目，能够无视此起彼伏的电话铃声、饥饿感，甚至时光流逝。

Query_Text_en: And she had not only produced top quality work but had done so in less time than it would have taken many equally talented competitors .
Translation: 她不仅完成了高质量的工作，而且在比许多才能相当的竞争对手更短的时间内做到了这一点。

Query_Text_en: The ability to devote unswerving attention to a task can produce success in any field .
Translation: 对任务保持专注的能力可以在任何领域取得成功。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , being unable to stay in a zone can turn a sure winner into an also-ran .
Translation: 另一方面，无法保持在某一关键领域的战略定位，会让原本稳操胜券的赢家沦为陪跑者。

Query_Text_en: At the 1992 U. S. Olympic trials , decathlon star Dan O'Brien began by setting such a record pace in the contest 's events that a place on the team seemed certain .
Translation: 在1992年美国奥运选拔赛上，十项全能明星丹·奥布莱恩以创纪录的节奏开启征程，其国家队席位似乎已成定局。

Query_Text_en: That 's when he relaxed and stumbled in the pole vaultһfailing to clear a height that he had reached hundreds of times before .
Translation: 就在那时，他放松警惕，在撑杆跳中出现失误，未能跃过他此前成功跨越数百次的高度。

Query_Text_en: Unable , as he admitted later , to ' get his head together , ' he tried and failed twice more . Despite O'Brien 's physical abilities a mental lapse had dashed his Olympic hopes .
Translation: 正如他后来承认的那样，由于无法集中精神，他再次尝试了两次但均告失败。尽管奥布莱恩具备出色的身体条件，但一次心理状态的波动却粉碎了他的奥运梦想。

Query_Text_en: Most of us can sympathize with O'Brien .
Translation: 我们大多数人能够感同身受奥勃良。

Query_Text_en: You 've probably had those frustrating times when you could n't seem to get your brain going .
Translation: 你可能经历过那些令人困扰的时刻，那时你似乎怎么也提不起思考的劲头。

Query_Text_en: You 've sat blankly in front of the computer screen , struggling to find the right words .
Translation: 你一直呆坐在电脑屏幕前，苦苦寻找合适的措辞。

Query_Text_en: You , ve stared at the budget figures , unable to get your mind around them .
Translation: 你面对预算数字，难以把握其全貌。

Query_Text_en: And yet you 've also known states of high concentrationһwhen you 've gotten your best work done at a fast pace .
Translation: 然而，你也经历过高度专注的状态，在这种状态下，你能够以高效的方式完成最佳工作成果。
