Query_Text_en: Smoothing the Learning Curve . Ordinarily there are fluctuations in the rise of a learning curve . It rises fast , then perhaps more slowly ;
Translation: 平滑学习曲线。通常，学习曲线的上升过程中存在波动，起初快速上升，随后可能增速放缓；

Query_Text_en: it may even fall , for just as a combination of favorable factors makes it rise , so a combination of unfavorable circumstances may make it fall .
Translation: 正如有利因素的结合使其上升，不利因素的结合也可能使其下降。

Query_Text_en: There are always many independently variable factors that combine to produce a learning record .
Translation: 学习记录的形成总是由许多相互独立的变量因素共同作用而成。

Query_Text_en: These factors are variously combined at different moments of our procedure and produce a curve of fluctuating rises and falls .
Translation: 这些因素在程序的不同阶段以不同方式组合，形成一条起伏波动的曲线。

Query_Text_en: The general tendency of the curve is better shown if , instead of showing the actual records , we construct a smoothed curve .
Translation: 如果绘制平滑曲线而非直接展示实际数据，总体趋势会更清晰地体现出来。

Query_Text_en: There are various ways of doing this .
Translation: 有多种方式可以实现这一目标。

Query_Text_en: We can do it roughly by indicating the actual records on our coordinate paper by dots and then drawing a curve that throws as many of the dots on one side as on the other .
Translation: 我们大致可以通过以下方法实现：在坐标纸上用点标注实际数据记录，然后绘制一条曲线，使两侧的点数量大致相等。

Query_Text_en: The dots show the actual records , the cuie shows the general tendency of the records .
Translation: 图中点表示实际记录值，曲线则显示记录的总体趋势。

Query_Text_en: Another method is to eliminate the temporary fluctuations of the curve by averaging each record with the adjacent records above and below .
Translation: 另一种方法是通过将每个数据点与上下相邻的数据点进行平均，从而消除曲线的短期波动。

Query_Text_en: The first and final records are doubled and combined with the one adjacent record , and the sum divided by three .
Translation: 首项和末项分别乘以2，并与各自相邻的记录相加，总和再除以三。

Query_Text_en: Learning Plateaus . A plateau or level place in the learning curve indicates a period of no progress in learning .
Translation: 学习高原。学习曲线中的平台期表明学习进展进入停滞阶段。

Query_Text_en: Such plateaus nearly always appear in the actual work of learning , in school work as well as in laboratory experiments .
Translation: 这种平台期几乎无一例外地出现在学习的实际工作中，无论是学校作业还是实验室实验中。

Query_Text_en: Various explanations for the appearance of the plateau have been given .
Translation: 对于高原的出现，人们提出了各种解释。

Query_Text_en: Bryan , in his early work on learning , suggested that plateaus were due to the fixing of lower order habits .
Translation: 布莱恩在其早期关于学习的研究中指出，高原期归因于较低层次习惯的巩固。

Query_Text_en: Progress due to higher order habits could not come till the lower order habits were fixed .
Translation: 只有当低层次的习惯得到巩固，高层次习惯带来的进步才能实现。

Query_Text_en: Book 's suggestion that the plateau is due to a flagging of interest , a letting up of effort , is doubtless nearer the truth for the plateau may appear in simple experiments involving a single definite habit . The fact seems to be that the plateau is not a necessity in learning , theoretically , although in practice it usually appears .
Translation: 该书认为平台期源于兴趣减退或努力减弱的观点，无疑更接近事实真相，因为在涉及单一明确习惯的简单实验中，平台期同样可能出现。从理论上讲，平台期并非学习的必然现象，尽管在实践中它通常会出现。

Query_Text_en: As long as a learner maintains a high degree of attention and puts forth maximum effort , he continues to improve till he reaches his limit .
Translation: 只要学习者保持高度专注并付出最大努力，他就会持续进步，直到达到自身极限。

Query_Text_en: But maintaining a high state of attention and putting forth maximum effort are impossible over long periods of time .
Translation: 但长时间保持高度专注并付出最大努力是不可能的。

Query_Text_en: The ordinary learner usually does his best for a time , then because of fatigue , or lack of attention , or loss of interest , he relaxes and works at a lower point of efficiency .
Translation: 普通学习者起初会竭尽全力，但由于疲劳、注意力分散或兴趣减退，往往会松懈下来，工作效率随之下降到较低水平。

Query_Text_en: For a time , the records may actually fall below previous records .
Translation: 在一段时间内，相关数据可能实际低于历史水平。

Query_Text_en: This phenomenon may appear during the experiment of a single sitting and be a matter of minutes . It may appear in a long series of experiments and be a matter of days .
Translation: 这种现象可能出现在单次实验过程中，并仅持续数分钟；也可能出现在一系列长期实验中，并持续数天。

Query_Text_en: The plateau has much significance to education .
Translation: 高原对教育具有重要意义。

Query_Text_en: When it is due to loss of interest and lack of attention , practice is not then profitable .
Translation: 当由于兴趣减退和关注度不足时，相关实践则无利可图。

Query_Text_en: At such a time , practice should stop or means be found to renew attention and effort .
Translation: 在这种情况下，要么暂停实践，要么采取措施重新激发关注与努力。

Query_Text_en: Pauses in habit-formation are valuable not only because they lead to a renewed interest and effort when the work is taken up again , but according to some writers , they lead to a weakening of inhibitions which had interfered with the habit .
Translation: 习惯养成过程中的暂停不仅具有价值，因为当工作重新开始时，它能重新激发兴趣和投入；根据某些作家的观点，这种暂停还能减弱那些干扰习惯形成的抑制因素。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , in habit-formation , time is an element which can not be ignored .
Translation: 此外，在习惯养成过程中，时间是一个不可忽视的因素。

Query_Text_en: Some sort of fixation goes on in the nervous system ; this fixation requires time and can not be unduly hurried .
Translation: 神经系统中存在某种固化过程；这一过程需要时间，不可操之过急。

Query_Text_en: As shown in a later chapter , practice beyond a certain amount at one sitting is valueless .
Translation: 如后文所述，单次练习超过一定量是没有价值的。

Query_Text_en: And in practice extending over many days , only a certain amount of improvement is possible , no matter how hard we work .
Translation: 实际上，经过多天的实践，无论我们如何努力，也只能实现一定程度的改进。

Query_Text_en: All the principles discussed in this chapter should , as far as possible , be illustrated by experiments .
Translation: 本章所讨论的所有原则，应尽可能通过实验加以阐释。

Query_Text_en: Any learning experiment will suffice , but for economy of time , an experiment should be selected that will show rapid improvement .
Translation: 任何学习实验均可，但为节省时间，应选择能快速见效的实验。

Query_Text_en: Several experiments are described below . The instructor can select those suited to his needs , or devise others .
Translation: 以下将介绍几个实验。教师可根据自身需求选择其中合适的实验，或自行设计其他实验。

Query_Text_en: Class experiment . Material , Pyle 's Digit-symbol substitution test blanks .
Translation: 班级实验材料：Pyle数字符号替代测试空白表格。

Query_Text_en: Method : Distribute about sixteen test sheets to each student , placing them face down before the student . Explain to the students that they are to substitute letters for the nine digits , in accordance with the key shown at the top of the test sheet , and that they are to work as fast as possible .
Translation: 方法：向每位学生分发约十六张测试卷，将其面朝下放置在学生面前。向学生说明，他们需根据测试卷顶部所示的对应表，用字母替换九个数字，并尽可能快速地完成。

Query_Text_en: Work in five-minute periods , and let the score be the number of substitutions correctly made in five minutes .
Translation: 以五分钟为一个时段进行工作，并将得分定为五分钟内正确完成的替换次数。

Query_Text_en: Eight such scores can probably be made in a one-hour period .
Translation: 在一小时间段内，可能可以完成八个这样的项目。

Query_Text_en: The scoring should be left till the experiment is finished .
Translation: 评分应推迟至实验结束后进行。

Query_Text_en: From the data obtained in experiment 1 , construct individual learning curves similar to figures 1 and 2 .
Translation: 根据实验1获得的数据，绘制类似图1和图2所示的个体学习曲线。

Query_Text_en: Construct a smoothed curve as described in the chapter .
Translation: 如本章所述构建平滑曲线。

Query_Text_en: Construct a learning curve from the class averages for each five-minute period .
Translation: 根据各五分钟时段的班级平均成绩构建学习曲线。

Query_Text_en: Laboratory experiment . Card-sorting . Material , ordinary playing cards .
Translation: 实验室实验。卡片分类法。材料：普通扑克牌。

Query_Text_en: Method : Shuffle the cards , then sort them into four piles according to suit , .
Translation: 方法：洗牌，然后按花色将其分成四堆。

Query_Text_en: , hearts together , spades together , clubs together , and diamonds together .
Translation: 红心齐，黑桃齐，梅花齐，方块齐。

Query_Text_en: Construct a cure similar to figure 3 .
Translation: 制定类似图3所示的解决方案。

Query_Text_en: Laboratory experiment . Material , card-sorting box and cards .
Translation: 实验室实验。实验材料、卡片分类盒及卡片。

Query_Text_en: The cards must be thoroughly shuffled before each sorting . Shuffling is facilitated if the cards are taken up after sorting , promiscuously , one at a time .
Translation: 每次分类前须将卡片充分洗匀。若在分类后逐张随机拾取卡片，将有助于洗牌操作。

Query_Text_en: Ten sorting can be finished in an hour .
Translation: 十次分类可在一小时内完成。

Query_Text_en: Construct individual learning curves similar to figure 3 .
Translation: 构建类似于图3所示的个体学习曲线。

Query_Text_en: By computing the number of cards sorted in a minute , curves can be made similar to figures 1 and 2 .
Translation: 通过计算每分钟分类的卡片数量，可以绘制出类似图1和图2所示的曲线。

Query_Text_en: Elaborator experiment . Material , mirror-writing apparatus .
Translation: 精制器实验。材料，镜像书写装置。

Query_Text_en: Method : The hand of the writer is to be covered from view . He is to see his hand as reflected in the mirror , which is vertical before him .
Translation: 方法：作者的手需被遮挡视线。他需通过面前竖直放置的镜子观察手部反射影像。

Query_Text_en: The subject is to write in script in such a way that the letters appear in the mirror as they would on a sheet of paper held vertically before him . Let the subjects copy the material of the first paragraph in this chapter .
Translation: 受试者需以特定方式书写，使得镜中呈现的字母与纸张垂直置于其面前时的效果完全一致。请受试者抄写本章第一段的内容。

Query_Text_en: While Hargreaves was still working on his `` spinning jenny , '' Richard Arkwright in 1769 invented a water-power machine .
Translation: 当哈格里夫斯仍在改进他的“珍妮纺纱机”时，理查德·阿克莱特于1769年发明了水力纺纱机。

Query_Text_en: This device drew the carded cotton through a series of rollers , each set revolving at a greater velocity than the preceding set and thus turning out cotton thread strong enough for any purpose .
Translation: 该装置通过一系列滚筒牵引梳理后的棉条，每组滚筒的转速依次递增，从而生产出强韧耐用、适用于任何用途的棉线。

Query_Text_en: The work of Hargreaves , Arkwright and others now made it possible to spin thread faster than the weavers could use it .
Translation: 哈格里夫斯、阿克莱特等人发明的机器如今使得纺纱的速度超过了织工的使用速度。

Query_Text_en: As far back as the days of ancient Egypt men had known that water turned into steam expanded to create power .
Translation: 早在古埃及时代，人们就已经知道水转化为蒸汽后膨胀可以产生动力。

Query_Text_en: The problem was to harness this power for the use of man , and to make it possible to locate a factory wherever it seemed desirable .
Translation: 问题在于如何将这种能源为人所用，并使其能够根据需要在任何适宜地点建立工厂。

Query_Text_en: He discovered how to save the steam and use it over and over , how the steam could be used to force a piston both ways , and how the backward and forward motion of the piston could be applied to the turning of wheels or the driving of a hammer .
Translation: 他成功研发了循环利用蒸汽的方法，使蒸汽能够反复驱动活塞双向运动，并将活塞的往复运动转化为轮轴转动或锤击装置的动力。

Query_Text_en: Soon with the aid of a wealthy English manufacturer he built steam engines on a commercial scale .
Translation: 不久之后，在一位英国富商制造商的资助下，他开始大规模商业化生产蒸汽机。

Query_Text_en: Watt 's steam engine not only introduced a new era in mining by making it easy to pump out the water , but it freed manufacturing from water power .
Translation: 瓦特蒸汽机不仅通过便捷的抽水方式开启了采矿业的新纪元，还使制造业摆脱了对水力的依赖。

Query_Text_en: In 1807 an American , Robert Fulton , first demonstrated the practicability of the steamboat in freight and passenger service when his boat , the Clermont , equipped with a Watt engine , ascended the Hudson from New York to Albany , a distance of 150 miles in 32 hours .
Translation: 1807年，美国工程师罗伯特·富尔顿首次展示了蒸汽船在货运和客运服务中的实用性。他的克莱蒙特号蒸汽船配备瓦特发动机，从纽约溯哈德逊河而上，航行150英里抵达奥尔巴尼，全程耗时32小时。

Query_Text_en: Although the Industrial Revolution came first in England , it was not long before Americans were contributing to the basic inventions which made this tremendous change possible .
Translation: 尽管工业革命首先在英国发生，但美国人很快就开始为这些使这一巨大变革成为可能的基础性发明作出贡献。

Query_Text_en: The spinning jenny and the power loom had made it possible to turn the cotton fiber into cloth quickly .
Translation: 珍妮纺纱机和动力织布机使得快速将棉花纤维制成布料成为可能。

Query_Text_en: Dr. Dani Bolognesi still remembers the afternoon in 1994 when one of his research colleagues , Tom Matthews , ran into his office at Duke University with some exciting news .
Translation: 丹尼·博洛尼亚尼博士至今仍记得1994年的一个下午，当时他的研究同事汤姆·马修斯带着令人振奋的消息跑进了杜克大学的办公室。

Query_Text_en: While searching for something that might work as a vaccine against HIV , Matthews had stumbled upon a compound that blocked the AIDS Virus from binding to and thus infecting healthy cells .
Translation: 在寻找可能用作艾滋病疫苗的物质过程中，马修斯偶然发现了一种能够阻止艾滋病病毒与健康细胞结合并进而感染这些细胞的化合物。

Query_Text_en: says Bolognesi , now CEO of the company he co-founded to explore-the compound 's commercial potential .
Translation: 博洛内西表示，目前担任他共同创立的公司首席执行官，该公司致力于探索该化合物的商业潜力。

Query_Text_en: It turns out that the compound Matthews identified does n't work as an AIDS vaccine , but it may still make a very good AIDS drag .
Translation: 事实证明，马修斯发现的化合物无法作为艾滋病疫苗使用，但它仍可能成为一种很好的艾滋病药物。

Query_Text_en: It belongs to a family of molecules known as entry inhibitors that , as the name suggests , prevent HIV 's entry into healthy immune cells .
Translation: 它属于一类被称为进入抑制剂的分子，正如其名称所示，这类分子能够阻止HIV进入健康的免疫细胞。

Query_Text_en: Bolognesi 's company , Trimeris , based in Durham , N. C. , collaborates with Hoffman LaRoche and is already in the final stages of human testing with one compound and in the earliest phases of testing with a second .
Translation: 博洛杰西的公司Trimeris总部位于北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市，正与罗氏公司合作开展研发。目前该公司有一种化合物已进入人体试验的最后阶段，第二种化合物也已启动最早期的测试环节。

Query_Text_en: Together , these drug candidates represent a sophisticated new generation of antiviral compound drugs born of a better understanding of how HIV works , at the molecular level inside the body .
Translation: 这些候选药物共同代表了基于对HIV作用机制在体内分子层面更深入理解而诞生的先进新一代抗病毒复方药物。

Query_Text_en: For this reason it and a second candidate , T-1249 , are known as fusion inhibitors .
Translation: 因此，它和第二种候选药物T-1249被称为融合抑制剂。

Query_Text_en: Progenics has been testing a different type of entry inhibitor , a molecular decoy for CD4 whose job is to find , bind and lure HIV away from the real CD4 cells .
Translation: 普罗基因公司一直在测试一种新型的进入抑制剂，这种抑制剂是一种CD4分子诱饵，其作用是寻找、结合并引诱HIV远离真正的CD4细胞。

Query_Text_en: Two years ago , researchers from the National Surgical Adjuvant Breast and Bowel project reported that in a study of 13,000 women at high risk of developing breast cancer , taking the drug tamoxifen for up to five years reduced their chances of getting cancer by almost 50 percent .
Translation: 两年前，国家外科辅助乳腺和结肠项目的研究人员报告称，在一项针对1.3万名乳腺癌高风险女性的研究中，服用他莫昔芬药物长达五年可使其患病几率降低近50%。

Query_Text_en: Now , in one of the largest studies ever , researchers are set to compare the effects of an even milder drug , called raloxifene , with tamoxifen .
Translation: 如今，在一项有史以来规模最大的研究中，研究人员计划比较一种名为雷洛昔芬的更温和药物与他莫昔芬的效果。

Query_Text_en: Tamoxifen has been given to women with breast cancer since 1974 , usually after surgery to remove a tumor and in conjunction with chemotherapy .
Translation: 自1974年起，他莫昔芬一直被用于乳腺癌患者，通常在切除肿瘤的手术后使用，并配合化疗。

Query_Text_en: The drug blocks receptors on cancer cells that normally bind with estrogen , and thereby prevents estrogen from stimulating tumors to grow .
Translation: 该药物通过阻断癌细胞表面通常与雌激素结合的受体，从而阻止雌激素刺激肿瘤生长。

Query_Text_en: Not all breast tumors have estrogen receptors , so the drug is only prescribed to women who have tumors that have tested positive for the receptors .
Translation: 并非所有乳腺肿瘤都含有雌激素受体，因此该药物仅限于向肿瘤检测结果呈阳性的女性开具处方。

Query_Text_en: Researchers began recruiting women for the STAR trial -LRB- Study of Tamoxifen and Raloxifene -RRB- in 1999 , and plan to follow them for 5 to 10 years .
Translation: 研究人员于1999年开始招募女性参与STAR试验（他莫昔芬与雷洛昔芬研究），并计划随访她们5到10年。

Query_Text_en: Gene therapy and gene-based drugs are two ways we could benefit from our growing mastery of genetic science .
Translation: 基因疗法和基因药物是人类能够从对遗传科学的日益精进的掌握中获益的两种途径。

Query_Text_en: While it 's true that just about every cell in the body has the instructions to make a complete human , most of those instructions are inactivated , and with good reason : the last thing you want is for your brain cells to start churning out stomach acid or your nose to turn into a kidney .
Translation: 虽然几乎每个身体细胞都携带着制造完整人类的全部指令，但其中绝大多数指令都处于非活跃状态。原因很简单：你最不希望看到的情况，莫过于脑细胞开始大量分泌胃酸，或是鼻部组织异变成肾脏。

Query_Text_en: But if efforts to understand and master stem-cell development prove successful , doctors will have a therapeutic tool of incredible power .
Translation: 但如果在理解并掌握干细胞发育方面的努力取得成功，医生将拥有一个威力无比的治疗工具。

Query_Text_en: The vaccines of tomorrow are likely to be far more sophisticated concoctions , made up of snippets of raw DNA from the genome of a virus , bacterium or parasite .
Translation: 未来疫苗很可能成为更加复杂的复合制剂，其成分将包含病毒、细菌或寄生虫基因组中的原始DNA片段。

Query_Text_en: Using DNA , as opposed to proteins made by a microbe , elicits a more vigorous , aggressive response from the immune system .
Translation: 使用DNA而非微生物产生的蛋白质会引发免疫系统更强烈且更具攻击性的反应。

Query_Text_en: Because gene-based vaccines can easily be manipulated by adding or deleting DNA , doctors are applying the technique to treat various forms of cancer .
Translation: 由于基因疫苗可通过增减DNA进行调整，医生们正将其应用于多种癌症类型的治疗。

Query_Text_en: The work is still limited to animals , but researchers have developed inoculations made up of tumor cells that act as a red flag to rally an animal 's immune system against the tumor .
Translation: 目前这项研究仍局限于动物实验，但研究人员已开发出由肿瘤细胞组成的疫苗，这种疫苗可充当警示标志，激发动物体免疫系统对抗肿瘤。

Query_Text_en: `` But it 's very promising . ''
Translation: 但前景非常广阔。

Query_Text_en: Researchers thought of atherosclerosis , or the clogging of arteries with fatty plaques , as basically a plumbing problem .
Translation: 研究人员曾将动脉粥样硬化（即动脉被脂肪斑块堵塞）视为一种基本的管道问题。

Query_Text_en: Bypass the choke points with new grafts and you would more than likely bypass any future heart attacks .
Translation: 通过开辟新渠道绕过瓶颈，便极有可能避免未来可能出现的重大危机。

Query_Text_en: They 're not by any means ready to abandon surgery , but now they rely more heavily on different types of drugs to treat both the long-term and short-term effects of heart disease .
Translation: 他们绝非准备放弃手术，但现在更加依赖不同类型药物来治疗心脏病的长期和短期影响。

Query_Text_en: For one thing , the wealth of data coming out of the human-genome project will allow physicians to tailor pharmaceutical treatments to an individual 's specific genetic profile in ways that have never before been possible .
Translation: 一方面，人类基因组计划产生的海量数据将使医生能够根据个人特定基因特征定制药物治疗方案，这种方式此前从未实现过。

Query_Text_en: To get a better idea of what could be in store , it helps to know what physicians believe lies at the root of most heart at tacks .
Translation: 为了更好地了解未来可能面临的情况，了解医生认为大多数心脏病发作的根本原因会有所帮助。

Query_Text_en: Doctors have already shown that drugs called statins , which curb the body 's ability to manufacture excess cholesterol , can significantly reduce the risk of suffering a heart attack .
Translation: 医生已经证实，他汀类药物（可抑制体内过量胆固醇的生成）能显著降低心脏病发作的风险。

Query_Text_en: But doctors would like to have a drug that targets coronary inflammation more specifically and aggressively than aspirin .
Translation: 但医生们希望拥有一种比阿司匹林更具针对性且更强效地抑制冠状动脉炎症的药物。

Query_Text_en: More and more Americans are developing a condition called congestive heart failure , in which the cardiac muscle becomes weakened and can no longer pump blood efficiently .
Translation: 越来越多的美国人患上一种被称为充血性心力衰竭的疾病，其特点是心脏肌肉衰弱，无法有效泵血。

Query_Text_en: The goal is to figure out a way to boost the levels of the beneficial hormones while lowering those that make the weakened heart 's job more difficult .
Translation: 目标是找到一种方法，在提升有益激素水平的同时降低那些会加重受损心脏负担的激素水平。

Query_Text_en: Drugs are bound to play a major role in any new advances based on genetic or tissue engineering as well .
Translation: 在基于基因或组织工程的任何新进展中，药物也必将发挥重要作用。

Query_Text_en: As mad cow disease hits country after country , the fear of catching the human form has infected Americans .
Translation: 随着疯牛病接连肆虐多个国家，美国人对感染人类同类疾病的担忧情绪不断蔓延。

Query_Text_en: Even so , the FDA recently recommended extending the ban on U. S. blood donors to include people who have spent 10 or more years in France , Ireland , or Portugal since 1980 .
Translation: 即便如此，美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）仍建议将对美国献血者的禁令范围扩大，涵盖自1980年以来在法国、爱尔兰或葡萄牙任何一个国家累计居住满10年的人群。

Query_Text_en: The proposed FDA move , contends David Ropiek , director of risk communication at the Harvard Center for Risk Analysis , would needlessly limit an already strained donor supply .
Translation: 哈佛大学风险分析中心风险沟通主任大卫·罗皮克认为，FDA的提议行动将毫无必要地限制本已紧张的捐赠供应。

Query_Text_en: And given that there have been no documented eases of the disease in the U. S -- nor of its cattle counterpart -- the risk to Americans is even lower .
Translation: 鉴于美国境内尚未发现该疾病的任何确诊病例——包括其在牛群中的对应病例——因此对美国民众的风险进一步降低。

Query_Text_en: The USDA bans imports on most beef and bovine tissues from countries that have seen mad cow cases -- and it also bans the practice of feeding cattle animal parts-but there are concerns over how strictly the bans are enforced .
Translation: 美国农业部禁止从发生疯牛病疫情的国家进口牛肉及牛组织，并禁止用动物制品喂养牛只，但人们担心这些禁令的执行力度。

Query_Text_en: There 's an economic incentive to comply with the bans , says Ropiek .
Translation: Ropiek指出，遵守相关禁令存在经济激励。

Query_Text_en: Animal parts are a good source of protein , but so are soybeans , which are plentiful and cheap here .
Translation: 动物内脏是优质蛋白质来源，而大豆同样是良好选择，且本地供应充足且价格低廉。

Query_Text_en: Curing a man of prostate cancer depends on detecting it while it 's still small and confined to the gland .
Translation: 治愈男性前列腺癌的关键在于在癌症仍处于早期阶段且局限于前列腺内时及时发现。

Query_Text_en: In the past decade , screening with the PSA -LRB- prostate-specific antigen -RRB- test has become a routine tool for the early detection of prostate tumors .
Translation: 在过去十年中，PSA（前列腺特异性抗原）检测已成为早期发现前列腺肿瘤的常规手段。

Query_Text_en: The American Cancer Society and the American Urological Association together recommend that all men be offered the PSA test , along with a digital rectal examination , annually4 beginning at age 50 .
Translation: 美国癌症协会和美国泌尿外科学会共同建议，所有男性应从50岁开始，每年接受前列腺特异性抗原检测（PSA检测）和直肠指检。

Query_Text_en: Since PSA levels also rise with age , a reading of , say , 3 might be considered more suspicious in a younger man than an older one .
Translation: 由于PSA水平也会随年龄增长而升高，因此同样的检测数值（例如3）在年轻男性中可能比年长者更令人怀疑。

Query_Text_en: With a test indicating a suspicious PSA level , the doctor would then conduct a digital rectal exam , in which the doctor inserts a gloved finger into the rectum and feels the adjacent prostate .
Translation: 如果检测显示前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）水平存在异常，医生会进一步进行直肠指检。在此过程中，医生将戴手套的手指插入直肠并触摸邻近的前列腺。

Query_Text_en: In an effort to better protect soldiers and civilians against biological weapons , the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency is investigating new ways to combat the threat .
Translation: 为更好地保护士兵和平民免受生物武器威胁，国防高级研究计划局正在探索新的应对方法。

Query_Text_en: In case a pathogen gets into the bloodstream , engineered proteins would boost red blood cells ' natural ability to destroy disease agents .
Translation: 一旦病原体进入血液，工程化蛋白质将增强红细胞的天然能力以消灭病原体。

Query_Text_en: Protein complexes injected into the body stick to red blood cells .
Translation: 注射到体内的蛋白质复合物会粘附在红细胞上。

Query_Text_en: The protein complex bound to the pathogen is destroyed in the liver by specialized cells that are caned macrophages .
Translation: 与病原体结合的蛋白质复合物在肝脏中被被称为巨噬细胞的特化细胞所破坏。

Query_Text_en: The red blood cell is released back into the blood stream .
Translation: 红细胞被释放回血液循环系统。

Query_Text_en: The seeds of this book were first planted in my garden while I was planting seeds , as a matter of fact .
Translation: 事实上，这本书的种子最初是在我的花园里播下的，当时我正在播种。

Query_Text_en: Sowing seed is pleasant , desultory , not terribly challenging work ; there 's plenty of space left over for thinking about other things while you 're doing it .
Translation: 播种是一项轻松愉快、节奏舒缓且并不费力的工作；在劳作之余还能腾出大量空间思考其他事情。

Query_Text_en: On this particular May afternoon , I happened to be sowing rows in the neighborhood of a flowering apple tree that was fairly vibrating with bees .
Translation: 那日五月午后，我恰好在开满花的苹果树旁播种，那树上蜜蜂密布，几乎震颤不止。

Query_Text_en: disseminating the genes of one species and not another , in this case a fingerling potato instead of , let 's say , a leek .
Translation: 传播某个物种的基因而非另一物种的基因，例如在这种情况下，用小薯种土豆而非韭菜。

Query_Text_en: in the space of this garden , I tell myself , I alone determine which species will thrive and which will disappear .
Translation: 在这片园地中，我告诉自己，由我独断哪些物种将繁荣兴盛，哪些将消亡。

Query_Text_en: the long chain of gardeners and botanists , plant breeders , and , these days , genetic engineers who ' selected , ' ' developed , ' or ' bred ' the particular potato that I decided to plant .
Translation: 贯穿漫长链条的园丁、植物学家、植物育种者以及如今的遗传工程师，正是他们选育了我决定种植的特定马铃薯品种。

Query_Text_en: Even our grammar makes the terms of this relationshi p perfectly clear : I choose the plants , I pull the weeds , I harvest the crops .
Translation: 就连我们的语言结构也明确规定了这种关系的权责：我选择作物，我清除杂草，我收获庄稼。

Query_Text_en: We divide the world i nto subjects and objects , and here i n the garden , as in nature generally , we humans are the subjects .
Translation: 我们将世界划分为主体与客体，在这个花园里，就像自然界普遍的情况一样，人类是主体。

Query_Text_en: A bumblebee would probably also regard himself as a subject in the garden and the bloom he 's plundering for its drop of nectar as an object .
Translation: 大黄蜂很可能也将自己视为花园中的主体，而它掠夺花蜜的花朵则是客体。

Query_Text_en: But we know that this is just a failure of his imagination .
Translation: 但我们知道，这仅仅是他的想象力不足所致。

Query_Text_en: The truth of the matter is that the flower has cleverly manipulated the bee into hauling its pollen from blossom to blossom .
Translation: 归根结底，花巧妙地引导蜜蜂为其在各朵花之间传播花粉。

Query_Text_en: The ancient relationship between bees and flowers is a classic example of what is known as ' coevolution . '
Translation: 蜜蜂与花朵之间古老的关系是所谓的"共同进化"这一概念的经典范例。

Query_Text_en: In a coevolutionary bargain like the one struck by the bee and the apple tree , the two parties act on each other to advance their individual interests but wind up trading favors : food for the bee , transportation for the apple genes .
Translation: 在蜜蜂与苹果树达成的那种共同进化契约中，双方通过相互作用推进各自的生存利益，最终形成互利关系：蜜蜂获得食物，苹果树的基因得以传播。

Query_Text_en: Consciousness need n't enter into it on either side , and the traditional distinction between subject and object is meaningless .
Translation: 意识无需介入任何一方，主体与客体之间的传统区分已失去意义。

Query_Text_en: we , too , are partners in a coevolutionary relationship , as indeed we have been ever since the birth of agriculture more than ten thousand years ago .
Translation: 我们同样是共同进化关系中的伙伴，正如自一万多年前农业诞生以来一直如此。

Query_Text_en: Like the apple blossom , whose form and scent have been selected by bees over countless generations , the size and taste of the potato have been selected over countless generations by us by Incas and Irishmen , even by people like me ordering french fries at McDonald 's .
Translation: 就像苹果花的形态与芬芳历经无数代被蜜蜂选择一样，马铃薯的大小与口味也历经无数代被我们、印加人和爱尔兰人选择，甚至包括像我这样在麦当劳点薯条的人。

Query_Text_en: heft and nutritional value in the case of the potato-eating human .
Translation: 在人类以土豆为主食的情况下，其重要性与营养价值。

Query_Text_en: The fact that one of us has evolved to become intermittently aware of its desires makes no difference whatsoever to the flower or the potato taking part in this arrangement .
Translation: 其中一员已经进化到能够间歇性地意识到自身欲望这一事实，对参与这一安排的花或土豆而言，毫无影响。

Query_Text_en: All those plants care about is what every being cares about on the most basic genetic level : making more copies of itself .
Translation: 所有植物所关注的，与每个生命体在最基本的遗传层面上所关注的一致：复制自身。

Query_Text_en: Through trial and error these plant species have found that the best way to do that is to induce animals bees or people , it hardly matters to spread their genes .
Translation: 通过试错，这些植物物种发现，诱导动物、蜜蜂或人类传播其基因是最佳方式，而传播的具体途径并不重要。

Query_Text_en: By playing on the animals ' desires , conscious and otherwise .
Translation: 通过利用动物有意识或无意识的欲望。

Query_Text_en: The flowers and spuds that manage to do this most effectively are the ones that get to be fruitful and multiply .
Translation: 最有效地做到这一点的花朵和土豆，就是那些能够成果丰硕并不断发展的。

Query_Text_en: In fact , both statements are true .
Translation: 事实上，两种说法都是正确的。

Query_Text_en: I can remember the exact moment that spud seduced me , showing off its knobby charms in the pages of a seed catalog .
Translation: 我清楚记得那个被土豆俘获的瞬间——在种子目录的页面上，它凸起的可爱模样正向我炫耀着。

Query_Text_en: I think it was the tasty-sounding ' buttery yellow flesh ' that did it .
Translation: 我想，正是这令人垂涎的"黄油般细腻的金黄色果肉"起到了关键作用。

Query_Text_en: This was a trivial , semiconscious event ; it never occurred to me that our catalog encounter was of any evolutionary consequence whatsoever .
Translation: 这原本是一个微不足道、半自觉的事件；我从未想过，我们这次目录上的相遇竟会具有任何进化意义上的重大影响。

Query_Text_en: Yet evolution consists of an infinitude of trivial , unconscious events , and in the evolution of the potato my reading of a particular seed catalog on a particular January evening counts as one of them .
Translation: 然而，进化由无穷无尽的微小无意识事件构成。在马铃薯的进化历程中，某年一月某个夜晚我翻阅某份种子目录的行为，便是其中之一。

Query_Text_en: That May afternoon , the garden suddenly appeared before me in a whole new light , the manifold delights it offered to the eye and nose and tongue no longer quite so innocent or passive .
Translation: 那个五月的午后，花园突然以全新的面貌展现在我眼前，曾带给视觉、嗅觉与味觉的种种愉悦，此刻也不再显得那般单纯或被动。

Query_Text_en: All these plants , which I 'd always regarded as the objects of my desire , were also , I realized , subjects , acting on me , getting me to do things for them they could n't do for themselves .
Translation: 我意识到，这些我一直视为追求目标的植物，实际上也是行动主体，它们影响着我，促使我为它们完成自身无法实现的任务。

Query_Text_en: This book attempts to do just that , by telling the story of four familiar plants the apple , the tulip , cannabis , and the potato and the human desires that link their destinies to our own .
Translation: 本书正是通过讲述苹果、郁金香、大麻和土豆这四种熟悉植物的故事，以及人类欲望如何将它们的命运与我们紧密相连，来实现这一目标。

Query_Text_en: Its broader subject is the complex reciprocal relationship between the human and natural world , which I approach from a somewhat unconventional angle : I take seriously the plant 's point of view .
Translation: 本书的核心主题是人类与自然世界之间错综复杂的相互关系，我从一个非同寻常的角度对此展开探讨：认真审视植物的视角。

Query_Text_en: The four plants whose stories this book tells are what we call ' domesticated species , ' a rather one-sided term that grammar again that leaves the erroneous impression that we 're in charge .
Translation: 本书讲述的四种植物都属于所谓的"驯化物种"，这个略显片面的术语其语法结构再次让人误以为我们是主宰者。

Query_Text_en: We automatically think of domestication as something we do to other species , but it makes just as much sense to think of it as something certain plants and animals have done to us , a clever evolutionary strategy for advancing their own interests .
Translation: 我们通常认为驯化是人类对其他物种采取的行为，但同样合理的是将其视为某些植物和动物对人类所采取的精明进化策略，以此增进自身利益。

Query_Text_en: The species that have spent the last ten thousand or so years figuring out how best to feed , heal , clothe , intoxicate , and otherwise delight us have made themselves some of nature 's greatest success stories .
Translation: 在一万年左右的时间里，那些不断探索如何最好地为我们提供食物、治疗疾病、制作衣物、麻醉以及以其他方式取悦我们的物种，已然成为自然界的最成功典范。

Query_Text_en: The surprising thing is , we do n't ordinarily regard species like the cow and the potato , the tulip and the dog , as nature 's more extraordinary creatures .
Translation: 令人惊讶的是，我们通常不会将牛、土豆、郁金香和狗这类物种视为自然界更为非凡的造物。

Query_Text_en: Domesticated species do n't command our respect the way their wild cousins often do .
Translation: 家养物种不像它们的野生近亲那样常常能赢得我们的尊重。

Query_Text_en: Evolution may reward interdependence , but our thinking selves continue to prize self-reliance .
Translation: 进化或许青睐相互依存，但人类的思考本性始终珍视自力更生。

Query_Text_en: The wolf is somehow more impressive to us than the dog .
Translation: 狼在某种程度上比狗更能给人留下深刻印象。

Query_Text_en: Yet there are fifty million dogs in America today , only ten thousand wolves .
Translation: 然而，目前美国有五千万只狗，而仅有狼一万头。

Query_Text_en: The big thing the dog knows about the subject it has mastered in the ten thousand years it has been evolving at our side is us : our needs and desires , our emotions and values , all of which it has folded into its genes as part of a sophisticated strategy for survival .
Translation: 狗在与人类相伴进化的数万年间所掌握的最重要课题便是人类自身：我们的需求与欲望、情感与价值观，这些都被其作为高明的生存策略融入了基因之中。

Query_Text_en: If you could read the genome of the dog like a book , you would learn a great deal about who we are and what makes us tick .
Translation: 如果能够像阅读一本书一样解读犬类基因组，你将深入了解人类的本质以及驱动我们行为的根本原因。

Query_Text_en: We do n't ordinarily give plants as much credit as animals , but the same would be true of the genetic books of the apple , the tulip , cannabis , and the potato .
Translation: 我们通常不像对待动物那样给予植物足够的认可，但同样的情况也适用于苹果、郁金香、大麻和马铃薯的基因图谱。

Query_Text_en: We could read volumes about ourselves in their pages , in the ingenious sets of instructions they 've developed for turning people into bees .
Translation: 我们可以在这些精心设计的指令体系中，从他们的"页面"里窥见我们自身的诸多真相——他们正是通过这些体系将人转化为工蜂般的存在。

Query_Text_en: After ten thousand years of coevolution , their genes are rich archives of cultural as well as natural information .
Translation: 经过万年的共同进化，他们的基因已成为既包含文化信息又包含自然信息的丰富档案库。

Query_Text_en: The DNA of that tulip there , the ivory one with the petals attenuated like sabers , contains detailed instructions on how best to catch the eye not of a bee but of an Ottoman Turk ; it has something to tell us about that age 's idea of beauty .
Translation: 那朵象牙色郁金香的DNA里，花瓣纤长如弯刀，详细记载着如何最能吸引的不是蜜蜂，而是奥斯曼土耳其人的眼睛；这向我们揭示了那个时代对美的理解。

Query_Text_en: Likewise , every Russet Burbank potato holds within it a treatise about our industrial food chain and our taste for long , perfectly golden french fries .
Translation: 同样，每一颗班塔土豆都蕴含着一篇关于工业化食品供应链的论述，揭示了人们对纤长金黄薯条的偏好。

Query_Text_en: That 's because we have spent the last few thousand years remaking these species through artificial selection , transforming a tiny , toxic root node into a fat , nourishing potato and a short , unprepossessing wildflower into a tall , ravishing tulip .
Translation: 这是因为数千年来，我们通过人工选择不断重塑这些物种，将细小有毒的根茎培育成硕大营养的马铃薯，将矮小寻常的野花改造成亭亭玉立的郁金香。

Query_Text_en: What is much less obvious , at least to us , is that these plants have , at the same time , been going about the business of remaking us .
Translation: 远非显而易见的是，至少对我们而言，这些植物一直在进行重塑我们的过程。

Query_Text_en: I call this book The Botany of Desire because it is as much about the human desires that connect us to these plants as it is about the plants themselves .
Translation: 我将这本书命名为《欲望的植物学》，是因为它既关注将人类与这些植物相连的欲望，也关注植物本身。

Query_Text_en: My premise is that these human desires form a part of natural history in the same way the hummingbird 's love of red does , or the ant 's taste for the aphid 's honeydew . I think of them as the human equivalent of nectar .
Translation: 我的基本观点是，人类的这些欲望就像蜂鸟偏爱红色、蚂蚁喜好蚜虫蜜露一样，属于自然史的一部分。我认为它们是人类的"花蜜"。

Query_Text_en: So while the book explores the social history of these plants , weaving them into our story , it is at the same time a natural history of the four human desires these plants evolved to stir and gratify .
Translation: 本书在探索这些植物的社会历史并将它们融入人类文明的发展历程的同时，也是一部关于这四种由植物进化过程中激发并满足的人类欲望的自然史。

Query_Text_en: I 'm interested not only in how the potato altered the course of European history or how cannabis helped fire the romantic revolution in the West , but also in the way notions in the minds of men and women transformed the appearance , taste , and mental effects of these plants .
Translation: 我不仅对马铃薯如何改写欧洲历史进程或大麻如何推动西方浪漫主义运动感兴趣，更在于人类观念如何塑造了这些植物的外观、味道以及它们对精神的影响。

Query_Text_en: Through the process of coevolution human ideas find their way into natural facts : the contors of a tulip 's petals , say , or the precise tang of a Jonagold apple .
Translation: 通过共同进化的进程，人类的思想得以融入自然事实：例如郁金香花瓣的轮廓，或是乔纳ゴール苹果那鲜明的口感。

Query_Text_en: and control in the story of the potato specifically , in the story of a genetically altered potato I grew in my garden to see where the ancient arts of domestication may now be headed .
Translation: 特别是在马铃薯的故事中，特别是在我在花园里种植的转基因马铃薯的故事中，以观察传统的驯化技艺如今可能的发展方向。

Query_Text_en: These four plants have something important to teach us about these four desires that is , about what makes us tick .
Translation: 这四家企业向我们揭示了这四种欲望，即驱动我们行动的核心动力。

Query_Text_en: For instance , I do n't think we can begin to understand beauty 's gravitational pull without first understanding the flower , since it was the flower that first ushered the idea of beauty into the world the moment , long ago , when floral attraction emerged as an evolutionary strategy .
Translation: 例如，我认为若不先理解花朵，我们就无法真正理解美的引力般的吸引力。因为在很久以前花卉吸引力作为一种进化策略出现的那一刻，正是花朵首次将美的概念带入这个世界。

Query_Text_en: By the same token , intoxication is a human desire we might never have cultivated had it not been for a handful of plants that manage to manufacture chemicals with the precise molecular key needed to unlock the mechanisms in our brain governing pleasure , memory , and maybe even transcendence .
Translation: 同样地，如果没有少数几种能够制造出特定化学物质的植物，人类或许永远不会培养出沉溺的欲望。这些植物产生的物质具有精确的分子结构，能够开启大脑中控制愉悦、记忆，甚至超越感的机制。

Query_Text_en: Domestication is about a whole lot more than fat tubers and docile sheep ;
Translation: 驯化绝不仅仅关乎硕大的块茎和温顺的绵羊；

Query_Text_en: the offspring of the ancient marriage of plants and people are far stranger and more marvelous than we realize .
Translation: 植物与人类远古联姻的结晶，远比我们所认知的更加奇异而神奇。

Query_Text_en: There is a natural history of the human imagination , of beauty , religion , and possibly philosophy too .
Translation: 人类的想象力、美、宗教，或许还有哲学，皆有其自然发展史。

Query_Text_en: One of my aims in this book is to shed some light on the part in that history these ordinary plants have played .
Translation: 本书的一个目的是揭示这些普通植物在那段历史中所扮演的角色。

Query_Text_en: Plants are so unlike people that it 's very difficult for us to appreciate fully their complexity and sophistication .
Translation: 植物与人类差异巨大，以至于我们很难充分认识到它们的复杂性和精妙之处。

Query_Text_en: Yet plants have been evolving much , much longer than we have , have been inventing new strategies for survival and perfecting their designs for so long that to say that one of us is the more ' advanced ' really depends on how you define that term , on what ' advances ' you value .
Translation: 植物的进化历程远比我们漫长得多，在漫长的进化历程中不断探索新的生存策略，不断完善自身结构。因此，究竟谁更"先进"，这完全取决于"先进"的定义以及人们更看重哪些进步。

Query_Text_en: Naturally we value abilities such as consciousness , toolmaking , and language , if only because these have been the destinations of our own evolutionary journey thus far .
Translation: 我们自然重视意识、工具制造和语言等能力，尤其是因为这些正是我们自身进化历程到目前为止所达到的目标。

Query_Text_en: Plants have traveled all that distance and then some they 've just traveled in a different direction .
Translation: 植物已经跋涉了那么长的距离，甚至更远，而只是选择了不同的方向继续前行。

Query_Text_en: Plants are nature 's alchemists , expert at transforming water , soil , and sunlight into an array of precious substances , many of them beyond the ability of human beings to conceive , much less manufacture .
Translation: 植物是大自然的炼金术士，擅长将水、土壤和阳光转化为多种珍贵物质，其中许多物质人类甚至难以想象其存在，更不用说制造了。

Query_Text_en: While we were nailing down consciousness and learning to walk on two feet , they were , by the same process of natural selection , inventing photosynthesis ( the astonishing trick of converting sunlight into food ) and perfecting organic chemistry .
Translation: 当我们在确立意识并学会直立行走时，它们（通过同样的自然选择过程）却演化出了光合作用（将阳光转化为食物的惊人技巧），并完善了有机化学。

Query_Text_en: As it turns out , many of the plants ' discoveries in chemistry and physics have served us well .
Translation: 事实证明，许多植物在化学和物理学领域的发现对我们大有裨益。

Query_Text_en: From plants come chemical compounds that nourish and heal and poison and delight the senses , others that rouse and put to sleep and intoxicate , and a few with the astounding power to alter consciousness even to plant dreams in the brains of awake humans .
Translation: 植物体内蕴含的化学物质滋养生命、治愈创伤，亦能毒害生灵、愉悦感官；有的可唤醒精神、助人入眠或令人沉醉，更有极少数具有不可思议的力量，竟能改变人类意识，甚至向清醒者的脑海中植入梦境。

Query_Text_en: One important reason is defense .
Translation: 一个重要原因在于国防。

Query_Text_en: A great many of the chemicals plants produce are designed , by natural selection , to compel other creatures to leave them alone : deadly poisons , foul flavors , toxins to confound the minds of predators .
Translation: 植物产生的大量化学物质是通过自然选择"设计"出来的，旨在迫使其他生物避开它们：致命毒素、难闻味道，以及扰乱捕食者神经系统的毒素。

Query_Text_en: But many other of the substances plants make have exactly the opposite effect , drawing other creatures to them by stirring and gratifying their desires .
Translation: 但植物产生的许多其他物质则会产生完全相反的效果，通过激发并满足其他生物的欲望来吸引它们前来。

Query_Text_en: The same great existential fact of plant life explains why plants make chemicals to both repel and attract other species : immobility .
Translation: 植物生命存在的这一基本事实解释了为何植物会制造既能驱赶又能吸引其他物种的化学物质：不可移动性。

Query_Text_en: The one big thing plants ca n't do is move , or , to be more precise , locomote .
Translation: 植物无法做到的一件事就是移动，或者说得更准确些，自主运动。

Query_Text_en: Plants ca n't escape the creatures that prey on them ; they also ca n't change location or extend their range without help .
Translation: 植物无法逃避捕食它们的生物；它们也无法自行改变位置或扩大分布范围。

Query_Text_en: And so about a hundred million years ago plants stumbled on a way actually a few thousand different ways of getting animals to carry them , and their genes , here and there .
Translation: 大约一亿年前，植物偶然发现了一种方法——实际上则是数以千计的不同方法——让动物帮助它们将自身及其基因传播到各处。

Query_Text_en: This was the evolutionary watershed associated with the advent of the angiosperms , an extraordinary new class of plants that made showy flowers and formed large seeds that other species were induced to disseminate .
Translation: 这是被子植物出现所引发的进化分水岭，这种能够开出艳丽花朵并形成大型种子的非凡新型植物，促使其他物种帮助其传播。

Query_Text_en: Plants began evolving burrs that attach to animal fur like Velcro , flowers that seduce honeybees in order to powder their thighs with pollen , and acorns that squirrels obligingly taxi from one forest to another , bury , and then , just often enough , forget to eat .
Translation: 植物开始演化出像维可牢一样能附着在动物皮毛上的苍耳，用花朵引诱蜜蜂让它们的腿沾满花粉，还有橡果——松鼠乐于帮忙将橡果从一片森林运送到另一片，埋藏起来，然后又恰好经常性地忘记食用。

Query_Text_en: Even evolution evolves .
Translation: 就连进化本身也在不断演变。

Query_Text_en: About ten thousand years ago the world witnessed a second flowering of plant diversity that we would come to call , somewhat self-centeredly , ' the invention of agriculture . '
Translation: 大约一万年前，世界见证了植物多样性的第二次繁荣，我们略带自我中心地将其称为"农业的发明"。

Query_Text_en: A group of angiosperms refined their basic put-the-animals-to-work strategy to take advantage of one particular animal that had evolved not only to move freely around the earth , but to think and trade complicated thoughts .
Translation: 被子植物完善了其基本的利用动物为其服务的策略，充分利用了一种能够不仅自由移动于地球之上，还能思考和交流复杂思想的特定动物。

Query_Text_en: These plants hit on a remarkably clever strategy : getting us to move and think for them .
Translation: 这些植物找到了一个极为巧妙的策略：让我们替它们行动和思考。

Query_Text_en: plants so compelling and useful and tasty they would inspire human beings to seed , transport , extol , and even write books about them .
Translation: 这些植物如此引人注目、实用且美味，以至于它们激发了人类去播种、传播、赞颂，甚至为它们撰写专著。

Query_Text_en: This is one of those books .
Translation: 这是其中一本这样的书。

Query_Text_en: Only in the sense that the flower ' makes ' the bee pay it a visit .
Translation: 仅仅在某种意义上说，花朵"促使"蜜蜂前来采蜜。

Query_Text_en: Evolution does n't depend on will or intention to work ; it is , almost by definition , an unconscious , unwilled process .
Translation: 进化发挥作用并不依赖意志或意图；几乎从定义上来说，它是一个无意识、无意图的过程。

Query_Text_en: All it requires are beings compelled , as all plants and animals are , to make more of themselves by whatever means trial and error present .
Translation: 它所需要的，只是那些如所有动植物一般被生存本能驱使的存在，它们通过尝试与错误所提供的各种方式不断自我繁衍。

Query_Text_en: Sometimes an adaptive trait is so clever it appears purposeful : the ant that ' cultivates ' its own gardens of edible fungus , for instance , or the pitcher plant that ' convinces ' a fly it 's a piece of rotting meat .
Translation: 有时，一种适应性特征会显得如此精妙，仿佛经过精心设计：例如，蚂蚁会"培育"自己的可食用真菌"花园"，或者猪笼草会"诱骗"苍蝇以为它是块腐肉。

Query_Text_en: But such traits are clever only in retrospect .
Translation: 但这类特质仅在事后回顾时才显得明智。

Query_Text_en: Design in nature is but a concatenation of accidents , culled by natural selection until the result is so beautiful or effective as to seem a miracle of purpose .
Translation: 自然界中的设计不过是偶然事件的连锁反应，经过自然选择的筛选，直到其结果如此美丽或高效，以至于看似一种充满目的性的奇迹。

Query_Text_en: By the same token , we 're prone to overestimate our own agency in nature .
Translation: 同样，我们也容易高估自身在自然中的能动性。

Query_Text_en: Many of the activities humans like to think they undertake for their own good purposes inventing agriculture , outlawing certain plants , writing books in praise of others are mere contingencies as far as nature is concerned .
Translation: 人类自认为为了自身利益而从事的许多活动——比如发明农业、禁止某些植物、撰写赞美他人的著作——在大自然看来不过是些偶然事件。

Query_Text_en: Our desires are simply more grist for evolution 's mill , no different from a change in the weather : a peril for some species , an opportunity for others .
Translation: 我们的欲望不过是进化的磨坊中的又一素材，与气候变化无异：对某些物种是威胁，对另一些则是机遇。

Query_Text_en: Our grammar might teach us to divide the world into active subjects and passive objects , but in a coevolutionary relationship every subject is also an object , every object a subject .
Translation: 我们的语法或许教导我们将世界划分为主动的主体与被动的客体，但在共同进化的关系中，每个主体同时也是客体，每个客体亦是主体。

Query_Text_en: That 's why it makes just as much sense to think of agriculture as something the grasses did to people as a way to conquer the trees .
Translation: 这就是为什么将农业视为草类为征服树木而对人类采取的策略同样合理。

Query_Text_en: When Charles Darwin was writing The Origin of Species , deciding how best to spring his outlandish idea of natural selection on the world , he settled on a curious rhetorical strategy .
Translation: 当查尔斯·达尔文撰写《物种起源》时，在考虑如何最好地向世界提出其离经叛道的自然选择理论时，他最终选定了一种奇特的修辞策略。

Query_Text_en: Rather than open the book with an account of his new theory , he began with a side subject he judged people ( and perhaps English gardeners in particular ) would have an easier time getting their heads around .
Translation: 他没有在书中开篇阐述自己的新理论，而是从一个他认为人们（尤其是英国园丁）更容易理解的次要话题入手。

Query_Text_en: Darwin devoted the first chapter of The Origin of Species to a special case of natural selection called ' artificial selection ' his term for the process by which domesticated species come into the world .
Translation: 达尔文在《物种起源》第一章专门探讨了自然选择的一个特殊案例——"人工选择"，他用这一术语指代驯化物种形成的过程。

Query_Text_en: Darwin was using the word artificial not as in fake but as in artifact : a thing reflecting human will .
Translation: 达尔文使用"人工的"一词并非指虚伪，而是指人工制品：一种体现人类意志的事物。

Query_Text_en: There 's nothing fake about a hybrid rose or a butter pear , a cocker spaniel or a show pigeon .
Translation: 杂交玫瑰或黄油梨、可卡犬或观赏鸽，这些都不是人造之物。

Query_Text_en: These were a few of the domesticated species Darwin wrote about in his opening chapter , demonstrating how in each case the species proposes a wealth of variation from which humans then select the traits that will be passed down to future generations .
Translation: 这些都是达尔文在著作开篇章节中提到的几种驯化物种，他通过这些例子说明，每个物种都会展现大量变异，人类从中选择特定性状并将其遗传给后代。

Query_Text_en: In the special realm of domestication , Darwin explained , human desire ( sometimes consciously , sometimes not ) plays the same role that blind nature does everywhere else , determining what constitutes ' ' fitness ' and thereby leading , over time , to the emergence of new forms of life .
Translation: 达尔文解释道，在驯化的特殊领域中，人类欲望（有时是有意识的，有时是无意识的）与自然界其他领域中盲目作用的自然力量发挥着相同的作用，它决定"适者"的判定标准，并随着时间推移引导出新的生命形态。

Query_Text_en: The evolutionary rules are the same ( ' modification by descent ' ) , but Darwin understood that they 'd be easier to follow in the story of the tea rose than the sea turtle , in the setting of the garden than the Galapagos .
Translation: 进化规律是相同的（"通过遗传的变异"），但达尔文认识到，在茶 roses 的案例中比在海龟身上更容易阐释这一规律，在花园环境中而非加拉帕戈斯群岛也是如此。

Query_Text_en: In the years since Darwin published The Origin of Species , the crisp conceptual line that divided artificial from natural selection has blurred .
Translation: 自达尔文发表《物种起源》以来，人工选择与自然选择之间那条鲜明的理论分界已逐渐模糊。

Query_Text_en: Whereas once humankind exerted its will in the relatively small arena of artificial selection ( the arena I think of , metaphorically , as a garden ) and nature held sway everywhere else , today the force of our presence is felt everywhere .
Translation: 过去人类仅在相对狭小的人工选择领域施展意志（我将其隐喻为"花园"这样一个领域），而自然在其他地方占据主导；而今人类存在的影响力已遍布各个角落。

Query_Text_en: It has become much harder , in the past century , to tell where the garden leaves off and pure nature begins .
Translation: 在过去的一个世纪里，要区分花园的尽头与纯粹自然的起点变得愈发困难。

Query_Text_en: indeed , even the weather itself is in some sense an artifact now , its temperatures and storms the reflection of our actions .
Translation: 的确，在某种意义上，如今的天气本身已成为人类活动的产物，其气温与风暴正是我们行为的反映。

Query_Text_en: For a great many species today , ' ' fitness ' means the ability to get along in a world in which humankind has become the most powerful evolutionary force .
Translation: 如今，对于众多物种而言，"适应力"意味着能够在人类已成为最强大的进化力量的世界中生存的能力。

Query_Text_en: Artificial selection has become a much more important chapter in natural history as it has moved into the space once ruled exclusively by natural selection .
Translation: 人工选择已成为自然历史进程中一个更加重要的篇章，因为它涉足了曾经完全由自然选择所主导的领域。

Query_Text_en: That space , which is the one we often call ' the wild , ' was never quite as innocent of our influence as we like to think ;
Translation: 我们通常称之为"荒野"的那个空间，从未像我们所认为的那样摆脱人类的影响。

Query_Text_en: the Mohawks and Delawares had left their marks on the Ohio wilderness long before John Chapman ( aka Johnny Appleseed ) showed up and began planting apple trees .
Translation: 远在约翰·钱普林（即"苹果种子约翰"）到来并开始种植苹果树之前，莫霍克人和德拉瓦人就已经在俄亥俄荒野留下了印记。

Query_Text_en: Yet even the dream of such a space has become hard to sustain in a time of global warming , ozone holes , and technologies that allow us to modify life at the genetic level one of the wild 's last redoubts .
Translation: 然而，在全球变暖、臭氧层空洞以及能够通过基因编辑改造生命的技术的时代，甚至连这样一个空间的梦想都难以维系——它本应是自然最后的堡垒之一。

Query_Text_en: Partly by default , partly by design , all of nature is now in the process of being domesticated of coming , or finding itself , under the ( somewhat leaky ) roof of civilization .
Translation: 部分出于被动，部分出于人为设计，如今整个自然界正经历着被驯化的过程——它们或是主动融入，或是被动置身于文明有所欠缺的庇护之下。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , even the wild now depends on civilization for its survival .
Translation: 事实上，就连荒野也依赖文明来维系自身的生存。

Query_Text_en: Nature 's success stories from now on are probably going to look a lot more like the apple 's than the panda 's or white leopard 's .
Translation: 《自然》杂志今后的成功案例可能更多地类似于苹果而非熊猫或白豹。

Query_Text_en: strangely enough , their survival now depends on what amounts to a form of artificial selection .
Translation: 令人惊讶的是，其生存如今实际上依赖于一种人工选择机制。

Query_Text_en: This is the world in which we , along with Earth 's other creatures , now must make our uncharted way .
Translation: 这就是我们与地球上的其他生物如今必须探索前行的世界。

Query_Text_en: This book takes place in that world ; consider it a set of dispatches from Darwin 's ever-expanding garden of artificial selection .
Translation: 本书的故事发生于那个世界；可将其视为源自达尔文不断扩展的人工选择园地中的一系列纪实报道。

Query_Text_en: Its main characters are four of that world 's success stories .
Translation: 该剧的主要人物是该领域四位成功典范。

Query_Text_en: The dogs , cats , and horses of the plant world , these domesticated species are familiar to everyone , so deeply woven into the fabric of our everyday lives that we scarcely think of them as ' species ' or parts of ' nature ' at all .
Translation: 作为植物界的"狗、猫和马"，这些驯化物种人人皆知，与我们的日常生活密不可分，以至于我们几乎不再将它们视为"物种"或"自然"的一部分。

Query_Text_en: I suspect it 's at least partly the fault of the word .
Translation: 恐怕这其中至少部分要归咎于这个词。

Query_Text_en: ' Domestic ' implies that these species have come in or been brought under civilization 's roof , which is true enough ;
Translation: "驯化"一词意味着这些物种已被纳入文明体系或被人类所驯养，这一点确实如此；

Query_Text_en: yet the house-y metaphor encourages us to think that by doing so they have , like us , somehow left nature , as if nature were something that only happens outside .
Translation: 这一家居隐喻促使我们误以为，通过这种方式，他们和我们一样已然脱离了自然，仿佛自然只是外部世界才存在的事物。

Query_Text_en: This is simply another failure of imagination : nature is not only to be found ' out there ' ;
Translation: 这不过是又一次想象力匮乏的体现：自然并非仅仅存在于外部世界；

Query_Text_en: it is also ' in here , ' in the apple and the potato , in the garden and the kitchen , even in the brain of a man beholding the beauty of a tulip or inhaling the smoke from a burning cannabis flower . My wager is that when we can find nature in these sorts of places as readily as we now find it in the wild , we 'll have traveled a considerable distance toward understanding our place in the world in the fullness of its complexity and ambiguity .
Translation: 它也存在于这里——在苹果和土豆中，在花园和厨房里，甚至存在于凝视郁金香之美或吸入燃烧大麻花烟雾的人的大脑中。我认为，当我们能在这些地方像现在发现野外自然那样轻易地发现自然时，我们就已经在理解这个复杂而充满歧义的世界中人类所处的位置方面取得了相当大的进展。

Query_Text_en: I 've chosen the apple , the tulip , cannabis , and the potato for several logical-sounding reasons .
Translation: 我选择苹果、郁金香、大麻和土豆是出于几个看似合理的理由。

Query_Text_en: Also , having grown these four plants at one time or another in my own garden , I 'm on fairly intimate terms with them .
Translation: 此外，由于我曾在自家花园里种植过这四种植物，因此我对它们相当熟悉。

Query_Text_en: But the real reason I chose these plants and not another four is simpler than that : they have great stories to tell .
Translation: 但真正的原因其实更简单：这些植物背后有着引人入胜的故事。

Query_Text_en: I also travel to potato farms in Idaho ;
Translation: 我也前往爱达荷州的土豆农场；

Query_Text_en: and paddle a canoe down a river in central Ohio in search of the real Johnny Appleseed .
Translation: 并乘独木舟顺俄亥俄州中部的河流而下，寻找真正的约翰尼·苹果籽。

Query_Text_en: Hoping to render our relationships with these four species in all their complexity , I look at them , by turns , through a variety of lenses : social and natural history , science , journalism , biography , mythology , philosophy , and memoir .
Translation: 为了全面呈现我们与这四种物种之间复杂的关系，我依次通过社会与自然史、科学、新闻、传记、神话、哲学及回忆录等不同视角进行观察。

Query_Text_en: These are stories , then , about Man and Nature .
Translation: 这些故事讲述的是人类与自然的关系。

Query_Text_en: We 've been telling ourselves such stories forever , as a way of making sense of what we call our ' relationship to nature ' to borrow that curious , revealing phrase .
Translation: 长期以来，我们一直在编织这样的故事，以此来阐释我们所谓的"与自然的关系"——借用那个既奇特又发人深省的表述。

Query_Text_en: For a long time now , the Man in these stories has gazed at Nature across a gulf of awe or mystery or shame . Even when the tenor of these narratives changes , as it has over time , the gulf remains .
Translation: 在这些故事中，人类长久以来始终隔着敬畏、神秘或羞愧的鸿沟凝视自然。即便叙事基调历经变迁悄然转变，这道鸿沟始终未曾消弭。

Query_Text_en: and , more recently , the environmental morality tale , in which Nature pays Man back for his transgressions , usually in the coin of disaster three different narratives ( at least ) , yet all of them share a premise we know to be false but ca n't seem to shake : that we somehow stand outside , or apart from , nature .
Translation: 最近，环境道德寓言开始流行，其中自然以灾难为代价对人类的过错进行报复。至少存在三种不同叙事，然而它们都基于一个我们深知其谬误却无法摆脱的前提：人类自认为能够置身于自然之外。

Query_Text_en: This book tells a different kind of story about Man and Nature , one that aims to put us back in the great reciprocal web that is life on Earth .
Translation: 这本书讲述了一个关于人类与自然关系的不同寻常的故事，旨在让我们重新融入地球生命体系中这一伟大的共生网络。

Query_Text_en: My hope is that by the time you close its covers , things outside ( and inside ) will look a little different , so that when you see an apple tree across a road or a tulip across a table , it wo n't appear quite so alien , so Other .
Translation: 我所期望的是，待您合上书页时，外界（与内心）的景象已稍有不同，如此这般，当您望见路旁的苹果树或桌上的郁金香时，它们便不再显得如此陌生、如此格格不入。

Query_Text_en: as the objects of other species ' designs and desires , as one of the newer bees in Darwin 's garden ingenious , sometimes reckless , and remarkably unself-conscious .
Translation: 作为其他物种意图与需求的目标对象，如同达尔文花园中新晋的蜜蜂，精巧、偶尔鲁莽、且异常缺乏自知之明。

Query_Text_en: Think of this book as that bee 's mirror .
Translation: 将此书视为那只蜜蜂的明镜。

Query_Text_en: If you happened to find yourself on the banks of the Ohio River on a particular afternoon in the spring of 1806 somewhere just to the north of Wheeling , West Virginia , say you would probably have noticed a strange makeshift craft drifting lazily down the river .
Translation: 如果你当时恰好身处西弗吉尼亚州威灵北部的某个地方，在1806年春天的一个下午沿俄亥俄河畔漫步，或许会注意到一艘奇特的临时搭建的木筏正缓缓顺流而下。

Query_Text_en: At the time , this particular stretch of the Ohio , wide and brown and bounded on both sides by steep shoulders of land thick with oaks and hickories , fairly boiled with river traffic , as a ramshackle armada of keelboats and barges ferried settlers from the comparative civilization of Pennsylvania to the wilderness of the Northwest Territory .
Translation: 当时，这条俄亥俄河段宽阔浑浊，两岸陡峭的河岸上长满了橡树和山毛榉。河面上熙熙攘攘，一艘艘结构松散的平底船和驳船正运送着移民，从宾夕法尼亚相对文明的地区前往西北领地的荒野。

Query_Text_en: The peculiar craft you 'd have caught sight of that afternoon consisted of a pair of hollowed-out logs that had been lashed together to form a rough catamaran , a sort of canoe plus sidecar .
Translation: 那天下午你可能注意到的那艘奇特船只，是由两根挖空的圆木用绳索绑扎而成的简陋双体船，形似独木舟加装了边车的组合。

Query_Text_en: In one of the dugouts lounged the figure of a skinny man of about thirty , who may or may not have been wearing a burlap coffee sack for a shirt and a tin pot for a hat .
Translation: 在其中一个掩体里斜倚着一个三十岁左右的瘦削男子，他可能身着麻布咖啡袋充当的衬衫，也可能头顶铁锅当作帽子。

Query_Text_en: According to the man in Jefferson County who deemed the scene worth recording , the fellow in the canoe appeared to be snoozing without a care in the world , evidently trusting in the river to take him wherever it was he wanted to go .
Translation: 根据杰斐逊县那位认为这一幕值得记录的居民所述，独木舟上的男子似乎正无忧无虑地打盹，显然对河流完全信赖，任其将自己带到想去的地方。

Query_Text_en: The other hull , his sidecar , was riding low in the water under the weight of a small mountain of seeds that had been carefully blanketed with moss and mud to keep them from drying out in the sun .
Translation: 另一艘船体——他的边车——因载着如小山般的种子而吃水很深，这些种子被精心覆盖在苔藓和泥土之下，以防在阳光下干涸。

Query_Text_en: The fellow snoozing in the canoe was John Chapman , already well known to people in Ohio by his nickname : Johnny Appleseed .
Translation: 正在独木舟里打盹的人正是约翰·查普曼，他早已以"苹果种子约翰"（Johnny Appleseed）这个昵称在俄亥俄州家喻户晓。

Query_Text_en: He was on his way to Marietta , where the Muskingum River pokes a big hole into the Ohio 's northern bank , pointing straight into the heart of the Northwest Territory .
Translation: 他正前往玛丽埃塔市，那里穆斯金格姆河在俄亥俄河北岸冲刷出一个大缺口，直指西北领地的腹地。

Query_Text_en: Chapman 's plan was to plant a tree nursery along one of that river 's as-yet-unsettled tributaries , which drain the fertile , thickly forested hills of central Ohio as far north as Mansfield .
Translation: 查普曼的计划是在该河尚未开发的支流旁建立一处苗圃，这些支流发源于中央俄亥俄州肥沃且林木茂密的丘陵地带，并向北延伸至曼斯菲尔德地区。

Query_Text_en: In all likelihood , Chapman was coming from Allegheny County in western Pennsylvania , to which he returned each year to collect apple seeds , separating them out from the fragrant mounds of pomace that rose by the back door of every cider mill .
Translation: 很可能，查普曼来自宾夕法尼亚州西部的奥尔良县。他每年都会回到那里收集苹果籽，从每家苹果酒厂后门堆积如山的果渣中，将这些种子仔细分拣出来——那些散发着香气的果渣堆就堆积在酒厂后门旁。

Query_Text_en: A single bushel of apple seeds would have been enough to plant more than three hundred thousand trees ; there 's no way of telling how many bushels of seed Chapman had in tow that day , but it 's safe to say his catamaran was bearing several whole orchards into the wilderness .
Translation: 一蒲式耳苹果种子就足以种植超过三十万棵树苗；当天恰普曼随船运载的具体有多少蒲式耳种子已无从考证，但可以确定的是，他的双体船上正载着数片完整的苹果园驶向荒野。

Query_Text_en: The image of John Chapman and his heap of apple seeds riding together down the Ohio has stayed with me since I first came across it a few years ago in an out-of-print biography .
Translation: 约翰·钱伯伦与他那堆苹果种子一同顺流而下俄亥俄河的画面，自从几年前我在一本绝版传记中首次见到后，一直萦绕在我脑海中。

Query_Text_en: The scene , for me , has the resonance of myth a myth about how plants and people learned to use each other , each doing for the other things they could not do for themselves , in the bargain changing each other and improving their common lot .
Translation: 对我来说，这一场景具有神话般的共鸣——它讲述了一个关于植物与人类如何学会相辅相成的故事：双方各自为对方完成自己无法独自完成的事情，在这个过程中相互改变，并改善了共同的命运。

Query_Text_en: Henry David Thoreau once wrote that ' it is remarkable how closely the history of the apple tree is connected with that of man , ' and much of the American chapter of that story can be teased out of Chapman 's story .
Translation: 亨利·戴维·梭罗曾写道："苹果树的历史与人类历史之间竟有着如此紧密的联系，这实在令人惊叹。"而这段故事中有关美国的部分，大多可以从查普曼的经历中得以揭示。

Query_Text_en: It 's the story of how pioneers like him helped domesticate the frontier by seeding it with Old World plants .
Translation: 这讲述的正是像他这样的先驱者如何通过引入旧大陆作物来开垦边疆的故事。

Query_Text_en: ' Exotics , ' we 're apt to call these species today in disparagement , yet without them the American wilderness might never have become a home .
Translation: 如今，人们常常带有贬义地称这些物种为“外来物种”，然而若没有它们，美国的荒野或许永远无法成为人类的家园。

Query_Text_en: A golden age : untold new varieties and half a world of new habitat .
Translation: 黄金时代：前所未有的新品种与遍布全球的新栖息地。

Query_Text_en: As an emblem of the marriage between people and plants , the design of Chapman 's peculiar craft strikes me as just right , implying as it does a relation of parity and reciprocal exchange between its two passengers .
Translation: 作为人类与植物共生关系的象征，查普曼的独特设计恰如其分地展现了两位"乘客"之间平等且相互受益的关联。

Query_Text_en: Instead of towing his shipment of seeds behind him , Chapman lashed the two hulls together so they would travel down the river side by side .
Translation: 查普曼没有选择将种子货物拖在身后，而是用绳索将两个船体绑在一起，以便让它们并排顺流而下。

Query_Text_en: We give ourselves altogether too much credit in our dealings with other species .
Translation: 我们在与其他物种的互动中，过分高估了自己的贡献。

Query_Text_en: Even the power over nature that domestication supposedly represents is overstated .
Translation: 就连驯化所代表的那种对自然的支配力也被过分夸大了。

Query_Text_en: It takes two to perform that particular dance , after all , and plenty of plants and animals have elected to sit it out .
Translation: 毕竟，这种特定的舞蹈需要双方共舞，而许多动植物却选择了置身事外。

Query_Text_en: Try as they might , people have never been able to domesticate the oak tree , whose highly nutritious acorns remain far too bitter for humans to eat .
Translation: 尽管人们尝试了各种方法，人类始终未能驯化橡树，而其富含营养的橡子因味道过于苦涩，至今仍无法供人类食用。

Query_Text_en: Evidently the oak has such a satisfactory arrangement with the squirrel which obligingly forgets where it has buried every fourth acorn or so ( admittedly , the estimate is Beatrix Potter 's ) that the tree has never needed to enter into any kind of formal arrangement with us .
Translation: 显然，橡树与松鼠之间有着如此令人满意的默契——这只松鼠总是"健忘"到记不起自己埋藏的每四颗橡子中有一颗的位置（不得不提的是，这一估算出自碧翠克斯·波特之手）——以至于这棵树从未需要与我们人类签订任何形式的正式协议。

Query_Text_en: The apple has been far more eager to do business with humans , and perhaps nowhere more so than in America .
Translation: 苹果公司一直更加积极寻求与人类合作，而这种热情在美国表现得尤为突出。

Query_Text_en: Like generations of other immigrants before and after , the apple has made itself at home here .
Translation: 如同历代其他移民，无论前辈还是后来者，苹果公司也在此成功扎根。

Query_Text_en: In fact , the apple did such a convincing job of this that most of us wrongly assume the plant is a native .
Translation: 事实上，苹果在这方面做得如此成功，以至于我们大多数人错误地认为这种植物是本地物种。

Query_Text_en: ( Even Ralph Waldo Emerson , who knew a thing or two about natural history , called it ' the American fruit . ' ) Yet there is a sense a biological , not just metaphorical sense in which this is , or has become , true , for the apple transformed itself when it came to America .
Translation: （就连对自然史颇有研究的拉尔夫·沃尔多·爱默生也曾称其为"美国水果"。然而，从生物学意义上来说，而不仅仅是比喻意义上，这一点已然成为事实，因为苹果在传入美国后实现了自我转变。）

Query_Text_en: Bringing boatloads of seed onto the frontier , Johnny Appleseed had a lot to do with that process , but so did the apple itself .
Translation: 将大量种子运往边疆，约翰·苹果籽对此功不可没，但苹果本身同样起到了关键作用。

Query_Text_en: No mere passenger or dependent , the apple is the hero of its own story .
Translation: 苹果并非旁观者或依附者，而是自身发展的主导者。

Query_Text_en: On a summery October afternoon almost two hundred years later , I found myself on the bank of the Ohio River a few miles south of Steubenville , Ohio , at the exact spot where John Chapman is thought to have set foot in the Northwest Territory for the first time .
Translation: 近两百年后的某个夏日般的十月午后，我站在俄亥俄州斯托本维尔以南几英里处的俄亥俄河畔，这里正是约翰·查普曼据认为首次踏入西北领地的地方。

Query_Text_en: I 'd come here to look for him , or at least that 's what I thought I was doing .
Translation: 我原本是来寻找他的，至少我自以为是这样。

Query_Text_en: I wanted to find out what I could about the ' real ' Johnny Appleseed , the historical figure behind the Disneyfied folk hero , as well as about the apples in whose story Chapman played such a pivotal role .
Translation: 我想要了解有关"真实的"约翰尼·苹果seed——这位在迪士尼风格的民间英雄形象背后的历史人物——以及在其故事中扮演关键作用的苹果的更多信息。

Query_Text_en: I figured it would be a modest piece of historical detective work : I 'd track down the sites of Chapman 's orchards , follow his footsteps ( and canoe wake ) from western Pennsylvania through central Ohio into Indiana , see if maybe I could find one of the trees he planted .
Translation: 我原以为这会是一项规模不大的历史探秘工作：我将追寻查普曼果园的遗址，沿着他从宾夕法尼亚州西部经俄亥俄州中部再到印第安纳州的足迹（以及他乘独木舟划过的路线）一路探寻，或许能发现他当年栽种的某棵苹果树。

Query_Text_en: And I did all that , though I 'm not sure it got me that much closer to the real John Chapman , a man who by now has been composted beneath a deep sift of myth and legend and wishful thinking . I did find another Johnny Appleseed , however , as well as another apple , both of which had been lost .
Translation: 我确实做了这一切，但我并不确定这让我离真正的约翰·钱普恩更近了多少。此人早已被层层叠叠的神话、传说和美好想象所掩埋。不过，我确实找到了另一个"苹果种子约翰"，以及另一种苹果，两者都曾失落。

Query_Text_en: Actually , the apples and the man have suffered a similar fate in the years since they journeyed down the Ohio together in Chapman 's double-hulled canoe .
Translation: 实际上，在切普曼乘坐双体独木舟与苹果一同沿俄亥俄河顺流而下的岁月里，苹果与切普曼本人遭遇了相似的命运。

Query_Text_en: Both then had the tang of strangeness about them , and both have long since been sweetened beyond recognition .
Translation: 两者当时都带着一种异样的气息，如今却早已变得温和得面目全非。

Query_Text_en: Figures of tart wildness , both have been thoroughly domesticated Chapman transformed into a benign Saint Francis of the American frontier , the apple into a blemish-free plastic-red saccharine orb .
Translation: 桀骜不驯的野性形象，两者都被彻底驯化。查普曼被重塑为美国边疆的温和圣方济各，苹果则化作无瑕的塑料红甜腻球体。

Query_Text_en: ' Sweetness without dimension ' is how one pomologist memorably described the Red Delicious ;
Translation: "红玉苹果的甜味缺乏层次感"，一位果树学家曾如此形容。

Query_Text_en: the same might be said of the Johnny Appleseed promulgated by Walt Disney and several generations of American children 's book writers .
Translation: 同样可以这样说，华特·迪士尼和几代美国儿童文学作家所塑造的约翰·苹果 seed 形象也是如此。

Query_Text_en: In both cases a cheap , fake sweetness has been substituted for the real thing , though it would take me a while to figure out exactly what that was the strong desire that bound them one to the other , and to the country that took them in .
Translation: 在两种情形中，廉价的虚假甜蜜取代了真实之物，虽然我需要花些时间才能真正弄清，正是这种强烈的渴望将他们彼此相连，并与接纳他们的国家相联结。

Query_Text_en: Of the man lounging in the two-hulled canoe , Robert Price , his biographer , wrote that he ' had the thick bark of queerness on him . '
Translation: 传记作者罗伯特·普赖斯曾这样描述这位悠然自得地躺在双体独木舟上的男子：他天生带着一层古怪的外壳。

Query_Text_en: Indeed . A man with no fixed address his entire adult life , Chapman preferred to spend his nights out of doors ;
Translation: 事实上，查普曼成年后从未有过固定居所，更倾向于在户外过夜。

Query_Text_en: one winter he set up house in a hollowed-out sycamore stump outside Defiance , Ohio , where he operated a pair of nurseries .
Translation: 一个冬天，他在俄亥俄州迪法恩斯城外的一个被掏空的梧桐树桩里安家，并在那里经营着两个苗圃。

Query_Text_en: he once punished his own foot for squashing a worm by throwing away its shoe .
Translation: 他曾因踩死一条蚯蚓而责罚自己的脚，将其鞋弃置。

Query_Text_en: He liked best the company of Indians and children and rumors trailed him to the effect that he 'd once been engaged to marry a ten-year-old girl , who 'd broken his heart .
Translation: 他最喜欢与印度人和孩子们为伴，有关他的传闻称，他曾与一名十岁女孩订婚，而正是那位女孩曾令他心碎。

Query_Text_en: Price feels compelled to assure his readers that Chapman ' was not a complete crank . '
Translation: 普赖斯不得不向读者保证，查普曼"并非彻头彻尾的怪人"。

Query_Text_en: The emphasis is mine .
Translation: 强调为笔者所加。

Query_Text_en: I 'd brought a copy of Price 's 1954 biography with me to Ohio , and ح relied on its maps to retrace Appleseed 's annual migration from western Pennsylvania , in search of seeds , to his far-flung properties in Ohio and , eventually , Indiana .
Translation: 我带着Price的1954年传记前往俄亥俄州，并借助书中的地图，沿着苹果种子（Appleseed）每年从宾夕法尼亚西部出发寻找种子的迁徙路线，追踪到他在俄亥俄州及最终印第安纳州的遥远地产。

Query_Text_en: It was Price 's account that had led me to the spot where Chapman first crossed the river into Ohio , in a faded , microscopic burg to the south of Steubenville called Brilliant .
Translation: 正是Price的叙述引导我来到了查普曼首次渡河进入俄亥俄州的那个地点——位于斯蒂文斯维尔以南一个衰败的微小小镇，名为Brilliant。

Query_Text_en: It had taken me a while to find the landmark mentioned in Price 's book , a stream that emptied into the Ohio called George 's Run .
Translation: 我花了一些时间才找到普莱斯书中提到的那个地标——一条注入俄亥俄河的溪流，名为乔治溪。

Query_Text_en: No one in Brilliant seemed to have heard of it .
Translation: 在Brilliant，似乎无人知晓此事。

Query_Text_en: Eventually I discovered that the stream had long since been rerouted through a culvert .
Translation: 最终我意识到，该溪流早已被改道至涵洞之中。

Query_Text_en: Today George 's Run flows , unseen , through a concrete pipe , passes a used-car dealership , crosses beneath a savagely potholed street , and finally reemerges from the earth halfway down a steep , littered embankment behind a convenience store .
Translation: 如今，乔治溪在混凝土管道中静静流淌，隐没于人眼难及之处，途经一家二手车经销店，从坑洼遍布的街道下方穿行，最终在一家便利店后方陡峭且堆满垃圾的堤岸中途重新露出地表。

Query_Text_en: From there it contributes its meager trickle to the Ohio .
Translation: 从那里，它以微小的水流汇入俄亥俄河。

Query_Text_en: The residents of Brilliant had urged Chapman to stay and plant a nursery , but by his lights the place was already overdeveloped .
Translation: 光辉镇的居民曾极力劝说查普曼留下并种植苗圃，但他认为那里已经过度开发了。

Query_Text_en: Ever since he 'd come west from Longmeadow , Massachusetts , in 1797 , at the age of twenty-three , Chapman had shied away from settled places , for reasons of both temperament and business .
Translation: 自从1797年23岁时从马萨诸塞州朗梅多西迁以来，查普曼一直避开已开发地区，原因既出于性格也出于商业考量。

Query_Text_en: To people in Brilliant , Chapman explained that he preferred to get out ahead of the settlers moving west , and this would become the pattern of his life : planting a nursery on a tract of wilderness he judged ripe for settlement and then waiting .
Translation: 查普曼向布里利安特镇的居民解释说，他更倾向于抢先于向西迁移的定居者抵达目的地，这成为他生活的方式：在他认为适合开发的荒野地带建立苗圃，随后静待时机。

Query_Text_en: By the time the settlers arrived , he 'd have apple trees ready to sell them .
Translation: 等定居者到达时，他已备好苹果树供他们购买。

Query_Text_en: In time he would find a local boy to look after his trees , move on , and start the process all over again . By the 1830s John Chapman was operating a chain of nurseries that reached all the way from western Pennsylvania through central Ohio and into Indiana .
Translation: 渐渐地，他会找到当地男孩照看他的果树，继续前行，重新开始整个过程。到19世纪30年代，约翰·钱普恩经营的苗圃链从宾夕法尼亚州西部经俄亥俄州中部一直延伸到印第安纳州。

Query_Text_en: It was in Fort Wayne that Chapman died in 1845 wearing the infamous coffee sack , some say , yet leaving an estate that included some 1200 acres of prime real estate .
Translation: 1845年，查普曼在弗特韦恩去世时身穿那条臭名昭著的咖啡麻袋，据称其遗留的财产中包含约1200英亩优质地产。

Query_Text_en: The barefoot crank died a wealthy man .
Translation: 这个出身寒微的固执者死时家财万贯。

Query_Text_en: Sketchy though they were , the biographical facts were enough to make anyone question the saintly Golden Books version of Johnny Appleseed ( the child bride ? ! ) , but it was a single botanical fact about the seeds themselves that made me realize that his story had been lost , and probably on purpose .
Translation: 虽然这些事实很零碎，但传记中的记载已经足以让人质疑金苹果书塑造的圣人版“约翰尼·苹果籽”形象（那个未成年新娘？！），但真正让我意识到他的事迹已被刻意遗忘的，却是一个关于苹果种子本身的关键植物学事实。

Query_Text_en: The fact , simply , is this : apples do n't ' come true ' from seeds that is , an apple tree grown from a seed will be a wildling bearing little resemblance to its parent . Anyone who wants edible apples plants grafted trees , for the fruit of seedling apples is almost always inedible ' sour enough , ' Thoreau once wrote , ' to set a squirrel 's teeth on edge and make a jay scream . '
Translation: 事实上，情况是这样的：苹果树不会通过种子保持品种特性——也就是说，由种子生长出的苹果树会变成与母树差异极大的野生树。任何想要收获可食用苹果的人，都会选择嫁接树，因为实生苹果的果实几乎总是无法食用。梭罗曾写道，这些果实"酸得足以让松鼠牙酸，令蓝鸟尖叫"。

Query_Text_en: Thoreau claimed to like the taste of such apples , but most of his countrymen judged them good for little but hard cider and hard cider was the fate of most apples grown in America up until Prohibition .
Translation: 梭罗声称喜爱这种苹果的味道，但他的同胞们认为它们除了制作硬苹果酒外别无他用，而硬苹果酒一直是美国禁酒令前大多数苹果的最终归宿。

Query_Text_en: Apples were something people drank .
Translation: 苹果曾是人们饮用的东西。

Query_Text_en: Johnny Appleseed was bringing the gift of alcohol to the frontier .
Translation: 约翰尼·苹果籽正将酒精的馈赠带到边疆。

Query_Text_en: The identification of the apple with notions of health and wholesomeness turns out to be a modern invention , part of a public relations campaign dreamed up by the apple industry in the early 1900s to reposition a fruit that the Women 's Christian Temperance Union had declared war on .
Translation: 苹果与健康、天然无害概念的关联实际上是一种现代产物，是20世纪初苹果行业发起的一场公关活动的组成部分，旨在重塑一种曾被妇女禁酒联盟宣战的水果形象。

Query_Text_en: Carry Nation 's hatchet , it seems , was meant not just for saloon doors but for chopping down the very apple trees John Chapman had planted by the millions .
Translation: 看来，凯莉·奈特的斧头不仅用来劈开酒吧门，还旨在砍倒约翰·张伯伦种植的百万棵苹果树。

Query_Text_en: That hatchet or at least Prohibition is probably responsible for the bowdlerizing of Chapman 's story .
Translation: 那把斧头，或者说至少是禁酒令，可能是导致查普曼故事被删节的原因。

Query_Text_en: he was a philanthropist , a healer , an evangelist ( of a doctrine veering perilously close to pantheism ) , a peacemaker with the Indians .
Translation: 他是一位慈善家、医者、传教者（宣扬一种危险地接近泛神论的教义），以及与印第安人缔结和平的缔造者。

Query_Text_en: But be fore that can happen , researchers need to overcome several major obstacles .
Translation: 但在此之前，研究人员需要克服若干重大障碍。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Biodegradable scaffoldings on which to grow human tissues have been around since the mid-1980s , but researchers are still experimenting with the shapes and materials used for the scaffoldings , to optimize cell growth .
Translation: 生物可降解支架自20世纪80年代中期就已经存在，但研究人员仍在试验支架的形状和材料，以优化细胞生长效果。

Query_Text_en: 3 . During the past few years , scientists have created individual components of the heart such as arteries , valves , and muscle tissue .
Translation: 在过去几年中，科学家已经制造了心脏的各个组成部分，例如动脉、瓣膜和肌肉组织。

Query_Text_en: But combining these in a single organ , and supplying them Human Hearts as Spare Parts with a network of tiny blood vessels , wo n't be easy .
Translation: 但将这些整合到单一器官中，并通过微血管网络作为人类心脏的备用部件进行供应，这绝非易事。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Whole hearts will have to be manufactured in a range of sizes and forms -- for people with different blood types , for example .
Translation: 完整的人造心脏需要生产成多种尺寸和类型——例如不同血型的人群。

Query_Text_en: Engineers will also need to find a way to preserve the hearts until transplantation-probably by storing them in super-cold liquid .
Translation: 工程师们还需要找到一种方法，在移植前保存心脏——可能通过将其储存在超低温液体中。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Someday every patient who needs a new heart may be able to get one from a hospital supply room .
Translation: 有朝一日，每一位需要心脏移植的患者或许都能从医院的器官库存中获取所需的心脏。

Query_Text_en: But unless tissue engineers can learn to create a heart from the patient 's own cells , rejection will remain a danger , just as with a conventional heart transplant .
Translation: 除非组织工程学家能够学会利用患者自身的细胞培育出心脏，否则排异反应仍将存在风险，就像传统心脏移植一样。

Query_Text_en: Within a decade , scientists aim to create transplantable human hearts that could be stocked on hospital shelves .
Translation: 在未来十年内，科学家的目标是制造出可移植的人类心脏，这些心脏能够像库存物品一样存放在医院。

Query_Text_en: Only the sickest patients make the list , and only about 2,300 of them will be lucky enough to get a heart this year .
Translation: 只有病情最为严重的患者才能被列入名单，而其中大约只有2300人今年有幸获得心脏移植。

Query_Text_en: While some surgeons are looking to artificial hearts or animal organs as transplants , others are turning to tissue engineering .
Translation: 与此同时，一些外科医生在探索人工心脏或动物器官作为移植来源，而另一些则转向组织工程。

Query_Text_en: Sefton estimates that creating functioning heart for preclinical testing will cost $ 5 billion .
Translation: 塞夫顿估计，为临床前试验制造具有功能的心脏将耗资50亿美元。

Query_Text_en: The ultimate goal is to create what Sefton calls a `` heart in a box '' , a transplantable heart that could be stored at hospitals until needed , alongside the syringes and scalpels .
Translation: 最终目标是创建Sefton所说的"盒中之心"，即一种可移植心脏，能够在医院储存直至需要时使用，与注射器和手术刀一同存放。

Query_Text_en: It might be easier to build a liver or a kidney , but that 's why Sefton chose the heart . `` If we can figure out how to engineer a heart , the rest will follow , '' he says .
Translation: 虽然制造肝脏或肾脏可能更容易，但这也正是塞夫顿选择心脏的原因。"如果我们能攻克心脏的人工研制，其他器官的研制也将迎刃而解，"他说。

Query_Text_en: The other big reason is that cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death in North America .
Translation: 另一个重要原因在于，心血管疾病是北美地区导致死亡的首要原因。

Query_Text_en: On the face of it , this seems an awkward example for the selfish gene theory to explain .
Translation: 表面上看，这一现象似乎是一个令自私基因理论难以解释的棘手例子。

Query_Text_en: They would seem to have nothing to lose .
Translation: 他们似乎别无损失可言。

Query_Text_en: But wait , perhaps they do have something to lose .
Translation: 不过，或许他们确实有需要顾虑之处。

Query_Text_en: We have already seen that if a territory-holder should happen to die , an outcast has a chance of taking his place , and therefore of breeding .
Translation: 我们已经看到，如果领地占有者不幸死亡，被排斥者便有机会取而代之，并因此获得繁殖资格。

Query_Text_en: If the odds of an outcast 's succeeding to a territory in this way are greater than the odds of his gaining one fighting , then it may pay him , as a selfish individual , to wait in hope that somebody will die , rather than squander what little energy he has in futile fighting .
Translation: 如果被放逐者通过这种方式继承领地的概率，比他通过战斗获得领地的概率更高，那么作为一个自私的个体，等待希望有人死去对他更有利，而不是浪费仅有的能量在徒劳的争斗中。

Query_Text_en: For Wynne-Edwards , the role of the outcasts in the welfare of the group is to wait in the wings as understudies , ready to step into the shoes of any territory holder who dies on the main stage of group reproduction .
Translation: 温-爱德华兹认为，在群体福祉方面，被排斥者的角色是作为替补成员在后台待命，随时准备接替任何在群体繁殖核心舞台上"谢幕"的领地持有者。

Query_Text_en: We can now see that this may also be their best strategy purely as selfish individuals .
Translation: 作为纯粹自私自利的个体，这或许也是他们的最佳策略。

Query_Text_en: As we saw in Chapter 4 , we can regard animals as gamblers .
Translation: 正如我们在第四章中所看到的，我们可以将动物视为赌徒。

Query_Text_en: The best strategy for a gambler may sometimes be a wait-and-hope strategy , rather than a bull-at-a-gate strategy .
Translation: 对于赌徒而言，最佳策略有时可能是等待观望，而非贸然强攻。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , the many other examples where animals appear to ' accept ' non-reproductive status passively can be explained quite easily by the selfish gene theory .
Translation: 同样地，许多其他动物看似被动接受非繁殖地位的例子，都可以用自私基因理论轻易解释。

Query_Text_en: The general form of the explanation is always the same : the individual 's best bet is to restrain himself for the moment , in the hope of better chances in the future .
Translation: 通常的解释模式都遵循相同的逻辑：个人的最佳选择是暂时自我约束，以期未来获得更好的机会。

Query_Text_en: A seal who leaves the harem-holders unmolested is not doing it for the good of the group . He is biding his time , waiting for a more propitious moment .
Translation: 一只不与占据后宫的雄性对抗的海豹，并非出于群体利益考虑。它是在韬光养晦，等待更有利的时机。

Query_Text_en: Even if the moment never comes and he ends up without descendants , the gamble might have paid off , though , with hindsight we can see that for him it did not .
Translation: 即便那个时刻从未到来，他最终也没有子嗣，这场赌博或许物有所值，但事后看来，对他而言并非如此。

Query_Text_en: They are seeking , every selfish one of them , a less crowded place in which to live .
Translation: 他们每一个都自私自利，都在寻求一个居住环境不那么拥挤的地方。

Query_Text_en: The fact that any particular one may fall to find it , and dies , is something we can see with hindsight .
Translation: 任何一个特定个体可能无法找到它而失败，这是我们在事后才能看清的事实。

Query_Text_en: It does not alter the likelihood that to stay behind would have been an even worse gamble .
Translation: 这并不会改变留在原地将是一个更加糟糕的选择的可能性。

Query_Text_en: It is a well-documented fact that overcrowding sometimes reduces birth-rates .
Translation: 众所周知，人口过度密集有时会降低出生率。

Query_Text_en: This is sometimes taken to be evidence for Wynne-Edwards 's theory .
Translation: 这有时被视为支持温-埃德华兹理论的证据。

Query_Text_en: It is nothing of the kind .
Translation: 这绝非此类。

Query_Text_en: It is compatible with his theory , and it is also just as compatible with the selfish gene theory .
Translation: 这与其理论相容，同时也同样与自私基因理论相容。

Query_Text_en: For example , in one experiment mice were put in an outdoor enclosure with plenty of food , and allowed to breed freely .
Translation: 例如，在一项实验中，研究人员将老鼠放入一个户外围栏，并提供充足的食物，允许其自由繁殖。

Query_Text_en: The population grew up to a point , then levelled off .
Translation: 人口增长到一定程度后趋于平稳。

Query_Text_en: The reason for the levelling-off turned out to be that the females became less fertile as a consequence of over-crowding : they had fewer babies .
Translation: 趋于平稳的原因在于，由于过度拥挤，雌性的生育能力下降，导致生育数量减少。
